8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-099.zh: 对于拥有 EX-97 追回政策、EX-31 SOX §302 认证以及具有明确母公司和子公司计数的 EX-21 子公司列表的公司，不同追回触发类型的结果有何不同？针对仅重述政策和重述及不当行为政策，报告匹配公司数量以及每家公司最大规定子公司数量的平均值（四舍五入至小数点后两位）。

8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-100.source: Among documents with NDA status that state a finite non-compete period and contain either a customer or employee non-solicitation clause, how are the matched NDA-company pairs distributed by whether the non-compete exceeds three years and whether the same company's EX-19 policy includes a blackout period, pre-clearance, and a Rule 10b5-1 provision? For each observed combination, report the matched-pair count and distinct-company count.
8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-100.zh: 在规定有限竞业禁止期并包含客户或员工禁止招揽条款的 NDA 状态文件中，如何根据竞业禁止是否超过三年以及同一公司的 EX-19 政策是否包括封锁期、预许可和规则 10b5-1 条款来分配匹配的 NDA-公司对？对于每个观察到的组合，报告匹配对计数和不同公司计数。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-001.source: Among Part 121 passenger reports, how many distinct incidents describe a go-around or missed approach primarily triggered by each of unstable_approach, traffic_spacing, and runway_occupancy, and which crew or ATC role most often initiated the maneuver in each category? Exclude maneuvers whose primary trigger was an aircraft equipment failure. Each represented trigger should occupy one row.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-001.zh: 在 Part 121客运运营报告中，有多少起不同的事件描述了主要由 unstable_approach、traffic_spacing 和 runway_occupancy 触发的复飞或中止进近，以及在每个类别中哪个机组或 ATC 角色最常发起该机动？排除主要触发因素是飞机设备故障的机动。每个表示的触发器应占据一行。

8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-101.source: Among documents with NDA status, an effective date on or after 2010-01-01, and exactly one stated governing-law jurisdiction, which three jurisdictions occur most often? For each, report the NDA count; the count containing all five core clauses—confidential-information definition, nondisclosure, non-use, return of materials, and survival; the count containing all six standard exceptions—public information, prior knowledge, independent development, third-party receipt, legal compulsion, and consent; and the count with a perpetual confidentiality term.
8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-101.zh: 在具有 NDA 状态的文件中，生效日期为 2010-01-01 或之后，并且恰好有一个规定的管辖法律管辖区，哪三个管辖区最常出现？对于每一项，报告 NDA 数量；包含所有五个核心条款的计数——机密信息定义、保密、不使用、材料返还和生存；包含所有六种标准例外的计数——公共信息、先验知识、独立开发、第三方接收、法律强制和同意；以及具有永久保密期限的计数。

8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-102.source: Among documents with NDA status, a finite confidentiality term, exactly one governing-law jurisdiction, and at least one restrictive covenant, which three jurisdictions contain the most documents? For each jurisdiction, report its qualifying NDA count and its most common exact five-covenant profile—non-compete, customer non-solicitation, employee non-solicitation, standstill, and vendor non-solicitation—together with that profile's document count and average duration in years rounded to two decimals.
8-17/ContractExhibit/CONTRACTEXHIBIT-102.zh: 在具有 NDA 状态、有限保密期限、恰好一个管辖法律管辖区和至少一项限制性契约的文件中，哪三个管辖区包含的文件最多？对于每个司法管辖区，报告其符合条件的 NDA 数量和最常见的准确五项契约概况（不竞争、不招揽客户、不招揽员工、停业和不招揽供应商）以及该概况的文件数量和平均持续时间（四舍五入到小数点后两位）。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-002.source: How are Human Factors reports distributed across the primary non-equipment reasons that an ATC clearance or restriction could not be followed: late_clearance, confusing_or_ambiguous, workload_or_timing_pressure, and expectation_or_readback_error? For each represented reason, include the distinct-incident count and the numbers of incidents that state a numeric amount of available time or distance. Mechanical limitations do not qualify.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-002.zh: 人为因素报告如何分布在无法遵循 ATC 许可或限制的主要非设备原因：late_clearance、confusing_or_ambiguous、workload_or_timing_pressure 和 expectation_or_readback_error？对于每个表示的原因，请包括不同事件计数以及说明可用时间或距离数值的事件数。机械限制不符合条件。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-003.source: Among Aircraft-primary reports in which smoke, fumes, or odor prompted a crew response without visible fire, how many distinct incidents involved each response in oxygen_masks_used, emergency_declared, diverted, returned, and precautionary_landing? For every represented response, also identify the most common suspected-source category from electrical, oil_or_hydraulic, air_conditioning_or_bleed, engine_or_apu, and unknown_or_other. An incident may contribute to more than one response row.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-003.zh: 在飞机的主要报告中，烟雾、烟雾或气味促使机组人员在没有明显火灾的情况下作出反应，oxygen_masks_used、emergency_declared、改道、返回和 precautionary_landing 中的每种反应涉及多少个不同的事件？对于每个代表的响应，还可以从电气、oil_or_hydraulic、air_conditioning_or_bleed、engine_or_apu 和 unknown_or_other 中识别最常见的可疑来源类别。一个事件可能会导致多个响应行。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-004.source: For reports in the 1201-1800 local-time period, how many distinct incidents describe a crew-versus-ATC, automation, or procedure mismatch for each of altitude, heading, speed, and runway when that mismatch contributed to a deviation? For each represented field, also give the most common resulting consequence from altitude_deviation, heading_or_route_deviation, speed_deviation, runway_deviation, and other_operational_consequence.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-004.zh: 对于 1201-1800 当地时间期间的报告，有多少起不同的事件描述了机组人员与 ATC、自动化或程序在高度、航向、速度和跑道方面不匹配（当这种不匹配导致偏差时）？对于每个表示的字段，还给出 altitude_deviation、heading_or_route_deviation、speed_deviation、runway_deviation 和 other_operational_consequence 的最常见结果。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-006.source: How many Air Carrier reports associated with an airport describe a taxi, crossing, or hold-short clearance conflict that was explicitly caught or stopped before the threatened aircraft entered the conflicting runway?
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-006.zh: 有多少与机场相关的航空公司报告描述了在受威胁飞机进入冲突跑道之前被明确捕获或拦截的滑行、穿越或等待短时间许可冲突？

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-008.source: Among Part 121 passenger reports, how many describe an ATC clearance, readback, or hearback problem that the crew detected or corrected before it caused a loss of separation, altitude deviation, runway incursion, or another operational consequence?
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-008.zh: 在 Part 121的客运运营报告中，有多少描述了机组人员在导致失去间隔、高度偏差、跑道侵入或其他运行后果之前检测到或纠正的 ATC 许可、读回或回听问题？

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-009.source: Among Air Carrier reports associated with an airport where a taxiway, runway, ramp, or gate conflict was resolved before the threatened aircraft entered the runway, how are the incidents distributed by the first correcting actor and prevention action? Use actors atc, flight_crew, and ground_vehicle_operator, and actions stop_or_hold, reroute_or_turnoff, and clearance_or_instruction_correction. Cases where either is unclear do not count.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-009.zh: 在与受威胁飞机进入跑道之前解决了滑行道、跑道、坡道或登机门冲突的机场相关的航空承运人报告中，第一个纠正行动者和预防行动如何分配事件？使用参与者 atc、flight_crew 和 ground_vehicle_operator，以及操作 stop_or_hold、reroute_or_turnoff 和 clearance_or_instruction_correction。任何一个不清楚的情况都不算数。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-005.source: How many US-reference reports state both horizontal and vertical separation for the same closest-approach event, with both dimensions recoverable in feet after converting any stated yards, nautical miles, or statute miles?
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-005.zh: 有多少美国参考报告规定了同一最近距离事件的水平和垂直间隔，并且在转换任何规定的码、海里或法定英里后，这两个尺寸都可以以英尺为单位恢复？

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-007.source: Among passenger Air Carrier reports where a stated fuel quantity, reserve, burn estimate, or remaining-flight-time calculation directly shaped an operational decision, how many distinct incidents involved each decision in attempt_approach, divert, return, hold, leave_holding, continue, declare_minimum_fuel, and declare_fuel_emergency? For every represented decision, also show how many incidents state a numeric fuel value and how many state a numeric time value. An incident may contribute to more than one decision row.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-007.zh: 在客运航空承运人报告中，规定的燃油量、储备、燃烧估计或剩余飞行时间计算直接影响了运营决策，attempt_approach、改航、返航、等待、leave_holding、继续、declare_minimum_fuel 和 declare_fuel_emergency 中的每个决策涉及多少个不同的事件？对于每个代表的决策，还显示有多少事件声明了数字燃料值以及有多少事件声明了数字时间值。一个事件可能会影响多个决策行。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-010.source: Among Human Factors-primary reports, how many distinct incidents describe a flight-deck decision affected by each primary cabin-side source: medical_event, security_issue, policy_issue, door_issue, slide_issue, cabin_equipment_issue, passenger_behavior, boarding_issue, deplaning_issue, and flight_attendant_communication? When several sources appear, use the listed order as precedence; cabin issues that did not affect a flight-deck decision do not count.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-010.zh: 在人为因素主要报告中，有多少不同的事件描述了受每个主要客舱侧源影响的驾驶舱决策：medical_event、security_issue、policy_issue、door_issue、slide_issue、cabin_equipment_issue、passenger_behavior、 boarding_issue、deplaning_issue 和 flight_attendant_communication？当出现多个来源时，请使用列出的顺序作为优先顺序；不影响驾驶舱决定的客舱问题不算在内。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-011.source: For Part 121 reports whose anomaly summary includes Aircraft Equipment Problem Critical, what are the distinct-incident counts for airborne engine, pressurization_or_bleed_or_pack, hydraulic, and flight_control problems in each response category? Apply this priority when several responses are recorded: return_to_departure, emergency_or_divert, continue_after_troubleshooting, then maintenance_action_only. Exclude ground-only problems and show one row for every represented system-response combination.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-011.zh: 对于其异常摘要包括飞机设备严重问题的 Part 121报告，每个响应类别中机载发动机、pressurization_or_bleed_or_pack、液压和 flight_control 问题的独特事件计数是多少？当记录多个响应时应用此优先级：return_to_departure、emergency_or_divert、continue_after_troubleshooting，然后是 maintenance_action_only。排除仅地面问题，并为每个表示的系统响应组合显示一行。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-012.source: Among Human Factors-primary reports, how many distinct incidents primarily involve each automation-confusion mechanism: data_entry_or_programming, alert_interpretation, automation_disengagement, unexpected_capture_or_leveloff, and mode_awareness? Count only reports where automation misunderstanding materially contributed and the issue was not primarily an equipment failure or ordinary manual-flying error. When several mechanisms apply, use the listed order as precedence.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-012.zh: 在人为因素主要报告中，有多少个不同事件主要涉及每种自动化混淆机制：data_entry_or_programming、alert_interpretation、automation_disengagement、unexpected_capture_or_leveloff 和 mode_awareness？仅计算自动化误解造成重大影响且问题主要不是设备故障或普通手动飞行错误的报告。当应用多种机制时，请优先使用列出的顺序。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-014.source: Among reports from the 1201-1800 local-time period, how many distinct incidents describe weather as the primary reason for each operational decision change in diversion, airport_change, holding, approach_change, altitude_change, and route_change? Weather must have caused the change rather than being incidental, and turbulence mentioned only for passenger comfort does not qualify. When several changes occur, use the listed order as precedence.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-014.zh: 在 1201-1800 当地时间的报告中，有多少不同事件将天气描述为改道、airport_change、等待、approach_change、altitude_change 和 route_change 中每个操作决策变化的主要原因？天气变化一定是造成这种变化的原因，而不是偶然的，而仅仅为了乘客舒适度而提到的湍流并不符合条件。当发生多个更改时，请使用列出的顺序作为优先顺序。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-013.source: Among US-reference reports that state numeric cleared-versus-flown or expected-versus-actual values, how many distinct comparisons concern each of altitude, speed, heading, and runway, and what resulting deviation is most common for each represented measurement type? Expected and actual values must refer to the same comparison, and nonnumeric or unmatched mentions do not qualify.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-013.zh: 在说明清除与飞行或预期与实际值的美国参考报告中，有多少个不同的比较涉及高度、速度、航向和跑道，以及对于每种表示的测量类型最常见的偏差是什么？预期值和实际值必须引用相同的比较，非数字或不匹配的提及不符合条件。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-017.source: How many US-reference reports both record an emergency declaration and explicitly state that the flight neither diverted nor returned, instead continuing to the planned destination or completing a normal landing?
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-017.zh: 有多少美国参考报告既记录了紧急声明，又明确指出航班既没有改航，也没有返航，而是继续飞往计划目的地或完成正常着陆？

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-015.source: Among reports whose anomaly summary includes an Aircraft Equipment Problem and whose narratives describe active crew or maintenance troubleshooting, how many distinct incidents ended as resolved, intermittent, or still_unsafe? Use still_unsafe when the problem persisted or left the aircraft unsafe, intermittent when it disappeared but remained uncertain or later recurred, and resolved when corrective action clearly cleared it; apply that order when more than one status is supported.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-015.zh: 在其异常摘要包括飞机设备问题且其叙述描述了活跃机组人员或维护故障排除的报告中，有多少不同的事件以已解决、间歇性或 still_unsafe 结束？当问题持续存在或导致飞机不安全时，使用 still_unsafe；当问题消失但仍不确定或后来再次出现时，使用间歇性；当纠正措施明确清除问题时，使用解决方案；当支持多种状态时应用该顺序。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-016.source: Among Aircraft-primary reports, which engine-symptom categories are most common: thrust_loss, oil_indication, temperature, vibration, flameout, and other_engine_indication? List the represented categories in descending incident count, with the most common immediate crew action and most common outcome for each; ties follow the category names alphabetically.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-016.zh: 在飞机主要报告中，哪些发动机症状类别最常见：thrust_loss、oil_indication、温度、振动、熄火和 other_engine_indication？按事件数量降序列出所代表的类别，以及每个类别中最常见的立即机组行动和最常见的结果；领带按照类别名称的字母顺序排列。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-019.source: Among Part 121 airport-associated reports whose navigation-in-use records name FMS/FMC or GPS and whose event rows contain an automation detector or result, how many distinct incidents have each primary crew response: followed_automation, overrode_or_disconnected, or sought_atc_clarification? Use that order as precedence when several responses occur. A clear narrative action may establish the response; when it is absent, an unambiguous structured automation result may do so.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-019.zh: 在 Part 121机场相关报告中，其使用中导航记录名为 FMS/FMC 或 GPS，其事件行包含自动检测器或结果，每个主要机组人员响应有多少个不同的事件：followed_automation、overrode_or_disconnected 或 sought_atc_clarification？当出现多个响应时，请使用该顺序作为优先顺序。清晰的叙述动作可以建立反应；当它不存在时，明确的结构化自动化结果可以这样做。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-022.source: Among Human Factors-primary incidents that were operated IFR and carry an ATC Issue All Types or Procedural Clearance anomaly, how do distinct-incident counts vary across four flight-phase groups and five primary clearance-conflict mechanisms? Phase groups are ground_or_departure, climb_or_cruise, descent_or_approach, and landing_or_other; mechanisms are late_or_changed_clearance, misunderstood_clearance, readback_hearback_failure, route_or_heading_confusion, and altitude_or_speed_restriction. Count a report only when one mechanism is clearly primary.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-022.zh: 在 IFR 操作并带有 ATC 问题所有类型或程序许可异常的人为因素主要事件中，四个飞行阶段组和五个主要许可冲突机制中的不同事件计数有何变化？相组为 ground_or_departure、climb_or_cruise、descent_or_approach 和 landing_or_other；机制为 late_or_changed_clearance、misunderstood_clearance、readback_hearback_failure、route_or_heading_confusion 和 altitude_or_speed_restriction。仅当一种机制明显是主要机制时才算作报告。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-020.source: For reports from the 1201-1800 local-time period, how are approach or landing incidents distributed by flight condition and recorded result when weather or visibility, rather than traffic spacing, runway occupancy, or equipment, caused a go-around, missed approach, or new clearance? Flight conditions are IMC, Marginal, and Mixed; results are go_around_or_missed_approach and new_clearance. Show one row for every represented combination.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-020.zh: 对于 1201-1800 当地时间期间的报告，当天气或能见度（而不是交通间距、跑道占用或设备）导致复飞、复飞或新的许可时，进场或着陆事件如何按飞行状况分布和记录结果？飞行条件有 IMC、边缘和混合；结果是 go_around_or_missed_approach 和 new_clearance。为每个表示的组合显示一行。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-018.source: Among Part 121 passenger reports where a fuel quantity, reserve, calculation, or dispatch-release decision directly affected the operation, which five incidents rank highest under this consequence order: emergency_declaration, diversion, return, holding, then continued_with_concern? When several consequences appear, use the highest-priority one. Within a category, incidents with a numeric fuel or time value rank first, followed by lower incident ID. Keep fuel and time values in separate short normalized lists.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-018.zh: 在 Part 121旅客报告中，燃油数量、储备、计算或调度释放决策直接影响运营，在此后果顺序下，哪五个事件排名最高：emergency_declaration、改道、返回、滞留，然后是 continued_with_concern？当出现多种后果时，请使用优先级最高的后果。在一个类别中，具有数字燃料或时间值的事件排名第一，其次是较低的事件 ID。将燃料和时间值保存在单独的简短标准化列表中。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-025.source: Among incidents with a General Maintenance Action, General Flight Cancelled / Delayed, or Flight Crew Returned To Departure Airport result and an Aircraft or MEL contributing-factor label, how many distinct incidents are primarily attributable to each disruption reason: predeparture_component_discrepancy, mel_or_deferred_item, maintenance_documentation_or_release, inflight_component_or_system_problem, and postflight_inspection_or_repair? Assign one primary reason and omit reports that do not clearly fit.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-025.zh: 在具有一般维护行动、一般航班取消/延误或机组人员返回出发机场结果以及飞机或 MEL 影响因素标签的事件中，有多少个不同事件主要归因于每个中断原因：predeparture_component_discrepancy、mel_or_deferred_item、maintenance_documentation_or_release、inflight_component_or_system_problem 和 postflight_inspection_or_repair？指定一个主要原因并忽略不明显适合的报告。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-021.source: Which twenty US-reference incidents with structured horizontal and vertical miss distances have the smallest recorded horizontal separation, breaking ties by smaller vertical separation and then incident ID? For each incident, identify the involved parties in a short phrase, show both structured distances in feet, and compare any corresponding narrative values as matches, differs, or not_stated.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-021.zh: 哪二十个具有结构化水平和垂直偏差距离的美国参考事件具有最小的水平间隔记录，通过较小的垂直间隔处理并列情况，然后是事件 ID？对于每个事件，用简短的短语识别相关方，显示以英尺为单位的结构化距离，并将任何相应的叙述值比较为匹配、不同或 not_stated。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-026.source: Among Part 121 airport-associated reports, which five incidents with an Automation Aircraft RA or TA detector and both horizontal and vertical miss distances show the most difficult conflict between automation guidance and an ATC instruction in the same episode? Rank direct_conflict above modified_or_delayed_compliance and clarification_required; within a pattern, use smaller horizontal separation, smaller vertical separation, then lower incident ID. Include short phrases for the automation guidance and ATC instruction.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-026.zh: 在 Part 121机场相关报告中，哪五起使用自动化飞机 RA 或 TA 探测器以及水平和垂直偏差距离的事件显示同一事件中自动化引导与 ATC 指令之间最困难的冲突？ direct_conflict 的排名高于 modified_or_delayed_compliance 和 clarification_required；在图案内，使用较小的水平间隔、较小的垂直间隔，然后使用较低的事件 ID。包括自动化指导和 ATC 指令的简短短语。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-023.source: Among Human Factors-primary reports whose communication-breakdown records involve flight crew with ATC or flight crew with flight crew, how many distinct incidents in each participant group primarily involve phraseology, timing_or_late_information, assumption_or_expectation, task_division_or_role, or failure_to_challenge? Count a participant-group and mechanism combination only when the narrative clearly supports both; the same incident may contribute to both participant groups.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-023.zh: 在人为因素主要报告中，其通信故障记录涉及机组人员与 ATC 或机组人员与机组人员，每个参与者组中有多少个不同事件主要涉及措辞：timing_or_late_information、assumption_or_expectation、task_division_or_role 或 failure_to_challenge？仅当叙述明确支持参与者-群体和机制组合时，才计算这两者；同一事件可能对两个参与者群体都有影响。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-024.source: Among Part 121 passenger reports with a passengers-involved Y event, which ten cabin-issue and changed-decision combinations occur most often when the cabin issue directly caused a flight-deck operational change? Issue categories are passenger_medical, security_or_behavior, cabin_equipment_or_door, boarding_or_deplaning, and flight_attendant_communication; decision categories are delay_or_cancel, return_or_divert, continue_changed, and other_operational_change. Cabin-service-only details do not qualify. Rank by distinct-incident count, then the two category names.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-024.zh: 在121部分客运运营报告的涉及乘客的Y事件中，当客舱问题直接导致驾驶舱操作变更时，哪十种客舱问题和改变决定组合最常发生？问题类别为 passenger_medical、security_or_behavior、cabin_equipment_or_door、boarding_or_deplaning 和 flight_attendant_communication；决策类别为 delay_or_cancel、return_or_divert、continue_changed 和 other_operational_change。仅客舱服务的详细信息不符合条件。按不同事件计数排名，然后是两个类别名称。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-028.source: Among Air Carrier airport-associated incidents with a Ground Conflict, Ground Incursion, or Ground Excursion event, how many distinct reports in low_light versus daylight explicitly describe each visual factor as materially contributing? Treat Night, Dusk, and Dawn as low_light; factors are reduced_visibility, inadequate_or_confusing_lighting, glare, missed_visual_scan, and obscured_signage_or_markings. An incident may count for more than one supported factor, but incidental mentions do not count.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-028.zh: 在与航空承运人机场相关的地面冲突、地面入侵或地面偏移事件中，有多少份 low_light 与日光下的不同报告明确描述了每个视觉因素具有重大影响？将夜晚、黄昏和黎明视为 low_light；因子包括 reduced_visibility、inadequate_or_confusing_lighting、眩光、missed_visual_scan 和 obscured_signage_or_markings。一个事件可能会计入多个受支持的因素，但偶然提及的事件不算数。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-027.source: Among Aircraft-primary reports with a maintenance records-complete or required-correct-document status and a component problem record, which documentation-issue and status combinations occur most often, up to fifteen combinations in total? Documentation types are incomplete_or_inaccurate_logbook, missing_or_incomplete_work_card, incorrect_or_incomplete_mel_procedure, missing_required_document, and release_or_signoff_error. Count only actual documentation problems rather than mechanical discrepancies alone. Rank by distinct-incident count, then documentation type and the two status values, and include a canonical affected item as a short phrase.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-027.zh: 在具有维护记录完整或要求正确的文档状态和组件问题记录的飞机主报告中，哪种文档问题和状态组合最常出现，总共多达 15 个组合？文档类型为 incomplete_or_inaccurate_logbook、missing_or_incomplete_work_card、incorrect_or_incomplete_mel_procedure、missing_required_document 和 release_or_signoff_error。仅计算实际的文档问题，而不是仅计算机械差异。按不同事件计数排名，然后按文档类型和两个状态值排名，并包含规范的受影响项目作为短语。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-032.source: Among IFR flights that received a late, confusing, or ambiguous ATC clearance and subsequently deviated from their assigned altitude, heading, or airspace boundary, what type of clearance conflict triggered the deviation, and how do these incidents break down by flight phase?
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-032.zh: 在收到延迟、混乱或不明确的 ATC 许可并随后偏离其指定高度、航向或空域边界的 IFR 航班中，哪种类型的许可冲突引发了偏离，以及这些事件如何按飞行阶段细分？

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-031.source: Within Part 121 airport-associated reports that contain a recorded automation detector or result, which ten cross-incident pairs describe similar alerts and operational contexts but contrasting first crew responses? A pair qualifies only when one response is follow_advisory and the other is override_advisory or seek_clarification_before_acting. Rank pairs first by the more consequential reported outcome using emergency_or_diversion, go_around_or_evasive_action, then continued_operation, and break ties by the two incident IDs in ascending order. For each pair, identify the shared alert or advisory in at most six words and the two response labels.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-031.zh: 在包含记录的自动检测器或结果的 Part 121机场相关报告中，哪十个交叉事件对描述了类似的警报和操作环境，但对比了第一机组人员的响应？仅当一个响应是 follow_advisory，另一个响应是 override_advisory 或 seek_clarification_before_acting 时，一对才符合资格。首先使用 emergency_or_diversion、go_around_or_evasive_action、continued_operation 对更重要的报告结果进行排名，对于相等的排名值，按两个事件 ID 升序排列。对于每一对，用最多六个单词和两个响应标签来标识共享警报或建议。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-029.source: Among Human Factors- or Procedure-primary incidents with flight-crew experience records, how are structured people distributed by crew function and the narrative role of their experience? Normalize crew function to captain, first_officer, single_pilot, instructor, or other_flight_crew, and classify experience as causal, incidental, or not_mentioned. For each represented combination, include the person count and medians of total, aircraft-type, and last-90-days flight hours when recorded.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-029.zh: 在具有飞行机组经验记录的人为因素或程序主要事件中，人员结构如何按机组职能及其经验的叙述角色进行分配？将船员职能标准化为船长、first_officer、single_pilot、教练或 other_flight_crew，并将经验分类为因果、偶然或 not_mentioned。对于每个表示的组合，包括记录时的总人数和中位数、飞机类型和最近 90 天的飞行小时数。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-030.source: Among flight-phase and aircraft-operator combinations with at least twenty candidate incidents carrying an ATC assistance or advisory, evasive-action, reorientation, equipment-problem recovery, or go-around result, which five have the highest successful safety-barrier rate? A report is successful only when its narrative clearly describes a hazard being detected, an intervention being made, and a worse consequence being avoided or the situation being stabilized. Rank by higher rate, higher successful-incident count, flight phase alphabetically, and aircraft operator alphabetically; include both counts and the rate.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-030.zh: 在飞行阶段与航空器运营方的各个组合中，筛选至少有20起候选事件的组合；候选事件的结果涉及空管协助或建议、规避行动、改变航向、从设备问题中恢复或复飞。其中，安全屏障成功率最高的5个组合是哪些？只有当报告叙述明确描述了发现危险、采取干预，以及避免更严重后果或稳定局势的过程时，才计为成功。依次按成功率降序、成功事件数降序、飞行阶段字母升序和航空器运营方字母升序排列，并返回事件数和成功率。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-033.source: Across reports carrying an Aircraft Equipment Problem event, which twenty narrative component terms are most frequently matched to canonical aircraft-component labels found anywhere in components? Rank by distinct-incident count, then canonical component and narrative term alphabetically; for each mapping, include the most common first detection cue as a phrase of at most six words.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-033.zh: 在涉及飞机设备问题事件的报告中，哪 20 个叙述性组件术语最常与组件中随处可见的规范飞机组件标签匹配？按不同事件计数排名，然后按字母顺序排列规范组成部分和叙述术语；对于每个映射，包括最常见的第一检测线索作为最多六个单词的短语。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-035.source: Among Human Factors-primary reports whose person-factor records contain Communication Breakdown, Workload, Confusion, or Situational Awareness, how many distinct incidents have narratives that causally support each recorded factor? Narrative wording should be matched to the global factor vocabulary by meaning rather than exact text or incident ID. For every represented factor, include the most common actor and operational effect as phrases of at most six words; a structured factor without narrative causal support does not count.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-035.zh: 在人为因素记录包含沟通障碍、工作量、混乱或情境意识的人为因素主要报告中，有多少不同的事件具有因果支持每个记录因素的叙述？叙述性措辞应通过含义而不是确切的文本或事件 ID 与全局因素词汇相匹配。对于每个表示的因素，包括最常见的参与者和操作效果作为最多六个单词的短语；没有叙事因果支持的结构性因素不算数。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-038.source: Which pairs of different ASRS incident IDs, up to twenty in total, most likely describe the same underlying occurrence? Compare only reports sharing incident month, state reference, locale-reference type, and primary problem, but require the narratives to agree on a distinctive event sequence, measurements, actions, and outcome rather than merely discussing the same topic. Rank matched pairs by incident month descending and then both incident IDs ascending. For each pair, give the shared primary event type and list which of flight phase, anomaly summary, and result summary differ between the two structured records.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-038.zh: 哪对不同的 ASRS 事件 ID（总共最多 20 个）最有可能描述相同的潜在事件？仅比较共享事件月份、状态参考、区域参考类型和主要问题的报告，但要求叙述就独特的事件顺序、测量、行动和结果达成一致，而不仅仅是讨论同一主题。按事件月份降序对匹配对进行排名，然后按两个事件 ID 升序排列。对于每对，给出共享的主要事件类型，并列出两个结构化记录之间的飞行阶段、异常摘要和结果摘要中哪些不同。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-039.source: Among reports with both Aircraft and Human Factors contributing-factor labels, how many distinct incidents are mainly_equipment_driven, mainly_human_factor_driven, or mixed_equipment_human_factor after considering the narrative causal order together with recorded component and person-factor information? Omit reports without a clear weighting. For each category, summarize the dominant initiating factor and intervention in at most six words each.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-039.zh: 在带有飞机和人为因素影响因素标签的报告中，在考虑叙述因果顺序以及记录的成分和人为因素信息后，有多少个不同的事件是 mainly_equipment_driven、mainly_human_factor_driven 或 mixed_equipment_human_factor？忽略没有明确权重的报告。对于每个类别，分别用最多六个词概括主要的启动因素和干预措施。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-034.source: In reports from the 1201-1800 local-time period, which twenty weather-mechanism and recorded-decision pairs occur most often when the narrative explicitly connects the two? Weather mechanisms are convective_weather, turbulence, windshear, icing, low_visibility, low_ceiling, strong_or_gusty_wind, and precipitation; recorded decisions are diversion, emergency_declaration, and new_clearance. Incidental weather and passenger-comfort-only turbulence do not qualify. Rank by distinct-incident count, then mechanism and decision alphabetically.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-034.zh: 在 1201-1800 当地时间的报告中，当叙述明确地将两者联系起来时，哪 20 个天气机制和记录决策对最常出现？天气机制为convective_weather、湍流、风切变、结冰、low_visibility、low_ceiling、strong_or_gusty_wind和降水；记录的决定是转移、emergency_declaration 和 new_clearance。偶然的天气和仅考虑乘客舒适度的湍流不符合条件。按不同事件计数排名，然后按字母顺序排列机制和决策。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-037.source: Among Aircraft-primary reports, which twelve combinations of maintenance status, discovery phase, and causal chain occur most often when an earlier deferral or release-to-service decision is explicitly connected to a later component discrepancy? Maintenance status is deferred, released_to_service, or both; discovery phase is before_departure, after_takeoff, or after_landing; chain category is deferred_item_recurred, released_item_failed, incomplete_repair_or_signoff, or maintenance_limitation_escalated. Rank by distinct-incident count and then the three labels. Each row should include a canonical affected item and recurring discrepancy as short phrases.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-037.zh: 在飞机主要报告中，当早期的推迟或发布服务决策与后来的组件差异明确相关时，哪十二种维护状态、发现阶段和因果链组合最常出现？维护状态为延期、released_to_service 或两者；发现阶段是 before_departure、after_takeoff 或 after_landing；链条类别为 deferred_item_recurred、released_item_failed、incomplete_repair_or_signoff 或 maintenance_limitation_escalated。按不同事件计数排名，然后按三个标签排名。每行应包含一个规范的受影响项目和作为短语的重复出现的差异。

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-036.source: Among Aircraft-primary reports that have both a pressurization, pack, bleed-air, or air-conditioning component record and a smoke, fumes, odor, or aircraft-equipment-problem event, how many distinct incidents are primarily attributable to equipment_malfunction, maintenance_or_release_decision, environmental_contamination, or crew_procedure? Include only reports with one clearly primary cause and an operational consequence beyond a maintenance-record entry. For each cause, summarize the canonical system and dominant operational outcome in at most six words each.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-036.zh: 在同时具有加压、包装、引气或空调部件记录以及烟雾、烟雾、气味或飞机设备问题事件的飞机主要报告中，有多少个不同的事件主要归因于 equipment_malfunction、maintenance_or_release_decision、environmental_contamination 或 crew_procedure？仅包含具有明确主要原因和维护记录条目之外的操作后果的报告。对于每个原因，分别用最多六个词概括规范系统和主要操作结果。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-003.source: For Dodge airbag complaints involving at least one injury and no fire, what primary airbag failure mode is described in each case? For every complaint ID, I want to know the model year and a short canonical failure-mode phrase.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-003.zh: 对于涉及至少一人受伤且未发生火灾的道奇安全气囊投诉，每种情况下描述的主要安全气囊故障模式是什么？对于每个投诉 ID，我想知道型号年份和简短的规范故障模式短语。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-002.source: Looking at every recall in the seatbelt component category, is it true that each one describes a defect that could prevent the belt from restraining an occupant during a crash and that none describes a purely cosmetic or comfort-only issue?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-002.zh: 纵观安全带组件类别中的每一次召回，是否每一次召回都描述了一种可能导致安全带在碰撞过程中无法约束乘员的缺陷，并且没有一次描述纯粹是美观或仅考虑舒适性的问题？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-001.source: Among 2022 model-year Tesla Model 3 complaints that reported a crash but no fire, how many describe phantom braking or sudden unintended acceleration?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-001.zh: 在2022车型年款特斯拉 Model 3报告发生碰撞但没有起火的投诉中，有多少描述了幻影制动或突然意外加速？

8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-040.source: Among incidents with a General Flight Cancelled / Delayed, Flight Crew Returned To Departure Airport, or General Maintenance Action result, which fifteen maintenance-driver and canonical-component combinations occur most often when maintenance was the primary disruption driver and an affected component can be identified? Driver categories are component_discrepancy_or_failure, mel_or_deferred_item, troubleshooting_or_repair, documentation_or_release_to_service, and required_inspection. Match narrative item names to the global component vocabulary semantically rather than by incident ID or exact spelling. Rank by distinct-incident count, then driver and component, and include the recorded result labels represented in each row.
8-17/ASRS/NASA_ASRS-040.zh: 在一般航班取消/延误、机组人员返回出发机场或一般维护行动结果的事件中，当维护是主要中断诱因并且可以识别受影响的组件时，哪 15 种维修诱因和规范组件组合最常发生？诱因类别为 component_discrepancy_or_failure、mel_or_deferred_item、troubleshooting_or_repair、documentation_or_release_to_service 和 required_inspection。按语义而不是按事件 ID 或精确拼写将叙述项名称与全局组件词汇表进行匹配。按不同事件计数排名，然后按驱动程序和组件排名，并包括每行中表示的记录结果标签。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-006.source: Among Subaru Outback complaints from the 2024 model year onward where no crash was reported, how many distinct model years are represented in records describing an unintended brake activation or sudden brake hold event?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-006.zh: 在斯巴鲁傲虎自 2024 年车型年以来未报告碰撞事故的投诉中，有多少个不同年份的车型在描述意外制动激活或突然制动保持事件的记录中出现？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-005.source: Which Tesla recall campaign numbers have no Park Outside or Do Not Drive consumer warning, use an over-the-air software update as the corrective action, and describe a steering or motion-control issue in the defect summary?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-005.zh: 哪些特斯拉召回活动编号没有“在室外停车”或“请勿驾驶”消费者警告，使用无线软件更新作为纠正措施，并在缺陷摘要中描述了转向或运动控制问题？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-007.source: Among Hyundai Elantra complaints where at least one occupant was injured but no fire was reported, how many describe a loss of vehicle control while driving?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-007.zh: 在现代伊兰特投诉中，至少一名乘员受伤，但未报告起火，有多少起投诉是在驾驶时车辆失控？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-008.source: For distinct Tesla recall campaigns in the steering component category that do not include a Park Outside or Do Not Drive consumer warning, what primary failure cause does each defect summary identify? I want to know the campaign number and a canonical cause phrase of at most six words for each one.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-008.zh: 对于转向组件类别中不包括“停在室外”或“请勿驾驶”消费者警告的不同特斯拉召回活动，每个缺陷摘要确定了哪些主要故障原因？我想知道活动编号和每个活动最多六个单词的规范原因短语。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-004.source: For each distinct Kia recall campaign number in the OTHER component category without a Park Outside consumer warning, what underlying failure mechanism does its defect summary describe?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-004.zh: 对于“其他”组件类别中每个不同的起亚召回活动编号，且没有向消费者发出“Park Outside”（建议停放室外）警告的情况，其缺陷摘要描述了哪些潜在故障机制？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-009.source: Among Subaru Outback complaints from the 2024 model year onward where no crash was reported, which failure mode is dominant: electrical, mechanical, or software? Outout 'mixed' when the dominant mode is unclear or tied.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-009.zh: 从 2024 年车型年份开始，斯巴鲁傲虎投诉中没有发生碰撞事故，哪种故障模式占主导地位：电气、机械还是软件？当主导模式不明确或平局时，输出'mixed'（混合）。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-014.source: Among investigation reports whose body indicates that the investigation is closed and that cite at least one NHTSA recall number, what is the primary defect topic for each file ID, and which normalized recall numbers does it cite? Describe the topic as one of {steering, braking, airbag, electrical, powertrain, other}.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-014.zh: 在正文表明调查已结束且至少引用了一个 NHTSA 召回编号的调查报告中，每个文件 ID 的主要缺陷主题是什么，以及引用了哪些标准化召回编号？将主题描述为{转向、制动、安全气囊、电气、动力总成、其他}之一。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-010.source: Do at least ten Toyota RAV4 complaints from the 2021 through 2024 model years, with at least one occupant injured and no fire reported, describe a loss of braking ability or unexpected brake failure?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-010.zh: 从 2021 年到 2024 车型年份，至少有 10 个起丰田 RAV4 RAV4 投诉，其中至少一名乘员受伤且没有火灾报告，是否描述了制动能力丧失或意外制动故障？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-012.source: Among all airbag complaints that describe an unintended airbag deployment, what fraction say the deployment happened before any collision impact or without a collision? Express the result as a decimal rounded to three places.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-012.zh: 在所有描述安全气囊意外展开的安全气囊投诉中，有多少比例表示气囊展开发生在任何碰撞影响之前或没有发生碰撞？将结果表示为四舍五入到三位小数。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-013.source: Which NHTSA investigation reports that both mention a Tesla model, such as Model 3, Model S, Model Y, or Model X, and cite at least one NHTSA recall number? For each file, which deduplicated and normalized recall numbers are cited?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-013.zh: 哪份 NHTSA 调查报告都提到了 Tesla 车型，例如 Model 3、Model S、Model Y 或 Model X，并至少引用了一个 NHTSA 召回编号？对于每个文件，引用了哪些重复数据删除和标准化召回编号？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-015.source: Which NHTSA investigation reports discuss an airbag inflator defect or an unintended airbag deployment while also citing at least one NHTSA recall number? For each file, which deduplicated and normalized recall numbers are cited?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-015.zh: 哪些 NHTSA 调查报告讨论了安全气囊充气机缺陷或意外安全气囊展开，同时还至少引用了一个 NHTSA 召回编号？对于每个文件，引用了哪些重复数据删除和标准化召回编号？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-019.source: Among complaints where the consumer received medical attention and a state is recorded, which five US states have the highest counts of airbag-related complaints describing a deployment failure, unintended deployment, or inflator rupture? States with equal counts are ordered by state code ascending.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-019.zh: 在消费者接受医疗护理并记录了某个州的投诉中，美国哪五个州描述安全气囊展开失败、意外展开或充气机破裂的相关投诉数量最多？计数相等的州按州代码升序排列。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-017.source: For recalls reported from January 2022 through December 2025, which corrective-action style is most common for each manufacturer: software update, part replacement, dealer inspection only, or other? Alongside the dominant style, how many recalls and distinct recalled components does each manufacturer have?
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-017.zh: 对于从 2022年1月 到 2025年12月 报告的召回，每个制造商最常见的纠正措施是：软件更新、零件更换、仅经销商检查还是其他？除了主导风格外，每个制造商还有多少次召回和不同的召回组件？

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-011.source: Among all engine-component complaints that describe an engine stall or loss of power, what fraction say the problem happened while the vehicle was moving or in traffic rather than while parked or idling? Express the result as a decimal rounded to three places.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-011.zh: 在所有描述发动机熄火或动力损失的发动机部件投诉中，有多少比例表示问题发生在车辆行驶或交通中，而不是在停车或怠速时？将结果表示为四舍五入到三位小数。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-018.source: Among complaints where the consumer received medical attention and the narrative describes a concrete vehicle malfunction or crash sequence, which three primary safety-event topics in {steering, braking, airbag, electrical, powertrain, other} have the highest complaint counts? Topics with equal counts are ordered alphabetically.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-018.zh: 在消费者接受医疗护理且叙述描述具体车辆故障或碰撞序列的投诉中，{转向、制动、安全气囊、电气、动力总成、其他}中哪三个主要安全事件主题的投诉数量最高？数量相等的主题按字母顺序排列。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-016.source: Among Nissan Altima airbag complaints with injury or death allegations that describe an inflator rupture, airbag explosion, shrapnel, or metal fragments, which ones involve vehicles covered by an airbag recall? For each match, I want to know the complaint ID, affected vehicle ID, matching recall campaign number, and a short failure-mode phrase.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-016.zh: 在日产 Altima 安全气囊投诉中，涉及充气机破裂、安全气囊爆炸、弹片或金属碎片的伤害或死亡指控，哪些涉及安全气囊召回范围内的车辆？对于每场比赛，我想知道投诉 ID、受影响的车辆 ID、匹配的召回活动编号以及简短的故障模式短语。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-023.source: For each Hyundai or Kia recall campaign that includes a Park Outside warning, how many complaints from the same make and component category describe fire, smoke, burning, melting, or an electrical short? I also want to know the campaign number, make, component category, and recall defect summary associated with each count.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-023.zh: 对于每一次包含停车警告的现代或起亚召回活动，有多少来自同一品牌和组件类别的投诉描述了火灾、烟雾、燃烧、熔化或电气短路？我还想知道与每个计数相关的活动编号、品牌、组件类别以及召回缺陷摘要。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-021.source: Among vehicle makes with at least one ADAS recall whose defect summary discusses automatic braking, driver-assist braking, or speed-control behavior, which four rank highest by the number of ADAS complaints specifically describing phantom braking? For each make, how many qualifying complaints and matching ADAS recalls are there? Make ascending breaks ties in complaint count.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-021.zh: 在至少有一项 ADAS 召回、且其缺陷摘要涉及自动制动、驾驶辅助制动或速度控制行为的车辆品牌（make）中，按明确描述幽灵刹车（phantom braking）的 ADAS 投诉数量排名最高的四个品牌是哪些？对于每个品牌，符合条件的投诉和匹配的 ADAS 召回各有多少项？投诉数量并列时按品牌（make）升序排列。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-020.source: For 2024 and 2025 model-year complaints whose narratives describe a tangible safety event, how do component categories compare in complaint count, towed rate, average injury count, and dominant short failure-mode label? Alphabetical order determines the dominant label when failure modes are tied.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-020.zh: 对于 2024 年和 2025 年车型年份投诉（其叙述描述了有形安全事件），组件类别在投诉数量、拖车率、平均伤害数量和主要短故障模式标签方面如何比较？当故障模式联系在一起时，字母顺序决定了主要标签。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-022.source: For Toyota RAV4 body complaints that describe safety-relevant glass, window, windshield, sunroof/moonroof, or water-in-door visibility defects, how are the cases distributed across {spontaneous_glass_breakage, door_water_intrusion, visibility_distortion_or_defect, other}, and which root-cause label is most common? Alphabetical order breaks a tie for the most common label.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-022.zh: 对于描述安全相关玻璃、车窗、挡风玻璃、天窗/天窗或车内进水能见度缺陷的丰田 RAV4 车身投诉，这些案例在 {spontaneous_glass_breakage、door_water_intrusion、visibility_distortion_or_defect、其他} 中的分布情况如何？哪种根本原因标签最常见？按字母顺序排列最常见的标签。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-024.source: For Toyota airbag complaints that describe an unintended deployment and an injury or burn caused by that deployment, how are the cases distributed across {sensor_misfire, software_logic_error, inflator_defect, other}, and which root-cause label is dominant? For each label, what are its complaint count and percentage? Alphabetical order breaks a tie for the dominant label.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-024.zh: 对于描述意外展开以及由该展开造成的伤害或烧伤的丰田安全气囊投诉，案例在 {sensor_misfire、software_logic_error、inflator_defect、其他} 中的分布情况如何，以及哪个根本原因标签占主导地位？对于每个标签，其投诉数量和百分比是多少？字母顺序打破了主导标签的平局。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-025.source: Between Toyota and Honda, which make has more severe in-motion complaints for vehicles covered by a same-vehicle recall whose defect summary describes a safety-critical crash, injury, fire, loss-of-control, airbag, braking, or loss-of-power risk? How many matched complaints does each make have? If the counts are equal, the comparison result is tie.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-025.zh: 丰田和本田之间，哪一家对同一车辆召回范围内的车辆提出了更严重的行驶中投诉，其缺陷摘要描述了安全关键的碰撞、伤害、火灾、失控、安全气囊、制动或断电风险？每个投诉有多少条匹配的投诉？如果计数相等，则比较结果为平局。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-031.source: Which complaint-recall pairs involve the same vehicle make, model, model year, and component category, have a recall reported at least 1,500 days after the complaint, and describe the same defect mechanism in the complaint and recall summaries? For each long-lag pair, I want to know the complaint ID, recall campaign number, elapsed days, and a short root-cause phrase from the recall defect summary.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-031.zh: 哪些投诉-召回对涉及相同的车辆品牌、型号、型号年份和零部件类别，在投诉后至少 1,500 天报告了召回，并在投诉和召回摘要中描述了相同的缺陷机制？对于每个长滞后对，我想知道投诉 ID、召回活动编号、经过的天数以及召回缺陷摘要中的简短根本原因短语。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-027.source: For 2023 through 2025 model-year complaints, which five makes rank highest by EV or hybrid component complaint count among makes that also have a recent recall discussing EV batteries, charging, high-voltage systems, electric drive, hybrid drivetrain, or powertrain-control software in its defect or remedy? For each make, how many qualifying complaints and related recalls are there? Make ascending breaks ties in complaint count.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-027.zh: 对于 2023 至 2025 车型年的投诉，在同时拥有近期召回（其缺陷或补救措施描述涉及 EV 电池、充电、高压系统、电驱动、混合动力传动系统或动力总成控制软件）的品牌中，按 EV 或混合动力部件投诉数量排名最高的五个品牌是哪些？对于每个品牌，符合条件的投诉和相关召回各有多少项？投诉数量并列时按品牌（make）升序排列。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-026.source: For Honda ADAS and BRAKES complaints that describe a tangible safety event while the vehicle was being driven, which component has the higher average injury count? Ignore minor inconveniences such as screen flicker or infotainment lag and exclude problems that occurred while parked or stationary. Output ADAS_higher if ADAS exceeds BRAKES, BRAKES_higher if BRAKES exceeds ADAS, otherwise tie.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-026.zh: 对于本田 ADAS 和制动器投诉，描述了车辆行驶时发生的切实安全事件，哪个部件的平均伤害数更高？忽略屏幕闪烁或信息娱乐延迟等轻微不便，并排除停车或静止时发生的问题。如果 ADAS 超过 BRAKES，则输出 ADAS_higher，如果 BRAKES 超过 ADAS，则输出 BRAKES_higher，否则平局。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-028.source: Within component categories whose ODI investigation reports explicitly identify at least one Jeep model in the investigated or reviewed vehicle population, how many distinct Jeep complaints describe a genuine safety defect that matches the underlying defect in at least one Jeep recall from the same component category? Exclude cosmetic and convenience-only complaints.
8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-028.zh: 在 ODI 调查报告明确指出所调查或审查的车辆群体中至少有一款 Jeep 车型的组件类别中，有多少个不同的 Jeep 投诉描述了与同一组件类别中至少一辆 Jeep 召回中的潜在缺陷相匹配的真正安全缺陷？排除仅针对外观和便利的投诉。

8-17/NHTSA/NHTSA-035.source: For Toyota recall campaigns in the broad OTHER component category whose defect summaries describe the same problem as Toyota OTHER-category complaint narratives, what's the distinct matching complaint count, dominant complaint sentiment in {acute_safety_event, intermittent_issue, cosmetic_or_minor}, dominant recall severity in {critical, severe, moderate, minor}, and short shared-defect phrase correspond to each campaign number?

7-30/DAB/crmarenapro/query8.source: Identify the agent with the fewest transfer counts in the last 4 quarters among those who handled more than 0 cases. Return only the Id of the agent. ## Transfer Count Policy - Definition: The number of instances a case was reassigned or transferred from one agent to another. Each transfer from agent A to agent B adds to the transfer count for agent A. - In the queries that specify 'agents managed/queries x cases' -- this filter applies to both the first agent that the case was first assigned to and the agent that the case was transferred to. This means that if an agent has 2 cases that was initially assigned to itself by admin and 1 case transferred from another agent, a filter like 'handled/managed at least 3 cases' would not filter this agent out. - For cases that have NOT been transferred to an other agent, there will be only ONE 'Owner Assignment', and for those that have been transferred, there will be MORE THAN ONE 'Owner Assignment'. ## Today's date: 2023-04-10
7-30/DAB/crmarenapro/query8.zh: 在处理超过 0 个案件的代理中，找出最近 4 季度转帐次数最少的代理。仅返回代理的 ID。 ## 转移计数策略 - 定义：案例从一个代理重新分配或转移到另一个代理的实例数。从代理 A 到代理 B 的每次转移都会增加代理 A 的转移计数。 - 在指定'agents managed/queries x cases'（代理管理/查询 x 案例）的查询中 - 此过滤器适用于案例首先分配到的第一个代理和案例转移到的代理。这意味着，如果代理具有最初由管理员分配给自己的 2 案例和从另一个代理转移的 1 案例，则'handled/managed at least 3 cases'（至少处理/管理 3 案例）之类的过滤器不会过滤掉该代理。 - 对于尚未转移给其他代理人的案件，将只有一份'Owner Assignment'（所有者分配），而对于已转移的案件，将有不止一份'Owner Assignment'（所有者分配）。 ## 今天的日期：2023-04-10

7-30/DAB/crmarenapro/query10.source: In the past four months, which agent had the lowest average handle time for those processing more than one case? Return only the Id of the agent. ## Handle Time Policy - Definition: The duration taken to close a case. Specifically, it is the time from when a case is opened to when it is closed. - In the queries that specify 'agents managed/queries x cases' -- this filter applies to both the first agent that the case was first assigned to and the agent that the case was transferred to. This means that if an agent has 2 cases that was initially assigned to itself by admin and 1 case transferred from another agent, a filter like 'handled/managed at least 3 cases' would not filter this agent out. - When computing handle time, we do not compute handle time for cases that have been transferred to other agents. - For cases that have NOT been transferred to an other agent, there will be only ONE 'Owner Assignment', and for those that have been transferred, there will be MORE THAN ONE 'Owner Assignment'. ## Today's date: 2023-09-02
7-30/DAB/crmarenapro/query10.zh: 在过去四个月中，在处理过不止一个支持工单（case）的座席中，哪位座席的平均处理时长最短？只返回该座席的 Id。## 处理时长政策 - 定义：关闭一个工单所花费的时长，具体而言，是从工单被创建（打开）到被关闭之间的时间。- 在指定 'agents managed/queries x cases'（座席管理/处理了 x 个工单）的查询中，该过滤条件同时适用于工单最初被分配给的座席，以及工单被转交给的座席。这意味着，如果某个座席有 2 个工单是由管理员最初分配给其本人的，另有 1 个工单是从其他座席转交过来的，那么诸如 'handled/managed at least 3 cases'（处理/管理了至少 3 个工单）这样的过滤条件不会将该座席排除。- 计算处理时长时，不计算已被转交给其他座席的工单的处理时长。- 对于未被转交给其他座席的工单，只会有一条 'Owner Assignment'（负责人分配）记录；对于已被转交的工单，则会有多于一条 'Owner Assignment' 记录。## 今天的日期：2023-09-02

7-30/FDABench/FDA0669.source: Between April 1 and July 31 of 2017, using the hits product revenue data along with the totals transactions to classify sessions as purchase (transactions ≥ 1 and productRevenue not null) or non-purchase (transactions null and productRevenue null), compare the average pageviews per visitor for each group by month. Calculate the percentage decrease in non-purchase average pageviews from April to June, and analyze what this trend reveals about website optimization effectiveness. The calculation rule: ((April non-purchase pageviews - June non-purchase pageviews) / April non-purchase pageviews) × 100.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0669.zh: 在 2017 年的 4 月 1 和 7 月 31 之间，使用点击产品收入数据以及交易总数将会话分类为购买（交易 ≥ 1 且productRevenue 不为空）或非购买（交易为 null 且productRevenue 为 null），按月比较每个组的每个访问者的平均浏览量。计算 4 月至 6 月非购买平均浏览量的下降百分比，并分析这一趋势揭示的网站优化有效性。计算规则：（（4月非购买浏览量-6月非购买浏览量）/4月非购买浏览量）×100。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0673.source: What were the monthly add-to-cart and purchase conversion rates, calculated as a percentage of pageviews on product details, from January to March 2017? 7-30/FDABench/FDA0671.source: Identify the longest number of days between the first visit and the last recorded event (either the last visit or the first transaction) for a user, where the last recorded event is associated with a mobile device.
