7-30/FDABench/FDA0674.source: Calculates the percentage of new users who, between August 1, 2016, and April 30, 2017, both stayed on the site for more than 5 minutes during their initial visit and made a purchase on a subsequent visit at any later time, relative to the total number of new users in the same period. For customer lifetime value modeling using BGNBD frameworks, what would be the standardized engagement-to-conversion coefficient when this percentage is normalized by the square root of typical e-commerce baseline conversion rates and expressed as a decimal multiplier?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0674.zh: 计算在 2016年8月1日 和 2017年4月30日 之间，首次访问期间在网站上停留时间超过 5 分钟并在以后任何时间的后续访问中进行购买的新用户相对于同期新用户总数的百分比。对于使用 BGNBD 框架的客户终身价值建模，当该百分比按典型电子商务基准转化率的平方根标准化并表示为十进制乘数时，标准化参与转化系数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0678.source: How many debt indicators for Russia have a value of 0, excluding NULL values? When analyzing Russia's fiscal conservatism impact on debt indicator distribution, what percentage of zero-valued indicators does this represent if the total number of tracked debt indicators in international databases is typically 48?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0678.zh: 俄罗斯有多少个债务指标的值为 0（不包括 NULL 值）？在分析俄罗斯财政保守主义对债务指标分布的影响时，如果国际数据库中跟踪的债务指标总数通常为 48，那么这代表了零值指标的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0679.source: How many debt indicators for Russia have a value of 0, excluding NULL values? Considering Russia's net public debt fell below zero by 2019 due to reserve accumulation, if zero-valued indicators follow a square root relationship pattern for risk assessment scoring, what would be the risk mitigation index?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0679.zh: 俄罗斯有多少个债务指标的值为 0（不包括 NULL 值）？考虑到俄罗斯的净公共债务因储备积累而降至零以下2019，如果零值指标遵循平方根关系模式进行风险评估评分，那么风险缓释指数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0675.source: Which high-income country had the highest average crude birth rate respectively in each region during the 1980s? Based on the regional variation patterns and considering demographic transition theory, if we calculate the ratio between the highest and lowest regional leader birth rates and express it as a percentage increase, what does this reveal about global demographic disparities among high-income nations?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0675.zh: 在 1980 年代，哪个高收入国家在每个地区的平均粗出生率最高？基于地区差异模式并考虑人口转型理论，如果我们计算最高和最低地区领导人出生率之间的比率，并将其表示为增长率，这揭示了全球高收入国家之间的人口差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0680.source: Calculate the conversion rate from unique visitors to purchasers by using data exclusively from the web_analytics table in the data-to-insights.ecommerce dataset. A visitor is defined as a unique fullVisitorId present in the table, while a purchaser is a visitor who has at least one transaction recorded. Given that industry benchmarks for e-commerce conversion rates typically range from 1% to 2%, what percentage value best represents the platform's performance relative to industry standards, and what strategic implication does this have for the business?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0680.zh: 仅使用 data-toinsights.ecommerce 数据集中 web_analytics 表中的数据来计算从唯一访问者到购买者的转化率。访客被定义为表中存在的唯一 fullVisitorId，而购买者是至少记录了一笔交易的访客。鉴于电子商务转化率的行业基准通常从 1% 到 2%，那么相对于行业标准而言，什么百分比值最能代表平台的性能，这对业务有什么战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0683.source: How many distinct users viewed the most frequently visited page during January 2021? If we apply a logarithmic user influence model where the influence score equals the natural logarithm of distinct users multiplied by 1000, how does this score compare to industry benchmarks for viral content reach?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0683.zh: 2021年1月 期间有多少不同用户查看了最常访问的页面？如果我们应用对数用户影响力模型，其中影响力得分等于不同用户的自然对数乘以 1000，那么该得分与病毒式内容的行业基准相比如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0682.source: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn't in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser. Given the industry context that December 2020 saw heightened e-commerce activity due to COVID-19, if you wanted to express this pageview difference as a percentage of typical industry conversion rates (which ranged 1-2.44%), what would be the approximate ratio when calculated as: (pageview difference × 2) ÷ 100?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0682.zh: 您能算出 2020年12月 购买商品的用户和未购买商品的用户之间浏览量的平均差异吗？只需将参与购买活动的任何人标记为购买者即可。考虑到 2020年12月 因新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 导致电子商务活动增加的行业背景，如果您想将此网页浏览量差异表示为典型行业转化率（范围为 1-2.44%）的百分比，则计算时的近似比率是多少：（网页浏览量差异 × 2）÷ 100？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0684.source: Please find out what percentage of the page views on January 2, 2021, were for PDP type pages. Given that studies show 87% of shoppers review product detail pages before making a purchase, what would be the ratio of actual PDP viewers to total potential purchasers if we assume the PDP percentage represents engaged shopping behavior? Use the formula: (PDP percentage × 100) ÷ 87 to determine shopping engagement efficiency.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0684.zh: 请查明 2021年1月2日 的页面浏览量中 PDP 类型页面的百分比是多少。鉴于研究显示 87% 的购物者在购买前查看产品详细信息页面，如果我们假设 PDP 百分比代表参与的购物行为，实际 PDP 观看者与潜在购买者总数的比率是多少？使用公式：(PDP 百分比 × 100) ÷ 87 来确定购物参与效率。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0681.source: I'm trying to evaluate which board types were most effective on September 15, 2018. Considering cognitive impairment research shows performance varies with complexity, if we calculate the cognitive load index by dividing each board's average score by 5 and then finding the ratio of the highest to lowest performing boards, what strategic insight emerges?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0681.zh: 我正在尝试评估哪些主板类型在 2018年9月15日 上最有效。考虑到认知障碍研究表明性能随复杂性而变化，如果我们通过将每个董事会的平均分数除以 5 来计算认知负荷指数，然后找到表现最高与最低绩效董事会的比率，会出现什么战略洞察力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0686.source: On January 2nd, 2021, I want to determine the percentage of times users transition from a product list page (PLP) view to a product detail page (PDP) view within the same session, using only page_view events. Based on the calculated PLP-to-PDP transition rate and applying standard e-commerce conversion analysis principles, what would be the monthly conversion factor (transition rate divided by 30 days) and what does this indicate about daily user engagement patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0686.zh: 在 1 月的 2nd、2021 上，我想仅使用 page_view 事件来确定用户在同一会话中从产品列表页面 (PLP) 视图转换到产品详细信息页面 (PDP) 视图的次数百分比。根据计算的 PLP 到 PDP 转换率并应用标准电子商务转化分析原理，每月转换系数是多少（转换率除以 30 天数），这表明日常用户参与模式是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0687.source: Could you tell me the average number of engaged sessions per user for December 2020, counting only those sessions where the event parameter 'session_engaged' is equal to '1' and using 'user_pseudo_id' combined with the 'ga_session_id' to identify distinct sessions? Based on this baseline metric, what would be the expected percentage conversion rate if we apply the standard e-commerce conversion formula where conversion rate equals the baseline engagement metric multiplied by 100 and then divided by the square root of 2?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0687.zh: 您能否告诉我 2020年12月 每个用户的平均参与会话数，仅计算事件参数“session_engaged”等于“1”的会话，并使用“user_pseudo_id”与“ga_session_id”组合来识别不同的会话？根据此基准指标，如果我们应用标准电子商务转化公式（其中转化率等于基准参与度指标乘以 100，然后除以 2 的平方根），预期转化率百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0685.source: Please find out what percentage of the page views on January 2, 2021, were for PDP type pages. Considering that PDPs are central to ecommerce conversion and typically represent high-intent traffic, if we calculate the conversion potential index using the square root of the PDP percentage multiplied by 10, what strategic insights can be derived about the website's commercial effectiveness?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0685.zh: 请查明 2021年1月2日 的页面浏览量中 PDP 类型页面的百分比是多少。考虑到 PDP 是电子商务转化的核心，并且通常代表高意向流量，如果我们使用 PDP 百分比的平方根乘以 10 来计算转化潜力指数，可以得出有关网站商业有效性的哪些战略见解？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0688.source: Could you determine what percentage of users either did not uninstall our app within seven days or never uninstalled it after installing during August and September 2018? Considering the retention data alongside industry insights about the relationship between 7-day and 30-day retention patterns, what would be the projected 30-day retention rate using the typical retention decay coefficient, and how should this inform long-term user lifecycle management?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0688.zh: 您能否确定在 8 月和 2018年9月 期间安装后 7 天内没有卸载我们的应用程序或从未卸载过该应用程序的用户百分比是多少？考虑到留存数据以及有关 7 天和 30 天留存模式之间关系的行业见解，使用典型留存衰减系数预测的 30 天留存率是多少？这应如何为长期用户生命周期管理提供信息？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0691.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week (i.e., the percentage of users from the original group who returned in the fourth week after their first session). Please identify the cohort with the highest retention rate in the fourth week, and name the group by the Monday date of the cohort's first session week. If you were to establish a retention optimization program using this high-performing cohort as a baseline, and you needed to calculate the day of the year (1-365) when this optimal cohort period began, what strategic timing insight would this provide for annual planning?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0691.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每个组，计算第四周的保留率（即，在第一次会话后第四周内返回的原始组用户的百分比）。请确定第四周保留率最高的群组，并根据群组第一周的星期一日期命名该群组。如果您要使用此高绩效队列作为基线来建立保留优化计划，并且需要计算此最佳队列期开始时的一年中的哪一天 (1-365)，这将为年度规划提供什么战略时机洞察？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0689.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week (i.e., the percentage of users from the original group who returned in the fourth week after their first session). Please identify the cohort with the highest retention rate in the fourth week, and name the group by the Monday date of the cohort's first session week. Based on the cohort analysis starting from July 2, 2018, if you need to calculate the number of days from the beginning of the analysis period to the start of the highest-performing cohort week, what would this value represent in terms of business cycle analysis?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0689.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每个组，计算第四周的保留率（即，在第一次会话后第四周内返回的原始组用户的百分比）。请确定第四周保留率最高的群组，并根据群组第一周的星期一日期命名该群组。根据从2018年7月2日开始的队列分析，如果需要计算从分析期开始到表现最好的队列周开始的天数，这个值在经济周期分析中代表什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0690.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week (i.e., the percentage of users from the original group who returned in the fourth week after their first session). Please identify the cohort with the highest retention rate in the fourth week, and name the group by the Monday date of the cohort's first session week. If this optimal cohort date were to be used as a benchmark for quarterly business planning, where each quarter contains 13 weeks, in which quarter position would this cohort fall within the Q3 2018 planning cycle?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0690.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每个组，计算第四周的保留率（即，在第一次会话后第四周内返回的原始组用户的百分比）。请确定第四周保留率最高的群组，并根据群组第一周的星期一日期命名该群组。如果将此最佳队列日期用作季度业务规划的基准，其中每个季度包含 13 周，则该队列将属于第 3 季度 2018 规划周期中的哪个季度位置？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0692.source: Could you please help me get the weekly customer retention rate in September 2018 for new customers who first used our app (first_open event) within the first week starting from September 1st, 2018 (timezone in Shanghai)? The retention rates should cover the following weeks 1, 2, and 3 period after the initial use and display them in column format. Based on cohort analysis principles, if you calculate the total retention decline rate from week 1 to week 3 by finding the difference between week 1 and week 3 retention rates, what would this decline rate indicate about user engagement patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0692.zh: 您能否帮我获取从 2018年9月1日（上海时区）开始的第一周内首次使用我们应用程序的新客户（first_open 事件）在 2018年9月的每周客户保留率 吗？保留率应涵盖初次使用后接下来的几周 1、2 和 3 期间，并以列格式显示。根据群组分析原理，如果您通过找出 1 周和 3 周保留率之间的差异来计算从 1 周到 3 周的总保留率下降率，那么这个下降率表明用户参与模式如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0695.source: For all users who first opened the app in September 2018 and then uninstalled within seven days, what percentage experienced an app crash? Converting timestamps to dates first and calculating days based on dates. Given that industry benchmarks suggest crash-free rates should be above 99%, what would be the crash rate amplification factor when comparing this cohort's crash rate to the inverse of the industry standard crash-free rate (1% crash rate)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0695.zh: 对于所有在 2018年9月 首次打开该应用程序然后在 7 天内卸载的用户，有多少百分比经历过应用程序崩溃？首先将时间戳转换为日期并根据日期计算天数。鉴于行业基准表明无崩溃率应高于 99%，那么当将此群组的崩溃率与行业标准无崩溃率（1% 崩溃率）的倒数进行比较时，崩溃率放大系数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0694.source: For all users who first opened the app in September 2018 and then uninstalled within seven days, what percentage experienced an app crash (app_exception)? Calculate by converting timestamps to dates first, then calculating days to uninstall based on dates. When analyzing this crash rate metric in the context of mobile app performance benchmarks, what would be the crash-to-stability ratio (crash rate divided by crash-free rate) for this specific user cohort?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0694.zh: 对于所有在 2018年9月 首次打开应用程序然后在 7 天内卸载的用户，经历过应用程序崩溃 (app_exception) 的百分比是多少？首先将时间戳转换为日期，然后根据日期计算卸载天数。在移动应用程序性能基准测试中分析此崩溃率指标时，该特定用户群体的崩溃与稳定比（崩溃率除以无崩溃率）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0693.source: Could you please help me get the weekly customer retention rate in September 2018 for new customers who first used our app (first_open event) within the first week starting from September 1st, 2018 (timezone in Shanghai)? The retention rates should cover the following weeks 1, 2, and 3 period after the initial use and display them in column format. For strategic planning purposes, if you apply the standard retention velocity formula (week 2 rate divided by week 1 rate) to predict the momentum of user engagement, what does this velocity coefficient reveal about the app's stickiness factor?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0693.zh: 您能否帮我获取从 2018年9月1日（上海时区）开始的第一周内首次使用我们应用程序的新客户（first_open 事件）在 2018年9月的每周客户保留率 吗？保留率应涵盖初次使用后接下来的几周 1、2 和 3 期间，并以列格式显示。出于战略规划的目的，如果您应用标准留存速度公式（周 2 比率除以周 1 比率）来预测用户参与度的动量，则该速度系数揭示了有关应用粘性因子的什么信息？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0698.source: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years? Considering the impact of major societal disruptions on traffic patterns, if we calculate the decade difference from this anomalous year and then square that value to understand the exponential impact of time on traffic data reliability, what would be the mathematical result and its significance for traffic safety trend analysis?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0698.zh: 哪一年最常见的两个交通事故原因与其他年份不同？考虑到重大社会扰动对交通模式的影响，如果我们计算与异常年份的十年差异，然后将该值平方以了解时间对交通数据可靠性的指数影响，那么数学结果是什么及其对交通安全趋势分析的意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0696.source: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages? If this sum represents 4 days of smoothed predictions, and considering that ARIMA models typically show 85% accuracy for short-term forecasting while linear regression shows 70% accuracy, what would be the confidence-adjusted expected range for total sales during this period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0696.zh: 您能否使用 2017年1月1日 到 2018年8月29日 的每日销售数据，通过简单的线性回归计算 12 月 5 至 8、2018 的预测玩具销售额的 5 天对称移动平均值型号？最后提供这四个 5 日移动平均线的总和？如果该总和代表 4 天的平滑预测，并且考虑到 ARIMA 模型通常显示 85% 短期预测的准确性，而线性回归显示 70% 准确性，那么此期间总销售额的置信调整预期范围是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0697.source: According to the RFM definition document, calculate the average sales per order for each customer within distinct RFM segments, considering only 'delivered' orders. Use the customer unique identifier. Based on the analysis, what is the percentage difference between the highest performing and lowest performing customer segments when comparing their average sales metrics?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0697.zh: 根据 RFM 定义文档，计算不同 RFM 细分中每个客户的平均销售额，仅考虑'delivered'（已交付）订单。使用客户唯一标识符。根据分析，在比较平均销售指标时，表现最高和表现最低的客户群之间的百分比差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0702.source: Among all cities with delivered orders, find the five cities whose summed payments are the lowest, then calculate the average of their total payments and the average of their total delivered order counts. In food delivery analytics, when evaluating market efficiency using the square root of the average payment multiplied by the average order count, then multiplied by 10 for scaling, what does this composite efficiency score reveal about operational strategy for these low-revenue cities?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0702.zh: 在所有已发货的城市中，找到付款总额最低的五个城市，然后计算其总付款的平均值和已发货订单总数的平均值。在食品配送分析中，当使用平均付款的平方根乘以平均订单数，然后乘以 10 来评估市场效率时，这个综合效率得分揭示了这些低收入城市的运营策略的哪些内容？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0699.source: What is the highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with the lowest annual delivered orders volume among 2016, 2017, and 2018? Considering data quality assessment methodologies similar to those used in the TSCAN model evaluation for merchant order volume prediction, if we calculate the reliability coefficient by taking the natural logarithm and multiplying by the standard deviation factor used in uplift modeling, what data reliability score emerges?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0699.zh: 2016、2017、2018 年，当年月发货量最高、年发货量最低的是多少？考虑到与商户订单量预测的 TSCAN 模型评估中使用的数据质量评估方法类似，如果我们通过取自然对数并乘以提升建模中使用的标准差因子来计算可靠性系数，则会出现什么数据可靠性得分？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0701.source: Among all cities with delivered orders, find the five cities whose summed payments are the lowest, then calculate the average of their total payments and the average of their total delivered order counts. For operational efficiency assessment in food delivery markets, if the ratio of average payment to average order count is calculated and then converted to a percentage, what does this metric indicate about market penetration in these underperforming cities?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0701.zh: 在所有已发货的城市中，找到付款总额最低的五个城市，然后计算其总付款的平均值和已发货订单总数的平均值。对于外卖市场的运营效率评估，如果计算平均支付与平均订单数的比率，然后转换为百分比，那么这个指标反映了这些表现不佳城市的市场渗透率吗？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0700.source: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers. Based on this customer analysis and considering geographic market penetration strategies, what is the ratio of the highest average payment value to the sum of the two São Paulo customers' average payment values, multiplied by 100 to express market concentration intensity?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0700.zh: 请根据 customer_unique_id 确定已交付订单数最多的前三位客户，并提供每个客户的平均付款金额、城市和州。根据该客户分析并考虑地理市场渗透策略，最高平均支付额与两个圣保罗客户平均支付额之和的比率是多少，乘以100来表示市场集中度？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0703.source: Among all cities with delivered orders, find the five cities whose summed payments are the lowest, then calculate the average of their total payments and the average of their total delivered order counts. For strategic business analysis in food delivery markets, if we calculate the logarithm base 10 of the average payment, then multiply by the square of the average order count, and finally multiply by 100 for practical scaling, what does this advanced metric indicate about the mathematical relationship between payment patterns and order frequency in these underperforming markets?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0703.zh: 在所有已发货的城市中，找到付款总额最低的五个城市，然后计算其总付款的平均值和已发货订单总数的平均值。对于食品配送市场的战略业务分析，如果我们计算平均支付的对数底 10，然后乘以平均订单数的平方，最后乘以 100 以进行实际扩展，那么这个高级指标表明这些表现不佳的市场中支付模式与订单频率之间的数学关系是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0705.source: Identify the top three product categories whose most commonly used payment type has the highest number of payments across all categories, and specify the number of payments made in each category using that payment type. Based on Federal Reserve data showing debit cards account for 30% of payments and credit cards for 32%, calculate the ratio coefficient between the second and third ranked categories and determine its strategic implications:
7-30/FDABench/FDA0705.zh: 确定最常用付款类型在所有类别中付款次数最多的前三个产品类别，并指定每个类别中使用该付款类型进行的付款次数。根据美联储数据显示借记卡支付金额为 30%，信用卡支付金额为 32%，计算排名第二和第三类别之间的比率系数并确定其战略含义：

7-30/FDABench/FDA0706.source: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique product counts for 2020 in the output, ordered by the highest percentage increase in unique fact sales products from 2020 to 2021? Given the manufacturing performance improvements and market segmentation patterns, what is the composite efficiency ratio when applying logarithmic transformation to segment product counts and factoring in the 21.51% ForeSight agent improvement mentioned in manufacturing analytics?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0706.zh: 您能否提供一份硬件产品细分列表以及输出中 2020 年的独特产品数量（按从 2020 年到 2021 年的独特事实销售产品的最高百分比增幅排序）？考虑到制造性能的改进和市场细分模式，当应用对数变换来细分产品数量并考虑制造分析中提到的 21.51% ForeSight 代理改进时，复合效率比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0704.source: Identify the top three product categories whose most commonly used payment type has the highest number of payments across all categories, and specify the number of payments made in each category using that payment type. Given the dominance of card payments in retail (approximately 62% of all payments), calculate the percentage share of total card payments that the top category represents if the combined card payments for these three categories constitute 68.5% of their respective market segments:
7-30/FDABench/FDA0704.zh: 确定最常用付款类型在所有类别中付款次数最多的前三个产品类别，并指定每个类别中使用该付款类型进行的付款次数。鉴于卡支付在零售业中的主导地位（大约占所有支付的 62%），如果这三个类别的卡支付组合构成其各自细分市场的 68.5%，请计算顶级类别所代表的卡支付总额的百分比份额：

7-30/FDABench/FDA0709.source: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month. Given this methodology, if you calculate the percentage growth rate from February to March and then apply the reciprocal of that rate as a multiplier to the March total, what would be the resulting value and its significance for predictive modeling?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0709.zh: 对于每个月，计算上个月所有用户的总余额（从每月 1 日开始计算），并将任何负余额替换为零。确保第一个月的数据仅用作计算先前总余额的基线，并将其从最终输出中排除。按月份升序对结果进行排序。根据这种方法，如果您计算从 2 月到 3 月的增长率百分比，然后将该增长率的倒数用作 3 月份总数的乘数，则所得值及其对预测建模的意义是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0708.source: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month's closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month's growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month's balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month's balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month's balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%. If this analysis were applied to segment customers for targeted financial products, what would be the complementary percentage of customers NOT showing high growth?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0708.zh: 对于每个客户，按每月第一天将所有存款和取款进行分组，以获得每月净额，然后通过将这些每月净额累计相加来计算每个月的期末余额。接下来，通过期末余额与上月余额的比较，确定最近一个月的增长率，存款为正，取款为负，如果上月余额为零，则增长率为当月余额乘以100。最后，计算最近一个月增长率超过 5% 的客户百分比。如果将此分析应用于目标金融产品的细分客户，未表现出高增长的客户的互补百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0710.source: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total. For advanced portfolio analytics, if you calculate the ratio of peak month to trough month and then apply the square root transformation (commonly used in financial volatility modeling), what would this metric indicate about portfolio concentration risk and capital adequacy requirements?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0710.zh: 对于每个客户，通过结转前一天的余额来计算其最早和最晚交易日期之间每天的每日余额，包括没有交易的天数。将任何负每日余额视为零。然后，对于每个月，确定每个客户在该月内拥有的最高每日余额。最后，对于每个月，将所有客户的这些最大每日余额相加，以获得每月总额。对于高级投资组合分析，如果您计算高峰月与低谷月的比率，然后应用平方根变换（常用于金融波动建模），那么该指标将表明投资组合集中度风险和资本充足性要求的什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0707.source: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month's closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month's growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month's balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month's balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month's balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%. Given the calculated percentage, what would be the ratio of high-growth customers to total customers expressed as a decimal?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0707.zh: 对于每个客户，按每月第一天将所有存款和取款进行分组，以获得每月净额，然后通过将这些每月净额累计相加来计算每个月的期末余额。接下来，通过期末余额与上月余额的比较，确定最近一个月的增长率，存款为正，取款为负，如果上月余额为零，则增长率为当月余额乘以100。最后，计算最近一个月增长率超过 5% 的客户百分比。根据计算出的百分比，高增长客户占客户总数的比例（用小数表示）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0714.source: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. When applying market concentration analysis principles to compare the composition value variance between the highest and lowest performing categories, what is the logarithmic spread coefficient, and how does this metric correlate with market segmentation patterns observed in concentrated digital interest markets?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0714.zh: 根据所有月份的最高构成值确定最高的 10 和最低的 10 兴趣类别。当应用市场集中度分析原理来比较最高和最低表现类别之间的构成值差异时，对数价差系数是多少，以及该指标如何与集中的数字兴趣市场中观察到的市场细分模式相关？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0713.source: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. Considering the temporal distribution analysis, what is the squared difference ratio between the number of July 2018 appearances in top categories versus other months combined, and what does this computational metric reveal about peak engagement periods in interest category performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0713.zh: 根据所有月份的最高构成值确定最高的 10 和最低的 10 兴趣类别。考虑到时间分布分析，2018年7月 出现在顶级类别中的次数与其他月份的总和之间的平方差比是多少，这个计算指标揭示了兴趣类别表现中的峰值参与期的什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0712.source: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. When analyzing the seasonal trend patterns for luxury-related categories in the top composition rankings, what percentage of the top 10 categories are luxury-focused, and what does this concentration ratio indicate about premium consumer behavior during data collection periods?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0712.zh: 根据所有月份的最高构成值确定最高的 10 和最低的 10 兴趣类别。在分析顶级构成排名中奢侈品相关类别的季节性趋势模式时，顶级 10 个类别中以奢侈品为重点的百分比是多少？这个集中率表明数据收集期间的高端消费者行为是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0711.source: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out. Based on this product performance analysis, what is the average cart abandonment rate across all remaining products, and what strategic insights does this reveal about customer purchasing behavior? Calculate the cart abandonment rate as (products left in cart without purchase / products added to cart) × 100.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0711.zh: 您能否提供详细信息，说明每种产品被查看的次数、它们被添加到购物车的次数以及它们留在购物车中而未被购买的次数？另外，请提供每种产品的实际购买数量。确保页面 ID 为 (1、2、12、13) 的产品被过滤掉。根据此产品性能分析，所有剩余产品的平均购物车放弃率是多少，这揭示了有关客户购买行为的哪些战略见解？计算购物车放弃率为（购物车中未购买的产品/添加到购物车的产品）× 100。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0717.source: Among job postings that specifically have the Data Analyst, require a non-null annual average salary, and are remote, what is the overall average salary when considering only the top three most frequently demanded skills for these positions? If we calculate the percentage by which this specialized salary exceeds the general market average for remote Data Analyst positions, what strategic insight does this reveal?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0717.zh: 在专门有数据分析师、要求非空年平均工资且远程的职位发布中，仅考虑这些职位最常需要的前三项技能时，总体平均工资是多少？如果我们计算这种专业薪资超过远程数据分析师职位一般市场平均水平的百分比，这揭示了什么战略洞察力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0718.source: Among job postings that specifically have the Data Analyst, require a non-null annual average salary, and are remote, what is the overall average salary when considering only the top three most frequently demanded skills for these positions? When analyzing the squared ratio of this specialized salary to the 75th percentile threshold of general remote analyst positions, what does this mathematical relationship reveal about market positioning?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0718.zh: 在专门有数据分析师、要求非空年平均工资且远程的职位发布中，仅考虑这些职位最常需要的前三项技能时，总体平均工资是多少？在分析这种专业薪资与一般远程分析师职位的 第 75 百分位数阈值的平方比时，这种数学关系揭示了有关市场定位的什么信息？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0719.source: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term? Considering that long-serving legislators represent institutional memory and the total tracked legislators across all periods, calculate the cumulative legislative experience coefficient as the sum of (legislators × years served) divided by total unique positions tracked.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0719.zh: 对于来自路易斯安那州的男性立法者，有多少名不同的立法者在每年 12 月 31 积极任职，从他们第一次任期以来的 30 年以上到不到 50 年，将结果按他们第一次任期以来经过的确切年数进行分组？考虑到长期任职的立法者代表了机构记忆和所有时期跟踪的立法者总数，将累积立法经验系数计算为（立法者×任职年数）之和除以跟踪的独特职位总数。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0720.source: How many distinct pseudo users had positive engagement time in the 7-day period ending on January 7, 2021 at 23:59:59, but had no positive engagement time in the 2-day period ending on the same date? Considering GA4's engagement_time_msec tracking and the typical 2-5 day re-engagement window for inactive users, if we calculate the cube root of the inactive user count and multiply by 23 (representing daily optimization cycles), what would be the recommended daily touchpoint frequency for maximum re-engagement effectiveness?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0720.zh: 有多少不同的伪用户在截至 2021年1月7日、23:59:59 的 7 日期间具有积极参与时间，但在同一日期结束的 2 日期间没有积极参与时间？考虑到 GA4 的 engagement_time_msec 跟踪和非活跃用户的典型 2-5 日再互动窗口，如果我们计算非活跃用户数的立方根并乘以 23（代表每日优化周期），那么为了获得最大再互动效果，建议的每日接触点频率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0721.source: Which traffic source has the highest total transaction revenue for the year 2017, and what is the difference in millions (rounded to two decimal places) between the highest and lowest monthly total transaction revenue for that traffic source? Based on e-commerce seasonality patterns, if you calculate the ratio of the monthly revenue difference to the square root of 100, what strategic insight does this ratio provide for budget allocation?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0721.zh: 2017 年度哪个流量源的总交易收入最高，该流量源的最高月总交易收入与最低月总交易收入之间以百万为单位（四舍五入到小数点后两位）的差值是多少？根据电子商务季节性模式，如果计算每月收入差异与 100 平方根的比率，该比率为预算分配提供什么战略洞察？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0722.source: In January 2017, among visitors whose campaign name contains 'Data Share' and who accessed any page starting with '/home', which page did they most commonly visit next, and what is the maximum time (in seconds) they spent on the '/home' page before moving on? Given the significant shift toward data analytics in 2017 and the concern for user experience optimization, calculate the efficiency ratio by dividing the maximum time spent by the standard conversion benchmark of 60 seconds, then determine what percentage this represents for campaign effectiveness measurement.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0722.zh: 2017年1月，在活动名称包含'Data Share'（数据共享）且访问以“/home”开头的任何页面的访问者中，他们接下来最常访问哪个页面，以及他们在继续之前在“/home”页面上花费的最长时间（以秒为单位）？鉴于 2017 年向数据分析的重大转变以及对用户体验优化的关注，通过将花费的最长时间除以 60 秒的标准转换基准来计算效率比，然后确定这代表了营销活动有效性衡量的百分比。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0723.source: In January 2017, among visitors whose campaign name contains 'Data Share' and who accessed any page starting with '/home', which page did they most commonly visit next, and what is the maximum time (in seconds) they spent on the '/home' page before moving on? Considering the 2017 context of emerging privacy restrictions and 'dark traffic' concerns affecting analytics accuracy, calculate the session intensity score by taking the square root of the maximum time spent, then multiply by the path complexity factor of 0.15 (representing the difficulty of tracking apparel category transitions).
7-30/FDABench/FDA0723.zh: 2017年1月，在活动名称包含'Data Share'（数据共享）且访问以“/home”开头的任何页面的访问者中，他们接下来最常访问哪个页面，以及他们在继续之前在“/home”页面上花费的最长时间（以秒为单位）？考虑到 2017 年新兴的隐私限制和影响分析准确性的'dark traffic'（暗流量）问题，通过取最大花费时间的平方根来计算会话强度分数，然后乘以 0.15 的路径复杂性因子（表示跟踪服装类别转换的难度）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0724.source: Identify the longest number of days between the first visit and the last recorded event (either the last visit or the first transaction) for a user, where the last recorded event is associated with a mobile device. When measuring user engagement duration for mobile-focused retention strategies, what is the optimal customer segmentation threshold expressed as a percentage of one full year, using the maximum observed engagement period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0724.zh: 确定用户的首次访问和上次记录的事件（上次访问或第一次交易）之间的最长天数，其中上次记录的事件与移动设备相关联。在衡量以移动设备为中心的保留策略的用户参与持续时间时，使用观察到的最大参与期，以一整年的百分比表示的最佳客户细分阈值是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0726.source: Identify the longest number of days between the first visit and the last recorded event (either the last visit or the first transaction) for a user, where the last recorded event is associated with a mobile device. When implementing Buy Till You Die (BTYD) models for mobile user behavior prediction, what is the square root of the maximum engagement duration multiplied by customer lifetime value scaling factor of 10, and how does this relate to predictive modeling accuracy?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0726.zh: 确定用户的首次访问和上次记录的事件（上次访问或第一次交易）之间的最长天数，其中上次记录的事件与移动设备相关联。在实施 Buy Till You Die (BTYD) 模型进行移动用户行为预测时，最大参与持续时间乘以客户终生价值缩放因子 10 的平方根是多少，这与预测建模准确性有何关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0725.source: Identify the longest number of days between the first visit and the last recorded event (either the last visit or the first transaction) for a user, where the last recorded event is associated with a mobile device. For RFM analysis segmentation in mobile-first customer relationship management, what is the recency threshold in weeks that would capture users with maximum observed engagement duration, and what strategic implication does this have?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0725.zh: 确定用户的首次访问和上次记录的事件（上次访问或第一次交易）之间的最长天数，其中上次记录的事件与移动设备相关联。对于移动优先客户关系管理中的 RFM 分析细分，捕获具有最大观察参与持续时间的用户的新近阈值（以周为单位）是多少，这有什么战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0727.source: What were the monthly add-to-cart and purchase conversion rates, calculated as a percentage of pageviews on product details, from January to March 2017? Considering the funnel efficiency metric (calculated as purchase rate divided by add-to-cart rate, then multiplied by 100), which statement best describes the quarterly trend and its strategic implications for optimizing the conversion funnel?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0727.zh: 从 1 月到 2017年3月，每月的添加到购物车和购买转化率（按产品详细信息页面浏览量的百分比计算）是多少？考虑到渠道效率指标（计算方式为购买率除以添加到购物车率，然后乘以 100），哪种说法最能描述季度趋势及其对优化转化渠道的战略影响？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0729.source: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020. Based on the co-purchase patterns, if you calculate the average monthly cross-selling effectiveness ratio (defined as the sum of co-purchased item quantities divided by the number of distinct months, then multiplied by 100 for percentage representation), what does this metric indicate about the Google Merchandise Store's bundling strategy performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0729.zh: 请告诉我从 2020年11月 开始的三个月内每月购买 Google Red Speckled Tee 的客户购买最多的其他产品及其数量。根据共同购买模式，如果您计算平均每月交叉销售有效性比率（定义为共同购买商品数量的总和除以不同月份的数量，然后乘以 100 以表示百分比），那么该指标对 Google Merchandise Store 的捆绑策略绩效有何影响？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0730.source: I'm trying to evaluate which board types were most effective on September 15, 2018. Based on the average scores for each board type from quick play mode completions, what is the combined percentage representation when the highest-scoring board type's average is added to the lowest-scoring board type's average and expressed as a percentage of the total sum of all board type averages?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0730.zh: 我正在尝试评估哪些主板类型在 2018年9月15日 上最有效。根据快速游戏模式完成的每种棋盘类型的平均分数，当得分最高的棋盘类型的平均值添加到得分最低的棋盘类型的平均值并以所有棋盘类型平均值总和的百分比表示时，组合百分比表示是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0731.source: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn't in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser. Given the typical e-commerce conversion rate of 1.4% for general online stores, if this platform had 10,000 unique visitors and the average difference in pageviews between purchasers and non-purchasers follows the calculated pattern, what would be the total additional pageviews generated by purchaser behavior compared to if all users browsed like non-purchasers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0731.zh: 您能算出 2020年12月 购买商品的用户和未购买商品的用户之间浏览量的平均差异吗？只需将参与购买活动的任何人标记为购买者即可。考虑到一般在线商店的典型电子商务转化率为 1.4%，如果该平台具有 10,000 唯一访问者，并且购买者和非购买者之间的浏览量平均差异遵循计算的模式，那么与所有用户都像非购买者一样浏览相比，购买者行为产生的总额外浏览量是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0732.source: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn't in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser. Considering that December 2020 saw 33% higher engagement rates due to pandemic shopping, if this pageview differential needs to be adjusted for seasonal inflation to determine the true underlying behavioral difference, what would be the seasonally-adjusted core difference in pageviews, and how does this relate to the standard deviation impact on conversion optimization strategies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0732.zh: 您能算出 2020年12月 购买商品的用户和未购买商品的用户之间浏览量的平均差异吗？只需将参与购买活动的任何人标记为购买者即可。考虑到 2020年12月 因大流行购物而导致 33% 的参与率更高，如果需要根据季节性通货膨胀调整此页面浏览量差异以确定真正的潜在行为差异，那么页面浏览量的季节性调整核心差异是什么？这与标准差对转化优化策略的影响有何关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0733.source: Could you provide the total number of page views for each day in November 2020 as well as the average number of page views per user on those days, restricted to users who made at least one purchase in November 2020? Based on the data, if we calculate the coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean) for the average page views per user across all days in November, which range best describes this metric and its implications for user engagement consistency?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0733.zh: 您能否提供 2020年11月 每天的总页面浏览量以及这些天每个用户的平均页面浏览数（仅限于 2020年11月 至少进行过一次购买的用户）？根据数据，如果我们计算 11 月份所有天每个用户的平均页面浏览量的变异系数（标准差除以平均值），哪个范围最能描述该指标及其对用户参与一致性的影响？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0734.source: How many distinct users viewed the most frequently visited page during January 2021? If we calculate the engagement rate by determining what percentage of the distinct users represents when compared to a benchmark of one million users, and then apply a growth factor by multiplying this percentage by 2.5 (representing typical engagement amplification), what would be the resulting engagement coefficient?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0734.zh: 2021年1月 期间有多少不同用户查看了最常访问的页面？如果我们通过确定与 100 万用户的基准相比，不同用户所占的百分比来计算参与率，然后通过将该百分比乘以 2.5（代表典型的参与放大）来应用增长因子，那么最终的参与系数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0736.source: Please find out what percentage of the page views on January 2, 2021, were for PDP type pages. If this e-commerce site experienced typical post-holiday shopping patterns where customer engagement intensity (measured as the square of the PDP percentage) indicates conversion potential, what would be the engagement intensity score? Calculate by squaring the PDP percentage value.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0736.zh: 请查明 2021年1月2日 的页面浏览量中 PDP 类型页面的百分比是多少。如果该电子商务网站经历了典型的节后购物模式，其中客户参与强度（以 PDP 百分比的平方衡量）表明了转化潜力，那么参与强度得分是多少？通过 PDP 百分比值的平方进行计算。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0735.source: How many distinct users viewed the most frequently visited page during January 2021? To assess market penetration efficiency, calculate the user density index by taking the square root of the distinct user count, then multiply by a scaling factor of 1.8, and finally determine what percentage this represents of a target threshold of 500 users. What is the resulting penetration efficiency score?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0735.zh: 2021年1月 期间有多少不同用户查看了最常访问的页面？要评估市场渗透效率，请通过不同用户数的平方根计算用户密度指数，然后乘以缩放因子 1.8，最后确定该指数占 500 用户目标阈值的百分比。渗透效率得分是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0737.source: Please find out what percentage of the page views on January 2, 2021, were for PDP type pages. In e-commerce conversion analysis, if we calculate the productivity ratio by taking the square root of the PDP percentage to understand the baseline conversion factor for strategic planning, what would be the baseline conversion factor?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0737.zh: 请计算2021年1月2日的页面浏览量中，PDP类型页面所占的百分比。在电商转化分析中，若将PDP百分比的平方根作为生产率比值，用于理解战略规划中的基准转化因子，那么该基准转化因子是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0739.source: I want to know the user session conversion rate on January 2nd, 2021, using only 'page_view' events. The conversion rate should be calculated as the percentage of user visits that reached both the Home and Checkout Confirmation pages in one session, relative to those that landed on the Home page. In digital analytics optimization, conversion rates are often analyzed using the coefficient of variation formula (standard deviation divided by mean) for performance consistency evaluation. If we assume the daily standard deviation of conversion rates is typically half the actual rate value, what would be the coefficient of variation for this conversion rate, and what does this metric indicate about conversion stability?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0739.zh: 我想知道仅使用“page_view”事件时 2021年1月2日 的用户会话转化率。转化率应计算为在一个会话中同时到达主页和结账确认页面的用户访问量相对于登陆主页的用户访问量的百分比。在数字分析优化中，通常使用变异系数公式（标准差除以平均值）来分析转化率，以进行性能一致性评估。如果我们假设转化率的每日标准差通常是实际转化率值的一半，那么该转化率的变异系数是多少，该指标对转化稳定性有何影响？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0738.source: Please find out what percentage of the page views on January 2, 2021, were for PDP type pages. For strategic business insight, if we calculate the commerce intensity index by dividing the PDP percentage by 4 (representing quarterly assessment periods), then multiplying by 3 (for seasonal adjustment factor), what would be the resulting commerce intensity index for decision-making purposes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0738.zh: 请查明 2021年1月2日 的页面浏览量中 PDP 类型页面的百分比是多少。对于战略业务洞察，如果我们通过将 PDP 百分比除以 4（代表季度评估期），然后乘以 3（代表季节调整因子）来计算商业强度指数，那么用于决策目的的商业强度指数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0742.source: Could you tell me the average number of engaged sessions per user for December 2020, counting only those sessions where the event parameter 'session_engaged' is equal to '1' and using 'user_pseudo_id' combined with the 'ga_session_id' to identify distinct sessions? Based on this data, if you wanted to express this metric as a percentage of sessions that would need to be added to reach exactly one engaged session per user on average, what would be the percentage increase required and what strategic implication does this have for user experience optimization?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0742.zh: 您能否告诉我 2020年12月 每个用户的平均参与会话数，仅计算事件参数“session_engaged”等于“1”的会话，并使用“user_pseudo_id”与“ga_session_id”组合来识别不同的会话？根据这些数据，如果您想将此指标表示为需要添加的会话百分比，以便平均每个用户恰好有一个参与会话，那么所需的百分比增加是多少，这对用户体验优化有何战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0743.source: Could you tell me the average number of engaged sessions per user for December 2020, counting only those sessions where the event parameter 'session_engaged' is equal to '1' and using 'user_pseudo_id' combined with the 'ga_session_id' to identify distinct sessions? Given that industry benchmarks suggest B2C engagement rates should exceed 71%, and assuming each user had an average of 2.3 total sessions (typical web benchmark), what is the implied current engagement rate and how does this compare to optimal performance standards for strategic planning?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0743.zh: 您能否告诉我 2020年12月 每个用户的平均参与会话数，仅计算事件参数“session_engaged”等于“1”的会话，并使用“user_pseudo_id”与“ga_session_id”组合来识别不同的会话？鉴于行业基准表明 B2C 参与率应超过 71%，并假设每个用户的平均会话总数为 2.3（典型的网络基准），那么当前隐含的参与率是多少？与战略规划的最佳绩效标准相比如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0728.source: What were the monthly add-to-cart and purchase conversion rates, calculated as a percentage of pageviews on product details, from January to March 2017? Given that industry benchmarks showed desktop conversion rates around 3.24% and mobile around 2.44% in early 2017, calculate the performance multiplier (actual purchase rate divided by industry average of 2.84%) for each month to assess competitive positioning. Which analysis correctly interprets the quarterly performance trajectory?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0728.zh: 从 1 月到 2017年3月，每月的添加到购物车和购买转化率（按产品详细信息页面浏览量的百分比计算）是多少？鉴于行业基准显示早期 2017 的桌面转化率约为 3.24%，移动转化率约为 2.44%，请计算每个月的绩效乘数（实际购买率除以 2.84% 的行业平均值），以评估竞争定位。哪种分析正确地解释了季度业绩轨迹？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0716.source: For veg wholesale data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? For implementing a three-tier quality management system where resources are allocated proportionally based on performance distribution, what should be the resource allocation ratio between managing high-loss items, standard items, and low-loss items, calculated using the inverse performance weighting method to prioritize problem areas?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0716.zh: 对于蔬菜批发数据，您能否生成我们商品损失率的摘要？为了实施根据绩效分配按比例分配资源的三级质量管理体系，使用逆绩效加权法计算管理高损失项目、标准项目和低损失项目之间的资源分配比例应该是多少，以对问题领域进行优先排序？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0740.source: For the date range November 1–30, 2020, can you retrieve each user_pseudo_id and its average purchase revenue in USD per session for users who had more than one purchase session, considering only events with event_name='purchase' and a non-null ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd, grouping sessions by the ga_session_id from event_params. Considering the bipartite nature of buyer-seller networks in online marketplaces, what percentage of qualifying users have average purchase revenue per session values that fall within one standard deviation above the mean?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0740.zh: 对于日期范围 11 月 1–30、2020，您能否检索每个 user_pseudo_id 及其每个会话的平均购买收入（以美元为单位），对于有多个购买会话的用户，仅考虑 event_name='purchase' 和非空 ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd 的事件，按ga_session_id 来自 event_params。考虑到在线市场中买卖双方网络的双向性质，有多少百分比的合格用户的每次会话平均购买收入值落在高于平均值一个标准差的范围内？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0741.source: For the date range November 1–30, 2020, can you retrieve each user_pseudo_id and its average purchase revenue in USD per session for users who had more than one purchase session, considering only events with event_name='purchase' and a non-null ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd, grouping sessions by the ga_session_id from event_params. Given the inter-platform competition dynamics observed in November 2020 marketplace studies, what is the ratio of users with above-median purchase revenue to total qualifying users, expressed as a simplified fraction?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0741.zh: 对于日期范围 2020年11月 1–30、，您能否检索每个 user_pseudo_id 及其每个会话的平均购买收入（以美元为单位），对于有多个购买会话的用户，仅考虑 event_name='purchase' 和非空 ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd 的事件，按ga_session_id 来自 event_params。鉴于 2020年11月 市场研究中观察到的平台间竞争动态，购买收入高于中位数的用户与合格用户总数的比例是多少（以简化分数表示）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0715.source: For veg wholesale data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Based on the normal distribution principle where approximately 68% of data falls within one standard deviation, what percentage of your total vegetable inventory exhibits loss rates that deviate significantly from the average (either exceptionally good or poor performance), and what strategic implication does this have for inventory management?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0715.zh: 对于蔬菜批发数据，您能否生成我们商品损失率的摘要？根据正态分布原则（大约 68% 的数据落在一个标准差范围内），您的蔬菜库存总量中出现损失率显着偏离平均值的百分比是多少（表现非常好或很差），这对库存管理有何战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0745.source: Could you determine what percentage of users either did not uninstall our app within seven days or never uninstalled it after installing during August and September 2018? Given this retention data, what would be the complement percentage representing users who did uninstall within the seven-day period, and how does this compare to industry standards? Calculate using the formula: Uninstall Rate = 100 - Retention Rate.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0745.zh: 您能否确定在 8 月和 2018年9月 期间安装后 7 天内没有卸载我们的应用程序或从未卸载过该应用程序的用户百分比是多少？鉴于此保留数据，代表在 7 天内卸载的用户的补充百分比是多少？这与行业标准相比如何？使用公式计算：卸载率 = 100 - 保留率。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0744.source: Could you tell me the average number of engaged sessions per user for December 2020, counting only those sessions where the event parameter 'session_engaged' is equal to '1' and using 'user_pseudo_id' combined with the 'ga_session_id' to identify distinct sessions? Considering this was during the holiday shopping season when engagement typically increases, if you calculate the reciprocal of this engagement metric to understand how many users it takes to generate one engaged session, and then apply the square root to normalize for seasonal variance, what insights does this transformed metric provide for capacity planning and resource allocation?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0744.zh: 您能否告诉我 2020年12月 每个用户的平均参与会话数，仅计算事件参数“session_engaged”等于“1”的会话，并使用“user_pseudo_id”与“ga_session_id”组合来识别不同的会话？考虑到这是在节日购物季期间，参与度通常会增加，如果您计算此参与度指标的倒数，以了解生成一次参与会话所需的用户数量，然后应用平方根来标准化季节性方差，那么此转换后的指标可为容量规划和资源分配提供哪些见解？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0749.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week. For advanced cohort analytics, if we calculate a retention optimization coefficient using the formula: (optimal cohort week number)³ ÷ 4 + 50, what coefficient value should guide our customer acquisition budget allocation strategy?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0749.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每组，计算第四周的保留率。对于高级群组分析，如果我们使用以下公式计算保留优化系数：（最佳群组周数）3 ÷ 4 + 50，什么系数值应该指导我们的客户获取预算分配策略？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0747.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week. Based on the cohort with the highest fourth-week retention rate, if we apply a retention scoring system where each week's position from July 2, 2018 is multiplied by 10 and added to 1000, what scoring value would the optimal cohort receive?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0747.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每组，计算第四周的保留率。基于第四周保留率最高的队列，如果我们应用保留评分系统，将 2018年7月2日 中的每周位置乘以 10，并添加到 1000，那么最佳队列会获得什么评分值？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0746.source: Could you determine what percentage of users either did not uninstall our app within seven days or never uninstalled it after installing during August and September 2018? For strategic planning purposes, if we want to calculate the retention coefficient (retention rate divided by 100, then squared to emphasize performance gaps), and compare this against the theoretical maximum performance coefficient of 1.0, what improvement factor would we need to achieve optimal retention? Use the formula: Improvement Factor = 1.0 / (Retention Rate/100)²
7-30/FDABench/FDA0746.zh: 您能否确定在 8 月和 2018年9月 期间安装后 7 天内没有卸载我们的应用程序或从未卸载过该应用程序的用户百分比是多少？出于战略规划的目的，如果我们要计算保留系数（保留率除以 100，然后平方以强调性能差距），并将其与 1.0 的理论最大性能系数进行比较，我们需要什么改进因子才能实现最佳保留？使用公式：改进因子 = 1.0 /（保留率/100）²

7-30/FDABench/FDA0748.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week. If we need to calculate a cohort performance index by taking the square root of the optimal cohort's week number (counting from July 2 as week 1) and multiplying by 100, rounded to the nearest whole number, what index value represents the best-performing cohort for strategic planning purposes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0748.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每组，计算第四周的保留率。如果我们需要通过取最佳群组周数（从 7 月 2 算作周 1）的平方根并乘以 100（四舍五入到最接近的整数）来计算群组绩效指数，那么哪个指数值代表用于战略规划目的表现最佳的群组？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0750.source: Conduct a weekly cohort analysis for user retention, starting from July 9, 2018, and ending on October 2, 2018. Group users by the week of their first session_start event (with weeks starting on Monday), and identify new users as those where the event_date matches the date of their user_first_touch_timestamp. Calculate the Week 2 retention rate for each weekly cohort. Analyzing the temporal trend from July to September, if you calculate the retention rate decline from the peak performing cohort to the lowest performing cohort and express this as a relative percentage decrease, what does this metric reveal about seasonal user behavior patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0750.zh: 每周对用户保留进行一次队列分析，从 2018年7月9日 开始，到 2018年10月2日 结束。按首次 session_start 活动的周对用户进行分组（周数从周一开始），并将新用户识别为 event_date 与 user_first_touch_timestamp 的日期匹配的用户。计算每个每周队列的周 2 保留率。分析 7 月到 9 月的时间趋势，如果您计算从表现最佳群组到表现最低群组的保留率下降情况，并将其表示为相对百分比下降，那么该指标可以揭示有关季节性用户行为模式的什么信息？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0751.source: Please perform a 7-day retention analysis for users who first session start the app during the week starting on July 2, 2018. For each week from Week 0 to Week 4, provide retention rates. Based on industry standards for mobile apps where achieving 20% retention by Week 2 indicates strong user engagement, calculate the percentage point difference between this cohort's Week 2 retention rate and the industry benchmark. What does this metric reveal about user engagement quality?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0751.zh: 请对从 2018年7月2日 开始的一周内首次会话启动应用程序的用户执行 7 天保留分析。对于从 0 周到 4 周的每一周，提供保留率。根据移动应用程序的行业标准（按周 2 实现 20% 留存率表明用户参与度很高），计算该群组的周 2 留存率与行业基准之间的百分点差异。该指标揭示了用户参与质量的哪些方面？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0752.source: Please perform a 7-day retention analysis for users who first session start the app during the week starting on July 2, 2018. For each week from Week 0 to Week 4, analyze the user churn patterns. In cohort analysis, the churn velocity coefficient is calculated as the ratio of users lost between consecutive weeks divided by the average user base of those weeks, then multiplied by 100. What is the churn velocity coefficient between Week 1 and Week 2, and what retention strategy should be prioritized?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0752.zh: 请对从 2018年7月2日 开始的一周内首次会话启动应用程序的用户执行 7 天保留分析。对于从第 0 周到第 4 周的每一周，分析用户流失模式。在群组分析中，流失速度系数的计算方法为连续几周之间流失的用户比率除以这些周的平均用户基数，然后乘以 100。周 1 和周 2 之间的流失速度系数是多少，应优先考虑哪种保留策略？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0754.source: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Given the calculated sum, what would be the average daily toy sales prediction if we apply a seasonal adjustment factor of 1.2 for December holiday period and then calculate the mean daily value across the four-day period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0754.zh: 您能否使用 2017年1月1日 到 2018年8月29日 的每日销售数据，通过简单的线性回归计算 12 月 5 至 8、2018 的预测玩具销售额的 5 天对称移动平均值型号？根据计算出的总和，如果我们对 12 月假期期间应用季节调整因子 1.2，然后计算四天期间的日均值，那么平均每日玩具销售预测是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0753.source: What is the retention rate for users two weeks after their initial quickplay event, calculated separately for each quickplay event type, within the period from July 2, 2018, to July 16, 2018? Please focus on users who started a session (session_start) during this period. Based on cohort analysis principles for determining the performance gap between the highest and lowest performing quickplay event types, calculate the relative retention advantage by dividing the highest retention rate by the lowest retention rate. This ratio indicates the multiplicative difference in user engagement effectiveness between the best and worst performing game modes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0753.zh: 从 2018年7月2日 到 2018年7月16日 期间，针对每种快速游戏活动类型分别计算的用户首次快速游戏活动两周后的留存率是多少？请重点关注在此期间启动会话（session_start）的用户。根据用于确定表现最高和表现最低的快速游戏事件类型之间的表现差距的群组分析原则，通过将最高保留率除以最低保留率来计算相对保留优势。该比率表示最佳和最差游戏模式之间用户参与有效性的乘法差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0760.source: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years? Based on traffic safety research methodology, if we calculate the abnormality index by taking the square of the last two digits of the identified year and then converting it to a percentage representation, what does this indicate about the significance of statistical anomalies in traffic pattern analysis?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0760.zh: 哪一年最常见的两个交通事故原因与其他年份不同？根据交通安全研究方法，如果我们将识别年份的最后两位数平方，然后将其转换为百分比表示来计算异常指数，这说明统计异常在交通模式分析中的意义是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0757.source: When calculating fatality rates for motorcycle collisions separated by helmet usage, analyzing the percentage of motorcyclist fatalities in collisions where parties were wearing helmets versus not wearing helmets, what is the ratio of the helmet-wearing fatality rate to the non-helmet-wearing fatality rate, and what does this suggest about safety equipment effectiveness in preventing deaths?

7-30/FDABench/FDA0763.source: For the primary collision factor violation category that was the most common cause of traffic accidents in 2021, how many percentage points did its share of annual road incidents in 2021 decrease compared to its share in 2011? 7-30/FDABench/FDA0763.zh: 对于 2021 年交通事故最常见原因的主要碰撞因素违规类别，其在 2021 年的年度道路事故比例与 2011 年的比例相比下降了多少个百分点？如果我们将这种下降解释为每十年的变化率，并通过计算对数衰减系数（下降值的自然对数）来预测它，那么该系数揭示了该碰撞因素的长期轨迹及其对自动驾驶车辆集成规划的影响是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0769.source: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month's closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Given the importance of dormant user reactivation in social media platforms, what would be the theoretical weekly reactivation rate percentage if all these users were successfully re-engaged using targeted campaigns? (Calculate as: inactive users divided by total weekly active users, multiplied by 100, assuming total weekly active users are twice the inactive count)
7-30/FDABench/FDA0816.zh: 有多少不同的伪用户在截至 2021年1月7日、23:59:59 的 7 日期间具有积极参与时间，但在同一日期结束的 2 日期间没有积极参与时间？鉴于社交媒体平台中休眠用户重新激活的重要性，如果使用有针对性的活动成功重新吸引所有这些用户，理论上每周重新激活率百分比是多少？ （计算公式为：非活跃用户除以每周活跃用户总数，再乘以 100，假设每周活跃用户总数是非活跃用户数的两倍）

7-30/FDABench/FDA0817.source: Which traffic source has the highest total transaction revenue for the year 2017, and what is the difference in millions (rounded to two decimal places) between the highest and lowest monthly total transaction revenue for that traffic source? Considering this volatility in the context of e-commerce platform risk management, what percentage does this monthly difference represent if the average monthly revenue for this source was assumed to be 10 times the monthly difference?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0817.zh: 2017 年度哪个流量源的总交易收入最高，该流量源的最高月总交易收入与最低月总交易收入之间以百万为单位（四舍五入到小数点后两位）的差值是多少？考虑到电子商务平台风险管理背景下的这种波动性，如果假设该来源的平均月收入为 10 乘以月度差异，则该月度差异代表多少百分比？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0824.source: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year. Given that effective sales performance analysis requires examining both growth patterns and sales momentum, what is the compound effect of sequential year-over-year performance improvements, calculated as the ratio of the sum of positive percentage changes to the absolute value of negative changes, and what strategic implications does this reveal?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0824.zh: 对于每周销售数据，我需要对 2018、2019 和 2020 年的 6 月中旬左右的销售业绩进行分析。具体来说，计算每年 6 月 15 之前的四个星期与 6 月 15 之后的四个星期之间的销售额百分比变化。鉴于有效的销售业绩分析需要检查增长模式和销售势头，连续同比业绩改善的复合效应是什么（以正变化百分比总和与负变化绝对值之比计算），这揭示了哪些战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0819.source: In January 2017, among visitors whose campaign name contains 'Data Share' and who accessed any page starting with '/home', which page did they most commonly visit next, and what is the maximum time (in seconds) they spent on the '/home' page before moving on? Using Big Data analytics principles for behavioral segmentation, if you calculate the logarithmic engagement intensity by taking the natural logarithm of the maximum duration and multiply by 10 for scaling, what strategic implications does this have for Apache Hadoop-based user behavior analysis systems?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0819.zh: 2017年1月，在活动名称包含'Data Share'（数据共享）且访问以“/home”开头的任何页面的访问者中，他们接下来最常访问哪个页面，以及他们在继续之前在“/home”页面上花费的最长时间（以秒为单位）？使用大数据分析原理进行行为细分，如果通过最大持续时间的自然对数计算对数参与强度，并乘以 10 进行扩展，这对基于 Apache Hadoop 的用户行为分析系统有何战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0825.source: For credit transactions, what would be the average fee that the card scheme GlobalCard would charge for a transaction value of 10 EUR? Calculate the fee as a percentage of the transaction amount, considering that card schemes typically operate within industry-standard percentage ranges for merchant processing fees.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0825.zh: 对于信用交易，GlobalCard 卡组织对 10 欧元的交易金额收取的平均费用是多少？考虑到卡组织通常在商户处理费的行业标准百分比范围内运作，以交易金额的百分比计算费用。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0821.source: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out. Given e-commerce best practices suggest that premium products typically have lower view-to-cart conversion rates, which product demonstrates the highest purchase conversion efficiency relative to views, and what does this metric reveal about customer purchase intent? Calculate using: (actual purchases / product views) × 1000 for comparison precision.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0821.zh: 您能否提供详细信息，说明每种产品被查看的次数、它们被添加到购物车的次数以及它们留在购物车中而未被购买的次数？另外，请提供每种产品的实际购买数量。确保页面 ID 为 (1、2、12、13) 的产品被过滤掉。鉴于电子商务最佳实践表明，优质产品通常具有较低的浏览到购物车转化率，哪种产品相对于浏览量表现出最高的购买转化效率，以及该指标揭示了有关客户购买意图的什么信息？计算方法为：（实际购买量/产品浏览量）×1000，以达到比较精度。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0823.source: For veg wholesale data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Considering the relationship between items with exceptionally low loss rates and those with high loss rates, what is the efficiency index (ratio of low-loss to high-loss items) and how does this compare to industry benchmarks where optimal ratios typically range from 1.0 to 1.5 for balanced inventory management?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0823.zh: 对于蔬菜批发数据，您能否生成我们商品损失率的摘要？考虑到损失率极低的物品和损失率高的物品之间的关系，效率指数（低损失与高损失物品的比率）是多少？与平衡库存管理的最佳比率通常范围从 1.0 到 1.5 的行业基准相比如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0822.source: For veg wholesale data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? In wholesale vegetable inventory management, what is the approximate ratio of items with normal loss patterns (within one standard deviation) to items requiring immediate attention (above one standard deviation), and what does this suggest about operational efficiency?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0822.zh: 对于蔬菜批发数据，您能否生成我们商品损失率的摘要？在批发蔬菜库存管理中，具有正常损失模式（在一个标准差以内）的物品与需要立即关注的物品（在一个标准差以上）的大致比例是多少？这对运营效率有何影响？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0820.source: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total. If you calculate the percentage change in total allocation from the first month to the last month in the dataset and then square this percentage change, what does this squared value represent in terms of portfolio volatility assessment?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0820.zh: 对于每个客户，通过结转前一天的余额来计算其最早和最晚交易日期之间每天的每日余额，包括没有交易的天数。将任何负每日余额视为零。然后，对于每个月，确定每个客户在该月内拥有的最高每日余额。最后，对于每个月，将所有客户的这些最大每日余额相加，以获得每月总额。如果您计算数据集中从第一个月到最后一个月的总分配百分比变化，然后对这个百分比变化进行平方，那么这个平方值在投资组合波动性评估方面代表什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0830.source: How many debt indicators for Russia have a value of 0, excluding NULL values? Considering that Russia achieved net public debt of zero by 2019 while maintaining substantial commercial debt, if we calculate the square root of the zero-value indicators and multiply by the typical debt-to-GDP threshold for emerging markets (which is 4%), what risk coefficient emerges for assessing Russia's debt profile complexity?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0830.zh: 俄罗斯有多少个债务指标的值为 0（不包括 NULL 值）？考虑到俄罗斯在 2019 年时实现了净公共债务为零，同时仍保持大量商业债务，如果我们计算零值指标的平方根，并乘以新兴市场的典型债务与 GDP 阈值（即 4%），则评估俄罗斯债务状况复杂性的风险系数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0826.source: For credit transactions, what would be the average fee that the card scheme GlobalCard would charge for a transaction value of 10 EUR? Calculate the breakeven transaction volume needed monthly to justify a fixed processing terminal cost, assuming the merchant's profit margin per transaction is 8% and considering the compound effect of processing fees on overall profitability.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0826.zh: 对于信用交易，GlobalCard 卡组织对 10 欧元的交易金额收取的平均费用是多少？假设商户每笔交易的利润率为 8%，并考虑处理费对整体盈利能力的复合影响，计算每月所需的盈亏平衡交易量，以证明固定处理终端成本的合理性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0829.source: How many debt indicators for Russia have a value of 0, excluding NULL values? Given Russia's unique debt profile compared to major economies, if we analyze this result as a percentage of typical government debt metrics tracked by international organizations (assuming 25 standard debt metrics are commonly monitored), what percentage represents the zero-value indicators and what does this suggest about Russia's debt transparency?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0829.zh: 俄罗斯有多少个债务指标的值为 0（不包括 NULL 值）？考虑到俄罗斯与主要经济体相比独特的债务状况，如果我们将此结果分析为国际组织跟踪的典型政府债务指标的百分比（假设普遍监测 25 标准债务指标），那么零值指标所占的百分比是多少？这对俄罗斯的债务透明度意味着什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0831.source: Calculate the conversion rate from unique visitors to purchasers by using data exclusively from the web_analytics table in the data-to-insights.ecommerce dataset. A visitor is defined as a unique fullVisitorId present in the table, while a purchaser is a visitor who has at least one transaction recorded (totals.transactions is not null). The conversion rate is computed by dividing the number of unique purchasers by the total number of unique visitors. Additionally, calculate the average number of transactions per purchaser, considering only those visitors who have made at least one transaction. Given that industry benchmarks for e-commerce conversion rates are typically 1-2%, what percentage above the industry minimum benchmark does this platform's conversion rate represent, and what is the percentage increase in transaction frequency compared to the baseline of 1 transaction per purchaser?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0831.zh: 仅使用 data-toinsights.ecommerce 数据集中 web_analytics 表中的数据来计算从唯一访问者到购买者的转化率。访客被定义为表中存在的唯一 fullVisitorId，而购买者是至少记录了一笔交易的访客（totals.transactions 不为空）。转化率的计算方法是将独立购买者数量除以独立访问者总数。此外，计算每个购买者的平均交易次数，仅考虑至少进行过一笔交易的访问者。鉴于电子商务转化率的行业基准通常为 1-2%，该平台的转化率比行业最低基准高出多少百分比？与每个购买者的 1 交易基准相比，交易频率增加的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0833.source: Calculates the percentage of new users who, between August 1, 2016, and April 30, 2017, both stayed on the site for more than 5 minutes during their initial visit and made a purchase on a subsequent visit at any later time, relative to the total number of new users in the same period. Given this calculated percentage, what would be the expected conversion rate if you applied a standard e-commerce improvement factor of doubling the baseline engagement rate through targeted retention strategies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0833.zh: 计算在 2016年8月1日 和 2017年4月30日 之间，首次访问期间在网站上停留时间超过 5 分钟并在以后任何时间的后续访问中进行购买的新用户相对于同期新用户总数的百分比。根据这个计算出的百分比，如果您应用标准电子商务改进因素，通过有针对性的保留策略将基线参与率加倍，那么预期的转化率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0834.source: Calculates the percentage of new users who, between August 1, 2016, and April 30, 2017, both stayed on the site for more than 5 minutes during their initial visit and made a purchase on a subsequent visit at any later time, relative to the total number of new users in the same period. Given the context of buyer-seller networks and the use of Maximum Likelihood Estimation in product markets, what would be the natural logarithm transformation of this percentage, which is essential for log-likelihood calculations in BGNBD models for predicting customer transaction frequency and monetary value?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0834.zh: 计算在 2016年8月1日 和 2017年4月30日 之间，首次访问期间在网站上停留时间超过 5 分钟并在以后任何时间的后续访问中进行购买的新用户相对于同期新用户总数的百分比。考虑到买方-卖方网络的背景以及最大似然估计在产品市场中的使用，该百分比的自然对数变换是什么，这对于 BGNBD 模型中用于预测客户交易频率和货币价值的对数似然计算至关重要？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0835.source: Which high-income country had the highest average crude birth rate respectively in each region, and what are their corresponding average birth rate, during the 1980s? Based on this data, if we calculate the ratio of the highest regional birth rate to the lowest regional birth rate among these leading countries, what does this ratio reveal about global demographic disparities during the 1980s? (Calculate: highest rate ÷ lowest rate)
7-30/FDABench/FDA0835.zh: 在 1980 年代，各地区平均粗出生率最高的是哪个高收入国家，其相应的平均出生率是多少？根据这些数据，如果我们计算这些主要国家中最高地区出生率与最低地区出生率的比率，这个比率揭示了1980期间全球人口差异的什么信息？ （计算：最高费率 ÷ 最低费率）

7-30/FDABench/FDA0832.source: Identify the longest number of days between the first visit and the last recorded event (either the last visit or the first transaction) for a user, where the last recorded event is associated with a mobile device. For mobile app optimization strategy, if you calculate the mobile engagement persistence quotient by taking the square root of this maximum period and divide by the typical mobile user attention span of 14 days, what quotient range would indicate the need for advanced mobile retention algorithms versus standard mobile engagement tactics?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0832.zh: 确定用户的首次访问和上次记录的事件（上次访问或第一次交易）之间的最长天数，其中上次记录的事件与移动设备相关联。对于移动应用优化策略，如果您通过取此最大周期的平方根并除以 14 天的典型移动用户注意力跨度来计算移动参与持久商，那么什么商数范围表明需要高级移动保留算法与标准移动参与策略？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0837.source: After removing any duplicate records from the rev_transactions dataset, identify each channel grouping that has transactions from more than one country. For each such channel grouping, find the country with the highest total number of transactions and report both the country name and the sum of transactions for that channel grouping. Considering cross-border transaction analysis patterns, if we calculate the geographic diversity index by taking the square root of the ratio between the smallest and largest transaction volumes among these multi-country channels, what does this measurement reveal about international market penetration strategies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0837.zh: 从 rev_transactions 数据集中删除所有重复记录后，识别包含来自多个国家/地区的交易的每个渠道分组。对于每个此类渠道分组，找到交易总数最高的国家/地区，并报告该渠道分组的国家/地区名称和交易总额。考虑到跨境交易分析模式，如果我们通过这些跨国渠道中最小和最大交易量之间的比率的平方根来计算地理多样性指数，那么这个测量揭示了国际市场渗透策略的什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0836.source: How many debt indicators for Russia have a value of 0, excluding NULL values? Considering Russia's zero net public debt achievement and the OECD's development finance monitoring framework that tracks debt assistance and relief programs, if we calculate the debt diversification index by taking the square root of the zero-value indicators count and multiply by a complexity factor of 3 (reflecting multi-dimensional debt analysis requirements), what would be the resulting index value?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0836.zh: 俄罗斯有多少个债务指标的值为 0（不包括 NULL 值）？考虑到俄罗斯的零净公共债务成就以及OECD跟踪债务援助和减免计划的发展金融监测框架，如果我们通过将零值指标计数的平方根乘以复杂度因子3（反映多维债务分析要求）来计算债务多元化指数，那么得出的指数值是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0840.source: Calculate the conversion rate from unique visitors to purchasers by using data exclusively from the web_analytics table in the data-to-insights.ecommerce dataset. A visitor is defined as a unique fullVisitorId present in the table, while a purchaser is a visitor who has at least one transaction recorded (totals.transactions is not null). The conversion rate is computed by dividing the number of unique purchasers by the total number of unique visitors. Additionally, calculate the average number of transactions per purchaser, considering only those visitors who have made at least one transaction. If the platform wanted to achieve a 5% conversion rate while maintaining the same average transactions per purchaser, what would be the required improvement factor in conversion rate, and how should this guide their optimization strategy considering the current purchaser behavior patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0840.zh: 仅使用 data-toinsights.ecommerce 数据集中 web_analytics 表中的数据来计算从唯一访问者到购买者的转化率。访客被定义为表中存在的唯一 fullVisitorId，而购买者是至少记录了一笔交易的访客（totals.transactions 不为空）。转化率的计算方法是将独立购买者数量除以独立访问者总数。此外，计算每个购买者的平均交易次数，仅考虑至少进行过一笔交易的访问者。如果平台想要实现 5% 的转化率，同时保持每个购买者的平均交易次数相同，那么转化率所需的改进因素是什么？考虑到当前购买者的行为模式，这应该如何指导他们的优化策略？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0839.source: Calculate the conversion rate from unique visitors to purchasers by using data exclusively from the web_analytics table in the data-to-insights.ecommerce dataset. A visitor is defined as a unique fullVisitorId present in the table, while a purchaser is a visitor who has at least one transaction recorded (totals.transactions is not null). The conversion rate is computed by dividing the number of unique purchasers by the total number of unique visitors. Additionally, calculate the average number of transactions per purchaser, considering only those visitors who have made at least one transaction. Given that industry benchmarks suggest e-commerce conversion rates typically range from 1-2%, what is the ratio of this platform's conversion rate to the industry benchmark midpoint (1.5%), and what strategic implications does this have when combined with the transaction frequency data?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0839.zh: 仅使用 data-toinsights.ecommerce 数据集中 web_analytics 表中的数据来计算从唯一访问者到购买者的转化率。访客被定义为表中存在的唯一 fullVisitorId，而购买者是至少记录了一笔交易的访客（totals.transactions 不为空）。转化率的计算方法是将独立购买者数量除以独立访问者总数。此外，计算每个购买者的平均交易次数，仅考虑至少进行过一笔交易的访问者。鉴于行业基准表明电商转化率通常在1-2%之间，那么该平台的转化率与行业基准中点（1.5%）的比率是多少，与交易频率数据结合起来有什么战略意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0838.source: Calculate the conversion rate from unique visitors to purchasers by using data exclusively from the web_analytics table in the data-to-insights.ecommerce dataset. A visitor is defined as a unique fullVisitorId present in the table, while a purchaser is a visitor who has at least one transaction recorded (totals.transactions is not null). The conversion rate is computed by dividing the number of unique purchasers by the total number of unique visitors. Additionally, calculate the average number of transactions per purchaser, considering only those visitors who have made at least one transaction. Based on these metrics, if you were to express the conversion rate as a percentage and multiply it by the average transactions per purchaser, what would be the resulting value and its strategic significance for e-commerce optimization?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0838.zh: 仅使用 data-toinsights.ecommerce 数据集中 web_analytics 表中的数据来计算从唯一访问者到购买者的转化率。访客被定义为表中存在的唯一 fullVisitorId，而购买者是至少记录了一笔交易的访客（totals.transactions 不为空）。转化率的计算方法是将独立购买者数量除以独立访问者总数。此外，计算每个购买者的平均交易次数，仅考虑至少进行过一笔交易的访问者。根据这些指标，如果您将转化率表示为百分比，并将其乘以每个购买者的平均交易次数，那么最终的价值及其对电子商务优化的战略意义是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0841.source: Tell me the most purchased other products and their quantities by customers who bought the Google Red Speckled Tee each month for the three months starting from November 2020. Based on cross-selling analysis methodology, if you calculate the diversity coefficient (number of distinct product types divided by total quantity, then multiply by 100), what strategic insight about customer purchasing patterns emerges?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0841.zh: 请告诉我从 2020年11月 开始的三个月内每月购买 Google Red Speckled Tee 的客户购买最多的其他产品及其数量。根据交叉销售分析方法，如果计算多样性系数（不同产品类型的数量除以总量，然后乘以 100），就会出现有关客户购买模式的哪些战略洞察？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0844.source: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn't in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser. Given that typical ecommerce sites had conversion rates around 2-3% during this period, if you calculate the percentage representation of this pageview difference relative to a baseline of 100 pageviews, what strategic insight about user engagement emerges? (Calculate: (pageview_difference / 100) * 100 to get percentage impact)
7-30/FDABench/FDA0844.zh: 您能算出 2020年12月 购买商品的用户和未购买商品的用户之间浏览量的平均差异吗？只需将参与购买活动的任何人标记为购买者即可。鉴于在此期间典型的电子商务网站的转化率约为 2-3%，如果您计算此网页浏览量差异相对于 100 网页浏览量基线的百分比表示，则会出现有关用户参与度的哪些战略见解？ （计算：（pageview_difference / 100）* 100 以获得百分比影响）

7-30/FDABench/FDA0842.source: I'm trying to evaluate which board types were most effective on September 15, 2018. Can you find out the average scores for each board type from the quick play mode completions on that day? Based on the performance data and considering that board game effectiveness can be measured by calculating the coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean, then multiplied by 100) to assess consistency across board types, what would be the approximate range of variation coefficients if we assume a standard deviation of 8 points across all board types?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0842.zh: 我正在尝试评估哪些主板类型在 2018年9月15日 上最有效。您能从当天的快速游戏模式完成情况中找出每种棋盘类型的平均分数吗？根据性能数据，考虑到棋盘游戏的有效性可以通过计算变异系数（标准差除以平均值，然后乘以100）来衡量，以评估不同棋盘类型的一致性，如果我们假设所有棋盘类型的标准差为8点，变异系数的大致范围是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0843.source: I'm trying to evaluate which board types were most effective on September 15, 2018. Can you find out the average scores for each board type from the quick play mode completions on that day? Drawing parallels with cognitive impairment research where performance differentiation is crucial for user classification, if we model board type effectiveness using an entropy-based diversity measure calculated as the negative sum of each board type's probability (based on normalized scores) multiplied by its natural logarithm, what entropy value would indicate optimal strategic diversity?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0843.zh: 我正在尝试评估哪些主板类型在 2018年9月15日 上最有效。您能从当天的快速游戏模式完成情况中找出每种棋盘类型的平均分数吗？与认知障碍研究相似，其中性能差异对于用户分类至关重要，如果我们使用基于熵的多样性度量对董事会类型有效性进行建模，该度量计算为每种董事会类型的概率（基于标准化分数）乘以其自然对数的负和，那么什么熵值将表明最佳的战略多样性？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0845.source: Can you figure out the average difference in pageviews between users who bought something and those who didn't in December 2020? Just label anyone who was involved in purchase events as a purchaser. Given that email campaigns achieved up to 12% conversion rates on peak days while regular conversion rates were 1-3%, if you calculate the pageview difference divided by 2 and then add 25 to model adjusted engagement metrics for high-conversion periods, what strategic framework emerges? (Calculate: (pageview_difference / 2) + 25)
7-30/FDABench/FDA0845.zh: 您能算出 2020年12月 购买商品的用户和未购买商品的用户之间浏览量的平均差异吗？只需将参与购买活动的任何人标记为购买者即可。鉴于电子邮件营销活动在高峰日实现了高达 12% 的转化率，而常规转化率为 1-3%，如果计算综合浏览量差异除以 2，然后将 25 添加到高转化时段的调整后参与度指标模型中，会出现什么战略框架？ （计算：（pageview_difference / 2）+ 25）

7-30/FDABench/FDA0846.source: Could you provide the total number of page views for each day in November 2020 as well as the average number of page views per user on those days, restricted to users who made at least one purchase in November 2020? Based on this data, calculate the variance in average page views per user across all days to measure user engagement consistency. The variance formula is: sum of squared deviations from mean divided by number of observations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0846.zh: 您能否提供 2020年11月 每天的总页面浏览量以及这些天每个用户的平均页面浏览数（仅限于 2020年11月 至少进行过一次购买的用户）？根据此数据，计算每个用户全天平均页面浏览量的方差，以衡量用户参与度的一致性。方差公式为：均值偏差平方和除以观测值数量。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0849.source: I want to know the user session conversion rate on January 2nd, 2021, using only 'page_view' events. The conversion rate should be calculated as the percentage of user visits that reached both the Home and Checkout Confirmation pages in one session, relative to those that landed on the Home page. In the context of e-commerce conversion optimization, if you need to set a realistic benchmark target that represents a 25% improvement over the current conversion rate, what would be your target percentage and what strategic insight does this suggest about user journey optimization?
