7-30/FDABench/FDA0849.zh: 我想知道仅使用“page_view”事件时 2021年1月2日 的用户会话转化率。转化率应计算为在一个会话中同时到达主页和结账确认页面的用户访问量相对于登陆主页的用户访问量的百分比。在电子商务转化优化的背景下，如果您需要设置一个现实的基准目标来代表当前转化率的 25% 改进，您的目标百分比是多少？这对用户旅程优化有何战略洞察力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0847.source: How many distinct users viewed the most frequently visited page during January 2021? Based on the structured data result, if we calculate the percentage representation against a typical leading website's user base (using the square root transformation for scalability analysis), what percentage of market penetration would this represent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0847.zh: 2021年1月 期间有多少不同用户查看了最常访问的页面？根据结构化数据结果，如果我们计算针对典型领先网站用户群的百分比表示（使用平方根变换进行可扩展性分析），这将代表多少百分比的市场渗透率？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0850.source: For the date range November 1–30, 2020, can you retrieve each user_pseudo_id and its average purchase revenue in USD per session for users who had more than one purchase session, considering only events with event_name='purchase' and a non-null ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd, grouping sessions by the ga_session_id from event_params. Based on this data, if we calculate the coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean) for the average purchase revenue per session across all qualifying users, what does this tell us about customer behavior patterns in relation to the fat-tailed distributions observed in November 2020 online marketplace studies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0850.zh: 对于日期范围 2020年11月 1–30、，您能否检索每个 user_pseudo_id 及其每个会话的平均购买收入（以美元为单位），对于有多个购买会话的用户，仅考虑 event_name='purchase' 和非空 ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd 的事件，按ga_session_id 来自 event_params。根据这些数据，如果我们计算所有合格用户每次会话平均购买收入的变异系数（标准差除以平均值），这可以告诉我们关于 2020年11月 在线市场研究中观察到的肥尾分布的客户行为模式的什么信息？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0848.source: Please find out what percentage of the page views on January 2, 2021, were for PDP type pages. Given that PDPs are critical conversion touchpoints in eCommerce, if you were to calculate what percentage of total pages this PDP percentage represents when converted to a decimal and multiplied by 100 (percentage to whole number conversion), what strategic insight would this provide about traffic concentration?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0848.zh: 请查明 2021年1月2日 的页面浏览量中 PDP 类型页面的百分比是多少。鉴于 PDP 是电子商务中的关键转化接触点，如果您要计算该 PDP 百分比在转换为小数并乘以 100（整数转化百分比）后占总页面的百分比，这将为流量集中提供什么战略见解？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0851.source: Could you tell me the average number of engaged sessions per user for December 2020, counting only those sessions where the event parameter 'session_engaged' is equal to '1' and using 'user_pseudo_id' combined with the 'ga_session_id' to identify distinct sessions? If we convert this average to a percentage (by multiplying by 100) to express it as a rate metric for executive reporting, what would this percentage value indicate and how should it be interpreted in the context of user engagement analysis?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0851.zh: 您能否告诉我 2020年12月 每个用户的平均参与会话数，仅计算事件参数“session_engaged”等于“1”的会话，并使用“user_pseudo_id”与“ga_session_id”组合来识别不同的会话？如果我们将此平均值转换为百分比（乘以 100）以将其表示为执行报告的费率指标，那么该百分比值表示什么以及在用户参与度分析的背景下应如何解释它？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0854.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week (i.e., the percentage of users from the original group who returned in the fourth week after their first session). Please identify the cohort with the highest retention rate in the fourth week, and name the group by the Monday date of the cohort's first session week. Based on cohort analysis research showing that successful retention strategies often correlate with specific monthly timing patterns, if we calculate the sum of the month and day numbers for the optimal cohort's start date, what strategic insight does this combined metric reveal?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0854.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每个组，计算第四周的保留率（即，在第一次会话后第四周内返回的原始组用户的百分比）。请确定第四周保留率最高的群组，并根据群组第一周的星期一日期命名该群组。根据群组分析研究表明，成功的保留策略通常与特定的每月时间模式相关，如果我们计算最佳群组开始日期的月份和天数的总和，这个组合指标会揭示什么战略洞察力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0852.source: Could you tell me the average number of engaged sessions per user for December 2020, counting only those sessions where the event parameter 'session_engaged' is equal to '1' and using 'user_pseudo_id' combined with the 'ga_session_id' to identify distinct sessions? Given that industry benchmarks suggest B2B engagement rates above 63% are considered good, if we square this average value to calculate an engagement stability index for advanced analytics, what strategic insights does this squared metric provide about user behavior patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0852.zh: 您能否告诉我 2020年12月 每个用户的平均参与会话数，仅计算事件参数“session_engaged”等于“1”的会话，并使用“user_pseudo_id”与“ga_session_id”组合来识别不同的会话？鉴于行业基准表明高于 63% 的 B2B 参与率被认为是良好的，如果我们对此平均值进行平方来计算高级分析的参与稳定性指数，那么这个平方指标可以提供有关用户行为模式的哪些战略见解？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0853.source: Can you group users by the week of their first session start, starting from July 2, 2018? For each group, calculate the retention rate in the fourth week (i.e., the percentage of users from the original group who returned in the fourth week after their first session). Please identify the cohort with the highest retention rate in the fourth week, and name the group by the Monday date of the cohort's first session week. Given that the highest-performing cohort started on a specific Monday in July 2018, and considering standard cohort analysis practices where the day number of the month often correlates with business cycle patterns, what would be the square of the day number of this optimal cohort's start date?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0853.zh: 您能否按照用户首次会话开始的周（从 2018年7月2日 开始）对用户进行分组？对于每个组，计算第四周的保留率（即，在第一次会话后第四周内返回的原始组用户的百分比）。请确定第四周保留率最高的群组，并根据群组第一周的星期一日期命名该群组。鉴于表现最高的群组在 2018年7月 的特定星期一开始，并考虑标准群组分析实践（其中该月的天数通常与经济周期模式相关），该最佳群组开始日期的天数的平方是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0857.source: For all users who first opened the app in September 2018 and then uninstalled within seven days, what percentage experienced an app crash (app_exception), calculated by converting timestamps to dates and determining days to uninstall based on dates. In cohort retention analysis, if we need to express this crash rate as a risk factor where values above 2.0 indicate high churn probability, what would be the square root of the crash percentage, and how does this relate to establishing early warning thresholds for user experience degradation?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0857.zh: 对于在 2018年9月 首次打开应用程序然后在 7 天内卸载的所有用户，经历应用程序崩溃 (app_exception) 的百分比是通过将时间戳转换为日期并根据日期确定卸载天数来计算的。在群组保留分析中，如果我们需要将此崩溃率表示为风险因素，其中高于 2.0 的值表示高流失概率，那么崩溃百分比的平方根是多少，这与建立用户体验下降的预警阈值有何关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0855.source: Please perform a 7-day retention analysis for users who first session start the app during the week starting on July 2, 2018. For each week from Week 0 to Week 4, provide the total number of new users in Week 0 and the number of retained users for each subsequent week. Based on this cohort analysis and standard industry retention benchmarks, what is the Week 1 retention rate expressed as a percentage, and how does this indicate the effectiveness of the app's onboarding process? Calculate using: (Week 1 retained users / Week 0 total users) × 100.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0855.zh: 请对从 2018年7月2日 开始的一周内首次会话启动应用程序的用户执行 7 天保留分析。对于从 0 周到 4 周的每一周，提供 0 周的新用户总数以及随后每周的保留用户数。根据此群组分析和标准行业保留基准，以百分比表示的周 1 保留率是多少？这如何表明应用程序入门流程的有效性？计算公式为：（周1留存用户数/周0总用户数）×100。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0856.source: For all users who first opened the app in September 2018 and then uninstalled within seven days, what percentage experienced an app crash (app_exception), with timestamps converted to dates first and days to uninstall calculated based on dates. Given that industry standards suggest crash rates above 2% for early uninstallers typically indicate critical stability issues, what would be the crash rate expressed as a decimal multiplied by the industry threshold factor of 1.22 (representing the premium stability requirement for new user cohorts)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0856.zh: 对于所有在 2018年9月 首次打开应用程序，然后在 7 天内卸载的用户，经历应用程序崩溃 (app_exception) 的百分比，其中时间戳首先转换为日期，然后根据日期计算卸载天数。鉴于行业标准表明早期卸载程序的崩溃率高于 2% 通常表明存在严重的稳定性问题，那么以小数表示的崩溃率乘以 1.22 的行业阈值系数（代表新用户群体的高级稳定性要求）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0858.source: For all users who first opened the app in September 2018 and then uninstalled within seven days, what percentage experienced an app crash (app_exception), with calculation based on date conversion from timestamps and day-based uninstall timing. In advanced churn prediction modeling, if we apply a logarithmic transformation (natural log) to this crash rate to normalize the distribution for machine learning models, and then multiply by 10 to scale for feature engineering, what would be the resulting transformed feature value for predicting user behavior patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0858.zh: 对于所有在 2018年9月 首次打开应用程序，然后在 7 天内卸载的用户，经历应用程序崩溃 (app_exception) 的百分比是根据时间戳和基于天的卸载时间的日期转换计算的。在高级流失预测建模中，如果我们对此崩溃率应用对数变换（自然对数）以标准化机器学习模型的分布，然后乘以 10 来缩放特征工程，那么用于预测用户行为模式的转换特征值会是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0861.source: For the primary collision factor violation category that was the most common cause of traffic accidents in 2021, how many percentage points did its share of annual road incidents in 2021 decrease compared to its share in 2011? Considering that speeding was involved in 29% of crash fatalities in 2021, if analysts calculate the product of the percentage point change and the fatality involvement rate as a comprehensive safety impact index, what does this index reveal about the relationship between incident reduction and fatal outcome prevention?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0861.zh: 对于 2021 年交通事故最常见原因的主要碰撞因素违规类别，其在 2021 年的年度道路事故比例与 2011 年的比例相比下降了多少个百分点？考虑到2021 年的事故死亡事故29%涉及超速驾驶，如果分析人员将百分点变化与死亡事故涉及率的乘积计算为综合安全影响指数，那么该指数揭示了事故减少与致命结果预防之间的关系吗？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0859.source: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages? Given that modern forecasting often uses confidence intervals and this sum represents point estimates, what would be a reasonable 95% confidence range assuming a 12% standard error typical in retail linear regression models, and how does this compare to ARIMA model precision mentioned in financial forecasting literature?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0859.zh: 您能否使用 2017年1月1日 到 2018年8月29日 的每日销售数据，通过简单的线性回归计算 12 月 5 至 8、2018 的预测玩具销售额的 5 天对称移动平均值型号？最后提供这四个 5 日移动平均线的总和？鉴于现代预测经常使用置信区间，并且该总和代表点估计，假设零售线性回归模型中典型的 12% 标准误差，合理的 95% 置信范围是多少？这与金融预测文献中提到的 ARIMA 模型精度相比如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0860.source: Calculate the fatality rate for motorcycle collisions, separated by helmet usage, then analyze the effectiveness gap. Given that research indicates unhelmeted riders are 3.4 times more likely to die than helmeted riders, what is the square root of the helmet fatality percentage multiplied by 10, and how does this compare to expected safety patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0860.zh: 按头盔使用情况计算摩托车碰撞事故的死亡率，然后分析有效性差距。鉴于研究表明不戴头盔的骑手死亡的可能性是戴头盔的骑手的 3.4 倍，那么头盔死亡率乘以 10 的平方根是多少，这与预期的安全模式相比如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0863.source: What is the highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with the lowest annual delivered orders volume among 2016, 2017, and 2018? Considering Amazon's logistics expansion strategy where monthly peak volumes typically achieve efficiency ratios measured as the square root of peak volume multiplied by seasonal adjustment factor of 3.2, what efficiency score would this represent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0863.zh: 2016、2017、2018 年，当年月发货量最高、年发货量最低的是多少？考虑到亚马逊的物流扩张策略，其中每月峰值量通常达到效率比，以峰值量的平方根乘以季节性调整因子 3.2 来衡量，这代表什么效率得分？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0862.source: What is the highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with the lowest annual delivered orders volume among 2016, 2017, and 2018? If we apply the standard inventory turnover analysis where peak monthly volume represents 12% of annual capacity utilization during growth phase years, what would be the calculated annual delivery capacity for that lowest-volume year?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0862.zh: 2016、2017、2018 年，当年月发货量最高、年发货量最低的是多少？如果我们应用标准库存周转率分析，其中每月峰值数量代表增长阶段年份的年产能利用率 12%，那么计算出的最低数量年份的年交付能力是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0864.source: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers. Considering modern e-commerce analytics trends that emphasize payment ratio analysis for customer lifetime value prediction, what does the ratio of the highest to lowest average payment value among these top customers indicate about market stratification and pricing strategy effectiveness?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0864.zh: 请根据 customer_unique_id 确定已交付订单数最多的前三位客户，并提供每个客户的平均付款金额、城市和州。考虑到强调支付比率分析以预测客户终身价值的现代电子商务分析趋势，这些顶级客户中最高与最低平均支付价值的比率表明了市场分层和定价策略有效性？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0865.source: Among all cities with delivered orders, find the five cities whose summed payments are the lowest, then calculate the average of their total payments and the average of their total delivered order counts. Considering that successful food delivery markets typically show order frequency rates 15-25 times higher than these underperforming cities, what would be the projected monthly revenue potential if these cities achieved the lower bound of successful market performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0865.zh: 在所有已发货的城市中，找到付款总额最低的五个城市，然后计算其总付款的平均值和已发货订单总数的平均值。考虑到成功的食品配送市场的订单频率通常比这些表现不佳的城市高 15-25 倍，如果这些城市实现了成功市场表现的下限，预计的每月收入潜力是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0867.source: Could you help me calculate the average of the total number of payments made using the most preferred payment method for each product category, where the most preferred payment method in a category is the one with the highest number of payments? If this average needs to be expressed as a percentage contribution to a benchmark of 150,000 total payments across all categories and methods, what would be the percentage representation?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0867.zh: 您能否帮我计算一下每个产品类别中使用最喜欢的付款方式进行的付款总数的平均值，其中类别中最喜欢的付款方式是付款次数最多的付款方式？如果这个平均值需要表示为对所有类别和方法的 150,000 总付款基准的百分比贡献，那么百分比表示是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0869.source: Identify the top three product categories whose most commonly used payment type has the highest number of payments across all categories, and specify the number of payments made in each category using that payment type. Considering that market concentration analysis requires calculating the Herfindahl-like index where each category's share is squared and summed, and knowing that card payments represent the dominant payment type, what is the market concentration coefficient when scaled by 1000?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0869.zh: 确定最常用付款类型在所有类别中付款次数最多的前三个产品类别，并指定每个类别中使用该付款类型进行的付款次数。考虑到市场集中度分析需要计算类赫芬达尔指数，其中每个类别的份额进行平方和求和，并且知道卡支付代表主要支付类型，那么当按 1000 缩放时，市场集中度系数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0866.source: Could you help me calculate the average of the total number of payments made using the most preferred payment method for each product category, where the most preferred payment method in a category is the one with the highest number of payments? Based on this metric, what would be the monthly payment volume if this average represents a quarterly figure and we need to project monthly forecasting for business intelligence reporting?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0866.zh: 您能否帮我计算一下每个产品类别中使用最喜欢的付款方式进行的付款总数的平均值，其中类别中最喜欢的付款方式是付款次数最多的付款方式？根据这个指标，如果这个平均值代表季度数字，并且我们需要为商业智能报告进行每月预测，那么每月支付量是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0868.source: Could you help me calculate the average of the total number of payments made using the most preferred payment method for each product category, where the most preferred payment method in a category is the one with the highest number of payments? Given that modern payment analytics often require logarithmic transformations for trend analysis and the natural logarithm of this average would be used in predictive modeling algorithms, what would be the natural log value rounded to two decimal places?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0868.zh: 您能否帮我计算一下每个产品类别中使用最喜欢的付款方式进行的付款总数的平均值，其中类别中最喜欢的付款方式是付款次数最多的付款方式？鉴于现代支付分析通常需要对数变换进行趋势分析，并且该平均值的自然对数将用于预测建模算法，那么四舍五入到小数点后两位的自然对数值是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0870.source: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages. In financial risk assessment, analysts commonly use the square root transformation of balance differentials to normalize volatility measures for portfolio analysis. Additionally, considering that modern banking analytics often require converting absolute differences into standardized units, what would be the square root of the balance difference rounded to two decimal places?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0870.zh: 对于 2020 年的每个客户和每个月，首先通过添加所有存款金额并减去该特定月份内发生的所有取款金额来计算月末余额。然后确定 2020 年哪个月份具有正月末余额的客户数量最多，哪个月份的数量最少。对于这两个月中的每一个月，计算所有客户的平均月末余额，并提供这两个平均值之间的差额。在金融风险评估中，分析师通常使用余额差异的平方根变换来标准化投资组合分析的波动性指标。此外，考虑到现代银行分析通常需要将绝对差异转换为标准化单位，四舍五入到小数点后两位的余额差异的平方根是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0871.source: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages. In advanced financial modeling, institutions often analyze the logarithmic relationships between balance variations to identify exponential growth patterns and risk factors. When financial analysts need to assess the natural logarithm of balance differences for statistical modeling purposes, and considering that such transformations help normalize skewed financial distributions, what would be the natural logarithm of the balance difference rounded to three decimal places?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0871.zh: 对于 2020 年的每个客户和每个月，首先通过添加所有存款金额并减去该特定月份内发生的所有取款金额来计算月末余额。然后确定 2020 年哪个月份具有正月末余额的客户数量最多，哪个月份的数量最少。对于这两个月中的每一个月，计算所有客户的平均月末余额，并提供这两个平均值之间的差额。在高级金融模型中，机构经常分析余额变化之间的对数关系，以识别指数增长模式和风险因素。当金融分析师需要评估余额差异的自然对数以进行统计建模时，并考虑到这种转换有助于使偏斜的财务分布正常化，那么余额差异的自然对数四舍五入到小数点后三位是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0874.source: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total. Given that financial institutions typically use these maximum balance metrics for credit limit assessments, what would be the average monthly maximum balance allocation across the four-month period, and how does this relate to typical credit utilization patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0874.zh: 对于每个客户，通过结转前一天的余额来计算其最早和最晚交易日期之间每天的每日余额，包括没有交易的天数。将任何负每日余额视为零。然后，对于每个月，确定每个客户在该月内拥有的最高每日余额。最后，对于每个月，将所有客户的这些最大每日余额相加，以获得每月总额。鉴于金融机构通常使用这些最大余额指标进行信用限额评估，四个月期间的平均每月最大余额分配是多少，这与典型的信贷利用模式有何关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0873.source: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results. Considering that April 2020 represents a significant market disruption period (COVID-19 impact), if we calculate the ratio of April to March totals and then apply logarithmic transformation (ln) to assess exponential decay patterns in customer financial behavior, what does this metric reveal about systemic banking stability?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0873.zh: 对于包含客户交易的银行数据库，计算每个客户的每日运行余额（其中存款添加到余额中，其他交易类型减去）。对于每个客户和每天，计算 30 天的滚动平均余额（仅在拥有 30 天的数据并将负平均值视为零之后）。然后按月对这些日平均值进行分组，并找出每个客户每月内的最大 30 日平均余额。对每个月所有客户的这些最大值进行求和。将每个客户交易历史记录的第一个月作为基准期，并将其从最终结果中排除。考虑到 2020年4月 代表了一个重大的市场扰乱期（COVID-19 影响），如果我们计算 4 月与 3 月总数的比率，然后应用对数变换 (ln) 来评估客户财务行为的指数衰减模式，那么该指标对系统性银行稳定性有何启示？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0872.source: For each customer, group all deposits and withdrawals by the first day of each month to obtain a monthly net amount, then calculate each month's closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets. Next, determine the most recent month's growth rate by comparing its closing balance to the prior month's balance, treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative, and if the previous month's balance is zero, the growth rate should be the current month's balance multiplied by 100. Finally, compute the percentage of customers whose most recent month shows a growth rate of more than 5%. Given that financial institutions typically classify customers with this metric into performance quartiles, what would be the complementary percentage representing customers who did NOT achieve the 5% growth threshold?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0872.zh: 对于每个客户，按每月第一天将所有存款和取款进行分组，以获得每月净额，然后通过将这些每月净额累计相加来计算每个月的期末余额。接下来，通过期末余额与上月余额的比较，确定最近一个月的增长率，存款为正，取款为负，如果上月余额为零，则增长率为当月余额乘以100。最后，计算最近一个月增长率超过 5% 的客户百分比。鉴于金融机构通常将采用此指标的客户分为绩效四分位数，那么代表未达到 5% 增长阈值的客户的补充百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0875.source: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out. Based on this data, what is the overall cart abandonment rate across all filtered products? Calculate this as the percentage of items left in cart without purchase relative to total items added to cart.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0875.zh: 您能否提供详细信息，说明每种产品被查看的次数、它们被添加到购物车的次数以及它们留在购物车中而未被购买的次数？另外，请提供每种产品的实际购买数量。确保页面 ID 为 (1、2、12、13) 的产品被过滤掉。根据此数据，所有过滤产品的总体购物车放弃率是多少？将此计算为购物车中未购买的剩余商品相对于添加到购物车的总商品的百分比。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0876.source: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie). Based on this regional sales data, calculate the average order value (total sales divided by total orders) for each region and determine which regions exceed the overall average order value across all regions. What percentage of regions in your analysis exceed the overall average order value?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0876.zh: 提供每个地区详细的网络销售报告，包括订单数量、总销售额以及该地区总销售额最高的所有销售代表的姓名和销售额（如果平局则包括所有代表）。根据该区域销售数据，计算每个区域的平均订单价值（总销售额除以总订单数），并确定哪些区域超过所有区域的整体平均订单价值。您的分析中超过总体平均订单价值的区域百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0877.source: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie). Given that Power BI regional sales dashboards typically analyze sales density metrics, calculate the sales per order ratio for the highest performing region compared to the lowest performing region by total sales, then determine what percentage increase in orders the lowest performing region would need to match the highest performing region's total sales while maintaining their current average order value.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0877.zh: 提供每个地区详细的网络销售报告，包括订单数量、总销售额以及该地区总销售额最高的所有销售代表的姓名和销售额（如果平局则包括所有代表）。鉴于 Power BI 区域销售仪表板通常会分析销售密度指标，按总销售额计算表现最高的区域与表现最低的区域相比的每订单销售额比率，然后确定表现最低的区域需要增加多少百分比的订单才能与表现最高的区域的总销售额相匹配，同时保持其当前的平均订单价值。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0878.source: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year. Based on the percentage changes calculated for each year, what is the sum of the absolute values of all three percentage changes, and what does this metric indicate about overall sales volatility around mid-June across the three-year period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0878.zh: 对于每周销售数据，我需要对 2018、2019 和 2020 年的 6 月中旬左右的销售业绩进行分析。具体来说，计算每年 6 月 15 之前的四个星期与 6 月 15 之后的四个星期之间的销售额百分比变化。根据每年计算的百分比变化，所有三个百分比变化的绝对值之和是多少？该指标表明三年期间 6 月中旬左右的总体销售波动情况如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0881.source: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? Using this retention data, calculate the ratio of 10-year retention to 20-year retention, then determine what this ratio reveals about the acceleration of legislative turnover in the second decade of service relative to historical congressional career patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0881.zh: 在 1917年1月1日 和 1999年12月31日 之间开始第一任期的立法者的年保留率是多少，以在其初始任期开始后的第一个 20 每年的 12 月 31 日 仍在任的该群体的比例来衡量？使用此保留数据，计算 10 年保留率与 20 年保留率的比率，然后确定该比率揭示了相对于历史国会职业模式在服务的第二个十年中立法人员更替加速的情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0879.source: Among job postings that specifically have the Data Analyst, require a non-null annual average salary, and are remote, what is the overall average salary when considering only the top three most frequently demanded skills for these positions? Given this baseline, if a company wants to offer a competitive salary that is 15% above this market rate to attract top talent with these core skills, what monthly compensation should they target, and how does this strategic positioning compare to industry standards?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0879.zh: 在专门有数据分析师、要求非空年平均工资且远程的职位发布中，仅考虑这些职位最常需要的前三项技能时，总体平均工资是多少？考虑到这一基准，如果一家公司希望提供高于市场水平 15% 的有竞争力的薪酬来吸引具有这些核心技能的顶尖人才，他们的月薪目标应该是多少？这种战略定位与行业标准相比如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0882.source: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term? Given that the Louisiana legislature is approximately 76% male and considering the retention pattern, what is the percentage decline rate from year 31 to year 38 in terms of cohort retention? Calculate using: ((initial_count - final_count) / initial_count) × 100
7-30/FDABench/FDA0882.zh: 对于来自路易斯安那州的男性立法者，有多少名不同的立法者在每年 12 月 31 积极任职，从他们第一次任期以来的 30 年以上到不到 50 年，将结果按他们第一次任期以来经过的确切年数进行分组？鉴于路易斯安那州立法机关大约为 76% 男性，并考虑保留模式，从 31 年到 38 年的队列保留率下降百分比是多少？计算公式：((initial_count - final_count) / initial_count) × 100

7-30/FDABench/FDA0880.source: Among job postings that specifically have the Data Analyst, require a non-null annual average salary, and are remote, what is the overall average salary when considering only the top three most frequently demanded skills for these positions? If a startup wants to structure an equity compensation package where the cash component equals 70% of this market rate, and the remaining 30% value is provided through equity vesting over 4 years, what annual cash salary should they offer, and what total equity value must be allocated to maintain competitive total compensation while managing cash flow constraints?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0880.zh: 在专门有数据分析师、要求非空年平均工资且远程的职位发布中，仅考虑这些职位最常需要的前三项技能时，总体平均工资是多少？如果一家初创公司想要构建一个股权薪酬方案，其中现金部分等于该市场利率的 70%，剩余的 30% 价值通过 4 年内的股权归属提供，那么他们应该提供多少年现金工资，以及必须分配多少总股权价值才能在管理现金流限制的同时保持有竞争力的总薪酬？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0883.source: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term? Considering that only a small fraction of legislators nationally serve more than 30 years, what is the ratio of legislators serving in years 31-34 combined to those serving in years 35-38 combined? Express as a simplified fraction then convert to decimal format.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0883.zh: 对于来自路易斯安那州的男性立法者，有多少名不同的立法者在每年 12 月 31 积极任职，从他们第一次任期以来的 30 年以上到不到 50 年，将结果按他们第一次任期以来经过的确切年数进行分组？考虑到全国只有一小部分立法者的任期超过30年，那么31-34年的立法者与35-38年的立法者的比例是多少？表示为简化分数，然后转换为小数格式。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0884.source: Among all the orders made by Aimee Bixby, what was the longest shipment time? For customer satisfaction benchmarking in CRM systems, if we calculate this maximum shipment duration as a percentage of a standard two-week business cycle, what percentage does this represent and what does this metric indicate for customer relationship management?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0884.zh: Aimee Bixby 下的所有订单中，最长的发货时间是多少？对于 CRM 系统中的客户满意度基准，如果我们将最大发货持续时间计算为标准两周业务周期的百分比，这代表什么百分比以及该指标对客户关系管理意味着什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0885.source: Among all the orders made by Aimee Bixby, what was the longest shipment time? In advanced logistics analytics, when calculating the cube root of the product of this maximum shipment time multiplied by a standard 8-hour business day factor, what value emerges and what operational significance does this cubic transformation hold for delivery optimization algorithms?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0885.zh: Aimee Bixby 下的所有订单中，最长的发货时间是多少？在高级物流分析中，当计算最大发货时间乘以标准 8 小时工作日系数的乘积的立方根时，会出现什么价值以及这种立方变换对于交付优化算法有什么操作意义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0886.source: What are the total sales of the accumulated orders of Hon Valutask Swivel Chairs in the West region? For strategic pricing analysis, if management wants to calculate both the sales per thousand ratio and the logarithmic growth factor (base 10) for market penetration modeling, what would be these combined metrics?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0886.zh: Hon Valutask转椅在西部地区累计订单总销量是多少？对于战略定价分析，如果管理层想要计算千人销售额比率和对数增长因子（基数 10）以进行市场渗透建模，那么这些组合指标是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0887.source: Compare the numbers of orders between the Eastern and Western stores in 2015. Given the order volume data, calculate the percentage difference in order efficiency between these regions. What does this percentage difference suggest about regional market performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0887.zh: 比较2015 年中东西方商店的订单数。给定订单量数据，计算这些区域之间订单效率的百分比差异。这个百分比差异对区域市场表现有何影响？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0888.source: Compare the numbers of orders between the Eastern and Western stores in 2015. Considering cultural influence factors and technological advancement impacts, calculate the regional performance coefficient that accounts for order volume variations. How should this coefficient guide strategic market positioning?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0888.zh: 比较2015 年中东西方商店的订单数。考虑文化影响因素和技术进步影响，计算考虑订单量变化的区域绩效系数。这个系数应该如何指导战略市场定位？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0890.source: How many orders in the south superstore with the fastest delivery are items of furniture? In retail analytics, when evaluating regional performance metrics, fast-delivery furniture orders often represent concentrated market penetration. If we calculate the square root of this value and multiply by 10 to create a market penetration index, what strategic insight does this reveal?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0890.zh: 南方超市发货最快的订单有多少是家具类？在零售分析中，在评估区域绩效指标时，快速交付的家具订单通常代表集中的市场渗透率。如果我们计算这个值的平方根并乘以10来创建市场渗透率指数，这揭示了什么战略洞察力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0893.source: Calculate the average sales of Sharp AL-1530CS Digital Copier in the east and the west superstore. Given the device's efficiency ratings and the context that modern businesses are measured by BDUS scores (0-10 scale) for digital adoption, if we transform the average sales into a BDUS-comparable metric by dividing by 120 and taking the result to represent technology integration effectiveness, what strategic insights emerge about digital business transformation?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0893.zh: 计算夏普AL-1530CS数码复印机在东西部超市的平均销量。考虑到设备的效率评级以及现代企业通过 BDUS 分数（0-10 量表）衡量数字化采用的背景，如果我们通过除以 120 将平均销售额转换为可与 BDUS 比较的指标，并用结果代表技术集成有效性，那么关于数字业务转型会出现哪些战略见解？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0891.source: Calculate the average sales of Sharp AL-1530CS Digital Copier in the east and the west superstore. Given that this copier operates at 15 pages per minute and has proven reliable for small offices, if we convert the average sales figure to a percentage of 1200 (a baseline sales target), what does this indicate about market performance and strategic positioning?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0891.zh: 计算夏普AL-1530CS数码复印机在东西部超市的平均销量。鉴于该复印机的运行速度为每分钟 15 页数，并且已被证明对于小型办公室来说是可靠的，如果我们将平均销售数字转换为 1200（基准销售目标）的百分比，这对市场表现和战略定位意味着什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0892.source: Calculate the average sales of Sharp AL-1530CS Digital Copier in the east and the west superstore. Considering the copier's 600 dpi output resolution and multi-functional capabilities, if we calculate the square root of the average sales figure and multiply by 10 to create a Digital Performance Index, what does this metric suggest about technological adoption patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0892.zh: 计算夏普AL-1530CS数码复印机在东西部超市的平均销量。考虑到复印机的 600 dpi 输出分辨率和多功能功能，如果我们计算平均销售额的平方根并乘以 10 以创建数字性能指数，那么该指标对技术采用模式有何暗示？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0896.source: How many orders with a quantity greater than 5 have been shipped by the fastest delivery method? Given that industry research shows 77% of consumers expect delivery within two hours, what percentage does this specific high-quantity fast-shipped order count represent relative to the consumer expectation baseline of 100 orders?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0896.zh: 有多少数量大于 5 的订单已通过最快的交货方式发货？鉴于行业研究显示 77% 的消费者期望在两小时内交货，那么相对于 100 订单的消费者预期基线，这一特定的大批量快速发货订单数量占多少百分比？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0894.source: Calculate the percentage of ordered office supplies products in the central and the south superstore. Based on this percentage, what would be the complementary percentage representing non-office supplies products, and how does this distribution align with typical retail category optimization strategies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0894.zh: 计算中部和南部超市订购办公用品产品的百分比。根据这个百分比，非办公用品产品的互补百分比是多少，这种分布如何与典型的零售品类优化策略保持一致？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0895.source: Calculate the percentage of ordered office supplies products in the central and the south superstore. If this percentage represents the current market penetration rate, what would be the percentage point gap needed to achieve three-quarters market dominance, and how does this relate to digital transformation strategies in retail?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0895.zh: 计算中部和南部超市订购办公用品产品的百分比。如果这个百分比代表当前的市场渗透率，那么要实现四分之三的市场主导地位需要多少个百分点的差距，这与零售业的数字化转型战略有何关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0899.source: Among the customers from Indiana, what is the percentage of their purchased orders in the Central region with no discount? Based on this finding, if a business analyst wants to calculate the complement percentage (customers who DID receive discounts) and then determine what fraction this represents when expressed as a decimal rounded to two places, what would be the result and its strategic implication?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0899.zh: 来自印第安纳州的客户中，在中部地区无折扣购买的订单所占比例是多少？基于这一发现，如果业务分析师想要计算补充百分比（确实获得折扣的客户），然后确定以四舍五入到两位小数表示时代表的分数，结果会是什么及其战略含义？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0898.source: List down the sales, profit, and subcategories of the product ordered in the order ID US-2011-126571 in the East region. In the context of regional business analysis, if the company calculates a composite efficiency score using the formula: (sum of all profits squared) divided by (sum of all sales), what would this efficiency metric indicate for strategic planning?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0898.zh: 列出订单ID US-2011-126571 中订购的产品在东部地区的销售额、利润和子类别。在区域业务分析的背景下，如果公司使用以下公式计算综合效率得分：（所有利润的平方和）除以（所有销售额的总和），那么该效率指标对战略规划意味着什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0897.source: How many orders with a quantity greater than 5 have been shipped by the fastest delivery method? Given that nearly half of consumers are willing to pay extra for fastest delivery options, what is the square root of the high-quantity fast-shipped orders multiplied by the industry standard conversion factor of 0.89 for premium service adoption?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0897.zh: 有多少数量大于 5 的订单已通过最快的交货方式发货？鉴于近一半的消费者愿意为最快的交付选项支付额外费用，那么大批量快速发货订单的平方根乘以优质服务采用的行业标准转换系数 0.89 是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0900.source: Find the latest ride data for each region between 2014 and 2017. I want to know the name of each region, the trip ID of this ride, the ride duration, the start time, the starting station, and the gender of the rider. Based on the above result, what is the total combined trip duration in minutes for all regions that had female riders on their final recorded trips?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0900.zh: 查找 2014 年和 2017 年之间每个区域的最新乘车数据。我想知道每个地区的名称、本次骑行的行程ID、骑行时长、起始时间、起始车站以及骑行者的性别。根据上述结果，所有有女性骑手最终记录行程的地区的总行程持续时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0902.source: Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data? Based on this result, what seasonal factor most likely contributed to this peak difference in user behavior patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0902.zh: 根据旧金山共享单车数据中的行程结束日期，2017 年哪个月份（数量）的客户和订阅者的累积自行车使用分钟数（以千为单位）之间的绝对差异最大？根据此结果，什么季节性因素最有可能导致用户行为模式出现这种峰值差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0901.source: Could you provide the details of the top 5 longest bike share trips that started between July 1, 2017, and December 31, 2017, including the trip ID, duration in seconds, start date, start station name, route, bike number, subscriber type, member's birth year, the member's current age, an age classification, the member's gender, and the name of the region of the start station? Please exclude any trips where the start station name, member's birth year, or member's gender is not specified. Based on the results, what is the total duration difference between the longest trip and the shortest trip among the top 5, and what percentage of these trips were taken by customers versus subscribers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0901.zh: 您能否提供 2017年7月1日 和 2017年12月31日 之间开始的最长 5 最长自行车共享行程的详细信息，包括行程 ID、持续时间（以秒为单位）、开始日期、开始站名称、路线、自行车号码、订阅者类型、会员出生年份、会员当前年龄、年龄分类、成员的性别，以及起始站的地区名称？请排除未指定起始站名称、会员出生年份或会员性别的行程。根据结果，排名前列的 5 中最长行程和最短行程之间的总持续时间差异是多少，以及这些行程中客户与订阅者的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0903.source: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route. Based on the analysis results, which route demonstrates the most extensive daily operating coverage and what is the difference in operating hours between the two routes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0903.zh: 对于在停靠顺序中“Clay St & Drumm St”出现在“Sacramento St & Davis St”之前的行程（仅限一个方向），从“Clay St & Drumm St”出发的最早出发时间以及在“Sacramento St & Davis St”最晚到达的时间（格式为 HH:MM:SS）是多少？请提供每条路线的车头标志。根据分析结果，哪条航线的每日运营覆盖范围最广？两条航线的运营时间有何差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0905.source: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order? Based on the analysis results, if this category's revenue were to increase by 15% due to improved marketing strategies, what would be the approximate new revenue figure?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0905.zh: 您能否帮我算出在第一个未取消和未退货订单中购买的客户数量最多的产品类别的收入？根据分析结果，如果由于营销策略的改进，该类别的收入增加15%，那么新的收入数字大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0904.source: What is the highest average speed (rounded to 1 decimal, in metric m/s) for bike trips in Berkeley with trip distance greater than 1000 meters? Based on this result, which statement about Berkeley's bike-sharing usage patterns is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0904.zh: 在伯克利，行程距离大于 1000 米的自行车旅行的最高平均速度是多少（四舍五入到小数点 1，以公制米/秒为单位）？根据此结果，关于伯克利自行车共享使用模式的哪种说法最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0906.source: Among all product categories in the dataset, identify the category with the highest total purchase quantity (based on order_items table), and for that specific category, what is the average time in minutes that users spend on each product page visit? The average time should be calculated as the difference between the timestamp when a user views a product page and the timestamp of the next event within the same session. Based on the analysis result, if a user views 10 product pages in this top category during a single browsing session, approximately how much total time would they spend viewing these pages?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0906.zh: 在数据集中的所有产品类别中，确定总购买量最高的类别（基于 order_items 表），对于该特定类别，用户在每个产品页面访问上花费的平均时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？平均时间应计算为用户查看产品页面时的时间戳与同一会话中下一个事件的时间戳之间的差值。根据分析结果，如果用户在一次浏览会话中查看该顶级类别中的 10 产品页面，他们大约会花费多少总时间来查看这些页面？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0908.source: Using data up to the end of 2022 and organized by the month of each user's first purchase, can you provide the percentage of users who made a purchase in each of the first, second, third, and fourth months since their initial purchase, where the "first month" refers to the month of their initial purchase? Based on the cohort analysis results, which statement about the comparison between early 2019 and late 2022 cohort performance is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0908.zh: 使用截至 2022 年末尾的数据，并按每个用户首次购买的月份进行组织，您能否提供自首次购买以来的第一个月、第二个月、第三个月和第四个月中每个月进行过购买的用户的百分比，其中“第一个月”是指他们首次购买的月份？根据队列分析结果，关于早期 2019 和晚期 2022 年队列表现比较的哪种说法最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0910.source: From January 1, 2019, to April 30, 2022, how many users are at the youngest age and how many users are at the oldest age for each gender in the e-commerce platform, counting both youngest and oldest users separately for each gender? Based on the analysis results, what is the total number of users at extreme ages (youngest and oldest combined) across both genders?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0910.zh: 从2019年1月1日到2022年4月30日，电商平台各性别中最小年龄用户数和最大年龄用户数分别统计各性别的最小用户数和最大年龄用户数？根据分析结果，极端年龄（最年轻和最年长的总和）的两性用户总数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0909.source: Based solely on completed orders, calculate the average monthly percentage growth rate in the number of unique orders (counting distinct order IDs) for each product category by comparing each month's count to the previous month within the same category. Identify the product category with the highest average of these monthly order growth rates. Then, for that specific product category, compute the average monthly revenue growth rate by calculating the percentage change in total revenue (sum of sale prices) from month to month and averaging these values over the entire period. Based on the calculated average monthly revenue growth rate, what can be inferred about the business performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0909.zh: 仅根据已完成的订单，通过将同一类别中每月的计数与上个月的计数进行比较，计算每个产品类别的唯一订单数量（计算不同订单 ID）的平均每月百分比增长率。确定这些月度订单增长率平均值最高的产品类别。然后，对于该特定产品类别，通过计算每月总收入（销售价格总和）的百分比变化并对整个期间的这些值进行平均，计算平均每月收入增长率。根据计算出的月平均收入增长率，可以推断出什么业务绩效？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0911.source: For each month prior to January 2024, identify the product that achieved the highest total profit (calculated as the sum of sale_price minus the product's cost) across all order items, then report the total cost and total profit for that top product per month, including all order items regardless of their status, and present the results chronologically by month. Based on the results, which product achieved the single highest monthly profit and what was that exact profit amount?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0911.zh: 对于 2024年1月 之前的每个月，确定所有订单项目中实现最高总利润（计算为 sale_price 减去产品成本）的产品，然后报告该最高产品每月的总成本和总利润，包括所有订单项目（无论其状态如何），并按月时间顺序显示结果。根据结果，哪种产品的单月利润最高？具体利润金额是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0907.source: Generate a monthly report for each product category , where each row corresponds to orders that have a status of 'Complete' and were delivered before the year 2022, grouping by the month and year of delivery. For each category, calculate the total revenue (the sum of sale_price), the total number of completed orders, and compute the month-over-month percentage growth for both revenue and orders by comparing each month's totals to the previous month's. Then, for the same orders, aggregate and show the total cost (from product costs), total profit (revenue minus total cost), and finally the profit-to-cost ratio for each month. Based on the results, which product category achieved the highest individual month-over-month order growth rate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0907.zh: 为每个产品类别生成一份月度报告，其中每一行对应状态为 'Complete'（已完成）且在 2022 年之前送达的订单，按送达的年份和月份分组。对每个类别，计算总收入（sale_price 之和）和已完成订单总数，并通过将每个月的合计值与上个月进行比较，计算收入和订单数的环比百分比增长。然后，针对同一批订单，汇总并展示总成本（来自产品成本）、总利润（收入减去总成本），最后给出每个月的利润成本比。根据结果，哪个产品类别取得了最高的单月订单环比增长率？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0912.source: Generate a monthly analysis report for e-commerce sales from June 2019 to December 2019 that includes, for each product category and each month, the total number of orders, total revenue, and total profit, along with their month-over-month growth rates using the data from June 2019 as the basis for calculating growth starting from July 2019. Ensure that all orders are included regardless of their status, and present the results sorted in ascending order by month (formatted as "2019-07") and then by product category. Omitting June 2019 from the final output but using it for the growth calculations. Based on the analysis results, which product category demonstrated the most consistent positive revenue growth trend from July through December 2019?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0912.zh: 生成6月2019至12月2019的电商销售额月度分析报告，包括每个产品类别、每个月的订单总数、总收入、总利润以及环比增长率，以6月2019的数据作为计算7月2019开始增长的基础。确保包含所有订单，无论其状态如何，并按月份（格式为“2019-07”）升序显示结果，然后按产品类别排序。从最终输出中省略 2019年6月，但将其用于增长计算。根据分析结果，2019 从 7 月到 12 月哪个产品类别表现出最一致的积极收入增长趋势？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0914.source: Please create a month-by-month report for the year 2023 that focuses on the 'Sleep & Lounge' category, showing for each month the total sales, total cost, number of complete orders, total profit, and the profit-to-cost ratio, ensuring that the order is marked as 'Complete,' the creation date is between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2023, and the cost data is accurately associated with the corresponding product through the order items. Based on the resulting data, which quarter demonstrated the highest average profit-to-cost ratio?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0914.zh: 请创建 2023 年的月度报告，重点关注'Sleep & Lounge'（睡眠和休闲）类别，显示每个月的总销售额、总成本、完成订单数、总利润和利润成本比，确保订单标记为'Complete,'（完成），创建日期在 2023年1月1日 和 12 月之间31、2023，成本数据通过订单项与对应的产品准确关联。根据结果数据，哪个季度的平均利润成本比最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0916.source: For each month prior to July 2024, identify the single best-selling product (determined by highest sales volume, with total revenue as a tiebreaker) among all orders with a 'Complete' status and products with non-null brands. Based on the results, what is the combined total revenue of the three highest-revenue monthly winners from Arc'teryx brand across the entire time period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0916.zh: 对于 2024年7月 之前的每个月，在所有具有'Complete'（完整）状态的订单和具有非空品牌的产品中确定单一最畅销的产品（由最高销量确定，以总收入作为决胜局）。根据结果，Arc'teryx 品牌在整个时间段内收入最高的三个月度冠军的总收入是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0915.source: Identify the difference in the number of the oldest and youngest users registered between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, from our e-commerce platform data. Based on the analysis results, if there were 15 oldest users registered during this period, how many youngest users were registered?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0915.zh: 从我们的电子商务平台数据中找出 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间最大和最小注册用户数量的差异。根据分析结果，如果在此期间有15最年长的用户注册，那么最年轻的用户注册了多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0913.source: Determine the number of users who are the youngest and oldest for each gender (male and female) separately, among those who signed up between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022. For each gender, identify the minimum and maximum ages within this date range, and count how many users fall into these respective age groups. Based on this analysis, what is the total number of users in extreme age categories (youngest and oldest combined) across both genders?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0913.zh: 分别确定 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间注册的用户中每种性别（男性和女性）最年轻和最年长的用户数量。对于每个性别，确定此日期范围内的最小和最大年龄，并计算有多少用户属于这些各自的年龄组。根据此分析，极端年龄类别（最年轻和最年长的总和）的两性用户总数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0919.source: Which three browsers have the shortest average session duration—calculated by the difference in seconds between the earliest and latest timestamps for each user's session—while only including browsers that have more than 10 total sessions, and what are their respective average session durations? Based on this analysis, what is the approximate percentage difference between the browser with the shortest average session duration and the browser with the longest average session duration among the top three?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0919.zh: 哪三种浏览器的平均会话持续时间最短（根据每个用户会话的最早和最新时间戳之间的秒数差异计算），同时仅包括总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器，它们各自的平均会话持续时间是多少？根据此分析，前三名中平均会话持续时间最短的浏览器和平均会话持续时间最长的浏览器之间的大致百分比差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0918.source: Please provide the names of the products that had sales in each month of 2020 and had the lowest profit, calculated as the difference between their retail price and cost from the products data. Exclude any months where this data isn't available. Please list the products in chronological order based on the month. Based on the above result, how many distinct products appear as the lowest-profit items across all months of 2020?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0918.zh: 请提供 2020 年每月有销售且利润最低的产品名称，其计算方式为零售价与产品数据成本之间的差额。排除无法获得此数据的任何月份。请根据月份按时间顺序列出产品。根据上述结果，在 2020 年的所有月份中，有多少种不同的产品显示为利润最低的商品？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0917.source: Can you list the email addresses of the top 10 users who registered in 2019 and made purchases in 2019, ranking them by their highest average order value, where average order value is calculated by multiplying the number of items in each order by the sale price, summing this total across all orders for each user, and then dividing by the total number of orders? Based on the ranking results, which email domain appears most frequently among the top performers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0917.zh: 您能否列出在 2019 年注册并在 2019 年进行购买的排名靠前的 10 用户的电子邮件地址，并按最高平均订单价值对他们进行排名，其中平均订单价值的计算方法是将每个订单中的商品数量乘以销售价格，将每个用户的所有订单的总和除以订单总数？根据排名结果，哪个电子邮件域最常出现在表现最佳的域中？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0920.source: For the user cohort with a first purchase date in January 2020, what proportion of users returned in the subsequent months of 2020? Based on the cohort analysis results, which statement about the November retention rate compared to other months is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0920.zh: 对于首次购买日期为 2020年1月 的用户群体，在 2020 年的后续月份中返回的用户比例是多少？根据队列分析结果，与其他月份相比，关于 11 月留存率的哪种说法最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0921.source: Please generate a report that, for each month in 2021, provides the number of orders, the number of unique purchasers, and the profit (calculated as the sum of product retail prices minus the sum of product costs), where the orders were placed during 2021 by users who registered in 2021 for inventory items created in 2021, and group the results by the users' country, product department, and product category. Based on the above result, which country-department combination generated the highest single-transaction profit in the dataset?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0921.zh: 请生成一份报告，其中提供 2021 年每个月的订单数、唯一购买者数以及利润（计算为产品零售价格总和减去产品成本总和），其中在 2021 年注册的用户针对 2021 年创建的库存商品在 2021 年下的订单，并按用户所在国家/地区、产品部门和产品对结果进行分组类别。根据上述结果，数据集中哪个国家/地区组合产生的单笔交易利润最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0922.source: Please provide the names of the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding any products associated with orders that were canceled or returned. For each product in each month, the profit should be calculated as the sum of the sale prices of all order items minus the sum of the costs of those sold items in that month. Based on the analysis results, which product category demonstrates the strongest market presence among the top performers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0922.zh: 请提供从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三种产品的名称，不包括与取消或退货订单相关的任何产品。对于每个月的每种产品，利润应计算为所有订单商品的销售价格总和减去该月销售商品的成本总和。根据分析结果，哪个产品类别在表现最佳的产品中表现出最强的市场影响力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0924.source: What is the name of the reference sequence with the highest variant density in the given cannabis genome dataset? Based on the identified sequence, which GenBank accession format does this reference follow?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0924.zh: 给定大麻基因组数据集中变异密度最高的参考序列的名称是什么？根据已识别的序列，该参考文献遵循哪种 GenBank 登录格式？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0923.source: Can you list the top 5 months from August 2022 to November 2023 where the profit from Facebook-sourced completed orders showed the largest month-over-month increase? Calculate profit as sales minus costs, group by delivery month, and include only orders created between August 2022 and November 2023. Compare each month's profit to its previous month to find the largest increases. Based on the results, what is the combined total profit increase for the second and fourth ranked months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0923.zh: 您能否列出从 2022年8月 到 2023年11月 的最高 5 月份，其中来自 Facebook 的已完成订单的利润显示出最大的环比增幅？将利润计算为销售额减去成本，按交货月份分组，并且仅包括 2022年8月 和 2023年11月 之间创建的订单。将每个月的利润与上个月进行比较，找出最大的增幅。根据结果，排名第二和第四的月份的总利润增幅是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0925.source: What is the variant density of the cannabis reference with the longest reference length? Pay attention that a variant is present if there is at least one variant call with a genotype greater than 0. Based on the analysis results, approximately how many base pairs are there between each variant on average?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0925.zh: 参考长度最长的大麻参考的变异密度是多少？请注意，如果至少有一个基因型大于 0 的变体调用，则表示存在变体。根据分析结果，每个变体之间平均大约有多少个碱基对？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0927.source: Which country has the highest percentage of population under the age of 25 in 2017? Based on this result, what demographic characteristic is most likely associated with countries having such high youth populations?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0927.zh: 哪个国家2017 年中25年龄以下的人口比例最高？根据这一结果，什么样的人口特征最有可能与拥有如此高青年人口的国家相关？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0926.source: Provide a list of the top 10 countries for the year 2020, ordered by the highest percentage of their population under 20 years old. For each country, include the total population under 20 years old, the total midyear population, and the percentage of the population that is under 20 years old. Based on the above result, what is the total population under 20 years old across all top 10 countries combined?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0926.zh: 提供 2020 年排名靠前的 10 国家/地区列表，按 20 岁以下人口的最高百分比排序。对于每个国家，包括 20 岁以下的总人口、年中总人口以及 20 岁以下的人口百分比。根据上述结果，所有顶级 10 个国家/地区的 20 岁以下总人口总数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0930.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020. Based on the calculated results, which statement about the top-performing countries in terms of case percentage is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0930.zh: 您需要计算截至 2020年6月30日 的每个国家/地区已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。根据计算结果，关于病例百分比方面表现最好的国家，哪种说法最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0929.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? Based on the analysis, which month contained the peak growth rate day?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0929.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？根据分析，增长率峰值日是哪一个月？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0931.source: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data? Based on the results, what is the approximate difference in cases per 100,000 people between the country with the highest rate and the country with the lowest rate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0931.zh: 您能否提供美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗截至 2020年4月20日 确诊的 COVID-19 病例总数，以及根据 2020 总人口计算出的每 100,000 人的病例数，该总人口是通过对世界银行数据中所有相关人口条目进行求和而计算得出的？根据结果，比率最高的国家和比率最低的国家之间每 100,000 人的病例数大约有多少差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0935.source: Given the latest population estimates from the 2018 five-year American Community Survey, what is the number of vaccine sites per 1000 people for counties in California? Based on the vaccination site density data, which statement about California's three most populous counties is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0935.zh: 根据 2018 年五年美国社区调查的最新人口估计，加利福尼亚州各县每 1000 人的疫苗接种点数量是多少？根据疫苗接种点密度数据，关于加州人口最多的三个县的哪种说法最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0932.source: Analyze daily new COVID-19 case counts from March to May 2020, identifying the top five states by daily increases. Please compile a ranking based on how often each state appears in these daily top fives. Then, examine the state that ranks fourth overall and identify its top five counties based on their frequency of appearing in the daily top five new case counts. Based on the county ranking results, what is the total number of distinct counties identified in the top five positions?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0932.zh: 分析 3 月至 2020年5月 每日新增的 COVID-19 病例数，确定每日增量最多的五个州。请根据每个州出现在每日前五名的频率来编制排名。然后，检查总体排名第四的州，并根据其出现在每日新增病例数前五名的频率中确定其前五个县。根据县排名结果，排名前五位的不同县总数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0933.source: Please calculate the overall percentage change in the average weekly search frequency for the symptom 'Anosmia' across the five New York City counties—Bronx County, Queens County, Kings County, New York County, and Richmond County—by comparing the combined data from January 1, 2019, through December 31, 2019, with the combined data from January 1, 2020, through December 31, 2020. Based on the calculated results, which statement best describes the relationship between the 2019 and 2020 average weekly search frequencies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0933.zh: 请通过将 2019年1月1日 到 2019年12月31日 的合并数据与 1 月的合并数据进行比较，计算纽约市五个县（布朗克斯县、皇后县、国王县、纽约县和里士满县）'Anosmia'（嗅觉缺失）症状的平均每周搜索频率的总体百分比变化1、2020，截至 2020年12月31日。根据计算结果，哪种说法最能描述 2019 年和 2020 年平均每周搜索频率之间的关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0934.source: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period. Based on these calculations, which statement best describes the relationship between anxiety and depression symptom changes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0934.zh: 请根据美国每周国家数据计算2019年1月1日至2020年1月1日以及2020年1月1日至1月1期间焦虑和抑郁症状的平均水平， 2021。然后，计算从 2019 年期间到 2020 年期间这些平均症状水平的增加百分比。根据这些计算，哪种说法最能描述焦虑和抑郁症状变化之间的关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0936.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. For these counties, provide the name, state, median age, total population, number of confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people, number of deaths per 100,000 people, and the case fatality rate as a percentage. Based on the results, which statement about the relationship between median age and case fatality rates is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0936.zh: 使用 2020 5 年人口普查数据查找人口超过 50,000 的前三个县，这些县在 2020年8月27日 的 COVID-19 病死率最高。对于这些县，请提供名称、州、中位年龄、总人口、每 100,000 人的 COVID-19 确诊病例数、每 100,000 人的死亡人数以及病死率（百分比）。根据结果，关于中位年龄和病死率之间关系的哪种说法最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0937.source: Please find all zip code areas located within 10 kilometers of the coordinates (-122.3321, 47.6062) by joining the 2010 census population data (summing only male and female populations with no age constraints) and the zip code area information, and return each area's polygon, land and water area in meters, latitude and longitude, state code, state name, city, county, and total population. Based on the results, which zip code has the highest population density (population per square meter of land area)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0937.zh: 请通过连接2010 年人口普查数据（仅对男性和女性人口进行求和，没有年龄限制）和邮政编码区域信息，查找位于坐标（-122.3321、47.6062）10公里范围内的所有邮政编码区域，并返回每个区域的多边形、土地和水域面积（以米为单位）、经纬度、州代码、州名称、城市、县、总人口。根据结果，哪个邮政编码的人口密度（每平方米土地面积的人口）最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0940.source: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Based on the analysis results, which tract code represents the area with the most significant income growth during this period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0940.zh: 加利福尼亚州哪个人口普查区的 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增幅最大？根据分析结果，哪个地区代码代表了这一时期收入增长最显着的地区？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0941.source: Using the 2017 U.S. Census Tract data from the BigQuery public datasets, you need to proportionally allocate each tract's population and income to the zip codes based on the overlapping area between their geographic boundaries. Then, filter the results to include only those zip codes located within a 5-mile radius of a specific point in Washington State, with coordinates at latitude 47.685833°N and longitude -122.191667°W. Finally, calculate the total population and the average individual income for each zip code (rounded to one decimal place) and sort the results by the average individual income in descending order. Based on the results, what is the combined population of the three zip codes with the highest average individual income?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0941.zh: 使用 BigQuery 公共数据集中的 2017 年美国人口普查区数据，您需要根据地理边界之间的重叠面积将每个地区的人口和收入按比例分配给邮政编码。然后，筛选结果以仅包含位于华盛顿州特定点的 5 英里半径范围内的邮政编码，坐标为纬度 47.685833°N 和经度 -122.191667°W。最后，计算每个邮政编码的总人口和个人平均收入（四舍五入到小数点后一位），并将结果按个人平均收入降序排列。根据结果，个人平均收入最高的三个邮政编码的总人口是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0942.source: Please provide a chronological summary of all scoring plays from the 2014 season game where the Wildcats were the home team and the Fighting Irish were the away team. Include for each scoring event the game clock, cumulative scores for both teams (Wildcats and Fighting Irish), the team that scored, and a description of the event. Based on the chronological scoring data, what was the final score of this basketball game?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0942.zh: 请提供 2014 年赛季比赛中所有得分比赛的时间摘要，其中野猫队是主队，战斗爱尔兰队是客队。包括每个得分项目的比赛时钟、两支球队（野猫队和爱尔兰战斗队）的累积得分、得分球队以及赛事描述。根据时间顺序的得分数据，这场篮球比赛的最终得分是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0944.source: Please generate a table from the NCAA basketball dataset that lists the top five records in each of these four categories: (1) Top Venues - the largest venues by seating capacity with Date shown as 'N/A'; (2) Biggest Championship Margins - National Championship games since the 2016 season (season > 2015) with the biggest point margin victories; (3) Highest Scoring Games - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total points scored by both teams combined; and (4) Total Threes - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total three-pointers made by both teams combined. Based on the results, what is the combined total of the highest venue capacity and the highest three-point total recorded?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0944.zh: 请从 NCAA 篮球数据集生成一个表格，其中列出了这四个类别中每个类别的前 5 名记录： (1) 顶级场馆 - 按座位数划分的最大场馆，日期显示为“N/A”； (2) 最大的冠军分差 - 自 2016 年赛季（赛季 > 2015）以来拥有最大分差胜利的全国冠军赛； (3) 最高得分比赛 - 自 2011 年赛季以来（赛季 > 2010）两支球队合计得分最高的比赛； (4) 三分球总数 - 自 2011 年赛季（赛季 > 2010）以来两队三分球总数最高的比赛。根据结果，最高场地容量和最高三分总数的总和是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0945.source: Could you determine, for each shot type, the average x and y coordinates (adjusted to ensure consistency regarding the left or right basket), the average number of shot attempts, and the average number of successful shots, considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the correct side of the court based on the team's basket? Based on the analysis results, which shot type demonstrates the highest success rate when combining accuracy with positioning efficiency?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0945.zh: 您能否确定每种投篮类型的平均 x 和 y 坐标（进行调整以确保左篮或右篮的一致性）、平均投篮尝试次数和平均投篮成功次数，仅考虑 2018年3月15日 之前的投篮，排除那些空投篮类型或坐标，确保投篮基于球队的篮筐在球场的正确一侧？根据分析结果，当精度与定位效率相结合时，哪种射击类型的成功率最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0946.source: For the top five team markets with the highest number of distinct players who scored at least 15 points during the second period of games between 2010 and 2018, provide details of each game they played in NCAA basketball historical tournament matches during the same period, as specified in the data model document. Based on the tournament performance data, which team market achieved the highest number of championship game appearances (round 2) during this period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0946.zh: 对于在 2010 年和 2018 年之间的第二场比赛中获得至少 15 分的不同球员数量最多的前 5 个球队市场，请提供他们在同一时期内 NCAA 篮球历史锦标赛比赛中所参加的每场比赛的详细信息，如数据模型文档中所指定。根据赛事表现数据，哪支球队在此期间获得冠军赛出场次数（2）最多？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0947.source: Create a dataset by combining NCAA men's basketball tournament game outcomes from the 2014 season onwards, including both the historical tournament games and the 2018 tournament results, with the corresponding pace and efficiency performance metrics for each team and their opponents from the feature_engineering data. The dataset should include the season, game outcome labels (win or loss), team and opponent seeds, school names, pace and efficiency rankings, statistical values, and the differences between the team's and the opponent's metrics to enable a comprehensive analysis of team and opponent dynamics. Based on this dataset, what was the largest efficiency ranking difference where the team with the worse ranking still won the game?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0947.zh: 通过将 2014 年赛季开始的 NCAA 男子篮球锦标赛比赛结果（包括历史锦标赛比赛和 2018 年锦标赛结果）与 feature_engineering 数据中每支球队及其对手的相应节奏和效率表现指标相结合来创建数据集。数据集应包括赛季、比赛结果标签（胜或负）、球队和对手种子、学校名称、速度和效率排名、统计值以及球队和对手指标之间的差异，以便全面分析球队和对手的动态。根据这个数据集，排名较差的球队仍然赢得比赛的最大效率排名差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0949.source: Find the latest ride data for each region between 2014 and 2017. I want to know the name of each region, the trip ID of this ride, the ride duration, the start time, the starting station, and the gender of the rider. Based on the results, what is the average trip duration across all regions for these latest rides?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0949.zh: 查找 2014 年和 2017 年之间每个区域的最新乘车数据。我想知道每个地区的名称、本次骑行的行程ID、骑行时长、起始时间、起始车站以及骑行者的性别。根据结果，这些最新游乐设施在所有地区的平均行程持续时间是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0950.source: Could you provide the details of the top 5 longest bike share trips that started between July 1, 2017, and December 31, 2017, including the trip ID, duration in seconds, start date, start station name, route (derived from start station name to end station name), bike number, subscriber type, member's birth year, the member's current age (calculated using the current year), an age classification based on whether the member is younger than 40, between 40 and 60, or older than 60, the member's gender, and the name of the region of the start station? Please exclude any trips where the start station name, member's birth year, or member's gender is not specified. Based on the results, what is the combined total duration of the two longest trips taken by female riders?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0950.zh: 您能否提供 2017年7月1日 和 2017年12月31日 之间开始的最长 5 最长自行车共享行程的详细信息，包括行程 ID、持续时间（以秒为单位）、开始日期、起始站名称、路线（从起始站名称到终点站名称）、自行车号码、订阅者类型、会员的出生年份、会员当前年龄（以当前年份计算）、根据会员是否小于40、介于40和60之间、或大于60进行年龄分类、会员性别、起始站的地区名称？请排除未指定起始站名称、会员出生年份或会员性别的行程。根据结果，女性骑手两次最长行程的总时间是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0951.source: Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data? Based on this result, which seasonal period does this peak month represent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0951.zh: 根据旧金山共享单车数据中的行程结束日期，2017 年哪个月份（数量）的客户和订阅者的累积自行车使用分钟数（以千为单位）之间的绝对差异最大？根据这个结果，这个高峰月代表哪个季节？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0952.source: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route. Based on the results, which route has the longer daily service span between these stops?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0952.zh: 对于在停靠顺序中“Clay St & Drumm St”出现在“Sacramento St & Davis St”之前的行程（仅限一个方向），从“Clay St & Drumm St”出发的最早出发时间以及在“Sacramento St & Davis St”最晚到达的时间（格式为 HH:MM:SS）是多少？请提供每条路线的车头标志。根据结果，哪条路线在这些站点之间的每日服务时间较长？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0953.source: What is the highest average speed (rounded to 1 decimal, in metric m/s) for bike trips in Berkeley with trip distance greater than 1000 meters? Based on this result, which statement best describes the cycling behavior characteristics in Berkeley?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0953.zh: 在伯克利，行程距离大于 1000 米的自行车旅行的最高平均速度是多少（四舍五入到小数点 1，以公制米/秒为单位）？根据这个结果，哪种说法最能描述伯克利的骑行行为特征？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0954.source: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order? Based on the analysis results, if this category's revenue represents approximately 23.7% of total company revenue, what would be the estimated total company revenue?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0954.zh: 您能否帮我算出在第一个未取消和未退货订单中购买的客户数量最多的产品类别的收入？根据分析结果，如果该类别的收入约占公司总收入的23.7%，则预计公司总收入是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0955.source: Among all product categories in the dataset, identify the category with the highest total purchase quantity (based on order_items table), and for that specific category, what is the average time in minutes that users spend on each product page visit? Based on the analysis results, if a marketing team wants to implement engagement optimization strategies that could increase user page viewing time by 20%, what would be the new target average time per visit?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0955.zh: 在数据集中的所有产品类别中，确定总购买量最高的类别（基于 order_items 表），对于该特定类别，用户在每个产品页面访问上花费的平均时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？根据分析结果，如果营销团队想要实施互动优化策略，将用户页面浏览时间增加 20%，那么新的目标平均每次访问时间是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0956.source: Generate a monthly report for each product category , where each row corresponds to orders that have a status of 'Complete' and were delivered before the year 2022, grouping by the month and year of delivery. For each category, calculate the total revenue (the sum of sale_price), the total number of completed orders, and compute the month-over-month percentage growth for both revenue and orders by comparing each month's totals to the previous month's. Then, for the same orders, aggregate and show the total cost (from product costs), total profit (revenue minus total cost), and finally the profit-to-cost ratio for each month. Based on the analysis results, which product category demonstrated the most extreme revenue volatility when comparing its highest positive growth month with its highest negative decline month?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0956.zh: 为每个产品类别生成一份月度报告，其中每一行对应状态为 'Complete'（已完成）且在 2022 年之前送达的订单，按送达的年份和月份分组。对每个类别，计算总收入（sale_price 之和）和已完成订单总数，并通过将每个月的合计值与上个月进行比较，计算收入和订单数的环比百分比增长。然后，针对同一批订单，汇总并展示总成本（来自产品成本）、总利润（收入减去总成本），最后给出每个月的利润成本比。根据分析结果，在比较其正增长最高的月份与负下降最大的月份时，哪个产品类别表现出最极端的收入波动？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0957.source: Using data up to the end of 2022 and organized by the month of each user's first purchase, can you provide the percentage of users who made a purchase in each of the first, second, third, and fourth months since their initial purchase, where the "first month" refers to the month of their initial purchase? Based on the cohort analysis results, which month showed the highest second-month retention rate, and what was the approximate difference between the highest and lowest second-month retention rates observed across all cohorts?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0957.zh: 使用截至 2022 年末尾的数据，并按每个用户首次购买的月份进行组织，您能否提供自首次购买以来的第一个月、第二个月、第三个月和第四个月中每个月进行过购买的用户的百分比，其中“第一个月”是指他们首次购买的月份？根据队列分析结果，哪个月份显示出最高的第二个月保留率，以及在所有队列中观察到的最高和最低第二个月保留率之间的大致差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0958.source: Based solely on completed orders, calculate the average monthly percentage growth rate in the number of unique orders (counting distinct order IDs) for each product category by comparing each month's count to the previous month within the same category. Identify the product category with the highest average of these monthly order growth rates. Then, for that specific product category, compute the average monthly revenue growth rate by calculating the percentage change in total revenue (sum of sale prices) from month to month and averaging these values over the entire period. Based on the calculated average monthly revenue growth rate, which of the following business interpretations is most accurate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0958.zh: 仅根据已完成的订单，通过将同一类别中每月的计数与上个月的计数进行比较，计算每个产品类别的唯一订单数量（计算不同订单 ID）的平均每月百分比增长率。确定这些月度订单增长率平均值最高的产品类别。然后，对于该特定产品类别，通过计算每月总收入（销售价格总和）的百分比变化并对整个期间的这些值进行平均，计算平均每月收入增长率。根据计算出的平均月收入增长率，以下哪种业务解释最准确？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0959.source: From January 1, 2019, to April 30, 2022, how many users are at the youngest age and how many users are at the oldest age for each gender in the e-commerce platform, counting both youngest and oldest users separately for each gender? Based on the above result, what is the total number of users at extreme ages (youngest and oldest combined) across both genders?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0959.zh: 从2019年1月1日到2022年4月30日，电商平台各性别中最小年龄用户数和最大年龄用户数分别统计各性别的最小用户数和最大年龄用户数？根据上述结果，极端年龄（最年轻和最年长的总和）的两性用户总数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0960.source: For each month prior to January 2024, identify the product that achieved the highest total profit (calculated as the sum of sale_price minus the product's cost) across all order items, then report the total cost and total profit for that top product per month, including all order items regardless of their status, and present the results chronologically by month. Based on the analysis results, which product generated the highest single-month profit and what was the profit margin percentage for that specific month?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0960.zh: 对于 2024年1月 之前的每个月，确定所有订单项目中实现最高总利润（计算为 sale_price 减去产品成本）的产品，然后报告该最高产品每月的总成本和总利润，包括所有订单项目（无论其状态如何），并按月时间顺序显示结果。根据分析结果，哪种产品单月利润最高？该月的利润率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0962.source: Determine the number of users who are the youngest and oldest for each gender (male and female) separately, among those who signed up between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022. For each gender, identify the minimum and maximum ages within this date range, and count how many users fall into these respective age groups. Based on the analysis results, what is the total number of users across all extreme age categories, and which gender shows a higher concentration in the youngest age group?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0962.zh: 分别确定 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间注册的用户中每种性别（男性和女性）最年轻和最年长的用户数量。对于每个性别，确定此日期范围内的最小和最大年龄，并计算有多少用户属于这些各自的年龄组。根据分析结果，所有极端年龄类别的用户总数是多少？哪种性别在最年轻的年龄组中表现出更高的集中度？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0961.source: Generate a monthly analysis report for e-commerce sales from June 2019 to December 2019 that includes, for each product category and each month, the total number of orders, total revenue, and total profit, along with their month-over-month growth rates using the data from June 2019 as the basis for calculating growth starting from July 2019. Ensure that all orders are included regardless of their status, and present the results sorted in ascending order by month (formatted as "2019-07") and then by product category. Omitting June 2019 from the final output but using it for the growth calculations. Based on the analysis results, which product category had the highest total revenue in October 2019 and what was the approximate revenue growth rate for Blazers & Jackets from July to December 2019?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0961.zh: 生成6月2019至12月2019的电商销售额月度分析报告，包括每个产品类别、每个月的订单总数、总收入、总利润以及环比增长率，以6月2019的数据作为计算7月2019开始增长的基础。确保包含所有订单，无论其状态如何，并按月份（格式为“2019-07”）升序显示结果，然后按产品类别排序。从最终输出中省略 2019年6月，但将其用于增长计算。根据分析结果，2019 10 月份哪个产品类别的总收入最高？2019年7月至 12 月 西装外套和夹克的收入增长率大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0963.source: Please create a month-by-month report for the year 2023 that focuses on the 'Sleep & Lounge' category, showing for each month the total sales, total cost, number of complete orders, total profit, and the profit-to-cost ratio, ensuring that the order is marked as 'Complete,' the creation date is between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2023, and the cost data is accurately associated with the corresponding product through the order items. Based on the results, which month demonstrated the highest efficiency in converting costs into profits?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0963.zh: 请创建 2023 年的月度报告，重点关注'Sleep & Lounge'（睡眠和休闲）类别，显示每个月的总销售额、总成本、完成订单数、总利润和利润成本比，确保订单标记为'Complete,'（完成），创建日期在 2023年1月1日 和 12 月之间31、2023，成本数据通过订单项与对应的产品准确关联。根据结果，哪一个月的成本转化为利润的效率最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0964.source: Identify the difference in the number of the oldest and youngest users registered between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, from our e-commerce platform data. Based on this analysis, if the youngest user group had 15 registered users during this period, how many oldest users were registered?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0964.zh: 从我们的电子商务平台数据中找出 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间最大和最小注册用户数量的差异。据此分析，如果最年轻的用户组在此期间有15注册用户，那么最老的用户注册了多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0965.source: For each month prior to July 2024, identify the single best-selling product (determined by highest sales volume, with total revenue as a tiebreaker) among all orders with a 'Complete' status and products with non-null brands. Based on the analysis results, what is the total number of times Arc'teryx products appeared as monthly best-sellers, and what was their highest single-month revenue achievement?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0965.zh: 对于 2024年7月 之前的每个月，在所有具有'Complete'（完整）状态的订单和具有非空品牌的产品中确定单一最畅销的产品（由最高销量确定，以总收入作为决胜局）。根据分析结果，Arc’teryx 产品出现月度畅销产品的总次数是多少？其单月最高收入成绩是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0968.source: Which three browsers have the shortest average session duration—calculated by the difference in seconds between the earliest and latest timestamps for each user's session—while only including browsers that have more than 10 total sessions, and what are their respective average session durations? Based on the analysis results, what is the percentage difference between the browser with the shortest average session duration and the browser with the longest average session duration among these three browsers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0968.zh: 哪三种浏览器的平均会话持续时间最短（根据每个用户会话的最早和最新时间戳之间的秒数差异计算），同时仅包括总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器，它们各自的平均会话持续时间是多少？根据分析结果，这三个浏览器中平均会话持续时间最短的浏览器和平均会话持续时间最长的浏览器之间的百分比差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0967.source: Please provide the names of the products that had sales in each month of 2020 and had the lowest profit, calculated as the difference between their retail price and cost from the products data. Exclude any months where this data isn't available. Please list the products in chronological order based on the month. Based on the above result, how many unique products appear in the lowest-profit list?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0967.zh: 请提供 2020 年每月有销售且利润最低的产品名称，其计算方式为零售价与产品数据成本之间的差额。排除无法获得此数据的任何月份。请根据月份按时间顺序列出产品。根据以上结果，有多少个独特的产品出现在利润最低的列表中？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0966.source: Can you list the email addresses of the top 10 users who registered in 2019 and made purchases in 2019, ranking them by their highest average order value, where average order value is calculated by multiplying the number of items in each order by the sale price, summing this total across all orders for each user, and then dividing by the total number of orders? Based on the results, what is the distribution of email domains among these top 10 customers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0966.zh: 您能否列出在 2019 年注册并在 2019 年进行购买的排名靠前的 10 用户的电子邮件地址，并按最高平均订单价值对他们进行排名，其中平均订单价值的计算方法是将每个订单中的商品数量乘以销售价格，将每个用户的所有订单的总和除以订单总数？根据结果，这些顶级 10 个客户的电子邮件域分布情况如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0969.source: For the user cohort with a first purchase date in January 2020, what proportion of users returned in the subsequent months of 2020? Based on the cohort analysis results, what was the highest monthly retention rate and in which month did it occur?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0969.zh: 对于首次购买日期为 2020年1月 的用户群体，在 2020 年的后续月份中返回的用户比例是多少？根据队列分析结果，最高的月保留率是多少？发生在哪一个月？
