7-30/FDABench/FDA0970.source: Please generate a report that, for each month in 2021, provides the number of orders, the number of unique purchasers, and the profit (calculated as the sum of product retail prices minus the sum of product costs), where the orders were placed during 2021 by users who registered in 2021 for inventory items created in 2021, and group the results by the users' country, product department, and product category. Based on the above result, which country-department-category combination generated the highest single-month profit?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0970.zh: 请生成一份报告，其中提供 2021 年每个月的订单数、唯一购买者数以及利润（计算为产品零售价格总和减去产品成本总和），其中在 2021 年注册的用户针对 2021 年创建的库存商品在 2021 年下的订单，并按用户所在国家/地区、产品部门和产品对结果进行分组类别。根据上述结果，哪个国家/地区/类别组合产生的单月利润最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0973.source: What is the name of the reference sequence with the highest variant density in the given cannabis genome dataset? Based on the identification of this sequence, which GenBank accession number format pattern does this reference follow?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0973.zh: 给定大麻基因组数据集中变异密度最高的参考序列的名称是什么？根据该序列的识别，该参考文献遵循哪种 GenBank 登录号格式模式？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0972.source: Can you list the top 5 months from August 2022 to November 2023 where the profit from Facebook-sourced completed orders showed the largest month-over-month increase? Calculate profit as sales minus costs, group by delivery month, and include only orders created between August 2022 and November 2023. Compare each month's profit to its previous month to find the largest increases. Based on the results, what is the combined month-over-month profit increase for the top 2 performing months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0972.zh: 您能否列出从 2022年8月 到 2023年11月 的最高 5 月份，其中来自 Facebook 的已完成订单的利润显示出最大的环比增幅？将利润计算为销售额减去成本，按交货月份分组，并且仅包括 2022年8月 和 2023年11月 之间创建的订单。将每个月的利润与上个月进行比较，找出最大的增幅。根据结果，2 表现最好的月份的月度合并利润增幅是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0971.source: Please provide the names of the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding any products associated with orders that were canceled or returned. For each product in each month, the profit should be calculated as the sum of the sale prices of all order items minus the sum of the costs of those sold items in that month. Based on the results, which brand appears most frequently among the top profitable products?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0971.zh: 请提供从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三种产品的名称，不包括与取消或退货订单相关的任何产品。对于每个月的每种产品，利润应计算为所有订单商品的销售价格总和减去该月销售商品的成本总和。根据结果，哪个品牌最常出现在利润最高的产品中？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0976.source: Which country has the highest percentage of population under the age of 25 in 2017? Based on this result, what demographic characteristic is most likely true about this country?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0976.zh: 哪个国家2017 年中25年龄以下的人口比例最高？根据此结果，该国家最有可能的人口特征是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0975.source: Provide a list of the top 10 countries for the year 2020, ordered by the highest percentage of their population under 20 years old. For each country, include the total population under 20 years old, the total midyear population, and the percentage of the population that is under 20 years old. Based on this data, how many countries have both a youth population exceeding 15 million people and a youth percentage above 55%?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0975.zh: 提供 2020 年排名靠前的 10 国家/地区列表，按 20 岁以下人口的最高百分比排序。对于每个国家，包括 20 岁以下的总人口、年中总人口以及 20 岁以下的人口百分比。根据该数据，有多少个国家的青年人口超过 1500万人，且青年比例超过 55%？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0974.source: What is the variant density of the cannabis reference with the longest reference length? Pay attention that a variant is present if there is at least one variant call with a genotype greater than 0. Based on the analysis results, what is the approximate number of base pairs per variant in this reference sequence?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0974.zh: 参考长度最长的大麻参考的变异密度是多少？请注意，如果至少有一个基因型大于 0 的变体调用，则表示存在变体。根据分析结果，该参考序列中每个变体的碱基对数量大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0978.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? The format is MM-DD. Based on this finding, what does the timing of this peak growth rate suggest about the early pandemic trajectory?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0978.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？格式为MM-DD。根据这一发现，这一峰值增长率的出现时间对早期大流行轨迹有何启示？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0981.source: Analyze daily new COVID-19 case counts from March to May 2020, identifying the top five states by daily increases. Please compile a ranking based on how often each state appears in these daily top fives. Then, examine the state that ranks fourth overall and identify its top five counties based on their frequency of appearing in the daily top five new case counts. Based on the analysis results, which county appears in the first position of the ranking?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0981.zh: 分析 3 月至 2020年5月 每日新增的 COVID-19 病例数，确定每日增量最多的五个州。请根据每个州出现在每日前五名的频率来编制排名。然后，检查总体排名第四的州，并根据其出现在每日新增病例数前五名的频率中确定其前五个县。根据分析结果，哪个县出现在排名第一的位置？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0979.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020. Based on the calculated results, which statement about the top three countries with highest infection rates is correct?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0979.zh: 您需要计算截至 2020年6月30日 的每个国家/地区已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。根据计算结果，关于感染率最高的三个国家的说法正确的是？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0982.source: Please calculate the overall percentage change in the average weekly search frequency for the symptom 'Anosmia' across the five New York City counties—Bronx County, Queens County, Kings County, New York County, and Richmond County—by comparing the combined data from January 1, 2019, through December 31, 2019, with the combined data from January 1, 2020, through December 31, 2020. Based on the calculated results, which statement best describes the relationship between the 2019 and 2020 average search frequencies?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0982.zh: 请通过将 2019年1月1日 到 2019年12月31日 的合并数据与 1 月的合并数据进行比较，计算纽约市五个县（布朗克斯县、皇后县、国王县、纽约县和里士满县）'Anosmia'（嗅觉缺失）症状的平均每周搜索频率的总体百分比变化1、2020，截至 2020年12月31日。根据计算结果，哪种说法最能描述 2019 年和 2020 年平均搜索频率之间的关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0984.source: Given the latest population estimates from the 2018 five-year American Community Survey, what is the number of vaccine sites per 1000 people for counties in California? Based on the data analysis, which statement accurately describes the relationship between county population size and vaccine site density?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0984.zh: 根据 2018 年五年美国社区调查的最新人口估计，加利福尼亚州各县每 1000 人的疫苗接种点数量是多少？根据数据分析，哪种说法准确地描述了县人口规模与疫苗点密度之间的关系？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0986.source: Please find all zip code areas located within 10 kilometers of the coordinates (-122.3321, 47.6062) by joining the 2010 census population data and the zip code area information. Based on the query results, which zip code has the highest population density per square kilometer of land area?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0986.zh: 请通过连接2010 年人口普查数据和邮政编码区域信息，查找位于坐标（-122.3321、47.6062）10公里范围内的所有邮政编码区域。根据查询结果，哪个邮政编码每平方公里土地面积的人口密度最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0983.source: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period. Based on this analysis, which statement best describes the directional changes and magnitude differences between anxiety and depression symptoms?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0983.zh: 请根据美国每周国家数据计算2019年1月1日至2020年1月1日以及2020年1月1日至1月1期间焦虑和抑郁症状的平均水平， 2021。然后，计算从 2019 年期间到 2020 年期间这些平均症状水平的增加百分比。根据此分析，哪种说法最能描述焦虑和抑郁症状之间的方向变化和程度差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0985.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. For these counties, provide the name, state, median age, total population, number of confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people, number of deaths per 100,000 people, and the case fatality rate as a percentage. Based on the results, what is the difference between the highest and lowest confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people among these three counties?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0985.zh: 使用 2020 5 年人口普查数据查找人口超过 50,000 的前三个县，这些县在 2020年8月27日 的 COVID-19 病死率最高。对于这些县，请提供名称、州、中位年龄、总人口、每 100,000 人的 COVID-19 确诊病例数、每 100,000 人的死亡人数以及病死率（百分比）。根据结果，这三个县中 100,000 人均确诊的 COVID-19 病例数最高和最低之间有何差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0989.source: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Tell me the tract code. Based on the analysis result, which census tract identifier represents the area with the highest median income growth during this period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0989.zh: 加利福尼亚州哪个人口普查区的 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增幅最大？告诉我道代码。根据分析结果，哪个人口普查区标识符代表该时期收入中位数增长最高的地区？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0990.source: Using the 2017 U.S. Census Tract data from the BigQuery public datasets, you need to proportionally allocate each tract's population and income to the zip codes based on the overlapping area between their geographic boundaries. Then, filter the results to include only those zip codes located within a 5-mile radius of a specific point in Washington State, with coordinates at latitude 47.685833°N and longitude -122.191667°W. Finally, calculate the total population and the average individual income for each zip code (rounded to one decimal place) and sort the results by the average individual income in descending order. Based on the analysis results, what is the income inequality ratio between the highest and lowest income zip codes in the dataset?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0990.zh: 使用 BigQuery 公共数据集中的 2017 年美国人口普查区数据，您需要根据地理边界之间的重叠面积将每个地区的人口和收入按比例分配给邮政编码。然后，筛选结果以仅包含位于华盛顿州特定点的 5 英里半径范围内的邮政编码，坐标为纬度 47.685833°N 和经度 -122.191667°W。最后，计算每个邮政编码的总人口和个人平均收入（四舍五入到小数点后一位），并将结果按个人平均收入降序排列。根据分析结果，数据集中收入最高和最低收入邮政编码之间的收入不平等比率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0991.source: Please provide a chronological summary of all scoring plays from the 2014 season game where the Wildcats were the home team and the Fighting Irish were the away team. Include for each scoring event the game clock, cumulative scores for both teams (Wildcats and Fighting Irish), the team that scored, and a description of the event. Based on the scoring data, what was Karl-Anthony Towns' total point contribution and how many times did he score in the paint versus from the free throw line?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0991.zh: 请提供 2014 年赛季比赛中所有得分比赛的时间摘要，其中野猫队是主队，战斗爱尔兰队是客队。包括每个得分项目的比赛时钟、两支球队（野猫队和爱尔兰战斗队）的累积得分、得分球队以及赛事描述。根据得分数据，卡尔-安东尼·唐斯的总得分是多少？他在内线和罚球线上得分的次数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0993.source: Please generate a table from the NCAA basketball dataset that lists the top five records in each of these four categories: (1) Top Venues - the largest venues by seating capacity with Date shown as 'N/A'; (2) Biggest Championship Margins - National Championship games since the 2016 season (season > 2015) with the biggest point margin victories; (3) Highest Scoring Games - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total points scored by both teams combined; and (4) Total Threes - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total three-pointers made by both teams combined. Based on the dataset results, what is the combined total of the highest championship margin victory and the maximum three-pointers made in a single game?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0993.zh: 请从 NCAA 篮球数据集生成一个表格，其中列出了这四个类别中每个类别的前 5 名记录： (1) 顶级场馆 - 按座位数划分的最大场馆，日期显示为“N/A”； (2) 最大的冠军分差 - 自 2016 年赛季（赛季 > 2015）以来拥有最大分差胜利的全国冠军赛； (3) 最高得分比赛 - 自 2011 年赛季以来（赛季 > 2010）两支球队合计得分最高的比赛； (4) 三分球总数 - 自 2011 年赛季（赛季 > 2010）以来两队三分球总数最高的比赛。根据数据集结果，冠军净胜率最高和单场比赛命中最多三分球的总和是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0994.source: Could you determine, for each shot type, the average x and y coordinates (adjusted to ensure consistency regarding the left or right basket), the average number of shot attempts, and the average number of successful shots, considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the correct side of the court based on the team's basket? Based on the analysis results, which shot type demonstrates the highest shooting efficiency when combining success rate with attempt volume?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0994.zh: 您能否确定每种投篮类型的平均 x 和 y 坐标（进行调整以确保左篮或右篮的一致性）、平均投篮尝试次数和平均投篮成功次数，仅考虑 2018年3月15日 之前的投篮，排除那些空投篮类型或坐标，确保投篮基于球队的篮筐在球场的正确一侧？根据分析结果，当结合成功率和出手次数时，哪种投篮类型的投篮效率最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0995.source: For the top five team markets with the highest number of distinct players who scored at least 15 points during the second period of games between 2010 and 2018, provide details of each game they played in NCAA basketball historical tournament matches during the same period. Based on the tournament data, which team among the top five achieved the most championship game appearances during this period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0995.zh: 对于在 2010 年和 2018 年之间的第二场比赛中获得至少 15 分的不同球员数量最多的前 5 个球队市场，请提供他们在同一时期 NCAA 篮球历史锦标赛比赛中参加的每场比赛的详细信息。从赛事数据来看，前五名中哪支球队在此期间获得冠军赛出场次数最多？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0996.source: Create a dataset by combining NCAA men's basketball tournament game outcomes from the 2014 season onwards, including both the historical tournament games and the 2018 tournament results, with the corresponding pace and efficiency performance metrics for each team and their opponents from the feature_engineering data. Based on the tournament data, what was the most significant efficiency rating advantage achieved by a winning team over their opponent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0996.zh: 通过将 2014 年赛季开始的 NCAA 男子篮球锦标赛比赛结果（包括历史锦标赛比赛和 2018 年锦标赛结果）与 feature_engineering 数据中每支球队及其对手的相应节奏和效率表现指标相结合来创建数据集。根据锦标赛数据，获胜球队相对于对手取得的最显着的效率等级优势是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0997.source: Which county in Utah experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, calculated by averaging the employment levels during the third month of each quarter in those years? What is the corresponding percentage increase? Based on the analysis results, which statement best characterizes the magnitude of this employment growth?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0997.zh: 犹他州哪个县的建筑业就业人数从 2000 年增加到 2018（通过这些年每个季度第三个月的平均就业水平计算得出）最大？相应的增幅是多少？根据分析结果，哪种说法最能描述就业增长的幅度？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0998.source: How many distinct pseudo users had positive engagement time in the 7-day period ending on January 7, 2021 at 23:59:59, but had no positive engagement time in the 2-day period ending on the same date? If you learned from a community activity report that re-engaging lapsed users beyond the past 2 days typically boosts weekly retention by 35 % when the raw re-activated group size is above 8000, and you wanted to estimate the extra weekly active users you could likely achieve by running a targeted re-engagement campaign aimed exactly at this group, which policy-scalable range would you choose?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0998.zh: 有多少不同的伪用户在截至 2021年1月7日、23:59:59 的 7 日期间具有积极参与时间，但在同一日期结束的 2 日期间没有积极参与时间？如果您从社区活动报告中了解到，当原始重新激活的群组规模高于 8000 时，在过去的 2 天之后重新吸引流失用户通常会将每周留存率提高 35 %，并且您想要估计通过专门针对该群体运行有针对性的重新吸引活动可能获得的额外每周活跃用户，您会选择哪个政策可扩展范围？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0999.source: Which traffic source has the highest total transaction revenue for the year 2017, and what is the difference in millions (rounded to two decimal places) between the highest and lowest monthly total transaction revenue for that traffic source? Given that everyday revenue is monitored across 12 months, and we know two monthly extremes for 2017 sum up to 167.5, how much higher is the single monthly gap, in millions and then expressed as a rounded 2-decimal percentage of (the gap ×100)/(gap+113), than the mean of the same two extremes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0999.zh: 2017 年度哪个流量源的总交易收入最高，该流量源的最高月总交易收入与最低月总交易收入之间以百万为单位（四舍五入到小数点后两位）的差值是多少？鉴于每天的收入是在 12 个月内进行监控的，并且我们知道 2017 年的两个月度极值总和为 167.5，那么单月差距要高出多少（以百万为单位），然后表示为（差距×100）/（差距+113）的四舍五入的 2-小数百分比，相同两个极值的平均值？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1000.source: For each visitor who made at least one transaction in February 2017, how many days on average elapsed between the date of their first visit in February and the date of their first transaction in February, and based on universal web-marketplace insights that 95 % of buyers complete their first purchase within 21 days, what is the equivalent additional average grace period (in days) that mobile users still 'saved' compared with desktop users before their debut transaction was recorded in February 2017?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1000.zh: 对于在 2017年2月 中至少进行一笔交易的每个访问者，从他们 2 月份第一次访问的日期到 2 月份第一次交易的日期之间平均经过了多少天，并且根据通用网络市场洞察，95 % 的买家在 21 天内完成了第一次购买，与桌面用户相比，移动用户在访问之前仍然'saved'（节省）的相当于额外平均宽限期（以天为单位）是多少？ 2017年2月首盘成交录得？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1001.source: During the first half of 2017, focusing on hits product revenue, which traffic source generated the highest total product revenue, and what were the maximum daily, weekly, and monthly product revenues (in millions) for that top-performing source over this period? Given that you can only observe the spikes in a provided raw revenue trace and are told that historically 40 % of an observed spike is attributable to Organic Search, 30 % to Paid Search, 20 % to Direct traffic and 10 % to Referrals, which share-from-spike assumption lets you identify the top performer and quantify the true max daily, weekly and monthly totals?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1001.zh: 在2017 年的上半年，重点关注热门产品收入，哪个流量来源产生了最高的产品总收入，以及该流量来源在此期间的最大每日、每周和每月产品收入是多少（以百万为单位）？鉴于您只能观察提供的原始收入跟踪中的峰值，并被告知历史上观察到的峰值的 40 % 归因于自然搜索，30 % 归因于付费搜索，20 % 归因于直接流量，10 % 归因于推荐，其中来自峰值的份额假设可让您识别表现最佳者并量化真实的最大值每日、每周和每月总计？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1003.source: In July 2017, among all visitors who bought any YouTube-related product, which distinct product—excluding those containing ‘YouTube’ in the product name—had the highest total quantity purchased? What was the difference in purchase quantity between this top-selling product and the runner-up? [Calculation rules: Apply a 1.2x scaling factor to the gap between top and runner-up quantities as observed in typical cross-product sales variation patterns]
7-30/FDABench/FDA1003.zh: 2017年7月，在所有购买 YouTube 相关产品的访问者中，哪种不同产品（不包括产品名称中包含“YouTube”的产品）的购买总量最高？该畅销产品与第二名的购买量有何差异？ [计算规则：将 1.2x 比例因子应用于典型的跨产品销售变化模式中观察到的最高数量和第二数量之间的差距]

7-30/FDABench/FDA1005.source: Find the latest ride data for each region between 2014 and 2017. I want to know the name of each region, the trip ID of this ride, the ride duration, the start time, the starting station, and the gender of the rider. Using the latest trip for each region, estimate the total system-wide 'rush-hour equivalent' journey stubs created if every trip begun between 17:00 and 24:00 were counted once, then subtract the count of trips that began during the same late-evening window in the region whose latest trip started at 59th St at Horton St. (Each trip started exactly at its listed time, and stubs are tallied individually.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1005.zh: 查找 2014 年和 2017 年之间每个区域的最新乘车数据。我想知道每个地区的名称、本次骑行的行程ID、骑行时长、起始时间、起始车站以及骑行者的性别。使用每个区域的最新行程，如果在 17:00 和 24:00 之间开始的每个行程都被计算一次，则估计创建的全系统'rush-hour equivalent'（高峰时段等效）旅程存根总数，然后减去该区域中同一深夜窗口内开始的行程计数，该区域的最新行程始于 59th St 和 Horton St.（每个行程恰好在其列出的时间开始，并且存根被统计）单独。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1004.source: In January 2017, among visitors whose campaign name contains 'Data Share' and who accessed any page starting with '/home', which page did they most commonly visit next, and what is the maximum time (in seconds) they spent on the '/home' page before moving on? Assuming the observed maximum individual session is 47 minutes and 28 seconds and all measured sessions were integer multiples of a common time-unit, what whole-number estimate (seconds) best reflects the unit that was repeatedly measured before entering the next page during optimization tests?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1004.zh: 2017年1月，在活动名称包含'Data Share'（数据共享）且访问以“/home”开头的任何页面的访问者中，他们接下来最常访问哪个页面，以及他们在继续之前在“/home”页面上花费的最长时间（以秒为单位）？假设观察到的最大单个会话为 47 分钟和 28 秒，并且所有测量的会话都是公共时间单位的整数倍，那么哪个整数估计值（秒）最能反映优化测试期间进入下一页之前重复测量的单位？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1007.source: Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data? If we convert this month's end_month number to a fiscal quarter (where Q1 = months 1-3, Q2 = months 4-6, etc.), and then calculate what percentage of the fiscal year this quarter represents, which of the following percentages best approximates this value? (To calculate this: Take the identified month, determine its fiscal quarter, then divide the quarter number by 4 to get the percentage of the year elapsed)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1007.zh: 根据旧金山共享单车数据中的行程结束日期，2017 年哪个月份（数量）的客户和订阅者的累积自行车使用分钟数（以千为单位）之间的绝对差异最大？如果我们将本月的 end_month 数字转换为会计季度（其中 Q1 = 月份 1-3，Q2 = 月份 4-6 等），然后计算本季度占会计年度的百分比，以下哪个百分比最接近该值？ （要计算此值：获取已识别的月份，确定其会计季度，然后将季度编号除以 4 以获得已过去一年的百分比）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1006.source: Could you provide the details of the top 5 longest bike share trips that started between July 1, 2017, and December 31, 2017, including the trip ID, duration in seconds, start date, start station name, route (derived from start station name to end station name), bike number, subscriber type, member's birth year, the member's current age (calculated using the current year), an age classification based on whether the member is younger than 40, between 40 and 60, or older than 60, the member's gender, and the name of the region of the start station? Please exclude any trips where the start station name, member's birth year, or member's gender is not specified. Question: Based on the actual durations shown, if the average comfortable riding speed for bike-sharing users on long routes like these is roughly 12–14 km/h, which of the estimated distances would most closely match the pattern shown by the longest trip durations?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1006.zh: 您能否提供 2017年7月1日 和 2017年12月31日 之间开始的最长 5 最长自行车共享行程的详细信息，包括行程 ID、持续时间（以秒为单位）、开始日期、起始站名称、路线（从起始站名称到终点站名称）、自行车号码、订阅者类型、会员的出生年份、会员当前年龄（以当前年份计算）、根据会员是否小于40、介于40和60之间、或大于60进行年龄分类、会员性别、起始站的地区名称？请排除未指定起始站名称、会员出生年份或会员性别的行程。问题：根据显示的实际时长，如果共享单车用户在此类长距离路线上的平均舒适骑行速度约为 12–14 km/h，那么哪个估计距离最符合最长出行时长所显示的模式？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1009.source: What is the highest average speed (rounded to 1 decimal, in metric m/s) for bike trips in Berkeley with trip distance greater than 1000 meters? Over a 1.25 km segment that is 95 % flat but has one 100 m-long 4 % uphill stretch just ahead of a 100 m-long 4 % downhill stretch, a cyclist wants to offset the extra time lost on the uphill (for every 1 % grade, a commuter loses ~3.1 % speed) by doubling the savings gained on the downhill (where every 1 % downhill returns only 2.2 % speed on a safety-conscious bike lane). Starting from the overall highest average speed indicated in the dataset, what will the cyclist’s adjusted average speed over the entire 1.25 km segment be?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1009.zh: 在伯克利，行程距离大于 1000 米的自行车旅行的最高平均速度是多少（四舍五入到小数点 1，以公制米/秒为单位）？在 1.25 公里路段（95 % 平坦，但在 100 米长 4 % 下坡路段前面有一条 100 米长 4 % 上坡路段上，骑自行车者希望抵消上坡损失的额外时间（对于每1 % 坡度，通勤者损失 ~3.1 % 速度），通过将下坡节省的费用加倍（其中，在注重安全的自行车道上，每个 1 % 下坡仅返回 2.2 % 速度）。从数据集中指示的总体最高平均速度开始，骑车人在整个 1.25 公里路段的调整后平均速度是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1011.source: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order? If this revenue represents 15% of the total first-order revenue across all categories, what is the approximate combined value of the remaining 85% of first-order revenue?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1011.zh: 您能否帮我算出在第一个未取消和未退货订单中购买的客户数量最多的产品类别的收入？如果此收入代表所有类别的总一阶收入中的 15%，那么剩余的一阶收入 85% 的总价值大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1010.source: For each neighborhood in San Francisco where at least one bike share station and at least one crime incident are located, provide the neighborhood name along with the total count of bike share stations and the total number of crime incidents in that neighborhood. If a hypothetical neighborhood had its station count tripled and crime count reduced by 15%, which neighborhood would then have the closest ratio of (crime per station) to South of Market's actual ratio?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1010.zh: 对于旧金山至少有 1 个自行车共享站和至少 1 个起犯罪事件的每个社区，请提供社区名称以及该社区的自行车共享站总数和犯罪事件总数。如果一个假设的社区的车站数量增加了两倍，犯罪数量减少了 15%，那么哪个社区的（每个车站犯罪）比率与市场以南的实际比率最接近？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1008.source: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route. Based on the structured result, if a commuter must leave their office located along the Presidio Avenue route every evening for a dinner appointment exactly 12 hours after the earliest recorded trip starts, while a second commuter must depart on the Geary + 33rd Avenue route for work exactly 5 minutes before the corridor closes for the day, how many minutes after the first commuter's actual departure time does the second commuter make their evening board?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1008.zh: 对于在停靠顺序中“Clay St & Drumm St”出现在“Sacramento St & Davis St”之前的行程（仅限一个方向），从“Clay St & Drumm St”出发的最早出发时间以及在“Sacramento St & Davis St”最晚到达的时间（格式为 HH:MM:SS）是多少？请提供每条路线的车头标志。根据结构化结果，如果一名通勤者每天晚上必须在最早记录的行程开始后 12 小时离开位于 Presidio Avenue 路线的办公室去赴晚餐，而第二名通勤者必须在当天走廊关闭前 5 分钟沿着 Geary + 33rd Avenue 路线出发去上班，那么第二名通勤者在第一个通勤者的实际出发时间之后需要多少分钟他们的晚间董事会？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1014.source: Based solely on completed orders, calculate the average monthly percentage growth rate in the number of unique orders (counting distinct order IDs) for each product category by comparing each month's count to the previous month within the same category. Identify the product category with the highest average of these monthly order growth rates. Then, for that specific product category, compute the average monthly revenue growth rate by calculating the percentage change in total revenue (sum of sale prices) from month to month and averaging these values over the entire period. If this process yields an average revenue growth rate that is exactly 1.564 times the baseline monthly growth rate for this category's order counts, and the baseline monthly order growth rate is known to be approximately 100% when no seasonal adjustments are made, what would be the inferred computed value under this scenario?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1014.zh: 仅根据已完成的订单，通过将同一类别中每月的计数与上个月的计数进行比较，计算每个产品类别的唯一订单数量（计算不同订单 ID）的平均每月百分比增长率。确定这些月度订单增长率平均值最高的产品类别。然后，对于该特定产品类别，通过计算每月总收入（销售价格总和）的百分比变化并对整个期间的这些值进行平均，计算平均每月收入增长率。如果此过程产生的平均收入增长率正好是 1.564 乘以该类别订单数的基准月度增长率，并且在不进行季节性调整的情况下已知基准月度订单增长率约为 100%，那么在这种情况下推断的计算值是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1012.source: Among all product categories in the dataset, identify the category with the highest total purchase quantity (based on order_items table), and for that specific category, what is the average time in minutes that users spend on each product page visit? The average time should be calculated as the difference between the timestamp when a user views a product page and the timestamp of the next event within the same session. If this average time were reduced by 19 minutes in a future AB-test intended to shorten the checkout flow, what would the new average look like (rounded to one decimal place)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1012.zh: 在数据集中的所有产品类别中，确定总购买量最高的类别（基于 order_items 表），对于该特定类别，用户在每个产品页面访问上花费的平均时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？平均时间应计算为用户查看产品页面时的时间戳与同一会话中下一个事件的时间戳之间的差值。如果在未来旨在缩短结帐流程的 AB 测试中将该平均时间减少 19 分钟，那么新的平均值会是什么样子（四舍五入到小数点后一位）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1015.source: From January 1, 2019, to April 30, 2022, how many users are at the youngest age and how many users are at the oldest age for each gender in the e-commerce platform, counting both youngest and oldest users separately for each gender? If all youngest male and oldest male users jointly launched a collaborative marketing campaign, and each of these users successfully influences 3 additional new users while female youngest/oldest groups inspire 2.5 new users per person, which combined marketing impact would generate approximately how many new user acquisitions in total?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1015.zh: 从2019年1月1日到2022年4月30日，电商平台各性别中最小年龄用户数和最大年龄用户数分别统计各性别的最小用户数和最大年龄用户数？如果所有最年轻的男性和最年长的男性用户共同发起协作营销活动，并且每个用户都成功影响 3 额外的新用户，而女性最年轻/最年长的群体每人激励 2.5 新用户，这种组合的营销影响总共会产生大约多少新用户获取？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1013.source: Using data up to the end of 2022 and organized by the month of each user's first purchase, can you provide the percentage of users who made a purchase in each of the first, second, third, and fourth months since their initial purchase, where the 'first month' refers to the month of their initial purchase? A mobile-app marketplace observes that its average First-month repurchase rate across all 2022 cohorts is 3.8 %. Suppose you random-sample 5 fresh installs in January-2023. Without any other assumptions, how many of those 5 customers are expected to make at least one additional purchase within their first month since first purchase? (Apply the 2022 observed rate and round the final count to the nearest whole person.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1013.zh: 使用截至 2022 年底的数据，并按每位用户首次购买的月份进行组织，你能否给出在自首次购买起的第一、第二、第三和第四个月中分别进行了购买的用户百分比？其中 'first month'（第一个月）指其首次购买所在的月份。某移动应用市场观察到，其 2022 年所有同期群的平均首月复购率为 3.8 %。假设你在 2023 年 1 月随机抽取 5 个新安装用户。在没有任何其他假设的情况下，这 5 位客户中预计有多少位会在自首次购买起的第一个月内至少再进行一次购买？（使用 2022 年观察到的比率，并将最终人数四舍五入到最接近的整数。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1016.source: For each month prior to January 2024, identify the product that achieved the highest total profit across all order items, then determine the cumulative profit difference between the top-performing product in December 2023 and the average monthly profit of all top products throughout 2023. What does this indicate about the seasonal sales performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1016.zh: 对于 2024年1月 之前的每个月，确定所有订单项目中实现最高总利润的产品，然后确定 2023年12月表现最好的产品 与整个 2023 年所有顶级产品的平均月利润之间的累积利润差。这对季节性销售业绩意味着什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1017.source: Generate a monthly analysis report for e-commerce sales from June 2019 to December 2019 that includes, for each product category and each month, the total number of orders, total revenue, and total profit, along with their month-over-month growth rates using the data from June 2019 as the basis for calculating growth starting from July 2019. Ensure that all orders are included regardless of their status, and present the results sorted in ascending order by month (formatted as "2019-07") and then by product category. Omitting June 2019 from the final output but using it for the growth calculations.Suppose a marketing director predicts that during the upcoming holiday season (covering only months November and December 2019) any product category whose average monthly profit margin (defined as total profit / total revenue) surpasses the global monthly average profit margin for the same two months will qualify for a 15 % quarter-end bonus pool. If the director’s forecast is applied only to those categories listed, which product would claim the single largest bonus share based on the rule stated above?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1017.zh: 生成6月2019至12月2019的电商销售额月度分析报告，包括每个产品类别、每个月的订单总数、总收入、总利润以及环比增长率，以6月2019的数据作为计算7月2019开始增长的基础。确保包含所有订单，无论其状态如何，并按月份（格式为“2019-07”）升序显示结果，然后按产品类别排序。从最终输出中省略 2019年6月，但将其用于增长计算。假设营销总监预测，在即将到来的假期期间（仅涵盖 11 月和 2019年12月），任何平均月利润率（定义为总利润/总收入）超过同两个月全球月平均利润率的产品类别将有资格获得 15 % 季末奖金池。如果董事的预测仅适用于所列出的类别，那么根据上述规则，哪种产品将获得最大的单一红利份额？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1018.source: Determine the number of users who are the youngest and oldest for each gender (male and female) separately, among those who signed up between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022. For each gender, identify the minimum and maximum ages within this date range, and count how many users fall into these respective age groups. If the company plans to launch a targeted wellness programme that simultaneously targets both the oldest female group and the youngest male group, and the programme can only run if the combined eligible participants form a group that is at least 20 % larger than the current combined total of the youngest females and oldest males, should the programme proceed under this rule?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1018.zh: 分别确定 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间注册的用户中每种性别（男性和女性）最年轻和最年长的用户数量。对于每个性别，确定此日期范围内的最小和最大年龄，并计算有多少用户属于这些各自的年龄组。如果公司计划推出一项同时针对最年长女性群体和最年轻男性群体的定向健康计划，并且只有符合资格的参与者组合形成的群体至少比当前最年轻女性和最年长男性的总和大至少 20 % 时，该计划才能运行，那么该计划是否应该按照此规则进行？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1019.source: Please create a month-by-month report for the year 2023 that focuses on the 'Sleep & Lounge' category, showing for each month the total sales, total cost, number of complete orders, total profit, and the profit-to-cost ratio, ensuring that the order is marked as 'Complete,' the creation date is between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2023, and the cost data is accurately associated with the corresponding product through the order items. Using only the average monthly profit-to-cost ratio across the entire year, estimate which upcoming month (January 2024) would be closest to launching a clearance campaign if the company’s finance committee decides that a campaign should start when the expected profit-to-cost ratio drops to one-quarter (25 %) below the 2023 average for the Sleep & Lounge category. The company assumes January 2024’s margin equals exactly the annual 2023 figure for December. Identify when the next campaign would therefore begin based solely on the month whose actual ratio is closest to this threshold.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1019.zh: 请创建 2023 年的月度报告，重点关注'Sleep & Lounge'（睡眠和休闲）类别，显示每个月的总销售额、总成本、完成订单数、总利润和利润成本比，确保订单标记为'Complete,'（完成），创建日期在 2023年1月1日 和 12 月之间31、2023，成本数据通过订单项与对应的产品准确关联。仅使用全年的平均月度利润成本比，如果公司财务委员会决定在预计利润成本比降至睡眠和休息室类别 2023 年平均水平四分之一 (25 %) 时开始开展清仓活动，则可以估计下个月（2024年1月）最接近发起清仓活动。该公司假设 2024年1月 的保证金恰好等于 12 月份 2023 年的年度数据。因此，仅根据实际比率最接近此阈值的月份来确定下一次活动的开始时间。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1021.source: For each month prior to July 2024, identify the single best-selling product (determined by highest sales volume, with total revenue as a tiebreaker) among all orders with a 'Complete' status and products with non-null brands. Suppose the marketing team now wants to know: If you take the average total revenue (rounded to the nearest integer) of all top monthly performers in the first half of any calendar year (Jan-Jun inclusive) in 2021–2023, and then compare that average with the average total revenue of all top monthly performers in the second half of the same years (Jul-Dec inclusive), what is the percentage difference between the two halves, rounded to the nearest whole number? Calculate as (second-half average first), (first-half average second), and express your answer as: (second-half average - first-half average) ÷ first-half average × 100.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1021.zh: 对于 2024年7月 之前的每个月，在所有具有'Complete'（完整）状态的订单和具有非空品牌的产品中确定单一最畅销的产品（由最高销量确定，以总收入作为决胜局）。假设营销团队现在想知道： 如果您将任何日历年上半年（包括 1 月至 6 月）所有月度表现最佳者的平均总收入（四舍五入到最接近的整数）记为 2021–2023，然后将该平均值与同年下半年（包括 7 月至 12 月）所有月度表现最佳者的平均总收入进行比较，则两半月之间的百分比差异是多少，四舍五入为最接近的整数？计算为（下半场平均值第一），（上半场平均值第二），并将答案表示为：（下半场平均值 - 上半场平均值）÷上半场平均值×100。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1023.source: Please provide the names of the products that had sales in each month of 2020 and had the lowest profit, calculated as the difference between their retail price and cost from the products data. Exclude any months where this data isn't available. Please list the products in chronological order based on the month. If the lowest-profit item sold in January 2020 had a profit margin that was 60 % lower than the highest-profit item sold in July 2020, what would be the most likely retail price of the highest-profit item if the January product 'Wurl Lace Trim Cotton Thong Panties' retailed for $20 and was calculated with a cost of $14? (Calculation: The profit difference between Jan and July is a 60 % lower margin on Jan product implying July profit = $20 - $14 = $6 (Jan profit) then 60 % higher is 0.40 Jan profit => 0.4*6 = $2.4 Jan profit Marching retail = $2.4 + $14 = $16.4 Highest July retail = 0.6/0.4*($16.4 - $14) + $14 = $17.6 implying highest July retail = $26)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1023.zh: 请提供 2020 年每月有销售且利润最低的产品名称，其计算方式为零售价与产品数据成本之间的差额。排除无法获得此数据的任何月份。请根据月份按时间顺序列出产品。如果 2020年1月销售的利润最低的商品 的利润率比 2020年7月销售的利润最高的商品 低 60 %，那么如果 1 月份的产品“Wurl Lace Trim Cotton Thong Panties”的零售价为 $20，并且按成本计算，那么利润最高的商品最有可能的零售价格是多少$14？ （计算：1 月和 7 月之间的利润差异是 1 月产品利润率较低的 60 %，意味着 7 月利润 = $20 - $14 = $6（1 月利润），然后 60 % 更高的是 0.40 1 月利润 => 0.4*6 = $2.4 1 月利润大幅零售 = $2.4 + $14 = $16.4 7 月最高零售 = 0.6/0.4*($16.4 - $14) + $14 = $17.6 意味着 7 月最高零售价 = $26)

7-30/FDABench/FDA1024.source: Which three browsers have the shortest average session duration—calculated by the difference in seconds between the earliest and latest timestamps for each user’s session—while only including browsers that have more than 10 total sessions, and what are their respective average session durations? Suppose you know that the browser with the 4th-shortest average session duration recorded exactly 24,600 seconds, and any browser with fewer than 50 sessions is disregarded for business relevance. How many seconds faster, on average, is the second-shortest browser compared to the fastest competitor browser among the top three, expressed as a percentage of the fastest browser's duration?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1024.zh: 哪三种浏览器的平均会话持续时间最短（根据每个用户会话的最早和最新时间戳之间的秒数差异计算），同时仅包括总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器，它们各自的平均会话持续时间是多少？假设您知道具有 4th 最短平均会话持续时间的浏览器准确记录了 24,600 秒，并且任何会话少于 50 个的浏览器都将被忽略与业务相关性。与前三名中最快的竞争对手浏览器相比，第二短的浏览器平均快了多少秒（以最快浏览器持续时间的百分比表示）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1022.source: Can you list the email addresses of the top 10 users who registered in 2019 and made purchases in 2019, ranking them by their highest average order value, where average order value is calculated by multiplying the number of items in each order by the sale price, summing this total across all orders for each user, and then dividing by the total number of orders? If a loyalty programme wanted to reward the top half of these customers with an extra 12% of their average order value as bonus credit, which group would accrue a combined bonus credit of slightly over $2,900?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1022.zh: 您能否列出在 2019 年注册并在 2019 年进行购买的排名靠前的 10 用户的电子邮件地址，并按最高平均订单价值对他们进行排名，其中平均订单价值的计算方法是将每个订单中的商品数量乘以销售价格，将每个用户的所有订单的总和除以订单总数？如果忠诚度计划想要奖励这些客户中的前半部分，以平均订单价值的额外 12% 作为奖励积分，那么哪一组将获得略高于 $2,900 的组合奖励积分？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1020.source: Identify the difference in the number of the oldest and youngest users registered between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, from our e-commerce platform data. If the LTV-based churn-risk segmentation shows that each percentile of this age-gap corresponds to a 1.5 percentage-point shift in expected inactivity probability, how many additional full-percent segments (rounded down) would be uncovered by doubling this age-gap and applying the same 1.5 ppt rule? Use no other numerical inputs.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1020.zh: 从我们的电子商务平台数据中找出 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间最大和最小注册用户数量的差异。如果基于 LTV 的流失风险细分显示，此年龄差距的每个百分位对应于预期不活动概率的 1.5 个百分点的变化，那么通过将此年龄差距加倍并应用相同的 1.5 ppt 规则，将发现多少额外的完整百分比细分（向下舍入）？不使用其他数字输入。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1026.source: Please generate a report that, for each month in 2021, provides the number of orders, the number of unique purchasers, and the profit (calculated as the sum of product retail prices minus the sum of product costs), where the orders were placed during 2021 by users who registered in 2021 for inventory items created in 2021, and group the results by the users' country, product department, and product category. — If you were to estimate the average country-level profit margin (profit per purchaser) for outerwear & coats in October 2021, using the top 3 countries by order count in that department-category-month combination, which estimate would you expect?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1026.zh: 请生成一份报告，其中提供 2021 年每个月的订单数、唯一购买者数以及利润（计算为产品零售价格总和减去产品成本总和），其中在 2021 年注册的用户针对 2021 年创建的库存商品在 2021 年下的订单，并按用户所在国家/地区、产品部门和产品对结果进行分组类别。 — 如果您要使用该部门-类别-月份组合中按订单数排名靠前的 3 国家/地区来估计 2021年10月外套和外套的平均国家/地区利润率（每个购买者的利润），您会期望哪个估计值？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1027.source: Please provide the names of the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding any products associated with orders that were canceled or returned. If the profit for a month is calculated as the sum of the sale prices of all order items minus the sum of the costs of those sold items, but only 75% of that figure is actually retained due to processing fees, which of the following choices best represents the minimum average monthly profit across all months after applying this adjustment?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1027.zh: 请提供从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三种产品的名称，不包括与取消或退货订单相关的任何产品。如果一个月的利润计算为所有订单商品的销售价格总和减去这些已售商品的成本总和，但由于处理费用实际只保留了 75%，则以下哪个选项最能代表应用此调整后所有月份的最低平均月利润？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1028.source: Can you list the top 5 months from August 2022 to November 2023 where the profit from Facebook-sourced completed orders showed the largest month-over-month increase? Calculate profit as sales minus costs, group by delivery month, and include only orders created between August 2022 and November 2023. Compare each month's profit to its previous month to find the largest increases. In which month did the second-highest profit increase occur, and if a fictional company using Facebook ads achieved a 15 % boost in profit the following month after seeing a similar jump as shown in the gold result, what would their profit increase be (rounded to the nearest integer)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1028.zh: 您能否列出从 2022年8月 到 2023年11月 的最高 5 月份，其中来自 Facebook 的已完成订单的利润显示出最大的环比增幅？将利润计算为销售额减去成本，按交货月份分组，并且仅包括 2022年8月 和 2023年11月 之间创建的订单。将每个月的利润与上个月进行比较，找出最大的增幅。第二高的利润增长发生在哪一个月，如果一家使用 Facebook 广告的虚构公司在看到黄金结果中所示的类似跳跃后，在下个月实现了 15 % 的利润增长，那么他们的利润增长是多少（四舍五入到最接近的整数）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1029.source: What is the name of the reference sequence with the highest variant density in the given cannabis genome dataset? Focus on a specific contig that shows a density contraction when projected onto the GRCh38 equivalent segment, assuming the contraction factor is three-to-one. Which identifier best approximates the contracted contig name after accounting for density adjustment?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1029.zh: 给定大麻基因组数据集中变异密度最高的参考序列的名称是什么？重点关注投影到 GRCh38 等效片段上时显示密度收缩的特定重叠群，假设收缩因子为三比一。考虑密度调整后，哪个标识符最接近约定的重叠群名称？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1025.source: For the user cohort with a first purchase date in January 2020, what proportion of users returned in the subsequent months of 2020, and how much more would the returning rate in month 11 exceed month 6 if the absolute difference was normalized by the month-10 returning rate's deviation from single-month baseline? (Assume baseline returning rate is uniform across months and equal to month-1 percentage; normalize the month-11 excess by how many percentage points it outperforms month-10 absolute value when expressed as a ratio of month-6 absolute value, rounded to nearest 0.1%. HINT: This requires summing absolute cohort_users_percentage from structured data, then calculating percentage increase steps.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1025.zh: 对于首次购买日期为 2020年1月 的用户群体，在 2020 年的后续月份中回访的用户比例是多少？如果通过 10 月回访率与单月基线的偏差对绝对差值进行归一化，则 11 月的回访率会比 6 月高出多少？ （假设基准回报率在各月内是统一的，并且等于月 1 百分比；当以月 6 绝对值的比率表示时，将月 11 超额标准化为优于月 10 绝对值多少个百分点，四舍五入到最接近的 0.1%。提示：这需要对绝对值求和来自结构化数据的 cohort_users_percentage，然后计算百分比增加步骤。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1030.source: What is the variant density of the cannabis reference with the longest reference length? Pay attention that a variant is present if there is at least one variant call with a genotype greater than 0. If you considered multiplying the total variant count by 1000 and then subtracting the reference length, what threshold would you obtain that indicates "high-density" variants? (Interpret densities above this threshold as areas with unusually concentrated polymorphism)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1030.zh: 参考长度最长的大麻参考的变异密度是多少？请注意，如果至少有一个基因型大于 0 的变体调用，则表示存在变体。如果您考虑将变体总数乘以 1000，然后减去参考长度，您会得到什么阈值来指示“高密度”变体？ （将高于此阈值的密度解释为具有异常集中的多态性的区域）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1032.source: Which country has the highest percentage of population under the age of 25 in 2017? If a sub-Saharan African nation has roughly 70 % of its citizens below that age while runner-up nations hover around 65 %, how much larger—in percentage points—is Uganda’s youth share compared to the next-closest competitors?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1032.zh: 哪个国家2017 年中25年龄以下的人口比例最高？如果撒哈拉以南非洲国家大约有 70 % 的公民低于该年龄，而亚军国家则徘徊在 65 % 左右，那么乌干达的青年比例与第二接近的竞争对手相比要高多少（以百分点计算）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1034.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? The format is MM-DD. Given that on March 9, the growth rate was 105% from the previous day, and April's highest growth day saw a 85% increase, which approach yields better strategic insight for forecasting future spikes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1034.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？格式为MM-DD。鉴于 3 月份 9 的增长率为 105%，而 4 月份最高增长率日的增长率为 85%，哪种方法可以为预测未来的峰值提供更好的战略洞察力？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1035.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020. The population data for 2018 can be found in the World Bank dataset, and the cumulative COVID-19 confirmed cases data is available in the COVID-19 Open Data dataset. A development bank wants to launch an emergency health-response grant limited to countries whose June COVID prevalence, expressed on a per-hundred-thousand-inhabitants scale, is exactly twice the overall global prevalence on the same scale. If it is known (from the vector DB) that the worldwide June total cases averaged 0.04 % of the global population, which grant-qualifying country recorded roughly 5½ times that metric?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1035.zh: 您需要计算截至 2020年6月30日 的每个国家/地区已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。 2018 年的人口数据可以在世界银行数据集中找到，累积的 COVID-19 确诊病例数据可以在 COVID-19 开放数据数据集中找到。一家开发银行希望向那些 6 月份新冠肺炎流行率（按每十万居民计算）恰好是全球总体流行率的两倍的国家发放紧急卫生应对赠款。如果（从向量数据库中）已知全球 6 月份总病例数平均占全球人口的 0.04 %，那么哪个符合赠款资格的国家记录的数据大约为该指标的 5½ 倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1037.source: Analyze daily new COVID-19 case counts from March to May 2020, identifying the top five states by daily increases. Please compile a ranking based on how often each state appears in these daily top fives. Then, examine the state that ranks fourth overall and identify its top five counties based on their frequency of appearing in the daily top five new case counts. Based on this analysis, if Lake County in the fourth-ranked state had 6 days with new case counts in the top five of its state's counties during March-May 2020, while Cook County had 87 such days during the same period, approximately what percentage of Lake County's frequency relative to Cook County would indicate a proportional increase needed to match Cook's distribution dominance? (Calculation rules: divide Lake's frequency by Cook's frequency, multiply by 100 to get percent, then round to nearest whole number. This percentage represents Lake's proportional frequency compared to Cook.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1037.zh: 分析 3 月至 2020年5月 每日新增的 COVID-19 病例数，确定每日增量最多的五个州。请根据每个州出现在每日前五名的频率来编制排名。然后，检查总体排名第四的州，并根据其出现在每日新增病例数前五名的频率中确定其前五个县。根据此分析，如果排名第四的州莱克县在 3 月至 2020年5月 期间，该州前五名县中新增病例数为 6 天，而库克县在同一时期有 87 个这样的天数，那么莱克县相对于库克县的频率大约有多少百分比表明需要按比例增加以匹配库克的分布优势？ （计算规则：Lake的频率除以Cook的频率，乘以100得到百分比，然后四舍五入到最接近的整数。这个百分比代表Lake与Cook的频率比例。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1038.source: Please calculate the overall percentage change in the average weekly search frequency for the symptom 'Anosmia' across the five New York City counties—Bronx County, Queens County, Kings County, New York County, and Richmond County—by comparing the combined data from January 1, 2019, through December 31, 2019, with the combined data from January 1, 2020, through December 31, 2020. Then determine: If NYC health officials set an alert threshold at 75% of the observed 2020 surge (rounded to the nearest whole percent), what percentage increase above the 2019 baseline would this previously-absent threshold represent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1038.zh: 请通过将 2019年1月1日 到 2019年12月31日 的合并数据与 1 月的合并数据进行比较，计算纽约市五个县（布朗克斯县、皇后县、国王县、纽约县和里士满县）'Anosmia'（嗅觉缺失）症状的平均每周搜索频率的总体百分比变化1、2020，截至 2020年12月31日。然后确定：如果纽约市卫生官员将观察到的 2020 激增的警报阈值设置为 75%（四舍五入到最接近的整数百分比），那么这个先前不存在的阈值代表比 2019 年基线高出多少百分比？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1039.source: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period. If researchers are looking for a combined risk indicator defined as the percent_increase for Anxiety minus the absolute value of the percent_change (regardless of direction) for Depression, which integer value best represents the overall mental-health risk score for policy maker?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1039.zh: 请根据美国每周国家数据计算2019年1月1日至2020年1月1日以及2020年1月1日至1月1期间焦虑和抑郁症状的平均水平， 2021。然后，计算从 2019 年期间到 2020 年期间这些平均症状水平的增加百分比。如果研究人员正在寻找一个组合风险指标，定义为焦虑的 percent_increase 减去抑郁的 percent_change（无论方向）的绝对值，哪个整数值最能代表政策制定者的总体心理健康风险评分？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1041.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. A county emergency-response analyst, knowing that an adult-aged county (median-age ≥ 40) experiencing ≥ 10 % case-fatality translates into roughly one additional on-site trauma team for every 1,000 infections, wants to estimate how many extra trauma teams would have been justified for the county with the LOWEST population among the three. Which figure is closest?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1041.zh: 使用 2020 5 年人口普查数据查找人口超过 50,000 的前三个县，这些县在 2020年8月27日 的 COVID-19 病死率最高。一位县应急响应分析师知道，一个成年县（中位年龄≥40）的病死率≥10，意味着每感染一个1,000感染就需要大约增加一个现场创伤小组，因此想要估计对于三个县中人口最少的县来说，需要多少额外的创伤小组是合理的。哪一个图形最接近？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1040.source: Given the latest population estimates from the 2018 five-year American Community Survey, what is the number of vaccine sites per 1000 people for counties in California? Imagine two neighboring medium-sized counties implementing surge-capacity planning: if County X currently has twice the population of County Y, but County Y has 25 more vaccine sites than County X, and the statewide average ‘sites per 1000 people’ is exactly 0.20, which action will achieve a fair allocation of sites such that both counties converge nearest to the statewide average after a redistribution?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1040.zh: 根据 2018 年五年美国社区调查的最新人口估计，加利福尼亚州各县每 1000 人的疫苗接种点数量是多少？想象一下两个相邻的中型县正在实施激增容量规划：如果 X 县目前的人口是 Y 县的两倍，但 Y 县的疫苗接种点比 X 县多 25，而全州平均“每人 1000 的疫苗点”恰好是 0.20，哪种行动将实现疫苗点的公平分配，使两个县在重新分配后最接近全州平均水平？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1050.source: Could you determine, for each shot type, the average x and y coordinates (adjusted to ensure consistency regarding the left or right basket), the average number of shot attempts, and the average number of successful shots, considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the correct side of the court based on the team's basket. If a defensive coach wants to reduce opposing layup attempts by 15%, how many average layup attempts per game would they expect from this dataset after this reduction?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1050.zh: 您能否确定每种投篮类型的平均 x 和 y 坐标（调整以确保左侧或右侧篮筐的一致性）、平均投篮尝试次数和平均成功投篮次数，仅考虑 2018年3月15日 之前的投篮，排除那些空投篮类型或坐标，确保根据球队的篮筐投篮在球场的正确一侧。如果防守教练希望将对方的上篮次数减少到 15%，那么在减少之后，他们期望从该数据集中获得多少平均每场上篮次数？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1042.source: Please find all zip code areas located within 10 kilometers of the coordinates (-122.3321, 47.6062) by joining the 2010 census population data (summing only male and female populations with no age constraints) and the zip code area information, and return each area’s polygon, land and water area in meters, latitude and longitude, state code, state name, city, county, and total population. Which Seattle zip code area within this 10km radius has the highest population-to-land-area ratio, where population is directly from the 2010 census summaries and land area excludes water area?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1042.zh: 请通过连接2010 年人口普查数据（仅对男性和女性人口求和，没有年龄限制）和邮政编码区域信息，查找位于坐标（-122.3321、47.6062）10公里范围内的所有邮政编码区域，并返回每个区域的多边形、土地和水域面积（以米为单位）、经纬度、州代码、州名称、城市、县、总人口。此 10km 半径内的哪个西雅图邮政编码区域的人口与土地面积比率最高，其中人口直接来自 2010 年人口普查摘要，且土地面积不包括水域？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1046.source: Using the 2017 U.S. Census Tract data from the BigQuery public datasets, you need to proportionally allocate each tract's population and income to the zip codes based on the overlapping area between their geographic boundaries. Then, filter the results to include only those zip codes located within a 5-mile radius of a specific point in Washington State, with coordinates at latitude 47.685833°N and longitude -122.191667°W. Finally, calculate the total population and the average individual income for each zip code (rounded to one decimal place) and sort the results by the average individual income in descending order. A new luxury housing development is being pitched just outside this 5-mile limit. Local rules state that any new development must not lower the overall median avg-income of the combined region (original 5-mile zip codes + the proposed zip) by more than 3%. For which ONE of the following projected average incomes for the new zip (rounded to one decimal place) would planners conclude the project is financially neutral or beneficial to the region?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1046.zh: 使用 BigQuery 公共数据集中的 2017 年美国人口普查区数据，您需要根据地理边界之间的重叠面积将每个地区的人口和收入按比例分配给邮政编码。然后，筛选结果以仅包含位于华盛顿州特定点的 5 英里半径范围内的邮政编码，坐标为纬度 47.685833°N 和经度 -122.191667°W。最后，计算每个邮政编码的总人口和个人平均收入（四舍五入到小数点后一位），并将结果按个人平均收入降序排列。一个新的豪华住宅开发项目正在 5 英里限制之外进行。地方规则规定，任何新开发项目不得使合并地区（原 5 英里邮政编码 + 拟议邮政编码）的总体平均收入中位数降低超过 3%。对于以下哪一项新邮政编码的预计平均收入（四舍五入到小数点后一位），规划者会认为该项目在财务上是中性的或对该地区有利？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1049.source: Please generate a table from the NCAA basketball dataset that lists the top five records in each of these four categories: (1) Top Venues - the largest venues by seating capacity with Date shown as 'N/A'; (2) Biggest Championship Margins - National Championship games since the 2016 season (season > 2015) with the biggest point margin victories; (3) Highest Scoring Games - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total points scored by both teams combined; and (4) Total Threes - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total three-pointers made by both teams combined. The final table should be organized with columns for Category, Date, Matchup or Venue, and Key Metric, with each category's 5 records presented in descending order of their key metric. (This part is not allowed to change. No deletions or Rephrase allowed). Assuming January 2019 is the midpoint of data coverage, which quantitative conclusion—in percentage terms—best describes how the 258-point combined score in the top "Highest Scoring Games" entry compares to the average of the next-highest 3 distinct game totals (254, 240, and the venue capacity of the smallest listed Top Venue minus a 2-point adjustment)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1049.zh: 请从 NCAA 篮球数据集生成一个表格，其中列出了这四个类别中每个类别的前 5 名记录： (1) 顶级场馆 - 按座位数划分的最大场馆，日期显示为“N/A”； (2) 最大的冠军分差 - 自 2016 年赛季（赛季 > 2015）以来拥有最大分差胜利的全国冠军赛； (3) 最高得分比赛 - 自 2011 年赛季以来（赛季 > 2010）两支球队合计得分最高的比赛； (4) 三分球总数 - 自 2011 年赛季（赛季 > 2010）以来两队三分球总数最高的比赛。最终表格应由“类别”、“日期”、“比赛或地点”以及“关键指标”列组成，每个类别的 5 记录按其关键指标的降序排列。 （此部分不允许更改。不允许删除或改写）。假设 2019年1月 是数据覆盖范围的中点，则该定量结论（以百分比形式）最好地描述了顶级“最高得分游戏”条目中的 258 积分组合得分与次高 3 不同游戏总数（254、240 和列出的最小顶级游戏的场馆容量）的平均值的比较情况。场地减去2点调整）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1052.source: Create a dataset by combining NCAA men's basketball tournament game outcomes from the 2014 season onwards, including both the historical tournament games and the 2018 tournament results, with the corresponding pace and efficiency performance metrics. If w​ is the predicted win/loss label in a game between teams A and B and g​ is the actual goal difference, and when w+g​ crosses a threshold T≥0, what is the probability that team A wins the tournament based on their momentum score calculated by (w+g)/T ? Given T = 5 and g = 3, if team A had a momentum score of 1.2 in their first round game, what is the closest probability percentage that team A will win the tournament assuming a uniform distribution of team strengths?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1052.zh: 通过将 2014 年赛季开始的 NCAA 男子篮球锦标赛比赛结果（包括历史锦标赛比赛和 2018 年锦标赛结果）与相应的速度和效率表现指标相结合来创建数据集。如果 w 是 A 队和 B 队之间的比赛中预测的输赢标签，g 是实际净胜球，当 w+g 跨越阈值 T≥0 时，根据 (w+g)/T 计算出的动量得分，A 队赢得比赛的概率是多少？给定 T = 5 和 g = 3，如果 A 队在第一轮比赛中的动量得分为 1.2，假设球队实力均匀分布，A 队赢得比赛的最接近概率百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1047.source: Please provide a chronological summary of all scoring plays from the 2014 season game where the Wildcats were the home team and the Fighting Irish were the away team. Include for each scoring event the game clock, cumulative scores for both teams (Wildcats and Fighting Irish), the team that scored, and a description of the event. If the Wildcats' final score was 20% higher than their average points per game that season, and the Fighting Irish's final score was 15% lower than their average points per game, which team had a greater deviation from their season average?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1047.zh: 请提供 2014 年赛季比赛中所有得分比赛的时间摘要，其中野猫队是主队，战斗爱尔兰队是客队。包括每个得分项目的比赛时钟、两支球队（野猫队和爱尔兰战斗队）的累积得分、得分球队以及赛事描述。如果野猫队的最终得分比他们赛季场均得分高 20%，而爱尔兰战斗队的最终得分比他们赛季场均得分低 15%，那么哪支球队与赛季平均得分的偏差更大？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1051.source: For the top five team markets with the highest number of distinct players who scored at least 15 points during the second period of games between 2010 and 2018, provide details of each game they played in NCAA basketball historical tournament matches during the same period, as specified in the data model document. Considering the frequency with which these five teams appear in the structured data, if each appearance represents a player that met the 15-point threshold, estimate which team had the highest aggregate point expectation across all their tournament games. The calculation must be done by counting total appearances of the team in gold_result, multiplying by a generic 15-point threshold average per appearance, and comparing this product across the five most frequent teams.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1051.zh: 对于在 2010 年和 2018 年之间的第二场比赛中获得至少 15 分的不同球员数量最多的前 5 个球队市场，请提供他们在同一时期内 NCAA 篮球历史锦标赛比赛中所参加的每场比赛的详细信息，如数据模型文档中所指定。考虑到这五支球队在结构化数据中出现的频率，如果每次出现都代表满足 15 分数阈值的玩家，则估计哪支球队在所有锦标赛比赛中具有最高的总分数期望。计算必须通过计算 gold_result 中球队的总出场次数，乘以每次出场的通用 15 分数阈值平均值，然后比较五个最常出现的球队的乘积来完成。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1045.source: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Tell me the tract code. If you're analyzing California's tech-driven wealth surge, and knowing that Silicon Valley's median income jumped from $80,000 to $120,000 (a 50% increase), while San Francisco tech tracts saw growth from $90,000 to $135,000 (a 50% increase), and considering that Mastodon vector data correlates tract 609601 with the highest investor heart-bonuses (a proxy for tech engagement), what factor most likely positions tract 609601 as California's income growth leader?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1045.zh: 加利福尼亚州哪个人口普查区的 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增幅最大？告诉我道代码。如果您正在分析加州科技驱动的财富激增，并且知道硅谷的中位收入从 $80,000 跃升至 $120,000（50% 增加），而旧金山科技区则从 $90,000 增长到 $135,000（50% 增加），并考虑 Mastodon 向量数据将 609601 区域与最高投资者红利（科技参与度的代表）相关联，什么因素最有可能将 609601 区域定位为加州收入增长领先者？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1055.source: For a bank database with customer transactions... presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances. If the total allocation for the month following the creation month of Customer-Group-X equals the March total shown, and Customer-Group-X had two additional months of active data, what percentage of the combined 2020-April totals across all customers stems from Customer-Group-X when we scale all customers' April weightings by the pattern exhibited in the full three-month result set?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1055.zh: 对于包含客户交易的银行数据库...显示这些最大 30 天平均余额的每月总计。如果 Customer-Group-X 创建月份之后下个月的总分配等于显示的 3 月份总数，并且 Customer-Group-X 还有另外两个月的活动数据，那么当我们按照完整三个月结果集中显示的模式缩放所有客户的 4 月份权重时，所有客户的 2020-4 月份合并总数中来自 Customer-Group-X 的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1054.source: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month. Based on the sequence of the final three ascending months shown, determine the rough average per-month growth rate between the earliest and latest month if we assume continuous compounding. (External knowledge: continuous-compounding growth rate ≈ ln(latest/earliest)/periods.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1054.zh: 对于每个月，计算上个月所有用户的总余额（从每月 1 日开始计算），并将任何负余额替换为零。确保第一个月的数据仅用作计算先前总余额的基线，并将其从最终输出中排除。按月份升序对结果进行排序。如果我们假设连续复利，根据显示的最后三个上升月份的顺序，确定最早和最近一个月之间的粗略平均每月增长率。 （外部知识：连续复合增长率 ≈ ln(最新/最早)/周期数。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1056.source: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total. After running this analysis for the first four calendar months of the dataset, suppose the finance team now wants to estimate how much extra regulatory capital the firm would need to hold if a new rule required setting aside 5% of the total of these monthly peak-allocation sums. Instead of just adding the raw allowance, they prefer to scale the months by their seasonal weighting factors: January × 1.0, February × 1.05, March × 1.12, April × 0.98. What is the estimated regulatory capital that would be held for the four-month period under the new rule?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1056.zh: 对于每个客户，通过结转前一天的余额来计算其最早和最晚交易日期之间每天的每日余额，包括没有交易的天数。将任何负每日余额视为零。然后，对于每个月，确定每个客户在该月内拥有的最高每日余额。最后，对于每个月，将所有客户的这些最大每日余额相加，以获得每月总额。在对数据集的前四个日历月运行此分析后，假设财务团队现在想要估计，如果新规则要求预留这些每月峰值分配总额的 5%，则公司需要持有多少额外监管资本。他们不只是添加原始津贴，而是更喜欢按季节性权重因子来缩放月份：一月 × 1.0、二月 × 1.05、三月 × 1.12、四月 × 0.98。根据新规则，四个月期间预计持有的监管资本是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1062.source: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places. Considering that industry-wide profit margins on green-leaf vegetables like Flower/Leaf Vegetables typically improve by 3 percentage-points when the average loss-rate drops below 10 %, which statement best describes the 2023 Flower/Leaf Vegetables performance by combining the actual loss rate shown in the data with this benchmark rule?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1062.zh: 对于veg whsle数据，您能分析一下我们从2020到2023 年这些年的财务业绩吗？我需要深入了解每年每个类别的平均批发价、最高批发价、最低批发价、批发差价、批发总价、销售总额、平均亏损率、总亏损和利润。所有计算值四舍五入至小数点后两位。考虑到当平均损失率低于 10 % 时，花/叶蔬菜等绿叶蔬菜的全行业利润率通常会提高 3 个百分点，通过将数据中显示的实际损失率与该基准规则相结合，哪种说法最能描述 2023 年花/叶蔬菜的绩效？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1060.source: Using the "bitcoin_prices" table, please calculate the daily percentage change in trading volume for each ticker from August 1 to August 10, 2021, ensuring that any volume ending in "K" or "M" is accurately converted to thousands or millions, any "-" volume is treated as zero, only non-zero volumes are used to determine the previous day's volume, and the results are ordered by ticker and date. (Question) If you combined all non-zero daily changes for BTC and ETH, then calculated their average rate of fluctuation over the 10-day window weighted by their maximum single-day moves in the period, which rounded combined weighted-average daily volatility would best characterize the two-coin market in early August 2021?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1060.zh: 使用“bitcoin_prices”表，请计算每个股票从8月1到2021年8月10日的每日交易量百分比变化，确保任何以“K”或“M”结尾的交易量准确转换为千或百万，任何“-”交易量被视为零，仅使用非零交易量来确定前一天的交易量，并对结果进行排序按股票代码和日期。 （问题）如果您将 BTC 和 ETH 的所有非零每日变化合并起来，然后计算它们在 10 日窗口内的平均波动率，并按其在此期间的最大单日波动进行加权，那么哪个四舍五入的组合加权平均每日波动率最能表征 2021年8月初 的两种货币市场？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1068.source: Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data? If you loosely estimate the absolute customer-subscriber gap in minutes by adding the position of the target month (1–12) to 3 and then multiplying the sum by 50, then dividing by 100, the closest integer result equals the actual month number that records the peak gap. Which month satisfies this?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1068.zh: 根据旧金山共享单车数据中的行程结束日期，2017 年哪个月份（数量）的客户和订阅者的累积自行车使用分钟数（以千为单位）之间的绝对差异最大？如果您通过将目标月份的位置 (1–12) 添加到 3，然后将总和乘以 50，然后除以 100，粗略地估计绝对客户与订阅者差距（以分钟为单位），则最接近的整数结果等于记录峰值差距的实际月份数。哪个月份可以满足这个要求？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1058.source: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value. Now, if a luxury travel brand wants to allocate 60% of its monthly targeting budget to the top-performing interests and the remaining 40% to explore potential in bottom 10 interests, what should be the ideal budget split between Work Comes First Travelers and Readers of Jamaican Content using their peak composition values as weights, assuming a total monthly budget of $50,000?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1058.zh: 根据所有月份的最高构成值确定最高的 10 和最低的 10 兴趣类别。对于每个类别，显示时间 (MM-YYYY)、兴趣名称和成分值。现在，如果豪华旅游品牌希望将其每月目标预算的 60% 分配给表现最好的兴趣，并将剩余的 40% 用于探索底层 10 兴趣的潜力，那么假设每月总预算为 $50,000，工作优先旅行者和牙买加内容读者之间的理想预算分配应该是多少，使用他们的峰值构成值作为权重？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1061.source: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? A stock-optimizer is preparing a 6-month purchasing budget and decides to pad every item’s forecast by the ‘typical loss’—defined here as the average loss rate. If he plans to order enough kale to cover 50 expected sales, how many extra units will he add to buffer spoilage, when the buffer % equals the overall average loss rate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1061.zh: 对于 veg whsle 数据，您能否生成我们商品损失率的摘要？库存优化人员正在准备 6 月的采购预算，并决定用“典型损失”（此处定义为平均损失率）来填充每个项目的预测。如果他计划订购足够的羽衣甘蓝来满足 50 的预期销售额，那么当缓冲百分比等于总体平均损失率时，他将添加多少额外单位来缓冲损坏？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1063.source: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume. Based on the provided data and web guidance: which seller best exemplifies the ‘ideal’ balance between revenue impact and customer satisfaction (high total sales while maintaining above-average review scores and keeping packing time below the median for all filtered sellers)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1063.zh: 准备一份关于我们卖家的综合绩效报告，重点关注总销售额、平均商品价格、平均评论分数和包装时间。确保报告仅包含销售数量超过 100 个产品的卖家，并突出显示销量最高的英文产品类别名称。根据提供的数据和网络指南：哪个卖家最能体现收入影响和客户满意度之间的“理想”平衡（总销售额高，同时保持高于平均水平的评论分数，并将包装时间保持在所有过滤卖家的中位数以下）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1057.source: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out. If a campaign manager wants to promote the product(s) with the highest implied marketing-driven lift—defined as (cart additions - actual purchases) ÷ number of product being viewed serving as a proxy for ad-driven demand generation—how should they rank the products and which group earns the statistically tightest|Description or marketing focus area?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1057.zh: 您能否提供详细信息，说明每种产品被查看的次数、它们被添加到购物车的次数以及它们留在购物车中而未被购买的次数？另外，请提供每种产品的实际购买数量。确保页面 ID 为 (1、2、12、13) 的产品被过滤掉。如果营销经理想要推广具有最高隐含营销驱动提升的产品（定义为（购物车添加量 - 实际购买量）÷ 被视为广告驱动需求生成代理的产品数量），他们应该如何对产品进行排名，以及哪组产品获得统计上最紧的|描述或营销重点领域？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1059.source: Analyze the annual average purchase price per Bitcoin by region, computed as the total dollar amount spent divided by the total quantity purchased each year, excluding the first year's data for each region. Then, for each year, rank the regions based on these average purchase prices, and calculate the annual percentage change in cost for each region compared to the previous year. Given that a global macro fund plans to replicate the cheapest regional DCA strategy each year as a benchmark but unfortunately only had access to data by January of the following year, what is the **shortfall in total bitcoins not acquired** by following its always-one-year-delayed benchmark purchases across Africa, Asia and India for 2020-2021 versus an immediate, lag-free strategy, assuming the fund directs an identical fixed yearly USD budget of 10,000 USD into the regional strategy at the regional DCA without leftover cash and rounding to the nearest 0.01 BTC? (Calculation rules: for every region-year, compute how many whole BTC the 10,000 USD could have bought instantly, then how many the fund really bought one year later, accumulate the difference, express the cumulative shortfall across the three regions and two years)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1059.zh: 按地区分析每个比特币的年度平均购买价格，计算方法为花费的美元总额除以每年购买的总量，不包括每个地区第一年的数据。然后，每年根据这些平均购买价格对各地区进行排名，并计算各地区与上一年相比的年度成本变化百分比。鉴于全球宏观基金计划每年复制最便宜的区域 DCA 策略作为基准，但遗憾的是只能在次年 1 月之前获取数据，假设该基金将 10,000 美元的相同固定年度美元预算投入到区域策略中，那么通过遵循其在非洲、亚洲和印度总是延迟一年的 2020-2021 基准购买，与立即、无滞后的策略相比，未获取的比特币总量的缺口是多少？在地区 DCA 没有剩余现金并四舍五入到最近的 0.01 BTC 吗？ （计算规则：对于每个地区年份，计算10,000 USD立即可以购买多少个完整的BTC，然后该基金一年后实际购买了多少个，累加差额，表示三个地区和两年内的累计缺口）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1067.source: Could you provide the details of the top 5 longest bike share trips that started between July 1, 2017, and December 31, 2017, including the trip ID, duration in seconds, start date, start station name, route (derived from start station name to end station name), bike number, subscriber type, member's birth year, the member's current age (calculated using the current year), an age classification based on whether the member is younger than 40, between 40 and 60, or older than 60, the member's gender, and the name of the region of the start station? Please exclude any trips where the start station name, member's birth year, or member's gender is not specified. – If all five riders in these longest rides went on a normal-length, station-based 11-minute trip instead, how many extra minutes of ride time would the bike-share network have freed up for the public (assuming the per-minute cost is the same for each extra minute of bike availability)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1067.zh: 您能否提供 2017年7月1日 和 2017年12月31日 之间开始的最长 5 最长自行车共享行程的详细信息，包括行程 ID、持续时间（以秒为单位）、开始日期、起始站名称、路线（从起始站名称到终点站名称）、自行车号码、订阅者类型、会员的出生年份、会员当前年龄（以当前年份计算）、根据会员是否小于40、介于40和60之间、或大于60进行年龄分类、会员性别、起始站的地区名称？请排除未指定起始站名称、会员出生年份或会员性别的行程。 – 如果这些最长骑行中的所有五名骑手都进行正常长度、基于车站的 11 分钟行程，那么自行车共享网络将为公众腾出多少分钟的额外骑行时间（假设每分钟的成本与每额外一分钟的自行车可用性相同）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1065.source: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales. Given that standard industry practice flags any attribute type with an average decline exceeding 3% as high-risk for re-targeting campaigns, and only 48 hours remains before the launch of a recovery ad-spend strategy, which of the following statements represents the most accurate segmentation priority for your limited ad-budget window?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1065.zh: 分析 2020年6月15日 之前和之后几周 12 之间销售额的平均百分比变化，针对每个属性类型：区域、平台、年龄段、人口统计和客户类型。对于每个属性类型，计算其所有属性值的平均销售额变化百分比。确定对销售额负面影响最大的属性类型，并提供其销售额的平均百分比变化。鉴于标准行业惯例将平均下降超过 3% 的任何属性类型标记为重新定位广告系列的高风险，并且在启动恢复广告支出策略之前只剩下 48 小时，以下哪项陈述代表了您有限的广告预算窗口的最准确的细分优先级？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1053.source: Which county in Utah experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, calculated by averaging the employment levels during the third month of each quarter in those years? Based on the calculated increase rate of approximately 135.9226%, if future projects are expected to add 42 workers in total by 2025, assuming the same proportional rate of growth continues relative to the 2000 baseline, what would be the projected additional percentage growth attributable ONLY to these new hires over the baseline?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1053.zh: 犹他州哪个县的建筑业就业人数从 2000 年增加到 2018（通过这些年每个季度第三个月的平均就业水平计算得出）最大？根据大约 135.9226% 的计算增长率，如果未来项目预计到 2025 年为止总共增加 42 工人，假设相对于 2000 年基线继续保持相同比例的增长率，则仅归因于这些超过基线的新员工的预计额外增长百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1066.source: Find the latest ride data for each region between 2014 and 2017. I want to know the name of each region, the trip ID of this ride, the ride duration, the start time, the starting station, and the gender of the rider. Assuming all listed trips ended at exactly 00:00 UTC on 2018-01-01, which region has the bike that logged the highest share of its total possible in-service minutes during its final ride, indicating the most intensive single-trip usage from the given dataset?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1066.zh: 查找 2014 年和 2017 年之间每个区域的最新乘车数据。我想知道每个地区的名称、本次骑行的行程ID、骑行时长、起始时间、起始车站以及骑行者的性别。假设所有列出的行程均在 2018-01-01 上的 00:00 UTC 时间结束，哪个地区的自行车在其最终骑行期间记录了其总可能使用分钟数中所占的最高份额，这表明给定数据集中最密集的单次行程使用？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1074.source: Generate a monthly report for each product category, where each row corresponds to orders that have a status of 'Complete' and were delivered before the year 2022, grouping by the month and year of delivery. After the full report is produced, the merchandising team wants to track one key “Quarterly Growth Pulse” across the report: it equals the blended (revenue-growth – order-growth) for the month in which a given Product_category recorded its highest monthly profit-to-cost ratio BEFORE December 2021. Treat only whole-number percentages; ignore decimals. Using no raw figures from the report, what is this Quarterly Growth Pulse expressed in percentage points?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1074.zh: 为每个产品类别生成一份月度报告，其中每一行对应状态为 'Complete'（已完成）且在 2022 年之前送达的订单，按送达的年份和月份分组。完整报告生成后，商品运营团队希望在整份报告中追踪一个关键指标 “Quarterly Growth Pulse”（季度增长脉搏）：它等于某个 Product_category 在 2021 年 12 月之前取得其最高月度利润成本比的那个月份的混合（收入增长 – 订单增长）。只考虑整数百分比，忽略小数部分。在不使用报告中任何原始数据的情况下，该季度增长脉搏以百分点表示是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1078.source: From January 1, 2019, to April 30, 2022, how many users are at the youngest age and how many users are at the oldest age for each gender in the e-commerce platform, counting both youngest and oldest users separately for each gender? If the platform institutes a risk-based limit on cumulative annual ad spend for every unique user aged 16-24 or 65-74, capping the total at a flat rate of 150 currency units per year and assuming every counted user in these bands is subject to the cap, what is the maximum possible annual advertising-budget exposure the platform must plan for across the youngest & oldest cohorts per gender, expressed as a ten-year aggregate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1078.zh: 从2019年1月1日到2022年4月30日，电商平台各性别中最小年龄用户数和最大年龄用户数分别统计各性别的最小用户数和最大年龄用户数？如果平台对每个年龄为 16-24 或 65-74 的唯一用户的累计年度广告支出设置基于风险的限制，以每年 150 货币单位的统一费率限制总额，并假设这些范围内的每个统计用户都受到上限的限制，那么平台必须为每个性别的最年轻和最年长群体规划的最大可能年度广告预算曝光是多少（以十年总计表示）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1081.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020. A policy maker wants to know: if Earth's total 2018 population were treated as one single “country,” roughly how many times *smaller* would the global COVID-19 confirmed-case percentage be compared to the highest national percentage among all countries listed?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1081.zh: 您需要计算截至 2020年6月30日 的每个国家/地区已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。一位政策制定者想知道：如果将地球上的 2018 总人口视为一个“国家”，那么与列出的所有国家/地区中最高的国家百分比相比，全球 COVID-19 确诊病例百分比大约会“小”多少倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1083.source: Determine the number of users who are the youngest and oldest for each gender (male and female) separately, among those who signed up between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022. For each gender, identify the minimum and maximum ages within this date range, and count how many users fall into these respective age groups. Consider that a company-wide wellness intervention is projected to increase the cohort-wide average retention by 5 % for users who belong to the youngest or oldest age bracket for their gender, while retention of other users remains unchanged. If the overall retention rate before the intervention was 78 % across all such highlighted young/old users, approximately how many more individuals from these youngest/oldest brackets are likely to stay loyal in the next 12-month period after the intervention?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1083.zh: 分别确定 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间注册的用户中每种性别（男性和女性）最年轻和最年长的用户数量。对于每个性别，确定此日期范围内的最小和最大年龄，并计算有多少用户属于这些各自的年龄组。考虑到公司范围内的健康干预预计将使属于其性别中最年轻或最年长年龄段的用户的全队列平均留存率提高 5 %，而其他用户的留存率保持不变。如果干预前所有这些突出显示的年轻/年长用户的总体保留率为 78 %，那么在干预后的下一个 12 个月内，这些最年轻/最年长的用户群体中大约还有多少人可能保持忠诚？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1084.source: Please create a month-by-month report for the year 2023 that focuses on the 'Sleep & Lounge' category... If the brand’s 2024 plan requires that profit-to-cost ratio remain at least as high as the AVERAGE ratio achieved during the **three best consecutive months** of 2023, and management estimates each 2024 complete order will carry the same average cost as in those same three months, in which range will the MINIMUM number of complete orders they must generate per month in 2024 to guarantee beating 2023’s single-month **highest total-cost month** by no less than a quarter of its value after rounding the required order count down to the nearest whole number?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1084.zh: 请为 2023 年度创建一份侧重于'Sleep & Lounge'（睡眠和休闲）类别的月度报告...如果该品牌的 2024 年计划要求利润成本比保持至少与 2023 年的连续三个月期间实现的平均比率一样高，并且管理层估计每个 2024 年完整订单将具有与这些订单相同的平均成本同样的三个月，在 2024 年每月必须生成的最小完整订单数量在哪个范围内才能保证在将所需订单计数四舍五入到最接近的整数后超过 2023 年的单月最高总成本月份不少于其价值的四分之一？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1079.source: For each month prior to January 2024, identify the product that achieved the highest total profit (calculated as the sum of sale_price minus the product’s cost) across all order items, then report the total cost and total profit for that top product per month, including all order items regardless of their status, and present the results chronologically by month. Based on the reported monthly data, if management decides to apply an additional 15% markup on cost for strategic pricing improvements in Q4 (October, November, December) of 2020, what would be the approximate average monthly profit increase (in currency units) for the top-selling product in that quarter, compared with the original reported profit?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1079.zh: 对于 2024年1月 之前的每个月，确定所有订单项目中实现最高总利润（计算为 sale_price 减去产品成本）的产品，然后报告该顶级产品每月的总成本和总利润，包括所有订单项目（无论其状态如何），并按月时间顺序显示结果。根据报告的月度数据，如果管理层决定对 2020 年第 4 季度（10 月、11 月、12 月）的战略定价改进进行额外的 15% 成本加价，那么与原始报告利润相比，该季度最畅销产品的平均每月利润增长（以货币单位计算）大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1080.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? The format is MM-DD. If March 9 is considered the base day when containment momentum shifted, how many weeks ahead of this base day did the sharpest acceleration period—when daily growth rates nearly doubled week-over-week—actually begin, predating the first non-pharmaceutical interventions by about 1.4 weeks?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1080.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？格式为MM-DD。如果 3 月 9 被认为是遏制势头发生转变的基准日，那么在该基准日之前多少周，最急剧的加速期（日增长率几乎每周翻倍）实际上开始了，比第一次非药物干预措施早了大约 1.4 周？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1070.source: What is the highest average speed (rounded to 1 decimal, in metric m/s) for bike trips in Berkeley with trip distance greater than 1000 meters?
