After carefully considering the result and the supportive context, determine the difference (to one decimal place) between that observed peak average bike speed and the mean of typical urban utility cycling and the posted car arterials limit. The mean speed against which you will compare the observed peak is computed by taking the midpoint of the published range for urban utility cycling speeds and then averaging that value with the speed implied by the 35 mph car arterial limit found in the context. Your final answer will be this single difference value.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1070.zh: 在伯克利，行程距离大于 1000 米的自行车旅行的最高平均速度是多少（四舍五入到小数点 1，以公制米/秒为单位）？在仔细考虑结果和支持背景后，确定观察到的峰值平均自行车速度与典型城市公用自行车的平均值和张贴的汽车主干道限制之间的差异（精确到小数点后一位）。您将与观察到的峰值进行比较的平均速度是通过以下方式计算的：取已发布的城市公用自行车速度范围的中点，然后将该值与上下文中找到的 35 英里每小时汽车动脉限制所暗示的速度进行平均。您的最终答案将是这个单一差值。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1069.source: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route. The system provides two headsigns. If a rider needs the longest possible one-way travel window to complete all errands and still catch the final bus of the day in this direction, the total available service window (in minutes) from the earliest east-to-west departure to the latest westbound arrival on any headsign equals which value?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1069.zh: 对于在停靠顺序中“Clay St & Drumm St”出现在“Sacramento St & Davis St”之前的行程（仅限一个方向），从“Clay St & Drumm St”出发的最早出发时间以及在“Sacramento St & Davis St”最晚到达的时间（格式为 HH:MM:SS）是多少？请提供每条路线的车头标志。系统提供两个车头标志。如果乘客需要尽可能最长的单程旅行窗口来完成所有差事，并且仍能赶上当天朝该方向的最后一班车，则任何车头标志上从最早的东西向出发到最晚的西行到达的总可用服务窗口（以分钟为单位）等于哪个值？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1076.source: Based solely on completed orders, calculate the average monthly percentage growth rate in the number of unique orders (counting distinct order IDs) for each product category by comparing each month's count to the previous month within the same category. Identify the product category with the highest average of these monthly order growth rates. Then, for that specific product category, compute the average monthly revenue growth rate by calculating the percentage change in total revenue (sum of sale prices) from month to month and averaging these values over the entire period. If that category’s revenue doubled twice in the final month compared with the average monthly revenue across the entire period, the impact on the already-computed average monthly revenue growth rate for that category would be roughly plus or minus how many percentage points?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1076.zh: 仅根据已完成的订单，通过将同一类别中每月的计数与上个月的计数进行比较，计算每个产品类别的唯一订单数量（计算不同订单 ID）的平均每月百分比增长率。确定这些月度订单增长率平均值最高的产品类别。然后，对于该特定产品类别，通过计算每月总收入（销售价格总和）的百分比变化并对整个期间的这些值进行平均，计算平均每月收入增长率。如果该品类最后一个月的收入与整个期间的月平均收入相比翻了一倍，那么对该品类已经计算出的月平均收入增长率的影响大约会加减多少个百分点？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1082.source: Original question: Generate a monthly analysis report for e-commerce sales from June 2019 to December 2019 that includes, for each product category and each month, the total number of orders, total revenue, and total profit, along with their month-over-month growth rates using the data from June 2019 as the basis for calculating growth starting from July 2019. Ensure that all orders are included regardless of their status, and present the results sorted in ascending order by month (formatted as "2019-07") and then by product category. Omitting June 2019 from the final output but using it for the growth calculations.In the last quarter (Oct-Nov-Dec), which accessories‐category segment appears closest to breaking-even on a cost-plus-fixed-fee model that adds 15 % of the total revenue as its required gross profit? You may approximate the profit margin of each month to get a quick sense of which month netted the smallest gap.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1082.zh: 原题：以6月2019的数据为基础，计算7月2019开始的增长情况，生成6月2019至12月2019的电商销售额月度分析报告，包括每个产品类别、每月的订单总数、总收入、总利润以及环比增长率。确保包含所有订单，无论其状态如何，并按月份（格式为“2019-07”）升序显示结果，然后按产品类别排序。从最终输出中省略 2019年6月的，但将其用于增长计算。在上个季度（10 月 - 11 月 - 12 月），哪个配件类别部分在成本加固定费用模型上最接近收支平衡，该模型将总收入的 15 % 添加为所需的毛利润？您可以估算每个月的利润率，以快速了解哪一个月的利润差距最小。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1073.source: Among all product categories in the dataset, identify the category with the highest total purchase quantity (based on order_items table), and for that specific category, what is the average time in minutes that users spend on each product page visit? The average time should be calculated as the difference between the timestamp when a user views a product page and the timestamp of the next event within the same session. A data-to-insight framework then asks: ‘What percentage of this average dwell time represents “effective engagement” if any visit that lasts more than 20% longer than the average is tagged as low-intent browsing?’ Find the nearest integer value (%) of remaining % after filtering out low-intent visits.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1073.zh: 在数据集中的所有产品类别中，确定总购买量最高的类别（基于 order_items 表），对于该特定类别，用户在每个产品页面访问上花费的平均时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？平均时间应计算为用户查看产品页面时的时间戳与同一会话中下一个事件的时间戳之间的差值。然后，数据洞察框架会询问：“如果任何持续时间超过 20% 的访问被标记为低意向浏览，则平均停留时间的百分比代表“有效参与”？”在过滤掉低意向访问后，找到剩余百分比的最接近整数值 (%)。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1075.source: Using data up to the end of 2022 and organized by the month of each user's first purchase, can you provide the percentage of users who made a purchase in each of the first, second, third, and fourth months since their initial purchase, where the "first month" refers to the month of their initial purchase? If we focus on the 2019-Feb cohort, what would be the monthly repurchase lift (defined as the average across the second, third and fourth months compared to the repurchase rate observed in the first month) expressed as a ratio?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1075.zh: 使用截至 2022 年末尾的数据，并按每个用户首次购买的月份进行组织，您能否提供自首次购买以来的第一个月、第二个月、第三个月和第四个月中每个月进行过购买的用户的百分比，其中“第一个月”是指他们首次购买的月份？如果我们关注 2019-Feb 队列，以比率表示的每月回购提升量（定义为第二个月、第三个月和第四个月的平均值与第一个月观察到的回购率相比）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1072.source: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order? To determine the percentage of total first-order revenue this category contributes (assuming total first-order revenue = $3,250,000 across all categories), which figure is correct?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1072.zh: 您能否帮我算出在第一个未取消和未退货订单中购买的客户数量最多的产品类别的收入？要确定该类别贡献的一阶总收入的百分比（假设所有类别的一阶总收入 = $3,250,000），哪个数字是正确的？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1094.source: Provide a list of the top 10 countries for the year 2020, ordered by the highest percentage of their population under 20 years old. Assume a hypothetical African nation is planning a 5-year school-construction program that will serve only citizens under 20. Using the given data, what is the approximate average proportion of each listed country's total population that must be served to maintain no more than **45 students per classroom** if class sizes must equal the population under 20 divided by a fixed number of classrooms, after accounting for the fact that every classroom needs 1 teacher and 1 support staff member, and neither staff member counts as a student?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1094.zh: 提供 2020 年排名靠前的 10 国家/地区列表，按 20 岁以下人口的最高百分比排序。假设一个假设的非洲国家正在规划一项为期 5 年的学校建设计划，该计划仅为 20 下的公民提供服务。使用给定的数据，在考虑到每间教室需要 1 教师和 1 支持人员且两名工作人员均不计为学生的事实后，如果班级规模必须等于 20 以下的人口除以固定的教室数量，则为维持每间教室不超过 45 个学生而必须服务的每个所列国家/地区总人口的大致平均比例是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1090.source: Given the original requirement to find the top three most profitable products by month (Jan 2019–Aug 2022) excluding canceled/returned items, and knowing that the listed products in the structured data all came from a specific clothing-focused ecommerce store, if this store were to expand into accessories (jewelry, sunglasses) next year while maintaining similar profit characteristics, and assuming each new accessory category carries 15% higher unit profit than the average of the 3rd-most-profitable clothing product in any given month, approximately how much more would a new jewelry item need to sell (in units_monthly) in January 2023 to match the most profitable clothing item's total profit from January 2022?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1090.zh: 考虑到最初要求按月查找利润最高的三种产品（2022年1月2019-8月），不包括取消/退货的商品，并且知道结构化数据中列出的产品均来自特定的以服装为主的电子商务商店，如果该商店明年要扩展到配饰（珠宝、太阳镜），同时保持类似的利润特征，并假设每个新的配饰类别具有更高的单位利润15%与任何给定月份中最赚钱的服装产品 3rd 的平均值相比，新珠宝商品在 2023年1月 大约需要多销售多少（以 units_monthly 为单位）才能与最赚钱的服装商品从 2022年1月 的总利润相匹配？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1087.source: Can you list the email addresses of the top 10 users who registered in 2019 and made purchases in 2019, ranking them by their highest average order value, where average order value is calculated by multiplying the number of items in each order by the sale price, summing this total across all orders for each user, and then dividing by the total number of orders? Assuming the 10th-ranked user had an average order value exactly 60% lower than the user ranked first, what is the closest whole-number rank were a new user to appear whose calculated average order value is 25% higher than the 10th-ranked user's, thereby shifting the entire list?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1087.zh: 您能否列出在 2019 年注册并在 2019 年进行购买的排名靠前的 10 用户的电子邮件地址，并按最高平均订单价值对他们进行排名，其中平均订单价值的计算方法是将每个订单中的商品数量乘以销售价格，将每个用户的所有订单的总和除以订单总数？假设排名10th的用户的平均订单值正好低于排名第一的用户60%，那么如果出现一个新用户，其计算的平均订单值比10th的用户高出25%，从而导致整个列表移动，那么最接近的整数排名是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1091.source: Can you list the top 5 months from August 2022 to November 2023 where the profit from Facebook-sourced completed orders showed the largest month-over-month increase? Calculate profit as sales minus costs, group by delivery month, and include only orders created between August 2022 and November 2023. Compare each month's profit to its previous month to find the largest increases. Now, which month in the top-5 list had the largest cumulative profit increase when compared to the second- and third-ranked months, expressed as a percentage difference calculated by summing the profit increases of those two lower-ranked months and comparing it to the profit increase of the top-ranked month?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1091.zh: 您能否列出从 2022年8月 到 2023年11月 的最高 5 月份，其中来自 Facebook 的已完成订单的利润显示出最大的环比增幅？将利润计算为销售额减去成本，按交货月份分组，并且仅包括 2022年8月 和 2023年11月 之间创建的订单。将每个月的利润与上个月进行比较，找出最大的增幅。现在，与排名第二和第三的月份相比，排名靠前的 5 列表中的哪个月份的累计利润增幅最大？通过将排名较低的两个月份的利润增幅相加，并将其与排名靠前的月份的利润增幅进行比较，计算出百分比差异？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1086.source: For each month prior to July 2024, identify the single best-selling product (determined by highest sales volume, with total revenue as a tiebreaker) among all orders with a 'Complete' status and products with non-null brands. Return a report showing the month, product name, brand, category, total sales, rounded total revenue, and order status for these monthly top performers. According to the generated report, which month had the top product whose rounded total revenue was exactly 7.5 times greater than its total sales volume?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1086.zh: 对于 2024年7月 之前的每个月，在所有具有'Complete'（完整）状态的订单和具有非空品牌的产品中确定单一最畅销的产品（由最高销量确定，以总收入作为决胜局）。返回一份报告，显示这些每月表现最佳的产品的月份、产品名称、品牌、类别、总销售额、四舍五入的总收入以及订单状态。根据生成的报告，哪个月的顶级产品的四舍五入总收入恰好是其总销量的 7.5 倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1085.source: Identify the difference in the number of the oldest and youngest users registered between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, from our e-commerce platform data. If this difference is tripled and then reduced by the approximate reported global share-points gap between seniors (65+) and global under-18 users each contributing roughly 4 % of internet users, what percentage of the resulting value equals the platform’s actual gap?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1085.zh: 从我们的电子商务平台数据中找出 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间最大和最小注册用户数量的差异。如果这种差异增加三倍，然后通过报告的老年人 (65+) 和全球低收入 18 用户之间的近似全球份额差距（各自贡献大约 4% 的互联网用户）来缩小，那么所得值的百分比等于平台的实际差距？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1089.source: Please generate a report that, for each month in 2021, provides the number of orders, the number of unique purchasers, and the profit (calculated as the sum of product retail prices minus the sum of product costs), where the orders were placed during 2021 by users who registered in 2021 for inventory items created in 2021, and group the results by the users' country, product department, and product category. Based on this strict filter across all months, if we now take **all Chinese buyers combined for the entire year** and treat their total profit as 100 %, what approximate percentage of their cumulative profit originates from product categories whose total annual contribution is less than the average monthly profit per category for China?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1089.zh: 请生成一份报告，其中提供 2021 年每个月的订单数、唯一购买者数以及利润（计算为产品零售价格总和减去产品成本总和），其中在 2021 年注册的用户针对 2021 年创建的库存商品在 2021 年下的订单，并按用户所在国家/地区、产品部门和产品对结果进行分组类别。基于对所有月份的严格过滤，如果我们现在将所有中国买家全年合计并将其总利润视为 100 %，那么其累计利润中来自年度总贡献低于中国每个类别平均月利润的产品类别的百分比大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1098.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020. The population data for 2018 can be found in the World Bank dataset, and the cumulative COVID-19 confirmed cases data is available in the COVID-19 Open Data dataset. Calculate the percentage of each country's population, that was cumulatively confirmed to have COVID-19. The countries here are sorted based on their confirmed cases. Now, if a public health expert wants to know how much more exposed to COVID-19 the average person in the country ranked 5th from the top is compared to the average person in the country ranked 5th from the bottom, what is that ratio expressed as an integer?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1098.zh: 您需要计算截至 2020年6月30日 的每个国家/地区已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。 2018 年的人口数据可以在世界银行数据集中找到，累积的 COVID-19 确诊病例数据可以在 COVID-19 开放数据数据集中找到。计算每个国家/地区累计确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。这里的国家是根据确诊病例进行排序的。现在，如果一位公共卫生专家想知道从顶部排名为 5th 的国家/地区的平均人口与从底部排名为 5th 的国家/地区的平均人口相比，对 COVID-19 的接触程度高出多少，用整数表示的比率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1092.source: What is the name of the reference sequence with the highest variant density in the given cannabis genome dataset? Based on published assemblies, if the GI number shown (1098476186) is treated as a proxy for the scaffold order, and assuming the density index is calculated by taking the last 4 digits (>0508) of the accession as a percentage of the GI number, which scaffold name most closely matches the derived density rank?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1092.zh: 给定大麻基因组数据集中变异密度最高的参考序列的名称是什么？根据已发布的程序集，如果显示的 GI 编号 (1098476186) 被视为支架顺序的代理，并假设通过将加入的最后 4 数字 (>0508) 作为 GI 编号的百分比来计算密度指数，则哪个支架名称与派生的密度等级最匹配？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1095.source: Which country has the highest percentage of population under the age of 25 in 2017? To estimate how many more years, on average, a child born in the answer country could remain within this under-25 age group compared to an average child born in the South-East Asian country projected to have the oldest population structure in 2017, calculate using the rule: Remaining under-25 years = (25 years - each country’s expected median age).
7-30/FDABench/FDA1095.zh: 哪个国家2017 年中25年龄以下的人口比例最高？要估计与预计拥有 2017 年最古老人口结构的东南亚国家出生的平均儿童相比，在答案国家/地区出生的儿童平均可以保持在 25 以下年龄组内多少年，请使用以下规则进行计算：保持在 25 以下年龄 =（25 岁 - 每个国家/地区的预期中位年龄）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1093.source: What is the variant density of the cannabis reference with the longest reference length? Pay attention that a variant is present if there is at least one variant call with a genotype greater than 0. Given that a typical whole-cannabis-genome variant analysis might report ~12 million SNPs as a baseline, and considering variant density is highest in repetitive/non-coding regions with least conservation, what is the percentage difference between the observed variant density of this longest cannabis reference and a hypothetical uniform genome-wide density predicted using the ~12 million SNPs number scaled by the known assembled size of Cannbio-2 (~900 Mb), while taking into account that the actual reference shown here is slightly shorter than 900 Mb?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1093.zh: 参考长度最长的大麻参考的变异密度是多少？请注意，如果至少有一个基因型大于 0 的变体调用，则表示存在变体。鉴于典型的全大麻基因组变异分析可能会报告约 12 百万个 SNP 作为基线，并且考虑到变异密度在保守性最少的重复/非编码区域中最高，那么最长大麻参考的观察到的变异密度与使用约 12 百万个 SNP 数量按已知组装大小缩放的假设统一全基因组密度之间的百分比差异是多少Cannbio-2 (~900 Mb)，同时考虑到此处显示的实际参考比 900 Mb 稍短？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1088.source: Please provide the names of the products that had sales in each month of 2020 and had the lowest profit, calculated as the difference between their retail price and cost from the products data. Exclude any months where this data isn't available. Please list the products in alphabetical order. Assume that across the full calendar list the aggregate profit-sum of all the lowest-profit items equals a baseline we will call X. Using only addition, subtraction, multiplication or division (operations within 1000), determine how many times bigger the count of different product titles in the returned list is than the numerical value of X divided by 100. (No other transformations or formula may be used.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1088.zh: 请提供 2020 年每月有销售且利润最低的产品名称，其计算方式为零售价与产品数据成本之间的差额。排除无法获得此数据的任何月份。请按字母顺序列出产品。假设在整个日历列表中，所有最低利润项目的总利润总和等于基线，我们将其称为 X。仅使用加法、减法、乘法或除法（1000 内的运算），确定返回列表中不同产品标题的计数比 X 除以 100 的数值大多少倍。 （不得使用其他转换或公式。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1097.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? The format is MM-DD. Now, if we set a 7-day moving average threshold at 31,900 new cases and observe an exponential rise that started 33 days earlier, approximately which earlier MM-DD (expressed as DD adding the hypothetical unchanged 7-day growth span between introduction of measures and peak) would indicate the onset of the rapid growth phase that caused the highest gyration to that April peak?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1097.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？格式为MM-DD。现在，如果我们将 7 天移动平均阈值设置为 31,900 新病例，并观察到 33 天前开始的指数上升，那么大约哪个较早的 MM-DD（表示为 DD 添加在采取措施和峰值之间假设不变的 7 天增长跨度）将表明快速增长阶段的开始，该阶段导致 4 月份峰值的最高回转？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1105.source: Please find all zip code areas located within 10 kilometers of the coordinates (-122.3321, 47.6062) by joining the 2010 census population data (summing only male and female populations with no age constraints) and the zip code area information, and return each area’s polygon, land and water area in meters, latitude and longitude, state code, state name, city, county, and total population. Assuming the population of each ZCTA must be weighted by its effective residential density (population divided by land area in square kilometers), what is the average residential density of ZCTAs whose weighted density falls within ±20 % of the overall mean weighted density for the entire metropolitan Seattle sample?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1105.zh: 请通过连接2010 年人口普查数据（仅对男性和女性人口求和，没有年龄限制）和邮政编码区域信息，查找位于坐标（-122.3321、47.6062）10公里范围内的所有邮政编码区域，并返回每个区域的多边形、土地和水域面积（以米为单位）、经纬度、州代码、州名称、城市、县、总人口。假设每个 ZCTA 的人口必须按其有效居住密度（人口除以平方公里土地面积）进行加权，那么加权密度落在整个西雅图大都市样本总体平均加权密度 ±20 % 范围内的 ZCTA 的平均居住密度是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1101.source: Please calculate the overall percentage change in the average weekly search frequency for the symptom 'Anosmia' across the five New York City counties—Bronx County, Queens County, Kings County, New York County, and Richmond County—by comparing the combined data from January 1, 2019, through December 31, 2019, with the combined data from January 1, 2020, through December 31, 2020. If Google subsequently imposed a 4 % week-to-week random noise reduction on all NYC localised Anosmia query volume starting in June-2020 to stop panic searching, approximately what adjustment to the originally reported 2020 weekly average would reveal the underlying (unfiltered) increase?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1101.zh: 请通过将 2019年1月1日 到 2019年12月31日 的合并数据与 1 月的合并数据进行比较，计算纽约市五个县（布朗克斯县、皇后县、国王县、纽约县和里士满县）'Anosmia'（嗅觉缺失）症状的平均每周搜索频率的总体百分比变化1、2020，截至 2020年12月31日。如果 Google 随后从 6 月 - 2020 开始对所有纽约市本地 Anosmia 查询量实施 4 % 每周随机降噪以停止恐慌搜索，那么对最初报告的 2020 每周平均值进行大约何种调整将揭示潜在的（未经过滤的）增长？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1099.source: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data. (Original Query) - Which country, excluding China due to statistical outliers, had the highest proportion of confirmed cases relative to the country's total population size among the remaining countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1099.zh: 您能否提供美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗截至 2020年4月20日 确诊的 COVID-19 病例总数，以及根据 2020 总人口计算出的每 100,000 人的病例数，该总人口是通过对世界银行数据中所有相关人口条目进行求和而计算得出的。 （原始查询）- 除中国以外，由于统计异常，哪个国家的确诊病例相对于该国总人口规模的比例最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1100.source: Analyze daily new COVID-19 case counts from March to May 2020, identifying the top five states by daily increases. Please compile a ranking based on how often each state appears in these daily top fives. Then, examine the state that ranks fourth overall and identify its top five counties based on their frequency of appearing in the daily top five new case counts. Now assume that, for this fourth-ranked state, the spread-weight is defined as the number of distinct counties that ever appear in that state’s daily top-five list divided by the total occurrences of all in-state counties in those lists. If the spread-weight threshold for “high concentration” is 0.40, which of the following values is closest to the actual spread-weight for that state and does it exceed the threshold? [Calculation rule: treat each of the top-five counties given as unique entities that together account for every single in-state mention; spread-weight = (count of unique counties)/(count of total county-mentions)]
7-30/FDABench/FDA1100.zh: 分析 3 月至 2020年5月 每日新增的 COVID-19 病例数，确定每日增量最多的五个州。请根据每个州出现在每日前五名的频率来编制排名。然后，检查总体排名第四的州，并根据其出现在每日新增病例数前五名的频率中确定其前五个县。现在假设，对于这个排名第四的州，分布权重定义为该州每日前五名列表中出现过的不同县的数量除以这些列表中所有州内县的出现总数。如果“高度集中”的分散权重阈值是 0.40，则以下哪个值最接近该州的实际分散权重并且是否超过阈值？ [计算规则：将给出的前五个县中的每个县视为独特的实体，共同考虑每个州内提及的内容；传播权重 =（唯一县的计数）/（提及的县总数）]

7-30/FDABench/FDA1109.source: Please provide a chronological summary of all scoring plays from the 2014 season game where the Wildcats were the home team and the Fighting Irish were the away team. Include for each scoring event the game clock, cumulative scores for both teams (Wildcats and Fighting Irish), the team that scored, and a description of the event. If the Wildcats had instead scored the amount of points they finished the game with in OT in total evenly across the first half rather than sporadically, by how many points would their halftime lead (positive) or deficit (negative) have changed compared to what actually occurred?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1109.zh: 请提供 2014 年赛季比赛中所有得分比赛的时间摘要，其中野猫队是主队，战斗爱尔兰队是客队。包括每个得分项目的比赛时钟、两支球队（野猫队和爱尔兰战斗队）的累积得分、得分球队以及赛事描述。如果野猫队在上半场的加时赛中平均得分而不是零星得分，那么与实际情况相比，他们的半场领先（正数）或落后（负数）会改变多少分？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1107.source: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Tell me the tract code. If the tract code 609601 experienced an absolute growth in median household income equal to 8% of the 2015 statewide median household income in California, while the 2018 statewide median increased by 2.3% over 2017, which inference best quantifies the region's exceptional performance?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1107.zh: 加利福尼亚州哪个人口普查区的 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增幅最大？告诉我道代码。如果区域代码 609601 的家庭收入中位数绝对增长等于加州 2015 年全州家庭收入中位数的 8%，而 2018 年全州家庭收入中位数比 2017 增长了 2.3%，那么哪个推论最能量化该地区的卓越表现？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1103.source: Given the latest population estimates from the 2018 five-year American Community Survey, what is the number of vaccine sites per 1000 people for counties in California? Alameda County reported 0.13 vaccine-sites-per-1,000-people (≈ 1.3 sites per 10,000 residents) according to the gold_result table. In the peer-reviewed nationwide study cited in the external knowledge, the inter-quartile range of county-level site density was 0.085–0.273 sites per 1,000 residents, with a median of 0.15 per 1,000. If Alameda County’s rate equals that median plus the mean pairwise difference between the IQR’s two bounds, how many additional vaccine sites would the county need today (keeping its 2018 population unchanged) to reach the minimum density that puts it into the upper quartile of all U.S. counties?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1103.zh: 根据 2018 年五年美国社区调查的最新人口估计，加利福尼亚州各县每 1000 人的疫苗接种点数量是多少？阿拉米达县根据 gold_result 表报告了每 1,000 人的 0.13 疫苗接种点（≈每 10,000 居民的 1.3 接种点）。在外部知识引用的同行评审的全国性研究中，县级站点密度的四分位数范围为每 1,000 居民的 0.085–0.273 站点，中位数为每 1,000 的 0.15。如果阿拉米达县的比率等于中位数加上 IQR 两个边界之间的平均成对差值，那么该县今天需要多少个额外的疫苗接种点（保持 2018 年人口不变）才能达到使其进入美国所有县的上四分之一的最低密度？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1102.source: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period. Now, using the true multidimensional gap emerging in those increases, estimate how many extra months of mildly elevated anxiety would each 1-point difference in the existing drivers (2.697) take to offset one month of even mild depression (-3.790), assuming standard linear elasticity between symptom domains.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1102.zh: 请根据美国每周国家数据计算2019年1月1日至2020年1月1日以及2020年1月1日至1月1期间焦虑和抑郁症状的平均水平， 2021。然后，计算从 2019 年期间到 2020 年期间这些平均症状水平的增加百分比。现在，利用这些增加中出现的真正的多维差距，假设症状域之间的标准线性弹性，估计现有驱动因素 (2.697) 中的每个 1 点差异需要多少个月的额外轻度焦虑，才能抵消一个月的轻度抑郁 (-3.790)。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1104.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. For these counties, provide the name, state, median age, total population, number of confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people, number of deaths per 100,000 people, and the case fatality rate as a percentage. Based on these data, which of the following best describes how the sum of the confirmed cases per 100K across these three counties compares to the national average confirmed cases per 100K in mid-August 2020 (approximately 1,800 per 100K), as measured by the absolute difference between these two values?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1104.zh: 使用 2020 5 年人口普查数据查找人口超过 50,000 的前三个县，这些县在 2020年8月27日 的 COVID-19 病死率最高。对于这些县，请提供名称、州、中位年龄、总人口、每 100,000 人的 COVID-19 确诊病例数、每 100,000 人的死亡人数以及病死率（百分比）。根据这些数据，以下哪项最能描述这三个县的每 100K 确诊病例总数与 2020年8月中旬 的全国平均每 100K 确诊病例数（每 100K 大约为 1,800）的比较（通过这两个值之间的绝对差来衡量）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1112.source: Could you determine, for each shot type, the average x and y coordinates (adjusted to ensure consistency regarding the left or right basket), the average number of shot attempts, and the average number of successful shots, considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the correct side of the court based on the team's basket. A coach wants to create station-based practice plans that maximize made-shots per minute. If practice time is proportional to total attempts and actual made shots come from the average successes, what is the made-shot-per-attempt ratio weighted by practice minutes for layups versus dunk?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1112.zh: 您能否确定每种投篮类型的平均 x 和 y 坐标（调整以确保左侧或右侧篮筐的一致性）、平均投篮尝试次数和平均成功投篮次数，仅考虑 2018年3月15日 之前的投篮，排除那些空投篮类型或坐标，确保根据球队的篮筐投篮在球场的正确一侧。教练想要制定基于站的练习计划，以最大限度地提高每分钟的投篮命中率。如果练习时间与总尝试次数成正比，并且实际投篮次数来自平均成功次数，那么按上篮与扣篮的练习分钟数加权的每次尝试投篮次数比率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1113.source: For the top five team markets with the highest number of distinct players who scored at least 15 points during the second period of games between 2010 and 2018, provide details of each game they played in NCAA basketball historical tournament matches during the same period. Based on the structured result data showing 70 total NCAA tournament game appearances by these teams, if each team-market averaged 6.25 distinct 15-point scorers in the second period, what percentage of these 70 games would logically require at least 2 such scorers to account for their tournaments success? (Calculation rule: Since 70 games / 5 markets = 14 games per market, and with 6.25 scorers per market, at least 1.56 scorers per game on average implies roughly 56% of games needed ≥2 scorers to balance out games with 1 scorer)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1113.zh: 对于在 2010 年和 2018 年之间的第二场比赛中获得至少 15 分的不同球员数量最多的前 5 个球队市场，请提供他们在同一时期 NCAA 篮球历史锦标赛比赛中参加的每场比赛的详细信息。根据显示 70 这些球队参加 NCAA 锦标赛的结构化结果数据，如果每个球队市场在第二阶段平均得分为 6.25 不同的 15 得分，那么这些 70 比赛中逻辑上需要至少 2 个这样的得分手才能取得比赛的成功？ （计算规则：由于 70 场次 / 5 市场 = 每个市场的 14 场次，并且每个市场的得分者为 6.25，因此平均每场比赛至少有 1.56 得分者意味着大约需要 56% ≥2 得分者的比赛来平衡与1 得分手）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1108.source: Using the 2017 U.S. Census Tract data from the BigQuery public datasets, you need to proportionally allocate each tract's population and income to the zip codes based on the overlapping area between their geographic boundaries. Then, filter the results to include only those zip codes located within a 5-mile radius of a specific point in Washington State, with coordinates at latitude 47.685833°N and longitude -122.191667°W. Finally, calculate the total population and the average individual income for each zip code (rounded to one decimal place) and sort the results by the average individual income in descending order. Among the zip codes identified, which one has an average income that is approximately 35% lower than the highest average income in the dataset, while also having a population that exceeds the median population of all identified zip codes by at least 15%?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1108.zh: 使用 BigQuery 公共数据集中的 2017 年美国人口普查区数据，您需要根据地理边界之间的重叠面积将每个地区的人口和收入按比例分配给邮政编码。然后，筛选结果以仅包含位于华盛顿州特定点的 5 英里半径范围内的邮政编码，坐标为纬度 47.685833°N 和经度 -122.191667°W。最后，计算每个邮政编码的总人口和个人平均收入（四舍五入到小数点后一位），并将结果按个人平均收入降序排列。在已识别的邮政编码中，哪一个的平均收入比数据集中的最高平均收入低约 35%，同时其人口也比所有已识别邮政编码的中位数至少高出 15%？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1111.source: Please generate a table from the NCAA basketball dataset that lists the top five records in each of these four categories... Considering that an average NCAA tournament venue has ~19,500 seats and the largest listed in our top-5 has 80,000, if these venues collectively hosted a hypothetical double-header event (2 games per venue on the same day), which matchup style would generate the highest estimated total aggregate attendance? [Calculation rules: Sum seating capacities of all top venues, multiply by 2 games per venue, then divide by 1000 to get total aggregate attendance in thousands. Must compare against analogous extreme values from other categories scaled by their ranges]
7-30/FDABench/FDA1111.zh: 请从 NCAA 篮球数据集中生成一个表格，列出这四个类别中每个类别的前五名记录...考虑到 NCAA 锦标赛场馆平均拥有 ~19,500 座位，而我们的顶级 5 个中列出的最大座位数为 80,000，如果这些场馆共同举办假设的双赛赛事（同一天每个场馆有 2 个场比赛），那么比赛风格会产生最高的估计总出席人数吗？ 【计算规则：将所有顶级场馆的座位数相加，乘以每个场馆的场次2，然后除以1000，得到总上座人数（以千为单位）。必须与其他类别中按其范围缩放的类似极值进行比较]

7-30/FDABench/FDA1123.source: Among all product categories in the dataset, identify the category with the highest total purchase quantity (based on order_items table), and for that specific category, what is the average time in minutes that users spend on each product page visit? The average time should be calculated as the difference between the timestamp when a user views a product page and the timestamp of the next event within the same session. If traffic to this category increases by 50%, approximately how long would 1000 visitors spend in total?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1123.zh: 在数据集中的所有产品类别中，确定总购买量最高的类别（基于 order_items 表），对于该特定类别，用户在每个产品页面访问上花费的平均时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？平均时间应计算为用户查看产品页面时的时间戳与同一会话中下一个事件的时间戳之间的差值。如果此类别的流量增加 50%，则 1000 访问者总共花费大约多长时间？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1121.source: For each neighborhood in San Francisco where at least one bike share station and at least one crime incident are located, provide the neighborhood name along with the total count of bike share stations and the total number of crime incidents in that neighborhood. Which neighborhood has the exact crime-to-station ratio that is the second highest across all listed neighborhoods?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1121.zh: 对于旧金山至少有 1 个自行车共享站和至少 1 个起犯罪事件的每个社区，请提供社区名称以及该社区的自行车共享站总数和犯罪事件总数。哪个社区的犯罪与车站比率在所有列出的社区中排名第二？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1122.source: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order? Suppose the 2nd-highest revenue category generated $52,853.02. How much larger (in dollars) is the leading category's revenue compared to the 2nd-highest?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1122.zh: 您能否帮我算出在第一个未取消和未退货订单中购买的客户数量最多的产品类别的收入？假设 2nd 最高收入类别产生了 $52,853.02。领先类别的收入与 2nd 最高收入相比有多少（以美元计）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1116.source: Find the latest ride data for each region between 2014 and 2017. I want to know the name of each region, the trip ID of this ride, the ride duration, the start time, the starting station, and the gender of the rider. Among these latest rides, what percentage of the total riding time is accounted for by the longest single ride?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1116.zh: 查找 2014 年和 2017 年之间每个区域的最新乘车数据。我想知道每个地区的名称、本次骑行的行程ID、骑行时长、起始时间、起始车站以及骑行者的性别。在这些最新的骑行项目中，最长的单次骑行时间占总骑行时间的比例是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1119.source: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route. Which headsign has the longest operational duration in hours?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1119.zh: 对于在停靠顺序中“Clay St & Drumm St”出现在“Sacramento St & Davis St”之前的行程（仅限一个方向），从“Clay St & Drumm St”出发的最早出发时间以及在“Sacramento St & Davis St”最晚到达的时间（格式为 HH:MM:SS）是多少？请提供每条路线的车头标志。哪个车头标志的运行时间最长（以小时为单位）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1125.source: Using data up to the end of 2022 and organized by the month of each user's first purchase, can you provide the percentage of users who made a purchase in each of the first, second, third, and fourth months since their initial purchase... Which of the following monthly cohorts had the highest combined four-month retention percentage across First through Fourth months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1125.zh: 使用截至 2022 年末尾的数据并按每个用户首次购买的月份进行组织，您能否提供自首次购买以来的第一、第二、第三和第四个月内进行过购买的用户的百分比...以下哪个月度群组在第一到第四个月中的组合四个月保留百分比最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1126.source: Based solely on completed orders, calculate the average monthly percentage growth rate in the number of unique orders (counting distinct order IDs) for each product category by comparing each month's count to the previous month within the same category. Identify the product category with the highest average of these monthly order growth rates. Then, for that specific product category, compute the average monthly revenue growth rate by calculating the percentage change in total revenue (sum of sale prices) from month to month and averaging these values over the entire period. Based on this analysis, if November's revenue for the identified category was $1.3 M and December’s figure was exactly the average monthly revenue growth rate above the November baseline, what would be December's projected revenue?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1126.zh: 仅根据已完成的订单，通过将同一类别中每月的计数与上个月的计数进行比较，计算每个产品类别的唯一订单数量（计算不同订单 ID）的平均每月百分比增长率。确定这些月度订单增长率平均值最高的产品类别。然后，对于该特定产品类别，通过计算每月总收入（销售价格总和）的百分比变化并对整个期间的这些值进行平均，计算平均每月收入增长率。根据此分析，如果 11 月份所确定类别的收入为 $1.3 M，而 12 月份的数字恰好是高于 11 月份基线的平均月收入增长率，那么 12 月份的预计收入是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1128.source: Generate a monthly analysis report for e-commerce sales from June 2019 to December 2019 that includes, for each product category and each month, the total number of orders, total revenue, and total profit, along with their month-over-month growth rates using the data from June 2019 as the basis for calculating growth starting from July 2019. Ensure that all orders are included regardless of their status, and present the results sorted in ascending order by month (formatted as "2019-07") and then by product category. Omitting June 2019 from the final output but using it for the growth calculations. Which product category showed the largest single-month absolute revenue increase (in USD) across the entire period?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1128.zh: 生成6月2019至12月2019的电商销售额月度分析报告，包括每个产品类别、每个月的订单总数、总收入、总利润以及环比增长率，以6月2019的数据作为计算7月2019开始增长的基础。确保包含所有订单，无论其状态如何，并按月份（格式为“2019-07”）升序显示结果，然后按产品类别排序。从最终输出中省略 2019年6月，但将其用于增长计算。整个期间哪个产品类别的单月绝对收入增幅最大（以美元计）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1118.source: Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data? To refine the context: given that month is month 9 and we only consider 2017 data, what is the customers share of total rider-minutes in month 9 if the absolute difference is the maximal value observed?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1118.zh: 根据旧金山共享单车数据中的行程结束日期，2017 年哪个月份（数量）的客户和订阅者的累积自行车使用分钟数（以千为单位）之间的绝对差异最大？细化上下文：假设该月是 9，我们只考虑 2017 年数据，如果绝对差是观察到的最大值，则 9 月总骑手分钟数中的客户份额是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1117.source: Could you provide the details of the top 5 longest bike share trips that started between July 1, 2017, and December 31, 2017... What percentage of these longest trips were made by Customers versus Subscribers?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1117.zh: 您能否提供 2017年7月1日 和 2017年12月31日 之间开始的最长 5 最长自行车共享行程的详细信息...这些最长行程中由客户与订阅者进行的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1115.source: Which county in Utah experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, calculated by averaging the employment levels during the third month of each quarter in those years? Assuming Utah County’s construction share of total employment held steady at about 9 % throughout the period, and its total job count jumped by the third-highest growth factor after Washington and Salt Lake, if Washington’s construction growth factor stands at roughly 2.5 × and Salt Lake’s at 2.2 ×, which factor matches the county that outpaced both and therefore had the highest construction increase? (Round results to one decimal place.)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1115.zh: 犹他州哪个县的建筑业就业人数从 2000 年增加到 2018（通过这些年每个季度第三个月的平均就业水平计算得出）最大？假设在此期间，犹他县的建筑业占总就业人数的比例稳定在 9 % 左右，并且其总就业人数跃升为继华盛顿州和盐湖城之后的第三高增长系数，如果华盛顿州的建筑业增长系数约为 2.5 × ，盐湖城的建筑业增长系数约为 2.2 × ，那么哪个因素与超过两者、因此建筑业增幅最高的县相符？ （结果四舍五入到小数点后一位。）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1114.source: Original question: Create a dataset by combining NCAA men's basketball tournament game outcomes from the 2014 season onwards ... [plus] ... Based on historical Adjusted Efficiency Margin (AdjEM) values, which single-game matchup in the 2018 tournament had the largest expected upset likelihood based on the difference in pre-tournament team quality, and what was the percentage gap in AdjEM between the two teams involved?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1114.zh: 原始问题：通过结合 2014 年赛季开始的 NCAA 男子篮球锦标赛比赛结果创建一个数据集...[加上]...基于历史调整效率裕度 (AdjEM) 值，根据赛前球队实力的差异，2018 年锦标赛中的哪一场单场比赛具有最大的预期爆冷可能性，以及两支球队之间 AdjEM 的百分比差距是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1130.source: Please create a month-by-month report for the year 2023 that focuses on the 'Sleep & Lounge' category... Based on the data shown, which month had the second-highest total sales while still maintaining a profit-to-cost ratio above 70%?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1130.zh: 请为 2023 年度创建一份月度报告，重点关注'Sleep & Lounge'（睡眠和休闲）类别...根据显示的数据，哪个月份的总销售额第二高，同时仍保持高于 70% 的利润成本比？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1127.source: For each month prior to January 2024, identify the product that achieved the highest total profit (calculated as the sum of sale_price minus the product’s cost) across all order items, then report the total cost and total profit for that top product per month, including all order items regardless of their status, and present the results chronologically by month; what was the largest month-to-month profit increase for the top-profiting product?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1127.zh: 对于 2024年1月 之前的每个月，找出所有订单项目中实现最高总利润（计算为 sale_price 减去产品成本）的产品，然后报告该最高产品每月的总成本和总利润，包括所有订单项目（无论其状态如何），并按月时间顺序呈现结果；利润最高的产品的最大月度利润增幅是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1129.source: Determine the number of users who are the youngest and oldest for each gender (male and female) separately, among those who signed up between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022... Which gender has a greater numeric difference between its oldest-user count and youngest-user count?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1129.zh: 分别确定 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间注册的用户中，每种性别（男性和女性）中最年轻和最年长的用户数量...哪种性别的最年长用户数和最年轻用户数之间的数字差异更大？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1120.source: What is the highest average speed (rounded to 1 decimal, in metric m/s) for bike trips in Berkeley with trip distance greater than 1000 meters? If the reported highest speed is equal to the 95th percentile of speeds for trips >1000 m, what multiple of the dataset's 50th percentile speed for trips >1000 m would this represent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1120.zh: 在伯克利，行程距离大于 1000 米的自行车旅行的最高平均速度是多少（四舍五入到小数点 1，以公制米/秒为单位）？如果报告的最高速度等于 > 1000 m 的行程速度的 第 95 百分位，那么这代表了 > 1000 m 的行程的数据集 第 50 百分位速度的多少倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1124.source: Generate a monthly report for each product category , where each row corresponds to orders that have a status of 'Complete' and were delivered before the year 2022, grouping by the month and year of delivery. For each category, calculate the total revenue (the sum of sale_price), the total number of completed orders, and compute the month-over-month percentage growth for both revenue and orders by comparing each month’s totals to the previous month’s. Then, for the same orders, aggregate and show the total cost (from product costs), total profit (revenue minus total cost), and finally the profit-to-cost ratio for each month. Which product category recorded a profit-to-cost ratio exceeding 3.5 in at least one single month?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1124.zh: 为每个产品类别生成月度报告，其中每行对应于状态为'Complete'（完成）且在 2022 年之前交付的订单，按交付月份和年份分组。对于每个类别，计算总收入（sale_price 的总和）、已完成订单总数，并通过将每个月的总数与上个月的总数进行比较来计算收入和订单的月环比增长率。然后，对于相同的订单，汇总并显示总成本（来自产品成本）、总利润（收入减去总成本），最后显示每个月的利润成本比。哪一类产品至少有一个月的成本利润率超过3.5？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1134.source: Please provide the names of the products that had sales in each month of 2020 and had the lowest profit, calculated as the difference between their retail price and cost from the products data. Exclude any months where this data isn't available. Please list the products in chronological order based on the month. How many distinct months are represented by the products listed?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1134.zh: 请提供 2020 年每月有销售且利润最低的产品名称，其计算方式为零售价与产品数据成本之间的差额。排除无法获得此数据的任何月份。请根据月份按时间顺序列出产品。列出的产品代表了多少个不同的月份？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1131.source: Identify the difference in the number of the oldest and youngest users registered between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, from our e-commerce platform data. If 14 more oldest users registered in the final quarter of 2021, what is the new difference?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1131.zh: 从我们的电子商务平台数据中找出 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间最大和最小注册用户数量的差异。如果14在2021 年的最后一个季度注册了更多最老的用户，那么新的差异是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1136.source: For the user cohort with a first purchase date in January 2020, what proportion of users returned in the subsequent months of 2020? Considering the entire observed period, how many distinct users from this cohort made at least one repeat purchase?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1136.zh: 对于首次购买日期为 2020年1月 的用户群体，在 2020 年的后续月份中返回的用户比例是多少？考虑到整个观察期间，该群体中有多少不同的用户至少进行过一次重复购买？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1140.source: What is the name of the reference sequence with the highest variant density in the given cannabis genome dataset? What percentage of its total variants are represented by the single sequence gi|1098476186|gb|MNPR01010508.1| if this sequence accounts for 1,204 out of 3,847 total variants?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1140.zh: 给定大麻基因组数据集中变异密度最高的参考序列的名称是什么？单序列 gi|1098476186|gb|MNPR01010508.1| 代表其总变体的百分比是多少该序列是否占 3,847 总变体中的 1,204？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1135.source: Which three browsers have the shortest average session duration—calculated by the difference in seconds between the earliest and latest timestamps for each user’s session—while only including browsers that have more than 10 total sessions, and what are their respective average session durations? If we rank these three browsers by their average durations, how many seconds separate the middle browser from the shortest one?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1135.zh: 哪三种浏览器的平均会话持续时间最短（根据每个用户会话的最早和最新时间戳之间的秒数差异计算），同时仅包括总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器，它们各自的平均会话持续时间是多少？如果我们按平均持续时间对这三种浏览器进行排名，那么中间的浏览器与最短的浏览器相隔多少秒？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1141.source: What is the variant density of the cannabis reference with the longest reference length? Pay attention that a variant is present if there is at least one variant call with a genotype greater than 0. Furthermore, how many base pairs exist per variant in this reference sequence?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1141.zh: 参考长度最长的大麻参考的变异密度是多少？请注意，如果至少有一个基因型大于 0 的变体调用，则表示存在变体。此外，该参考序列中每个变体存在多少个碱基对？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1132.source: For each month prior to July 2024, identify the single best-selling product... What is the cumulative revenue (rounded to the nearest thousand) generated by the monthly best-selling products from January 2019 through December 2023 inclusive?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1132.zh: 对于 2024年7月 之前的每个月，确定单一畅销产品...从 2019年1月 到 2023年12月（含）期间每月畅销产品产生的累计收入（四舍五入到最接近的千）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1137.source: Please generate a report that, for each month in 2021, provides the number of orders, the number of unique purchasers, and the profit... Based on 2021-01 and 2021-12 data, what is the ratio of the largest single-month profit shown to the sum of January profit across all January rows?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1137.zh: 请生成一份报告，其中提供 2021 年每个月的订单数、唯一购买者数和利润...根据 2021-01 和 2021-12 数据，显示的最大单月利润与所有 1 月行中的 1 月利润总和的比率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1145.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? The format is MM-DD. How many days after 02-29 was this peak growth recorded?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1145.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？格式为MM-DD。 02-29 记录此峰值增长后多少天？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1147.source: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data? Based on this data, which country had the second-highest number of cases per 100,000 population among these nations?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1147.zh: 您能否提供美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗截至 2020年4月20日 确诊的 COVID-19 病例总数，以及根据 2020 总人口计算出的每 100,000 人的病例数，该总人口是通过对世界银行数据中所有相关人口条目进行求和而计算得出的？根据此数据，在这些国家中哪个国家的人均 100,000 病例数第二高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1148.source: Analyze daily new COVID-19 case counts from March to May 2020, identifying the top five states by daily increases. Please compile a ranking based on how often each state appears in these daily top fives. Then, examine the state that ranks fourth overall and identify its top five counties based on their frequency of appearing in the daily top five new case counts. What percentage of the state's total counties do these top five represent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1148.zh: 分析 3 月至 2020年5月 每日新增的 COVID-19 病例数，确定每日增量最多的五个州。请根据每个州出现在每日前五名的频率来编制排名。然后，检查总体排名第四的州，并根据其出现在每日新增病例数前五名的频率中确定其前五个县。这前五个县占全州县总数的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1143.source: Which country has the highest percentage of population under the age of 25 in 2017? If that country's under-25 population share is roughly 23 p.p. above the global average, what is the approximate global average?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1143.zh: 哪个国家2017 年中25年龄以下的人口比例最高？如果该国家/地区低于 25 的人口比例大约为 23 p.p.高于全球平均水平，全球平均水平大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1138.source: Please provide the names of the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022... Considering the full 44-month dataset, what is the average number of months (rounded to one decimal place) that any individual product name appears inside the monthly top-three profitable products list?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1138.zh: 请提供从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三个产品的名称...考虑到完整的 44 月数据集，任何单个产品名称出现在每月利润最高的三个产品列表中的平均月数（四舍五入到小数点后一位）是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1139.source: Can you list the top 5 months from August 2022 to November 2023 where the profit from Facebook-sourced completed orders showed the largest month-over-month increase? ... If the total month-over-month profit increase across these top 5 months was distributed evenly across all remaining months in the period (August 2022-November 2023 excluding these 5 months), what would be the expected increase per remaining month?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1139.zh: 您能否列出从 2022年8月 到 2023年11月 的最高 5 月份，其中来自 Facebook 的已完成订单的利润显示出最大的环比增幅？ ...如果 5 这些最高月份的月度总利润增幅均匀分布在该期间的所有剩余月份（2022年8月 至 2023年11月 不包括这些 5 月份），则每个剩余月份的预期增幅是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1133.source: Can you list the email addresses of the top 10 users who registered in 2019 and made purchases in 2019, ranking them by their highest average order value, where average order value is calculated by multiplying the number of items in each order by the sale price, summing this total across all orders for each user, and then dividing by the total number of orders? If these 10 users are divided into two equal groups by their ranking, how many of the top 5 users' emails start with the same letter as any of the users in the bottom 5 group?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1133.zh: 您能否列出在 2019 年注册并在 2019 年进行购买的排名靠前的 10 用户的电子邮件地址，并按最高平均订单价值对他们进行排名，其中平均订单价值的计算方法是将每个订单中的商品数量乘以销售价格，将每个用户的所有订单的总和除以订单总数？如果这些 10 用户按排名分为两个相等的组，则排名靠前的 5 用户的电子邮件中有多少与排名靠后的 5 组中的任何用户以相同的字母开头？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1146.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020. How many more confirmed cases would the country with the second-highest case-percent have needed (as of 30 June) to exceed the leader’s per-capita infection rate, assuming the leader’s figures stayed unchanged?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1146.zh: 您需要计算截至 2020年6月30日 的每个国家/地区已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比。假设领导人的数据保持不变，病例百分比第二高的国家（截至 6 月 30）还需要多少确诊病例才能超过领导人的人均感染率？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1149.source: Please calculate the overall percentage change in the average weekly search frequency for the symptom 'Anosmia' across the five New York City counties—Bronx County, Queens County, Kings County, New York County, and Richmond County—by comparing the combined data from January 1, 2019, through December 31, 2019, with the combined data from January 1, 2020, through December 31, 2020. Given the calculated percentage increase, by what factor approximately did searches grow?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1149.zh: 请通过将 2019年1月1日 到 2019年12月31日 的合并数据与 1 月的合并数据进行比较，计算纽约市五个县（布朗克斯县、皇后县、国王县、纽约县和里士满县）'Anosmia'（嗅觉缺失）症状的平均每周搜索频率的总体百分比变化1、2020，截至 2020年12月31日。根据计算出的增长百分比，搜索量大约增长了多少倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1152.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020... Among these three counties, which one had the largest absolute gap between its confirmed case rate and death rate?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1152.zh: 使用 2020 5 年人口普查数据，查找人口超过 50,000 的前三个县，这些县在 8 月的 COVID-19 病例死亡率最高 27、2020... 在这三个县中，哪一个县的确诊病例数与死亡率之间的绝对差距最大？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1150.source: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period. According to the calculated results, which symptom type exhibited a change closer to zero in its percentage change, and what was that percentage change?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1150.zh: 请根据美国每周国家数据计算2019年1月1日至2020年1月1日以及2020年1月1日至1月1期间焦虑和抑郁症状的平均水平， 2021。然后，计算从 2019 年期间到 2020 年期间这些平均症状水平的增加百分比。根据计算结果，哪种症状类型的变化百分比接近于零，变化百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1151.source: Given the latest population estimates from the 2018 five-year American Community Survey, what is the number of vaccine sites per 1000 people for counties in California? Among the ten counties with ≥1,500,000 residents, which one has a vaccine-site density that is still below the statewide median of 0.19 sites per 1 k-ppl?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1151.zh: 根据 2018 年五年美国社区调查的最新人口估计，加利福尼亚州各县每 1000 人的疫苗接种点数量是多少？在拥有 ≥1,500,000 居民的 10 个县中，哪一个县的疫苗接种点密度仍低于全州每 1 k-ppl 的 0.19 接种点中位数？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1142.source: The original question: 'Provide a list of the top 10 countries for the year 2020, ordered by the highest percentage of their population under 20 years old. For each country, include the total population under 20 years old, the total midyear population, and the percentage of the population that is under 20 years old.' With that in mind, if Mozambique and Burkina Faso were to merge into one country without any change to their individual counts, which of the following would be the merged percentage of population under 20 years of age?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1142.zh: 原始问题为：'请列出 2020 年 20 岁以下人口占比最高的前 10 个国家，按该占比从高到低排序。对每个国家，给出 20 岁以下的总人口、年中总人口，以及 20 岁以下人口所占的百分比。' 基于此，如果 Mozambique（莫桑比克）和 Burkina Faso（布基纳法索）在各自人口计数不变的情况下合并为一个国家，下列哪一项是合并后 20 岁以下人口所占的百分比？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1153.source: Please find all zip code areas within 10 km of (-122.3321, 47.6062) and determine which zip code has the highest population-to-land-area ratio (population density)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1153.zh: 请找出（-122.3321、47.6062）10 公里范围内的所有邮政编码区域，并确定哪个邮政编码的人口与土地面积比率（人口密度）最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1155.source: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Tell me the tract code. What is the tract code for the area where the median income increased by more than 25 percentage points while still maintaining a median income below $80,000 in 2015?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1155.zh: 加利福尼亚州哪个人口普查区的 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增幅最大？告诉我道代码。 2015 年位收入增幅超过 25 个百分点，同时仍保持中位收入低于 $80,000 的地区的区域代码是什么？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1161.source: For the top five team markets with the highest number of distinct players who scored at least 15 points during the second period of games between 2010 and 2018, provide details of each game they played in NCAA basketball historical tournament matches during the same period, as specified in the data model document. Among these five markets, which market participated in exactly 35 total NCAA tournament games between 2010-2018 according to the provided data?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1161.zh: 对于在 2010 年和 2018 年之间的第二场比赛中获得至少 15 分的不同球员数量最多的前 5 个球队市场，请提供他们在同一时期内 NCAA 篮球历史锦标赛比赛中所参加的每场比赛的详细信息，如数据模型文档中所指定。根据提供的数据，在这五个市场中，哪个市场到底参加了 35 之间 2010-2018 年之间的 NCAA 锦标赛总比赛次数？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1160.source: Could you determine, for each shot type, the average x and y coordinates (adjusted to ensure consistency regarding the left or right basket), the average number of shot attempts, and the average number of successful shots, considering only shots taken before March 15, 2018, excluding those with null shot types or coordinates, ensuring the shots are on the correct side of the court based on the team's basket. How much higher is the observed success rate (successful shots per attempt) of the most efficient shot type compared to that of the least efficient one?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1160.zh: 您能否确定每种投篮类型的平均 x 和 y 坐标（调整以确保左侧或右侧篮筐的一致性）、平均投篮尝试次数和平均成功投篮次数，仅考虑 2018年3月15日 之前的投篮，排除那些空投篮类型或坐标，确保根据球队的篮筐投篮在球场的正确一侧。与效率最低的射击类型相比，观察到的最有效射击类型的成功率（每次尝试的成功射击次数）高出多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1156.source: Using the 2017 U.S. Census Tract data from the BigQuery public datasets, you need to proportionally allocate each tract's population and income to the zip codes based on the overlapping area between their geographic boundaries. Then, filter the results to include only those zip codes located within a 5-mile radius of a specific point in Washington State, with coordinates at latitude 47.685833°N and longitude -122.191667°W. Finally, calculate the total population and the average individual income for each zip code (rounded to one decimal place) and sort the results by the average individual income in descending order. Approximately what percentage of the total population of all returned zip codes is contributed by the top three zip codes with the highest average incomes?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1156.zh: 使用 BigQuery 公共数据集中的 2017 年美国人口普查区数据，您需要根据地理边界之间的重叠面积将每个地区的人口和收入按比例分配给邮政编码。然后，筛选结果以仅包含位于华盛顿州特定点的 5 英里半径范围内的邮政编码，坐标为纬度 47.685833°N 和经度 -122.191667°W。最后，计算每个邮政编码的总人口和个人平均收入（四舍五入到小数点后一位），并将结果按个人平均收入降序排列。平均收入最高的三个邮政编码大约占所有返回邮政编码总人口的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1157.source: Please provide a chronological summary of all scoring plays from the 2014 season game where the Wildcats were the home team and the Fighting Irish were the away team. Include for each scoring event the game clock, cumulative scores for both teams (Wildcats and Fighting Irish), the team that scored, and a description of the event. Which player recorded the most second-half field-goal points for the Wildcats while the Fighting Irish held either a tied score or any lead at the moment the basket was made?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1157.zh: 请提供 2014 年赛季比赛中所有得分比赛的时间摘要，其中野猫队是主队，战斗爱尔兰队是客队。包括每个得分项目的比赛时钟、两支球队（野猫队和爱尔兰战斗队）的累积得分、得分球队以及赛事描述。当爱尔兰战斗队在投篮时保持平局或领先时，哪位球员在下半场为野猫队记录了最多的投篮得分？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1164.source: Find the latest ride data for each region between 2014 and 2017. I want to know the name of each region, the trip ID of this ride, the ride duration, the start time, the starting station, and the gender of the rider. What is the total minutes of the longest ride combined with the shortest ride among these latest regional records?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1164.zh: 查找 2014 年和 2017 年之间每个区域的最新乘车数据。我想知道每个地区的名称、本次骑行的行程ID、骑行时长、起始时间、起始车站以及骑行者的性别。这些最新的地区记录中最长骑行和最短骑行的总分钟数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1159.source: Please generate a table from the NCAA basketball dataset that lists the top five records in each of these four categories: (1) Top Venues - the largest venues by seating capacity with Date shown as 'N/A'; (2) Biggest Championship Margins - National Championship games since the 2016 season (season > 2015) with the biggest point margin victories; (3) Highest Scoring Games - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total points scored by both teams combined; and (4) Total Threes - games since the 2011 season (season > 2010) with the highest total three-pointers made by both teams combined. The final table should be organized with columns for Category, Date, Matchup or Venue, and Key Metric, with each category's 5 records presented in descending order of their key metric. What is the ratio of the highest three-point total in a game to the largest championship margin?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1159.zh: 请从 NCAA 篮球数据集生成一个表格，其中列出了这四个类别中每个类别的前 5 名记录： (1) 顶级场馆 - 按座位数划分的最大场馆，日期显示为“N/A”； (2) 最大的冠军分差 - 自 2016 年赛季（赛季 > 2015）以来拥有最大分差胜利的全国冠军赛； (3) 最高得分比赛 - 自 2011 年赛季以来（赛季 > 2010）两支球队合计得分最高的比赛； (4) 三分球总数 - 自 2011 年赛季（赛季 > 2010）以来两队三分球总数最高的比赛。最终表格应由“类别”、“日期”、“比赛或地点”以及“关键指标”列组成，每个类别的 5 记录按其关键指标的降序排列。单场最高三分球总数与最大冠军差距之比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1173.source: Using data up to the end of 2022 and organized by the month of each user's first purchase, can you provide the percentage of users who made a purchase in each of the first, second, third, and fourth months since their initial purchase, where the "first month" refers to the month of their initial purchase? Which single 2022 cohort reversed the year-wide pattern by exhibiting a non-monotonic sequence of percentages across the four months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1173.zh: 使用截至 2022 年末尾的数据，并按每个用户首次购买的月份进行组织，您能否提供自首次购买以来的第一个月、第二个月、第三个月和第四个月中每个月进行过购买的用户的百分比，其中“第一个月”是指他们首次购买的月份？哪个 2022 年队列通过在四个月内表现出非单调的百分比序列来扭转全年模式？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1167.source: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route. What is the difference in operational duration (hours:minutes:seconds) between the Presidio Avenue and Geary + 33rd Avenue services?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1167.zh: 对于在停靠顺序中“Clay St & Drumm St”出现在“Sacramento St & Davis St”之前的行程（仅限一个方向），从“Clay St & Drumm St”出发的最早出发时间以及在“Sacramento St & Davis St”最晚到达的时间（格式为 HH:MM:SS）是多少？请提供每条路线的车头标志。 Presidio Avenue 和 Geary + 33rd Avenue 服务的运营时间（小时：分钟：秒）有什么区别？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1175.source: From January 1, 2019, to April 30, 2022, how many users are at the youngest age and how many users are at the oldest age for each gender in the e-commerce platform, counting both youngest and oldest users separately for each gender? What is the numerical difference between the count of youngest-age female users and the count of youngest-age male users?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1175.zh: 从2019年1月1日到2022年4月30日，电商平台各性别中最小年龄用户数和最大年龄用户数分别统计各性别的最小用户数和最大年龄用户数？最年轻女性用户数和最年轻男性用户数之间的数字差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1176.source: For each month prior to January 2024, identify the product that achieved the highest total profit (calculated as the sum of sale_price minus the product’s cost) across all order items, then report the total cost and total profit for that top product per month, including all order items regardless of their status, and present the results chronologically by month. Among these top products, which month had the single highest total-cost figure recorded?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1176.zh: 对于 2024年1月 之前的每个月，确定所有订单项目中实现最高总利润（计算为 sale_price 减去产品成本）的产品，然后报告该顶级产品每月的总成本和总利润，包括所有订单项目（无论其状态如何），并按月时间顺序显示结果。在这些热门产品中，哪个月份的单项总成本最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1168.source: What is the highest average speed (rounded to 1 decimal, in metric m/s) for bike trips in Berkeley with trip distance greater than 1000 meters? If the median speed for these long-distance trips is 6.2 m/s and the standard deviation is 1.8 m/s, how does this highest speed compare statistically?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1168.zh: 在伯克利，行程距离大于 1000 米的自行车旅行的最高平均速度是多少（四舍五入到小数点 1，以公制米/秒为单位）？如果这些长途旅行的中位速度是 6.2 m/s，标准差是 1.8 m/s，那么这个最高速度在统计上如何比较？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1163.source: Which county in Utah experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, calculated by averaging the employment levels during the third month of each quarter in those years? What is the corresponding percentage increase? Based on the result, if the January-March average construction employment for Utah county was 8,500 in 2000, what would be the projected average for quarter-ending months in 2018?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1163.zh: 犹他州哪个县的建筑业就业人数从 2000 年增加到 2018（通过这些年每个季度第三个月的平均就业水平计算得出）最大？相应的增幅是多少？根据结果，如果犹他州 1 月至 3 月的平均建筑业就业人数为 2000 年的 8,500，则 2018 年季末月份的预计平均值是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1171.source: Among all product categories in the dataset, identify the category with the highest total purchase quantity (based on order_items table), and for that specific category, what is the average time in minutes that users spend on each product page visit? The average time should be calculated as the difference between the timestamp when a user views a product page and the timestamp of the next event within the same session. With this average being the lowest among all categories analyzed (categories A showed 3.25 min, B showed 2.48 min, C showed 2.17 min), what percentage decline does this represent compared to category B's average time spent?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1171.zh: 在数据集中的所有产品类别中，确定总购买量最高的类别（基于 order_items 表），对于该特定类别，用户在每个产品页面访问上花费的平均时间（以分钟为单位）是多少？平均时间应计算为用户查看产品页面时的时间戳与同一会话中下一个事件的时间戳之间的差值。由于该平均值是所有分析类别中最低的（类别 A 显示 3.25 分钟，B 显示 2.48 分钟，C 显示 2.17 分钟），与类别 B 的平均花费时间相比，这代表了多少百分比的下降？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1162.source: Create a dataset by combining NCAA men's basketball tournament game outcomes from the 2014 season onwards, including both the historical tournament games and the 2018 tournament results, with the corresponding pace and efficiency performance metrics for each team and their opponents from the feature_engineering data. Which 2018 NCAA tournament game showed the largest absolute difference in combined pace and efficiency metrics (|pace_rating_diff| + |eff_rank_diff|)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1162.zh: 通过将 2014 年赛季开始的 NCAA 男子篮球锦标赛比赛结果（包括历史锦标赛比赛和 2018 年锦标赛结果）与 feature_engineering 数据中每支球队及其对手的相应节奏和效率表现指标相结合来创建数据集。哪场 2018 NCAA 锦标赛在综合节奏和效率指标方面显示出最大的绝对差异 (|pace_rating_diff| + |eff_rank_diff|)？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1170.source: Can you help me figure out the revenue for the product category that has the highest number of customers making a purchase in their first non-cancelled and non-returned order? If that category generated exactly 237146.98 in revenue and the overall average revenue across all categories was 187500, by what percentage did the top category beat the benchmark?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1170.zh: 您能否帮我算出在第一个未取消和未退货订单中购买的客户数量最多的产品类别的收入？如果该类别产生的收入恰好为 237146.98，并且所有类别的总体平均收入为 187500，那么顶级类别比基准的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1177.source: Generate a monthly analysis report for e-commerce sales from June 2019 to December 2019 that includes, for each product category and each month, the total number of orders, total revenue, and total profit, along with their month-over-month growth rates using the data from June 2019 as the basis for calculating growth starting from July 2019. Ensure that all orders are included regardless of their status, and present the results sorted in ascending order by month (formatted as "2019-07") and then by product category. Omitting June 2019 from the final output but using it for the growth calculations. According to the gold_result data, which product category achieved the single highest absolute dollar increase in profit between consecutive months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1177.zh: 生成6月2019至12月2019的电商销售额月度分析报告，包括每个产品类别、每个月的订单总数、总收入、总利润以及环比增长率，以6月2019的数据作为计算7月2019开始增长的基础。确保包含所有订单，无论其状态如何，并按月份（格式为“2019-07”）升序显示结果，然后按产品类别排序。从最终输出中省略 2019年6月，但将其用于增长计算。根据 gold_result 数据，哪个产品类别在连续几个月之间实现了单一最高的绝对美元利润增幅？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1178.source: Determine the number of users who are the youngest and oldest for each gender (male and female) separately, among those who signed up between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022. For each gender, identify the minimum and maximum ages within this date range, and count how many users fall into these respective age groups. The question is: Adding up the extreme-age counts for male users yields the same total as adding up the extreme-age counts for female users minus how many users?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1178.zh: 分别确定 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间注册的用户中每种性别（男性和女性）最年轻和最年长的用户数量。对于每个性别，确定此日期范围内的最小和最大年龄，并计算有多少用户属于这些各自的年龄组。问题是：将男性用户的极端年龄计数相加得出的总数与将女性用户的极端年龄计数相加减去多少用户得出的总数相同？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1174.source: Based solely on completed orders, calculate the average monthly percentage growth rate in the number of unique orders (counting distinct order IDs) for each product category by comparing each month's count to the previous month within the same category. Identify the product category with the highest average of these monthly order growth rates. Then, for that specific product category, compute the average monthly revenue growth rate by calculating the percentage change in total revenue (sum of sale prices) from month to month and averaging these values over the entire period. If the starting revenue for this category in month 1 was $20,000, what would be the approximate revenue after 3 months of growth at this average rate? (Round to nearest dollar)
7-30/FDABench/FDA1174.zh: 仅根据已完成的订单，通过将同一类别中每月的计数与上个月的计数进行比较，计算每个产品类别的唯一订单数量（计算不同订单 ID）的平均每月百分比增长率。确定这些月度订单增长率平均值最高的产品类别。然后，对于该特定产品类别，通过计算每月总收入（销售价格总和）的百分比变化并对整个期间的这些值进行平均，计算平均每月收入增长率。如果该类别在 1 月的起始收入为 $20,000，那么 3 月按此平均增长率增长后的收入大约是多少？ （四舍五入到最接近的美元）

7-30/FDABench/FDA1172.source: Generate a monthly report for each product category... [original query continued...] Which product category had the highest combined total revenue from January 2021 and December 2021, and what was the approximate month-over-month revenue growth percentage for that category?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1172.zh: 为每个产品类别生成月度报告... [原始查询继续...] 哪种产品类别从 2021年1月 到 2021年12月 的总收入最高，该类别的月环比收入增长率大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1166.source: Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data? If the absolute difference equals 1.4 million customer-minutes and subscriber cumulative usage in the same month totals 2.7 million minutes, what is the subscriber usage as a percentage of customer usage?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1166.zh: 根据旧金山共享单车数据中的行程结束日期，2017 年哪个月份（数量）的客户和订阅者的累积自行车使用分钟数（以千为单位）之间的绝对差异最大？如果绝对差值等于 1.4 百万客户分钟，并且当月订户累积使用量总计 2.7 百万分钟，则订户使用量占客户使用量的百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1165.source: Could you provide the details of the top 5 longest bike share trips... What is the exact ratio of customer-based trips to subscriber-based trips among these 5 longest duration trips?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1165.zh: 您能否提供5最长的共享单车出行的详细信息...在这些5最长持续时间的出行中，基于客户的出行与基于订阅者的出行的确切比例是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1169.source: For each neighborhood in San Francisco where at least one bike share station and at least one crime incident are located, provide the neighborhood name along with the total count of bike share stations and the total number of crime incidents in that neighborhood. Among the neighborhoods listed, which neighborhood has the LOWEST crime-to-station ratio (i.e., the fewest crime incidents per bike share station)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1169.zh: 对于旧金山至少有 1 个自行车共享站和至少 1 个起犯罪事件的每个社区，请提供社区名称以及该社区的自行车共享站总数和犯罪事件总数。在列出的社区中，哪个社区的犯罪与车站比率最低（即每个自行车共享站的犯罪事件最少）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1183.source: Please provide the names of the products that had sales in each month of 2020 and had the lowest profit according to the gold result. How many months had exactly 2 products sharing the minimum profit value?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1183.zh: 请提供2020 年各月有销量且根据黄金结果利润最低的产品名称。 2产品共有多少个月的最低利润值？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1187.source: Please provide the names of the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding any products associated with orders that were canceled or returned. For each product in each month, the profit should be calculated as the sum of the sale prices of all order items minus the sum of the costs of those sold items in that month. Given the list of profitable products, how many different products in total appear in the top-three list across all months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1187.zh: 请提供从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三种产品的名称，不包括与取消或退货订单相关的任何产品。对于每个月的每种产品，利润应计算为所有订单商品的销售价格总和减去该月销售商品的成本总和。给定盈利产品列表，所有月份中总共有多少种不同的产品出现在前三名列表中？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1185.source: For the user cohort with a first purchase date in January 2020, what proportion of users returned in the subsequent months of 2020? What is the cumulative percentage of the original January-2020 cohort that returned at least once by December 2020?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1185.zh: 对于首次购买日期为 2020年1月 的用户群体，在 2020 年的后续月份中返回的用户比例是多少？到 2020年12月 至少返回一次的原始 2020年1月 队列的累计百分比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1184.source: Which three browsers have the shortest average session duration—calculated by the difference in seconds between the earliest and latest timestamps for each user’s session—while only including browsers that have more than 10 total sessions, and what are their respective average session durations? How much shorter is the average duration of the fastest browser compared to the middle-Ranked browser in seconds?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1184.zh: 哪三种浏览器的平均会话持续时间最短（根据每个用户会话的最早和最新时间戳之间的秒数差异计算），同时仅包括总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器，它们各自的平均会话持续时间是多少？与排名中等的浏览器相比，最快的浏览器的平均持续时间短了多少秒？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1180.source: Identify the difference in the number of the oldest and youngest users registered between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, from our e-commerce platform data. If the oldest 5% cohort in that same window contained 317 users, what was the approximate size of the youngest 5% cohort?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1180.zh: 从我们的电子商务平台数据中找出 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 之间最大和最小注册用户数量的差异。如果同一窗口中最老的 5% 群组包含 317 用户，那么最年轻的 5% 群组的大致规模是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1182.source: Can you list the email addresses of the top 10 users who registered in 2019 and made purchases in 2019, ranking them by their highest average order value, where average order value is calculated by multiplying the number of items in each order by the sale price, summing this total across all orders for each user, and then dividing by the total number of orders? If the median order count among these top 10 users is 8, what is the total number of orders across all 10 users?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1182.zh: 您能否列出在 2019 年注册并在 2019 年进行购买的排名靠前的 10 用户的电子邮件地址，并按最高平均订单价值对他们进行排名，其中平均订单价值的计算方法是将每个订单中的商品数量乘以销售价格，将每个用户的所有订单的总和除以订单总数？如果这些顶级 10 个用户的订单中位数是 8，那么所有 10 个用户的订单总数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1195.source: You need to calculate the percentage of each country's population that had been confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020... Which country has the smallest population among those with confirmed-case-to-population ratios above 0.9%?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1195.zh: 您需要计算截至 6 月每个国家已确诊感染 COVID-19 的人口百分比 30、2020...确诊病例与人口比率高于 0.9% 的国家中哪个国家的人口最少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1192.source: Which country has the highest percentage of population under the age of 25 in 2017? Given that approximately 78% of Uganda's population is under 25, what would you estimate for its dependency ratio compared to Japan's ratio?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1192.zh: 哪个国家2017 年中25年龄以下的人口比例最高？鉴于乌干达大约有 78% 人口低于 25，与日本相比，您估计其抚养比是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1194.source: Which day in March and April had the highest COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate in the United States? The format is MM-DD. By how many percentage points did that day’s growth rate exceed the rate observed on March 5?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1194.zh: 3 月和 4 月的哪一天美国 COVID-19 确诊病例增长率最高？格式为MM-DD。当天的增长率比 3 月份 5 观察到的增长率高了多少个百分点？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1190.source: What is the variant density of the cannabis reference with the longest reference length? Pay attention that a variant is present if there is at least one variant call with a genotype greater than 0. — If this same density applied across an aggregate 10×10^6-bp consensus created by concatenating ~13 copies of the longest contig, which of the following ranges would contain the total expected number of non-reference genotype variant calls?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1190.zh: 参考长度最长的大麻参考的变异密度是多少？请注意，如果至少有一个基因型大于 0 的变体调用，则表示存在变体。 — 如果将相同的密度应用于通过连接最长重叠群的 ~13 副本创建的聚合 10×10^6-bp 共识，则以下哪个范围将包含非参考基因型变体调用的预期总数？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1179.source: Please create a month-by-month report for the year 2023 that focuses on the 'Sleep & Lounge' category... Based on this data, which month exhibited the greatest month-over-month increase in total profit?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1179.zh: 请创建 2023 年度的月度报告，重点关注'Sleep & Lounge'（睡眠和休闲）类别...根据此数据，哪一个月的总利润环比增幅最大？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1181.source: For each month prior to July 2024, identify the single best-selling product (determined by highest sales volume, with total revenue as a tiebreaker) among all orders with a 'Complete' status and products with non-null brands. Return a report showing the month, product name, brand, category, total sales, rounded total revenue, and order status for these monthly top performers. Based on this, which single brand among the following generated the highest cumulative total revenue from its appearances as a monthly best-seller?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1181.zh: 对于 2024年7月 之前的每个月，在所有具有'Complete'（完整）状态的订单和具有非空品牌的产品中确定单一最畅销的产品（由最高销量确定，以总收入作为决胜局）。返回一份报告，显示这些每月表现最佳的产品的月份、产品名称、品牌、类别、总销售额、四舍五入的总收入以及订单状态。据此，以下哪个品牌的月度畅销书累计总收入最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1191.source: Provide a list of the top 10 countries for the year 2020, ordered by the highest percentage of their population under 20 years old... Which country has an under-20 percentage that exceeds the weighted-average under-20 share of all ten countries by the smallest margin?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1191.zh: 提供当年 2020 年排名最高的 10 国家/地区列表，按 20 岁以下人口的最高百分比排序...哪个国家/地区的低于 20 的百分比以最小的幅度超过所有十个国家/地区的加权平均低于 20 的比例？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1186.source: Please generate a report that, for each month in 2021... group the results by the users' country, product department, and product category. Which country had the highest total profit across all months combined when aggregating all Women's department products?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1186.zh: 请生成一份报告，针对 2021... 中的每个月，按用户所在国家/地区、产品部门和产品类别对结果进行分组。在汇总所有女装部门产品时，哪个国家/地区的所有月份的总利润最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1188.source: Can you list the top 5 months from August 2022 to November 2023 where the profit from Facebook-sourced completed orders showed the largest month-over-month increase? Calculate profit as sales minus costs, group by delivery month, and include only orders created between August 2022 and November 2023. Compare each month's profit to its previous month to find the largest increases. What is the ratio between the largest month-over-month profit increase and the fifth largest increase among the identified top 5 months?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1188.zh: 您能否列出从 2022年8月 到 2023年11月 的最高 5 月份，其中来自 Facebook 的已完成订单的利润显示出最大的环比增幅？将利润计算为销售额减去成本，按交货月份分组，并且仅包括 2022年8月 和 2023年11月 之间创建的订单。将每个月的利润与上个月进行比较，找出最大的增幅。在确定的 5 最高月份中，最大的环比利润增幅与第五大增幅之间的比率是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1189.source: What is the name of the reference sequence with the highest variant density in the given cannabis genome dataset? In a follow-up analysis, if we normalize the highest variant density sequence (gi|1098476186|gb|MNPR01010508.1|) to a baseline score of 100, approximately what score would the 3rd-ranked sequence receive if their raw variant counts were 12,847 and 8,932 respectively?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1189.zh: 给定大麻基因组数据集中变异密度最高的参考序列的名称是什么？在后续分析中，如果我们将最高变异密度序列 (gi|1098476186|gb|MNPR01010508.1|) 归一化为 100 的基线分数，如果原始变异计数为 12,847 且 3rd 排序的序列大约会获得什么分数分别是8,932？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1198.source: Please calculate the overall percentage change ... December 31, 2020. If one defines a 'noteworthy surge' as any county-level increase >400 %, does the aggregated NYC result meet or exceed that level?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1198.zh: 请计算总体百分比变化...2020年12月31日。如果将'noteworthy surge'（值得注意的激增）定义为任何县级增长 >400 %，那么纽约市的汇总结果是否达到或超过该水平？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1196.source: According to the original query, which country's cases-per-100k value exceeds the median value among the listed seven countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1196.zh: 根据原始查询，哪个国家的 Cases-per-100k 值超过列出的七个国家中的中值？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1205.source: Which census tract has witnessed the largest increase in median income between 2015 and 2018 in California? Tell me the tract code. If the tract’s 2018 median income was $83,125, what was its approximate 2015 median income?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1205.zh: 加利福尼亚州哪个人口普查区的 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增幅最大？告诉我道代码。如果该区域的 2018 年收入中位数为 $83,125，那么其 2015 年收入中位数大约是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1199.source: Please calculate the average levels of anxiety and depression symptoms from the weekly country data for the United States during the periods from January 1, 2019, to January 1, 2020, and from January 1, 2020, to January 1, 2021. Then, compute the percentage increase in these average symptom levels from the 2019 period to the 2020 period. What was the absolute difference in percentage change between anxiety and depression symptoms?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1199.zh: 请根据美国每周国家数据计算2019年1月1日至2020年1月1日以及2020年1月1日至1月1期间焦虑和抑郁症状的平均水平， 2021。然后，计算从 2019 年期间到 2020 年期间这些平均症状水平的增加百分比。焦虑和抑郁症状之间百分比变化的绝对差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1200.source: Given the latest population estimates from the 2018 five-year American Community Survey, what is the number of vaccine sites per 1000 people for counties in California? Among the counties shown, which county has the closest sites-per-1k value to the state-wide county median ratio?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1200.zh: 根据 2018 年五年美国社区调查的最新人口估计，加利福尼亚州各县每 1000 人的疫苗接种点数量是多少？在显示的县中，哪个县的 1k 站点值与全州县中位比率最接近？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1207.source: Please provide a chronological summary of all scoring plays from the 2014 season game where the Wildcats were the home team and the Fighting Irish were the away team. Include for each scoring event the game clock, cumulative scores for both teams (Wildcats and Fighting Irish), the team that scored, and a description of the event. — At what game-clock time following the under-4-minute media timeout in the 2nd half did the Wildcats reclaim a lead they would never relinquish?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1207.zh: 请提供 2014 年赛季比赛中所有得分比赛的时间摘要，其中野猫队是主队，战斗爱尔兰队是客队。包括每个得分项目的比赛时钟、两支球队（野猫队和爱尔兰战斗队）的累积得分、得分球队以及赛事描述。 — 在 2nd 半场媒体暂停不到 4 分钟后，野猫队在什么比赛时间重新夺回了他们永远不会放弃的领先优势？
