7-30/FDABench/FDA0405.source: Analyze our customer retention patterns by building a cohort analysis that segments users by their first purchase month, then calculate the percentage who returned in each of the subsequent three months - but first research industry benchmark retention rates for our sector and compare our performance against competitors mentioned in our internal strategy documents. Identify which cohorts significantly underperform these benchmarks and propose data-driven hypotheses for the gaps based on any relevant market events or seasonal factors you can find.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0405.zh: 通过建立队列分析来分析我们的客户保留模式，该分析按用户的第一个购买月份对用户进行细分，然后计算随后三个月中每个月回访的百分比 - 但首先要研究我们行业的行业基准保留率，并将我们的表现与内部战略文件中提到的竞争对手进行比较。确定哪些群体的表现明显低于这些基准，并根据您可以找到的任何相关市场事件或季节性因素，针对差距提出数据驱动的假设。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0413.source: Analyze which browsers are experiencing the shortest user engagement sessions in our dataset, then investigate whether these browsers have known technical limitations or compatibility issues that could explain the poor session retention. Cross-reference your findings with our internal documentation on browser support policies to recommend whether any of these underperforming browsers should be deprecated from our officially supported list.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0413.zh: 分析我们的数据集中哪些浏览器正在经历最短的用户参与会话，然后调查这些浏览器是否存在已知的技术限制或兼容性问题，这些问题可以解释会话保留不佳的原因。将您的发现与我们有关浏览器支持政策的内部文档进行交叉引用，以建议是否应从我们的官方支持列表中弃用这些表现不佳的浏览器。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0416.source: Analyze the quarterly profit trends of our top-performing products from 2019 through mid-2022, excluding canceled and returned orders, and determine which products consistently appeared in the top three most profitable each month. Cross-reference these findings with external market research to identify what industry factors or competitor actions may have influenced any significant profit fluctuations, and search our internal product documentation to explain how our pricing strategies or cost structures for these specific products evolved during this period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0416.zh: 分析从 2019 年到 2022 年期表现最好的产品的季度利润趋势（不包括取消和退回的订单），并确定哪些产品始终出现在每月利润最高的前三名中。将这些发现与外部市场研究进行交叉参考，以确定哪些行业因素或竞争对手的行为可能会影响任何重大的利润波动，并搜索我们的内部产品文档，以解释我们在此期间这些特定产品的定价策略或成本结构是如何演变的。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0418.source: Analyze the relationship between reference genome length and variant density across all cannabis references in the database, then determine whether the observed pattern aligns with published research on genome assembly quality metrics. For the reference exhibiting the highest variant density relative to its length, cross-reference its chromosome-level variant distribution against known cannabinoid biosynthesis gene clusters and provide a comprehensive genomic characterization report explaining any correlations found.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0418.zh: 分析数据库中所有大麻参考文献的参考基因组长度和变异密度之间的关系，然后确定观察到的模式是否与已发表的基因组组装质量指标研究相一致。对于相对于其长度表现出最高变异密度的参考，将其染色体水平变异分布与已知的大麻素生物合成基因簇交叉引用，并提供全面的基因组表征报告，解释所发现的任何相关性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0410.source: Analyze the age distribution patterns of users registered on our e-commerce platform between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, identifying the gap between our oldest and youngest users, then research how this demographic spread compares to industry benchmarks for similar e-commerce platforms and determine whether our age diversity aligns with best practices for customer retention strategies documented in our internal marketing guidelines.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0410.zh: 分析 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 期间在我们的电子商务平台上注册的用户的年龄分布模式，确定我们最年长和最年轻用户之间的差距，然后研究这种人口分布与类似电子商务平台的行业基准的比较，并确定我们的年龄多样性是否符合我们内部营销指南中记录的客户保留策略的最佳实践。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0409.source: Analyze the performance of sleepwear and loungewear products throughout 2023 by identifying which months showed declining profitability trends compared to industry benchmarks for this retail segment, then investigate whether any seasonal patterns or external market factors (such as supply chain disruptions or consumer spending shifts) correlate with months where the profit-to-cost ratio fell below the category's annual average. Based on your findings, recommend which quarters would benefit most from promotional strategies used by leading competitors in this space.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0409.zh: 通过确定与该零售领域的行业基准相比哪些月份显示盈利能力下降趋势，分析整个 2023 睡衣和家居服产品的表现，然后调查是否有任何季节性模式或外部市场因素（例如供应链中断或消费者支出变化）与利润成本比低于该类别年平均水平的月份相关。根据您的发现，建议哪些季度可以从该领域领先竞争对手使用的促销策略中受益最多。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0412.source: Identify which products maintained consistent monthly sales throughout 2020 while operating at the lowest profit margins, then research industry benchmarks to determine if these margins align with typical pricing strategies for similar product categories. Cross-reference your findings with our internal product documentation to explain why these specific items might have been strategically priced this way, and assess whether this approach was successful compared to competitor practices during the same period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0412.zh: 确定哪些产品在整个 2020 年保持稳定的月销售额，同时以最低的利润率运营，然后研究行业基准以确定这些利润是否与类似产品类别的典型定价策略一致。将您的发现与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉引用，以解释为什么这些特定商品可能会以这种方式进行战略性定价，并评估与同期竞争对手的做法相比，这种方法是否成功。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0415.source: Analyze the monthly performance trends throughout 2021 for newly acquired customers purchasing from newly added inventory, breaking down the results by geographic region, product category, and item classification. Identify which specific combination of customer location and product segment showed the strongest profit margin growth between Q1 and Q4, then research what major retail industry events or economic factors during 2021 might explain this pattern. Finally, find similar case studies or benchmarks from industry reports that contextualize whether this growth trajectory aligns with broader e-commerce trends for that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0415.zh: 分析整个 2021 年从新增库存采购的新客户的每月绩效趋势，按地理区域、产品类别和商品分类细分结果。确定第一季度和第四季度之间哪种客户位置和产品细分的特定组合显示出最强劲的利润率增长，然后研究 2021 年期间的哪些主要零售行业事件或经济因素可能解释这种模式。最后，从行业报告中找到类似的案例研究或基准，以了解这种增长轨迹是否与该时期更广泛的电子商务趋势相符。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0420.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 case rates per capita and healthcare system capacity across the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran during the first wave of the pandemic (specifically mid-April 2020), determining which countries had disproportionately high or low case rates relative to their healthcare infrastructure metrics. Cross-reference the confirmed case data with World Bank population figures and healthcare indicators to identify potential explanations for the variance in outcomes, and assess whether any correlation exists between pre-pandemic health expenditure per capita and the reported infection rates during this period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0420.zh: 分析第一波大流行期间（特别是 2020年4月中旬）美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗的人均 COVID-19 病例率与医疗保健系统能力之间的关系，确定哪些国家的病例率相对于其医疗保健基础设施指标不成比例地高或低。将确诊病例数据与世界银行人口数据和医疗保健指标进行交叉参考，以确定结果差异的潜在解释，并评估大流行前的人均卫生支出与该时期报告的感染率之间是否存在任何相关性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0414.source: Analyze the retention patterns for users who made their first purchase in January 2020 throughout the remainder of that year, and determine whether any significant drops in return rates correlate with major external events or industry trends during that period. Additionally, compare these retention metrics against our internal benchmark documents for acceptable churn thresholds, and recommend whether this cohort's performance warrants intervention based on both the data findings and retention best practices.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0414.zh: 分析 2020年1月 首次购买的用户在当年剩余时间内的保留模式，并确定退货率的显着下降是否与该期间的重大外部事件或行业趋势相关。此外，将这些留存指标与我们的内部基准文档进行比较，以确定可接受的流失阈值，并根据数据发现和留存最佳实践建议该群体的表现是否值得进行干预。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0428.source: Analyze which universities demonstrated the most consistent peak performance in NCAA basketball between 1900-2000 by identifying teams that achieved maximum wins in their respective seasons, then research the historical factors (coaching changes, recruitment strategies, conference realignments) that contributed to these dynasties, and compare how their dominance patterns correlate with broader trends in college athletics funding and television broadcasting deals during this era.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0428.zh: 通过确定在各自赛季中取得最大胜利的球队，分析哪些大学在 1900-2000 之间的 NCAA 篮球比赛中表现出最一致的巅峰表现，然后研究促成这些王朝的历史因素（教练变更、招募策略、会议调整），并比较它们的统治模式如何与该时代大学体育资助和电视转播交易的更广泛趋势相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0419.source: Analyze the relationship between healthcare system characteristics and COVID-19 recovery outcomes by identifying which three countries with over 50,000 confirmed cases as of May 10, 2020 achieved the highest recovery rates, then investigate what specific healthcare policies, infrastructure factors, or treatment protocols these top-performing countries had in common that might explain their success. Additionally, compare these findings against countries with similar case counts but lower recovery rates to determine whether economic indicators or pre-pandemic health system rankings were predictive of recovery performance.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0419.zh: 通过确定截至 2020年5月10日 确诊病例超过 50,000 的三个国家实现了最高的康复率，分析医疗保健系统特征与 COVID-19 恢复结果之间的关系，然后调查这些表现最好的国家有哪些共同的特定医疗保健政策、基础设施因素或治疗方案可以解释它们的成功。此外，将这些发现与病例数相似但康复率较低的国家进行比较，以确定经济指标或大流行前卫生系统排名是否可以预测康复表现。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0427.source: Analyze the scoring dynamics and momentum shifts in the 2014 college football matchup between Northwestern and Notre Dame played at Ryan Field, identifying how each scoring play correlated with tactical adjustments, weather conditions during the game, and historical performance patterns between these two programs. Determine whether the final outcome aligned with pre-game predictions from major sports analysts, and evaluate how the game's flow compared to other ranked vs. unranked matchups from that same week in college football.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0427.zh: 分析西北大学和圣母大学在 Ryan Field 举行的 2014 年大学橄榄球比赛中的得分动态和势头变化，确定每次得分与战术调整、比赛期间的天气条件以及这两个项目之间的历史表现模式的相关性。确定最终结果是否与主要体育分析师的赛前预测一致，并评估与大学橄榄球同一周的其他排名与未排名比赛相比，比赛的流程如何。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0426.source: Using publicly available U.S. Census data, calculate the weighted average household income for zip codes within commuting distance of the headquarters of the company that operates the largest e-commerce fulfillment center in Washington State, where tract-level demographics must be proportionally allocated to zip codes based on geographic boundary overlaps. Then identify which of these zip codes have median incomes that fall below the poverty threshold for a family of four, and explain the potential socioeconomic implications for workforce recruitment in that area.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0426.zh: 使用公开的美国人口普查数据，计算运营华盛顿州最大电子商务履行中心的公司总部通勤距离内的邮政编码的加权平均家庭收入，其中必须根据地理边界重叠将区域级人口统计数据按比例分配给邮政编码。然后确定这些邮政编码中哪些邮政编码的收入中位数低于四口之家的贫困线，并解释该地区劳动力招聘的潜在社会经济影响。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0425.source: Identify the California census tract that experienced the most significant median income growth between 2015 and 2018, then investigate what economic development initiatives, major employer relocations, or policy changes in that specific geographic area could explain this transformation. Cross-reference your findings with any documented demographic shifts or housing development patterns in that tract, and assess whether this income growth has been sustained or reversed in subsequent years based on available research and reports.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0425.zh: 确定 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增长最显着的加州人口普查区，然后调查该特定地理区域的哪些经济发展举措、主要雇主搬迁或政策变化可以解释这种转变。将您的发现与该地区任何有记录的人口变化或住房开发模式进行交叉引用，并根据现有的研究和报告评估这种收入增长在随后的几年中是否持续或逆转。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0424.source: Analyze the demographic density patterns of postal zones surrounding the birthplace of Starbucks Coffee Company, within a radius equivalent to the length of the Lake Washington floating bridge. For each qualifying zone, calculate the population per square kilometer of land area, retrieve the current median household income from recent census estimates, and identify any historical significance of the area by searching relevant archives. Return the geographic boundaries, area measurements, location coordinates, administrative divisions, and synthesized demographic-economic profile for each zone, ranked by population density.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0424.zh: 分析星巴克咖啡公司诞生地周围邮政区的人口密度模式，半径相当于华盛顿湖浮桥的长度。对于每个符合条件的区域，计算每平方公里土地面积的人口，从最近的人口普查估计中检索当前家庭收入中位数，并通过搜索相关档案来确定该区域的历史意义。返回每个区域的地理边界、面积测量、位置坐标、行政区划和综合人口经济概况（按人口密度排名）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0423.source: Analyze how the age demographics and healthcare infrastructure of high-population counties correlated with COVID-19 outcomes during the summer 2020 surge, identifying which counties defied expected mortality patterns based on their population characteristics. For the three most anomalous counties you identify, investigate what local policies, hospital capacity factors, or socioeconomic conditions might explain their unexpected case fatality rates, and assess whether these factors were subsequently validated in peer-reviewed epidemiological studies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0423.zh: 分析人口稠密县的年龄人口统计数据和医疗基础设施与夏季 2020 高峰期间的 COVID-19 结果之间的相关性，并根据人口特征确定哪些县违反了预期的死亡率模式。对于您确定的三个最异常的县，调查哪些当地政策、医院容量因素或社会经济条件可能解释其意外的病死率，并评估这些因素随后是否在同行评审的流行病学研究中得到验证。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0422.source: Analyze how COVID-19 vaccine site distribution across California counties correlates with both population density and social vulnerability indicators, identifying which communities faced the greatest accessibility gaps. Compare the per-capita vaccine site availability against CDC-recommended benchmarks and examine whether counties with higher proportions of elderly or immunocompromised residents received proportionally adequate coverage. Provide policy recommendations for improving equitable vaccine distribution in future public health emergencies based on the disparities you uncover.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0422.zh: 分析加利福尼亚州各县的 COVID-19 疫苗接种点分布如何与人口密度和社会脆弱性指标相关，从而确定哪些社区面临最大的可及性差距。将人均疫苗接种点可用性与疾病预防控制中心推荐的基准进行比较，并检查老年人或免疫功能低下居民比例较高的县是否获得了适当的覆盖率。根据您发现的差异，提供政策建议，以改善未来突发公共卫生事件中疫苗的公平分配。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0421.source: Analyze the COVID-19 case trajectory during the initial U.S. outbreak phase and identify which state consistently ranked fourth in daily case increases, then investigate the socioeconomic and demographic factors of its most impacted counties to determine whether population density, median household income, or healthcare infrastructure best predicted case frequency rankings. Cross-reference your findings with contemporary public health policy decisions in that state to assess whether early intervention measures correlated with county-level outcomes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0421.zh: 分析美国爆发初期的 COVID-19 病例轨迹，确定哪个州在每日病例增长中始终排名第四，然后调查其受影响最严重的县的社会经济和人口因素，以确定人口密度、家庭收入中位数或医疗基础设施是否最能预测病例频率排名。将您的发现与该州当代公共卫生政策决策进行交叉参考，以评估早期干预措施是否与县级结果相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0435.source: Analyze the San Francisco bikeshare trip data to identify which month in 2017 showed the most significant divergence in cumulative usage patterns between casual customers and subscribers based on trip end dates, then investigate what external factors (local events, weather patterns, or policy changes) might explain this behavioral gap. Cross-reference your findings with bikeshare industry best practices and academic research on urban mobility to recommend specific interventions that could have balanced usage between these user segments during that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0435.zh: 分析旧金山共享单车出行数据，根据出行结束日期确定 2017 年的哪一个月显示休闲客户和订阅者之间的累积使用模式差异最大，然后调查哪些外部因素（当地事件、天气模式或政策变化）可能解释这种行为差异。将您的发现与共享单车行业的最佳实践和城市交通的学术研究进行交叉参考，以推荐具体的干预措施，从而平衡该时期这些用户群体之间的使用情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0439.source: Identify which product category generates the highest total purchase volume, then for products in that category, calculate the average time users spend viewing product pages before their next interaction. Additionally, compare this engagement metric against industry benchmark data for similar e-commerce categories and explain whether the observed browsing duration aligns with typical consumer behavior patterns for that type of product.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0439.zh: 确定哪个产品类别产生最高的总购买量，然后对于该类别中的产品，计算用户在下次交互之前查看产品页面的平均时间。此外，将此参与度指标与类似电子商务类别的行业基准数据进行比较，并解释观察到的浏览持续时间是否与该类型产品的典型消费者行为模式一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0432.source: Identify which Utah county experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, using only the employment figures from the third month of each quarter in both years. Then, research what major infrastructure projects, policy changes, or economic factors specific to that county likely drove this growth, and compare the county's construction employment trajectory against statewide trends in building permits and population growth during this period to determine if the employment surge was proportionate to development activity.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0432.zh: 仅使用这两年每个季度第三个月的就业数据，确定犹他州哪个县的建筑业就业人数从 2000 年到 2018 年增幅最大。然后，研究该县特有的重大基础设施项目、政策变化或经济因素可能推动这一增长，并将该县的建筑业就业轨迹与这一时期全州建筑许可和人口增长的趋势进行比较，以确定就业激增是否与发展活动成比例。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0442.source: Analyze our historical sales performance to identify which product category consistently outperformed industry benchmark profit margins before 2024, then investigate whether any external market factors or competitor activities correlate with months where our top-performing products showed unusual profit fluctuations. Based on this analysis, recommend whether we should adjust our pricing strategy for these products and explain how current e-commerce trends might impact this decision.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0442.zh: 分析我们的历史销售业绩，以确定哪些产品类别在 2024 年之前始终优于行业基准利润率，然后调查是否有任何外部市场因素或竞争对手的活动与我们表现最佳的产品表现出异常利润波动的月份相关。根据此分析，建议我们是否应该调整这些产品的定价策略，并解释当前的电子商务趋势可能如何影响这一决定。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0433.source: Analyze how regional ride-sharing patterns between 2014 and 2017 correlate with major local economic events, regulatory changes, or weather phenomena that occurred during that period, and determine which external factors had the most significant impact on ride volume fluctuations in each region. Additionally, compare these findings against industry best practices for demand forecasting to identify which regions showed anomalous behavior that couldn't be explained by standard predictive models.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0433.zh: 分析 2014 年和 2017 年之间的区域乘车共享模式与该时期发生的当地重大经济事件、监管变化或天气现象之间的关联，并确定哪些外部因素对每个区域的乘车量波动影响最大。此外，将这些发现与需求预测的行业最佳实践进行比较，以确定哪些区域表现出标准预测模型无法解释的异常行为。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0434.source: Analyze the longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017 and investigate whether the routes taken correlate with any major events, festivals, or infrastructure changes that occurred in the city during that period. For the top performers, determine if their subscriber demographics align with documented urban cycling trends and research findings on bike-sharing adoption patterns, then assess whether the trip durations suggest recreational versus commuter usage based on industry benchmarks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0434.zh: 分析 2017 年下半年最长的共享单车出行，并调查所选择的路线是否与该时期城市发生的重大活动、节日或基础设施变化相关。对于表现最好的企业，确定他们的用户人口统计数据是否与记录的城市骑行趋势和共享单车采用模式的研究结果相符，然后根据行业基准评估行程持续时间是否表明休闲使用与通勤使用。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0430.source: Analyze how shooting accuracy and court positioning patterns vary across different shot types for games played before the NBA's 2018 All-Star break, and determine whether teams that predominantly use certain shot types (based on their historical playing style and coaching philosophy) show statistically different spatial distributions in their attempts. Additionally, identify which shot types have seen the most significant changes in average attempt location compared to league trends from five years prior, accounting for the court orientation normalization needed when teams switch sides at halftime.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0430.zh: 分析 NBA 2018 全明星赛前不同投篮类型的投篮准确性和球场定位模式有何变化，并确定主要使用某些投篮类型（基于其历史比赛风格和教练理念）的球队在投篮尝试中是否表现出统计上不同的空间分布。此外，与五年前的联赛趋势相比，确定哪些投篮类型的平均出手位置发生了最显着的变化，并考虑到球队在半场换边时所需的球场方向标准化。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0431.source: Analyze whether teams that significantly outperformed their regular season offensive efficiency metrics during March Madness from 2014-2018 were more likely to be eliminated in subsequent rounds, and determine if this "tournament overperformance regression" phenomenon correlates with any patterns identified in recent sports analytics research on clutch performance sustainability.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0431.zh: 分析在 2014-2018 疯狂三月期间明显优于常规赛进攻效率指标的球队是否更有可能在后续几轮中被淘汰，并确定这种“锦标赛超表现回归”现象是否与最近关于关键表现可持续性的体育分析研究中发现的任何模式相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0444.source: Analyze the demographic patterns of users who signed up during the period bounded by two major global events that significantly impacted digital platform adoption, focusing on the extreme age cohorts within each gender category. Investigate whether the youngest and oldest user counts for each gender align with industry research on generational technology adoption trends during this timeframe, and cross-reference your findings with documented user behavior patterns from similar platforms. Provide a comprehensive report explaining any correlations between the age distribution anomalies you discover and external socioeconomic factors that may have influenced signup patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0444.zh: 分析在对数字平台采用产生重大影响的两大全球事件期间注册用户的人口统计模式，重点关注每个性别类别中的极端年龄群体。调查每个性别中最年轻和最年长的用户是否符合该时间段内各代技术采用趋势的行业研究，并将您的发现与类似平台记录的用户行为模式进行交叉引用。提供一份综合报告，解释您发现的年龄分布异常与可能影响注册模式的外部社会经济因素之间的相关性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0437.source: Analyze the relationship between Berkeley's bike-sharing trip performance and the city's urban cycling infrastructure investments. Determine whether the highest average speeds achieved on longer-distance bike trips (exceeding 1km) align with the design standards recommended for protected bike lanes in similar university cities, and assess how Berkeley's topographical challenges documented in transportation planning literature might explain any performance gaps compared to flat-terrain cycling cities.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0437.zh: 分析伯克利的自行车共享出行绩效与该市城市自行车基础设施投资之间的关系。确定长途自行车旅行所达到的最高平均速度（超过 1km）是否符合类似大学城受保护的自行车道的设计标准，并评估交通规划文献中记录的伯克利的地形挑战如何解释与平坦地形自行车城市相比的任何性能差距。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0436.source: Analyze the transit corridor connecting the Financial District's clay-level street grid to the Sacramento Street business zone, identifying trips where stops follow the downtown-to-waterfront directional pattern. For these routes, determine the operational service window (earliest departure to latest arrival) and investigate whether the headway patterns align with peak commuter demand based on typical office district work schedules in this urban area. Cross-reference the trip headsigns with any known transit service changes or rerouting announcements that may have affected this corridor, and assess how the stop sequence geography relates to notable landmarks or points of interest along the route.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0436.zh: 分析连接金融区粘土层街道网格与萨克拉门托街商业区的交通走廊，确定沿市中心到海滨方向模式停靠的行程。对于这些路线，确定运营服务窗口（最早出发到最晚到达），并根据该城区典型的办公区工作时间表调查发车时间模式是否与高峰通勤需求相符。将行程车头标志与可能影响该走廊的任何已知交通服务变更或重新路线公告进行交叉引用，并评估停靠顺序地理与路线沿线著名地标或兴趣点的关系。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0440.source: Analyze the historical performance of our product categories by examining completed orders delivered before the pandemic's economic impact became significant, calculating monthly revenue trends and order volumes. Identify which categories showed the strongest month-over-month growth patterns and research what external market factors or industry events during those specific peak months might explain the performance variations. Cross-reference your findings with our internal product documentation to determine if any promotional campaigns or inventory strategies aligned with the observed growth anomalies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0440.zh: 通过检查在大流行对经济产生重大影响之前交付的已完成订单，计算每月收入趋势和订单量，分析我们产品类别的历史表现。确定哪些类别表现出最强的逐月增长模式，并研究那些特定高峰月份期间的外部市场因素或行业事件可能会解释业绩变化。将您的发现与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉引用，以确定是否有任何促销活动或库存策略与观察到的增长异常相符。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0450.source: Analyze the January 2020 acquisition cohort's monthly retention curve throughout the year, then compare our retention performance against published SaaS industry benchmarks for similar subscription models. Based on patterns you identify in customer support tickets and feedback data, explain the likely drivers behind any significant retention drop-off points and recommend evidence-based intervention strategies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0450.zh: 分析 2020年1月 收购群体全年的月度留存曲线，然后将我们的留存表现与已发布的类似订阅模式的 SaaS 行业基准进行比较。根据您在客户支持票和反馈数据中识别的模式，解释任何重大保留下降点背后的可能驱动因素，并推荐基于证据的干预策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0453.source: Analyze the profit trends from our social media advertising channel that faced major algorithm changes in 2023 to identify which months showed the strongest recovery patterns. For the top 5 months with the largest profit improvements compared to their prior month, research what external market events or platform policy updates might explain these sudden increases. Cross-reference your findings with our internal marketing strategy documents to determine whether the profit surges aligned with any documented campaign optimizations or were driven by external factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0453.zh: 分析 2023 年面临重大算法变化的社交媒体广告渠道的利润趋势，以确定哪些月份显示出最强的复苏模式。对于与上个月相比利润增幅最大的 5 月份，研究哪些外部市场事件或平台政策更新可能会解释这些突然的增长。将您的发现与我们的内部营销策略文件进行交叉引用，以确定利润激增是否与任何记录的营销活动优化一致，还是由外部因素驱动。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0454.source: Analyze the relationship between reference genome length and variant density across all cannabis references in the database, then identify which reference exhibits the most unusual variant density ratio compared to typical genomic variation rates reported in recent cannabis genomics literature. Provide a comprehensive report explaining whether this outlier's characteristics align with known biological factors such as polyploidy, structural variations, or sequencing methodology differences documented in published studies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0454.zh: 分析数据库中所有大麻参考文献的参考基因组长度和变异密度之间的关系，然后确定与最近大麻基因组学文献中报告的典型基因组变异率相比，哪个参考文献表现出最不寻常的变异密度比。提供一份全面的报告，解释该异常值的特征是否与已发表的研究中记录的已知生物因素（例如多倍体、结构变异或测序方法差异）一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0448.source: Identify products that had consistent monthly sales throughout 2020 but generated the lowest profit margins, then research industry benchmarks for acceptable profit margins in those product categories and compare against similar products in our catalog. Analyze whether the underperforming products' pricing strategy aligns with current market trends and recommend whether to discontinue, reprice, or reposition each product based on your findings.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0448.zh: 确定 2020 年月销售额稳定但利润率最低的产品，然后研究这些产品类别中可接受的利润率的行业基准，并与我们目录中的类似产品进行比较。分析表现不佳产品的定价策略是否符合当前市场趋势，并根据您的发现建议是否停止、重新定价或重新定位每个产品。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0447.source: Identify the top 10 users from the 2019 cohort with the highest average order values and cross-reference their email domains against known data breach databases to assess potential account security risks. For each flagged user, search the company knowledge base for any related customer support tickets or fraud prevention policies that might apply, then recommend whether their accounts should be placed on security hold based on both their transaction patterns and external threat intelligence.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0447.zh: 从 2019 年队列中识别平均订单价值最高的顶级 10 个用户，并将其电子邮件域与已知数据泄露数据库交叉引用，以评估潜在的帐户安全风险。对于每个被标记的用户，在公司知识库中搜索可能适用的任何相关客户支持票证或欺诈预防策略，然后根据其交易模式和外部威胁情报建议是否应将其帐户置于安全状态。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0449.source: Identify the three browsers with the shortest average session durations (calculated as the difference between earliest and latest timestamps per user session), but only include browsers with more than 10 total sessions. For each of these browsers, research their known performance characteristics and market positioning, then cross-reference with our internal documentation to determine if any optimization recommendations or known issues have been documented for these specific browsers. Provide an analytical report explaining whether the short session durations correlate with the browsers' technical limitations or other documented factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0449.zh: 确定平均会话持续时间最短的三个浏览器（计算为每个用户会话最早和最新时间戳之间的差值），但仅包括总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器。对于每个浏览器，研究其已知的性能特征和市场定位，然后与我们的内部文档进行交叉引用，以确定是否已针对这些特定浏览器记录了任何优化建议或已知问题。提供分析报告，解释短会话持续时间是否与浏览器的技术限制或其他记录因素相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0443.source: Analyze our e-commerce performance from June through December 2019 by calculating monthly order volumes, revenue, and profit margins by product category, then compare our month-over-month growth trends against industry benchmarks for that period to identify which categories outperformed or underperformed the market. Additionally, investigate any significant external factors or retail events during this timeframe that may have influenced the observed patterns, and correlate your findings with customer sentiment from our product reviews to explain the performance variations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0443.zh: 通过按产品类别计算每月订单量、收入和利润率，分析我们从 6 月到 2019年12月 的电子商务表现，然后将我们的月度增长趋势与该时期的行业基准进行比较，以确定哪些类别表现优于或低于市场。此外，调查在此时间范围内可能影响观察到的模式的任何重要外部因素或零售事件，并将您的发现与我们产品评论中的客户情绪相关联，以解释性能变化。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0411.source: Analyze the monthly best-selling products (by volume, with revenue as tiebreaker) for completed orders before July 2024, but only include products from brands that are headquartered in countries currently ranked in the top 10 globally for e-commerce market size. For each qualifying month, compare the winning product's category performance against industry benchmarks for that category's typical profit margins, and flag any products whose brand has faced major recalls or controversies in the past 3 years. Return the month, product details, brand origin country, category benchmark comparison, and any relevant risk flags discovered.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0411.zh: 分析 2024年7月 之前完成的订单的每月最畅销产品（按数量，以收入作为决胜负），但仅包括总部位于目前全球电子商务市场规模排名前 10 个的国家/地区的品牌的产品。对于每个符合资格的月份，将获胜产品的类别表现与该类别典型利润率的行业基准进行比较，并标记其品牌在过去 3 几年中面临重大召回或争议的任何产品。返回月份、产品详细信息、品牌原产国、类别基准比较以及发现的任何相关风险标记。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0445.source: Analyze the performance of sleepwear and loungewear products throughout 2023, comparing monthly profitability trends against industry benchmarks for this retail segment while identifying which specific months showed profit-to-cost ratios that deviated significantly from the category's seasonal norms. Determine whether any observed fluctuations correlate with major retail events or economic factors that affected the broader apparel industry during that period, and recommend inventory strategies based on your findings.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0445.zh: 分析整个 2023 的睡衣和家居服产品的表现，将每月盈利趋势与该零售领域的行业基准进行比较，同时确定哪些特定月份的利润成本比明显偏离该类别的季节性标准。确定任何观察到的波动是否与该时期影响更广泛服装行业的重大零售事件或经济因素相关，并根据您的发现推荐库存策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0446.source: Analyze the monthly top-selling products with complete orders and known brands through June 2024, then research each winning brand's current market position and sustainability initiatives. Cross-reference these findings with our internal product documentation to identify which of these top performers align with emerging consumer trends in eco-conscious purchasing, and provide strategic recommendations on which products should receive increased inventory investment for Q4 2024.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0446.zh: 分析截至 2024年6月 的每月最畅销产品（具有完整订单和知名品牌），然后研究每个获奖品牌当前的市场地位和可持续发展举措。将这些调查结果与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉引用，以确定哪些表现最佳的产品符合生态意识购买中的新兴消费者趋势，并就哪些产品应在第四季度 2024 增加库存投资提供战略建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0452.source: Identify the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding canceled and returned orders, then cross-reference these products against current industry sustainability ratings to determine which consistently profitable items also meet modern ESG compliance standards. For any products that appear in the top three for more than six months, search for recent news about their manufacturers and analyze whether their market positioning strategy aligns with the profitability patterns you discovered in the sales data.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0452.zh: 确定从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三种产品（不包括取消和退回的订单），然后将这些产品与当前行业可持续发展评级进行交叉引用，以确定哪些持续盈利的产品也符合现代 ESG 合规标准。对于任何出现在前三名超过六个月的产品，搜索有关其制造商的最新新闻，并分析其市场定位策略是否与您在销售数据中发现的盈利模式相符。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0459.source: Analyze how the search frequency patterns for anosmia-related symptoms in New York City's five boroughs during 2020 correlated with the timeline of major COVID-19 policy interventions in the region, and determine which borough showed the most anomalous deviation from its 2019 baseline relative to its demographic characteristics and healthcare infrastructure capacity.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0459.zh: 分析 2020 年期间纽约市五个行政区嗅觉丧失相关症状的搜索频率模式与该地区主要 COVID-19 政策干预时间线的相关性，并确定哪个行政区相对于其人口特征和医疗保健基础设施能力与其 2019 基线的异常偏差最大。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0463.source: Using publicly available U.S. Census data, identify the demographic and economic characteristics of zip codes within commuting distance of the headquarters of the largest employer in Spokane, Washington. Proportionally allocate tract-level population and median household income to zip codes based on geographic boundary overlaps, then analyze how these metrics correlate with the proximity to major regional medical facilities in that area.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0463.zh: 使用公开的美国人口普查数据，确定华盛顿州斯波坎最大雇主总部通勤距离内邮政编码的人口和经济特征。根据地理边界重叠，将地区人口和家庭收入中位数按比例分配到邮政编码，然后分析这些指标与该地区主要区域医疗设施的邻近程度如何相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0458.source: Analyze the correlation between COVID-19 case acceleration patterns during the initial US outbreak wave and each state's timing of implementing stay-at-home orders, focusing specifically on the fourth-ranked state by frequency of daily top-five appearances. For that state, investigate whether counties with major international airports or high population density showed statistically different case trajectories compared to rural counties, and determine if the state's public health emergency declarations preceded or followed the CDC's specific guidance documents issued during that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0458.zh: 分析美国爆发初期的 COVID-19 病例加速模式与每个州实施居家令的时间之间的相关性，特别关注每日出现频率排名前五的第四个州。对于该州，调查拥有主要国际机场或人口密度高的县与农村县相比，在统计上是否显示出不同的病例轨迹，并确定该州的公共卫生紧急状态声明是在疾病预防控制中心在此期间发布的具体指导文件之前还是之后发布的。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0461.source: Analyze the demographic density patterns of postal zones surrounding the headquarters location of the company that hosted the first-ever commercial cloud computing service, comparing their land-to-water ratios with population distribution. For each qualifying zone, retrieve its geographic boundaries and administrative hierarchy, then cross-reference with documentation about census methodology changes between 2000 and 2010 to explain any anomalies in the male-to-female population ratios you observe.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0461.zh: 分析托管首个商业云计算服务的公司总部所在地周围邮政区的人口密度模式，将其土地与水的比率与人口分布进行比较。对于每个符合条件的区域，检索其地理边界和行政层次结构，然后交叉引用有关 2000 年和 2010 年之间人口普查方法变化的文档，以解释您观察到的男女人口比例中的任何异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0456.source: Analyze the relationship between healthcare system preparedness indicators and COVID-19 recovery outcomes by identifying which countries with significant outbreak levels (above 50,000 confirmed cases) as of May 10, 2020 achieved the highest recovery rates, then investigate what specific national health policies, hospital capacity metrics, and treatment protocols these top-performing countries had implemented that might explain their superior recovery outcomes compared to countries with similar case counts but lower recovery rates. Provide a comparative analysis that connects the quantitative recovery data with qualitative policy factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0456.zh: 通过确定截至 2020年5月10日 疫情严重程度（高于 50,000 确诊病例）的国家实现了最高的康复率，分析医疗保健系统准备指标与 COVID-19 恢复结果之间的关系，然后调查这些表现最好的国家实施了哪些具体的国家卫生政策、医院容量指标和治疗方案，这些政策、医院容量指标和治疗方案可能解释了它们与病例数相似的国家相比具有更好的恢复结果但治愈率较低。提供将定量复苏数据与定性政策因素联系起来的比较分析。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0457.source: Analyze how countries' healthcare infrastructure capacity correlates with their COVID-19 infection rates during the first wave of the pandemic, comparing nations across different income classifications. Identify which factors best explain why some countries with similar economic development levels experienced vastly different outbreak severities, and determine whether population density or government response timing played a more significant role in these outcomes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0457.zh: 比较不同收入类别的国家，分析第一波大流行期间各国的医疗保健基础设施能力与其 COVID-19 感染率的相关性。确定哪些因素最能解释为什么一些经济发展水平相似的国家经历了截然不同的疫情严重程度，并确定人口密度或政府应对时间是否在这些结果中发挥了更重要的作用。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0460.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 vaccine site accessibility and socioeconomic vulnerability across California counties by calculating vaccine sites per capita, then correlating these figures with the CDC's Social Vulnerability Index components. Identify which specific vulnerability factors (housing burden, minority status, transportation access) most strongly predict vaccine site distribution gaps, and compare your findings against peer-reviewed research on vaccine equity to determine whether California's distribution aligned with recommended public health frameworks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0460.zh: 通过计算人均疫苗站点，然后将这些数字与 CDC 的社会脆弱性指数组成部分相关联，分析加州各县的 COVID-19 疫苗站点可及性与社会经济脆弱性之间的关系。确定哪些特定的脆弱性因素（住房负担、少数族裔地位、交通便利）最能预测疫苗地点分布差距，并将您的发现与同行评审的疫苗公平性研究进行比较，以确定加州的分布是否符合建议的公共卫生框架。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0465.source: Analyze which universities demonstrated the most consistent peak performance in NCAA basketball between 1900-2000 by identifying those with the most season-win maximums, then investigate how each top program's historical coaching changes and major institutional events correlate with their championship-caliber seasons. Cross-reference your findings with contemporary sports journalism and academic research to explain what systemic factors—such as recruiting advantages, conference affiliations, or institutional investments—contributed to these programs sustaining excellence across multiple decades.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0465.zh: 通过确定那些赛季获胜次数最多的大学，分析哪些大学在 1900-2000 之间的 NCAA 篮球比赛中表现出最一致的巅峰表现，然后调查每个顶级项目的历史教练变动和重大机构事件与其冠军级别赛季的相关性。将您的发现与当代体育新闻和学术研究进行交叉引用，以解释哪些系统性因素（例如招募优势、会议关系或机构投资）有助于这些项目在数十年中保持卓越。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0468.source: Analyze which playing style characteristics (tempo, offensive efficiency, defensive metrics) have been most predictive of NCAA tournament upset victories over the past decade, and determine whether the 2024 tournament results support or contradict these historical patterns. Identify the specific statistical thresholds that differentiate Cinderella teams from early-round exits, and explain any recent rule changes or trends that might be affecting these dynamics.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0468.zh: 分析过去十年中哪些比赛风格特征（节奏、进攻效率、防守指标）最能预测 NCAA 锦标赛的爆冷胜利，并确定 2024 年锦标赛结果是否支持或矛盾这些历史模式。确定区分灰姑娘团队与早期退出的具体统计阈值，并解释可能影响这些动态的任何最近的规则变化或趋势。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0464.source: Analyze the scoring momentum shifts in the 2014 regular season matchup between Northwestern and Notre Dame, identifying which quarter represented the critical turning point based on scoring efficiency and time of possession patterns. Cross-reference the key plays with contemporary sports media coverage to determine whether analysts' real-time assessments aligned with the statistical inflection points you identify, and evaluate how this game's outcome impacted both teams' subsequent bowl eligibility projections.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0464.zh: 分析西北大学和圣母大学之间的 2014 年常规赛比赛中得分势头的变化，根据得分效率和控球时间模式确定哪个季度代表了关键转折点。将关键比赛与当代体育媒体报道进行交叉引用，以确定分析师的实时评估是否与您确定的统计拐点一致，并评估这场比赛的结果如何影响两支球队随后的保龄球资格预测。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0467.source: Analyze how shooting accuracy and court positioning patterns vary across different shot types for attempts made before the NBA's 2018 All-Star break, and determine whether teams that historically emphasize three-point shooting show statistically different coordinate clustering compared to teams known for paint-dominant offenses. Additionally, investigate if any correlation exists between a player's shooting efficiency from specific court zones and their team's overall offensive rating during that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0467.zh: 分析 NBA 2018 全明星赛前不同投篮类型的投篮准确性和球场位置模式有何变化，并确定历史上强调三分球的球队与以内线进攻为主的球队相比是否表现出统计上不同的坐标聚类。此外，调查球员在特定球场区域的投篮效率与球队在此期间的整体进攻效率之间是否存在任何相关性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0451.source: Analyze the monthly purchasing patterns throughout 2021 for customers who joined that same year, focusing only on newly introduced inventory items. Calculate profitability metrics and customer engagement indicators, then correlate these findings with major global events or economic factors that may have influenced consumer behavior in the top-performing geographic regions and product categories. Identify any anomalies or seasonal trends that deviate from what industry benchmarks would predict for those specific market segments.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0451.zh: 分析同年加入的客户在 2021 年的每月购买模式，仅关注新推出的库存商品。计算盈利能力指标和客户参与度指标，然后将这些发现与可能影响表现最好的地理区域和产品类别的消费者行为的重大全球事件或经济因素相关联。识别与行业基准对这些特定细分市场的预测不同的任何异常或季节性趋势。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0455.source: Analyze which country had the youngest population structure in 2017 and investigate how this demographic profile correlates with that nation's economic development indicators, historical colonial influences, and current social challenges. Compare this country's youth bulge phenomenon with two other nations from different continents that have similarly young populations, examining what common factors contribute to high youth percentages and what divergent outcomes these countries have experienced. Based on your findings, assess whether a large under-25 population serves as a demographic dividend or burden for developing nations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0455.zh: 分析 2017 年哪个国家的人口结构最年轻，并调查该人口结构与该国家的经济发展指标、历史殖民影响和当前社会挑战之间的关系。将这个国家的青年膨胀现象与来自不同大陆的两个拥有类似年轻人口的国家进行比较，研究哪些共同因素导致了高青年比例，以及这些国家经历了哪些不同的结果。根据您的发现，评估大量 25 以下人口是否会成为发展中国家的人口红利或负担。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0475.source: Among visitors who purchased YouTube-related products in July 2017, identify which non-YouTube-branded product had the highest purchase quantity, then analyze whether this cross-purchasing pattern aligns with established theories of complementary product bundling in e-commerce literature. Compare your findings against recent academic research on digital platform cross-selling strategies and explain what psychological or behavioral factors might drive customers to purchase these specific product combinations together.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0475.zh: 在 2017年7月 购买 YouTube 相关产品的访问者中，确定哪种非 YouTube 品牌产品的购买量最高，然后分析这种交叉购买模式是否符合电子商务文献中互补产品捆绑的既定理论。将您的发现与最近有关数字平台交叉销售策略的学术研究进行比较，并解释哪些心理或行为因素可能会促使客户一起购买这些特定的产品组合。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0462.source: Identify the California census tract that experienced the most significant median income growth between 2015 and 2018, then investigate what economic developments, policy changes, or demographic shifts occurred in that specific geographic area during this period that might explain this transformation. Cross-reference your findings with any documented urban development projects, tech industry expansions, or housing market analyses mentioned in planning documents or economic reports for that region, and assess whether this income growth pattern aligns with broader state or national economic trends of that era.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0462.zh: 确定 2015 年和 2018 年之间收入中位数增长最显着的加州人口普查区，然后调查该特定地理区域在此期间发生的哪些经济发展、政策变化或人口变化可能解释这种转变。将您的发现与该地区规划文件或经济报告中提到的任何记录在案的城市发展项目、科技产业扩张或住房市场分析进行交叉引用，并评估这种收入增长模式是否符合该时代更广泛的州或国家经济趋势。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0477.source: Analyze how the final recorded rides in each region between 2014-2017 correlate with that region's bike share infrastructure maturity and urban density characteristics, then determine whether the timing patterns of these last rides and the gender distribution of riders reflect broader national trends in bike share adoption during this period. Cross-reference the starting stations of these terminal rides with their geographic positioning to identify whether system contraction followed predictable spatial patterns seen in other transportation network declines.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0477.zh: 分析 2014-2017 之间每个区域的最终记录骑行与该地区的共享单车基础设施成熟度和城市密度特征之间的关联，然后确定这些最后骑行的时间模式和骑行者的性别分布是否反映了这一时期更广泛的全国共享单车采用趋势。将这些终点站乘车的起始站与其地理位置进行交叉参考，以确定系统收缩是否遵循其他交通网络衰退中所见的可预测空间模式。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0473.source: Analyze the revenue performance patterns of the top-performing traffic source during the first half of 2017, comparing its maximum daily, weekly, and monthly product revenues against industry benchmarks for e-commerce channels during that period. Identify what external market factors or platform changes might explain the observed revenue patterns for this source, and evaluate whether its performance trajectory aligned with broader digital marketing trends documented in industry reports from that timeframe.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0473.zh: 分析 2017 年上半年表现最好的流量源的收入表现模式，将其每日、每周和每月的最大产品收入与该期间电子商务渠道的行业基准进行比较。确定哪些外部市场因素或平台变化可以解释该来源观察到的收入模式，并评估其绩效轨迹是否与该时间范围内行业报告中记录的更广泛的数字营销趋势一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0469.source: Analyze the relationship between construction employment growth and population migration patterns in Utah counties from 2000 to 2018, using quarterly employment data averaged from the third month of each quarter. Identify which county's construction sector growth most strongly correlates with the economic development initiatives or major infrastructure projects that occurred during this period, and determine whether the percentage increase in construction employment outpaced the regional housing demand indicators. Provide a comprehensive report explaining the underlying factors that drove the top-performing county's construction employment surge.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0469.zh: 使用每季度第三个月的平均季度就业数据，分析犹他州 2000 年到 2018 年各县的建筑业就业增长与人口迁移模式之间的关系。确定哪个县的建筑业增长与这一时期发生的经济发展举措或重大基础设施项目的相关性最强，并确定建筑业就业增长的百分比是否超过了地区住房需求指标。提供一份综合报告，解释推动表现最好的县建筑业就业激增的根本因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0474.source: Analyze how seasonal shopping patterns and major e-commerce events during Q2-Q3 2017 influenced the browsing behavior gap between converting and non-converting visitors on Google's merchandise store, then determine whether the observed pageview differences align with industry benchmark conversion metrics for retail e-commerce sites during that period. Identify which specific month showed the most anomalous engagement pattern relative to typical online retail trends and explain what external factors might account for this deviation.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0474.zh: 分析第 2 季度至第 3 季度 2017 期间的季节性购物模式和主要电子商务事件如何影响 Google 商品商店中转化访问者和非转化访问者之间的浏览行为差异，然后确定观察到的网页浏览量差异是否与该期间零售电子商务网站的行业基准转化指标相符。确定相对于典型的在线零售趋势，哪个特定月份显示出最异常的参与模式，并解释哪些外部因素可能会导致这种偏差。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0481.source: Analyze the relationship between cycling speeds and trip distances in Berkeley by identifying the speed characteristics of longer bike trips, then investigate how these patterns compare to academic research on optimal urban cycling infrastructure design and determine whether Berkeley's bike network efficiency aligns with best practices identified in urban mobility studies for cities of similar size and climate.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0481.zh: 通过确定较长自行车出行的速度特征，分析伯克利的自行车速度和出行距离之间的关系，然后研究这些模式与最佳城市自行车基础设施设计的学术研究如何比较，并确定伯克利的自行车网络效率是否符合规模和气候相似的城市的城市交通研究中确定的最佳实践。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0478.source: Analyze the longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017 and determine whether the riders' age demographics correlate with research findings on cycling behavior patterns across different life stages. For the top performers, calculate how their trip durations compare to the average commute times in the cities where these stations are located, and assess whether the routes taken align with officially recommended bike paths or scenic corridors mentioned in urban planning documents for those areas.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0478.zh: 分析 2017 年下半年最长的共享单车行程，并确定骑手的年龄人口统计数据是否与不同生命阶段的骑车行为模式的研究结果相关。对于表现最好的人，计算他们的行程持续时间与这些车站所在城市的平均通勤时间相比如何，并评估所采取的路线是否与这些地区的城市规划文件中提到的官方推荐的自行车道或风景廊道相符。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0482.source: Analyze whether San Francisco neighborhoods with higher bike share infrastructure have different public safety profiles, and investigate what urban planning research suggests about the relationship between alternative transportation options and neighborhood crime patterns. Based on your findings, recommend which underserved neighborhoods might benefit from bike share expansion while considering both equity and safety factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0482.zh: 分析具有较高自行车共享基础设施的旧金山社区是否具有不同的公共安全状况，并调查城市规划研究对替代交通选择与社区犯罪模式之间关系的建议。根据您的发现，建议哪些服务不足的社区可能会从自行车共享扩张中受益，同时考虑公平和安全因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0486.source: Analyze customer cohort retention patterns from our transaction database to identify which acquisition months produced the highest-performing customer segments, then compare these retention curves against published industry benchmarks for our sector to determine if our performance is above or below average. Additionally, cross-reference these findings with our internal marketing campaign documentation to explain any anomalies or significant shifts in cohort quality over time.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0486.zh: 从我们的交易数据库中分析客户群体保留模式，以确定哪些收购月份产生了表现最高的客户群，然后将这些保留曲线与我们行业已发布的行业基准进行比较，以确定我们的表现是否高于或低于平均水平。此外，将这些发现与我们的内部营销活动文档进行交叉引用，以解释随着时间的推移队列质量的任何异常或重大变化。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0470.source: Identify the distinct pseudo users who showed engagement activity in the broader weekly window but became completely inactive in the final 48 hours before the cutoff timestamp, then analyze what percentage this "drop-off" cohort represents and compare this attrition pattern against industry benchmarks and recent academic research on user disengagement signals. Based on your findings, determine whether this drop-off rate falls within normal platform behavior ranges and what the latest studies suggest about predicting and preventing such engagement decay patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0470.zh: 识别在更广泛的每周窗口中表现出参与活动但在截止时间戳之前的最后 48 小时内完全不活跃的不同伪用户，然后分析这个“下降”群体所代表的百分比，并将这种流失模式与行业基准和最近关于用户脱离信号的学术研究进行比较。根据您的发现，确定该下降率是否在正常的平台行为范围内，以及最新研究对预测和防止此类参与度下降模式的建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0487.source: Analyze the order fulfillment patterns to identify which product category demonstrates the strongest momentum in customer adoption over time, then investigate whether this growth leader aligns with current industry forecasts for that sector's market expansion. For the top-performing category, determine if there's a correlation between its growth trajectory and the sentiment expressed in customer feedback, and recommend whether the company should increase inventory investment based on your findings.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0487.zh: 分析订单履行模式，以确定随着时间的推移，哪个产品类别在客户采用方面表现出最强的势头，然后调查该增长领先者是否符合当前行业对该行业市场扩张的预测。对于表现最好的类别，确定其增长轨迹与客户反馈中表达的情绪之间是否存在相关性，并根据您的发现建议公司是否应该增加库存投资。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0417.source: Identify which months showed the strongest profit momentum from Facebook-sourced orders during our major marketing campaign period, then research what external market events or Facebook algorithm changes during those specific high-growth months might explain the performance spikes. Cross-reference your findings with our internal marketing strategy documents to determine whether the profit increases aligned with our planned promotional calendar or were driven by unexpected external factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0417.zh: 确定在我们的主要营销活动期间，哪些月份的 Facebook 订单显示出最强劲的利润势头，然后研究在这些特定的高增长月份期间外部市场事件或 Facebook 算法的变化可能会解释业绩飙升。将您的发现与我们的内部营销策略文件进行交叉引用，以确定利润增长是否与我们计划的促销日历一致，还是由意外的外部因素驱动。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0483.source: Identify which product category dominates first-time successful purchases and calculate its total revenue contribution, then compare this finding against industry benchmarks for "gateway products" in e-commerce customer acquisition. Using your analysis, evaluate whether our first-purchase category performance aligns with established customer lifetime value modeling frameworks and recommend whether our current acquisition strategy should double down on this category or diversify based on frequency-recency patterns in our customer data.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0483.zh: 确定哪个产品类别在首次成功购买中占主导地位，并计算其总收入贡献，然后将这一发现与电子商务客户获取中“门户产品”的行业基准进行比较。使用您的分析，评估我们的首次购买类别绩效是否与已建立的客户终身价值建模框架一致，并建议我们当前的收购策略是否应该加倍关注该类别，或者根据客户数据中的频率-新近模式进行多样化。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0472.source: Analyze the relationship between visitor engagement patterns and conversion timing for Q1 2017, identifying whether the time-to-first-transaction metric correlates with industry benchmarks for e-commerce conversion windows, and determine if device preferences among converting visitors align with the mobile commerce adoption trends reported during that period. Additionally, investigate whether visitors who took longer to convert showed different behavioral signals that could inform customer segmentation strategies based on established marketing frameworks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0472.zh: 分析第一季度 2017 的访问者参与模式和转化时间之间的关系，确定首次交易时间指标是否与电子商务转化窗口的行业基准相关，并确定转化访问者的设备偏好是否与该期间报告的移动商务采用趋势一致。此外，调查转化时间较长的访问者是否表现出不同的行为信号，这些信号可以为基于既定营销框架的客户细分策略提供信息。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0466.source: Analyze the relationship between venue characteristics and championship game performance by identifying whether games played in the largest capacity venues correlate with higher scoring outputs or larger victory margins. Cross-reference your findings with historical context about how NCAA tournament venue selection criteria have evolved since 2010, and determine if any patterns exist between arena size, geographic location, and the performance of teams seeded in the top 4. Present your analysis with supporting data tables and explain any anomalies you discover.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0466.zh: 通过确定在容量最大的场馆中进行的比赛是否与更高的得分输出或更大的胜率相关，分析场馆特征与锦标赛表现之间的关系。将您的发现与有关自 2010 年以来 NCAA 锦标赛场地选择标准如何演变的历史背景进行交叉参考，并确定竞技场大小、地理位置和顶级 4 种子球队的表现之间是否存在任何模式。使用支持数据表展示您的分析，并解释您发现的任何异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0485.source: Analyze the performance trends of our product categories by examining completed orders delivered before the regulatory changes took effect, calculating both revenue and order volume with their month-over-month growth rates. Identify which categories showed consistent growth patterns that align with industry benchmarks for e-commerce during that period, and flag any anomalies that might indicate data quality issues or seasonal effects worth investigating further.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0485.zh: 通过检查监管变更生效之前交付的已完成订单，计算收入和订单量及其环比增长率，分析我们产品类别的业绩趋势。确定哪些类别显示出与该时期电子商务行业基准一致的一致增长模式，并标记可能表明数据质量问题或值得进一步调查的季节性影响的任何异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0484.source: Determine which product category has the highest total purchase quantity, then for products in that category, calculate the average time in minutes users spend viewing product pages before their next interaction. Additionally, research current industry benchmarks for e-commerce page dwell time in this product category and analyze whether our user engagement metrics indicate stronger or weaker purchase intent compared to market standards.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0484.zh: 确定哪个产品类别的总购买量最高，然后对于该类别中的产品，计算用户在下次交互之前查看产品页面的平均时间（以分钟为单位）。此外，研究该产品类别中电子商务页面停留时间的当前行业基准，并分析我们的用户参与度指标与市场标准相比是否表明购买意愿更强或更弱。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0471.source: Analyze the quarterly revenue trends across all traffic sources for 2017 to identify which source demonstrates the most significant growth trajectory, then calculate the coefficient of variation for that source's monthly revenues and determine whether this volatility level falls within industry benchmarks for e-commerce platforms. Based on your findings and current digital marketing research, recommend whether resources should be reallocated from the lowest-performing traffic source to the highest-performing one, considering both revenue potential and acquisition cost efficiency.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0471.zh: 分析 2017 年所有流量来源的季度收入趋势，以确定哪个来源表现出最显着的增长轨迹，然后计算该来源每月收入的变异系数，并确定此波动水平是否在电子商务平台的行业基准范围内。根据您的发现和当前的数字营销研究，考虑收入潜力和获取成本效率，建议是否应将资源从绩效最低的流量来源重新分配到绩效最高的流量来源。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0488.source: For the period between January 1, 2019, and April 30, 2022, analyze the distribution of users at age extremes (both youngest and oldest) across each gender category on the e-commerce platform, then investigate whether the demographic patterns you discover align with or contradict current academic research on generational and gender-based differences in online shopping adoption and behavior. Based on your findings, identify which age-gender segments appear underrepresented compared to industry benchmarks and recommend targeted engagement strategies supported by evidence from recent market studies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0488.zh: 在 2019年1月1日 和 2022年4月30日 期间，分析电子商务平台上每个性别类别中极端年龄（最年轻和最年长）用户的分布，然后调查您发现的人口统计模式是否与当前关于在线购物采用和行为的代际和性别差异的学术研究相符或矛盾。根据您的发现，确定与行业基准相比哪些年龄-性别细分群体的代表性不足，并推荐由最近市场研究证据支持的有针对性的参与策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0494.source: Analyze our complete order data to identify which product dominated sales each month, then research the parent company behind each winning brand to determine if any conglomerate has consistently captured our top seller position. Cross-reference these findings with our internal product documentation to explain what specific product features or marketing claims may have contributed to each monthly winner's success, and flag any cases where our documented product benefits contradict publicly available consumer reviews or regulatory information about these brands.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0494.zh: 分析我们完整的订单数据，以确定哪种产品主导每月的销售，然后研究每个获胜品牌背后的母公司，以确定是否有任何企业集团始终占据我们最畅销的位置。将这些发现与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉引用，以解释哪些特定的产品功能或营销主张可能有助于每个月获奖者的成功，并标记我们记录的产品优势与公开的消费者评论或有关这些品牌的监管信息相矛盾的任何情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0489.source: Analyze the monthly profit performance of our product catalog through December 2023, identifying which product category dominated each month and investigating whether any external market factors or seasonal trends in the retail industry correlate with the observed profit fluctuations. Compare our top-performing products against industry benchmarks for similar product types, and determine if there are any anomalies in our pricing strategy based on standard markup practices for each product category.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0489.zh: 分析截至 2023年12月 的产品目录的每月利润表现，确定每月主导的产品类别，并调查零售行业的任何外部市场因素或季节性趋势是否与观察到的利润波动相关。将我们表现最好的产品与类似产品类型的行业基准进行比较，并根据每个产品类别的标准加价实践确定我们的定价策略是否存在任何异常。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0496.source: Identify products that consistently appeared as the lowest profit performers across all available months in 2020, then research industry benchmark profit margins for those specific product categories to determine if our margins fall below, meet, or exceed typical market standards. Cross-reference these findings with our internal documentation on pricing strategy to explain any significant deviations from industry norms and recommend whether pricing adjustments are warranted.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0496.zh: 确定 2020 年所有可用月份中利润表现最低的产品，然后研究这些特定产品类别的行业基准利润率，以确定我们的利润率是否低于、达到或超过典型市场标准。将这些调查结果与我们有关定价策略的内部文档进行交叉引用，以解释与行业规范的任何重大偏差，并就是否有必要进行定价调整提出建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0480.source: Analyze the sequential relationship between the Clay St & Drumm St and Sacramento St & Davis St stops to identify trips where they appear in a specific order, then determine the temporal boundaries of service for these trips. Using these findings, search for recent academic research on urban transit optimization and route scheduling efficiency, and synthesize how current methodological trends in the field could be applied to improve the observed service patterns and temporal coverage gaps.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0480.zh: 分析 Clay St & Drumm St 和 Sacramento St & Davis St 站点之间的顺序关系，以确定它们以特定顺序出现的行程，然后确定这些行程的服务时间边界。利用这些发现，搜索有关城市交通优化和路线调度效率的最新学术研究，并综合如何应用该领域当前的方法趋势来改善观察到的服务模式和时间覆盖差距。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0492.source: Analyze the performance of sleepwear and loungewear products throughout 2023, comparing monthly profitability metrics against industry benchmarks for this retail segment. Identify which months showed the strongest profit-to-cost efficiency, investigate what external factors (seasonal trends, economic conditions, or market events) might explain the performance patterns you observe, and recommend whether the company should expand or contract this product category based on your findings.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0492.zh: 分析整个 2023 的睡衣和家居服产品的表现，将每月盈利指标与该零售领域的行业基准进行比较。确定哪些月份显示出最强的利润成本效率，调查哪些外部因素（季节性趋势、经济状况或市场事件）可以解释您观察到的绩效模式，并根据您的发现建议公司是否应该扩大或收缩该产品类别。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0479.source: Analyze the San Francisco bikeshare trip data to identify which month in 2017 showed the most significant divergence in cumulative usage patterns between casual users and regular subscribers, calculating the precise magnitude of this gap. Then investigate what urban transportation research and demographic studies reveal about the underlying factors driving such seasonal disparities in shared mobility adoption across different user segments, particularly in the context of San Francisco's unique population dynamics and tourism patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0479.zh: 分析旧金山共享单车出行数据，确定 2017 年的哪一个月显示休闲用户和常规用户之间的累积使用模式差异最大，并计算这种差距的精确大小。然后调查城市交通研究和人口统计研究揭示了推动不同用户群体共享出行采用季节性差异的潜在因素，特别是在旧金山独特的人口动态和旅游模式的背景下。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0498.source: Analyze the retention behavior of users who made their first purchase in January 2020 by calculating month-over-month retention rates throughout 2020, then compare these patterns against industry benchmarks for e-commerce marketplaces and explain any deviations using established research on customer lifetime value and marketplace network effects. Identify which months showed anomalous retention and propose hypotheses for these patterns based on both the quantitative data and academic literature on buyer-seller dynamics.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0498.zh: 通过计算整个 2020 的月度留存率，分析 2020年1月首次购买 的用户的留存行为，然后将这些模式与电子商务市场的行业基准进行比较，并使用对客户生命周期价值和市场网络效应的既定研究来解释任何偏差。确定哪些月份表现出异常保留，并根据定量数据和关于买卖双方动态的学术文献提出这些模式的假设。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0497.source: Identify the three browsers with the shortest average session durations (calculated as the difference between earliest and latest timestamps per user session), but only consider browsers with more than 10 total sessions. For each of these browsers, research their known performance issues or technical limitations that might explain the shorter session times, and cross-reference this with our internal documentation to determine if any engineering tickets or optimization efforts have been logged related to session handling for these specific browsers.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0497.zh: 确定平均会话持续时间最短的三个浏览器（计算为每个用户会话最早和最新时间戳之间的差值），但仅考虑总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器。对于每个浏览器，研究其已知的性能问题或技术限制，这些问题或技术限制可能会解释较短的会话时间，并将其与我们的内部文档交叉引用，以确定是否已记录与这些特定浏览器的会话处理相关的任何工程票据或优化工作。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0438.source: Analyze the correlation between our top-performing product category by first-time customer conversion and industry benchmark data for that category's market share trends over the past 3 years. Then identify which specific products within that category have descriptions most semantically similar to our highest-rated customer reviews, and calculate whether these products outperform the category average in terms of revenue per transaction.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0438.zh: 分析我们的首次客户转化表现最好的产品类别与过去 3 年来该类别市场份额趋势的行业基准数据之间的相关性。然后确定该类别中哪些特定产品的描述在语义上与我们评分最高的客户评论最相似，并计算这些产品在每笔交易收入方面是否优于类别平均水平。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0505.source: Identify the countries with the highest proportions of youth populations and analyze how their demographic structures correlate with their performance on human development indices, labor market outcomes, and climate vulnerability scores. Based on these patterns, evaluate whether the "demographic dividend" theory holds true when controlling for governance quality and educational investment levels, and project which specific policy interventions would be most effective for countries currently in early demographic transition stages.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0505.zh: 确定青年人口比例最高的国家，并分析其人口结构与其人类发展指数、劳动力市场结果和气候脆弱性评分的表现之间的关系。基于这些模式，评估“人口红利”理论在控制治理质量和教育投资水平时是否成立，并预测哪些具体政策干预措施对于目前处于人口转型早期阶段的国家最为有效。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0441.source: Analyze customer retention patterns across our e-commerce platform by building a cohort analysis that segments users by their first purchase month, then calculate the percentage who returned in each of the subsequent three months. Compare these retention curves against industry benchmarks for similar business models, and cross-reference the findings with our internal documentation on marketing campaigns and promotional events that may have influenced customer behavior during each cohort period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0441.zh: 通过构建队列分析来分析整个电子商务平台上的客户保留模式，该分析按用户的第一个购买月份对用户进行细分，然后计算随后三个月中每个月的回访百分比。将这些保留曲线与类似业务模式的行业基准进行比较，并将研究结果与我们有关可能影响每个群组期间客户行为的营销活动和促销活动的内部文档进行交叉引用。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0502.source: Identify which reference sequence in the cannabis genome dataset exhibits the most anomalous variant density relative to its length, then investigate whether this pattern aligns with known genomic hotspot regions documented in recent plant genomics literature. Based on your findings, evaluate how the statistical performance metrics of variant detection for this sequence compare to benchmark standards established in peer-reviewed studies on Cannabis sativa structural variation analysis.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0502.zh: 确定大麻基因组数据集中的哪个参考序列相对于其长度表现出最异常的变异密度，然后研究这种模式是否与最近植物基因组学文献中记录的已知基因组热点区域相符。根据您的发现，评估该序列变异检测的统计性能指标与大麻结构变异分析同行评审研究中建立的基准标准的比较情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0499.source: Analyze the monthly performance trends for our newest customer cohort purchasing recently added inventory throughout their first year, breaking down key metrics by geographic region, product category, and item classification. Identify which country showed the strongest profit margins relative to industry benchmarks for e-commerce in that region, and explain any seasonal patterns you observe by correlating them with major shopping events or economic factors. Recommend which product department we should prioritize for expansion based on your findings.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0499.zh: 分析我们最新客户群在第一年购买最近添加的库存的每月绩效趋势，按地理区域、产品类别和商品分类细分关键指标。确定哪个国家/地区相对于该地区的电子商务行业基准显示出最强的利润率，并通过将其与主要购物活动或经济因素相关联来解释您观察到的任何季节性模式。根据您的发现建议我们应该优先扩展哪个产品部门。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0500.source: Identify the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding canceled and returned orders, then analyze whether the seasonal patterns in these high-performers correlate with industry-wide retail trends and macroeconomic events during that period. For the product categories and brands that appear most frequently among these top performers, retrieve and compare their official sustainability commitments or ESG ratings to determine if there's a relationship between corporate responsibility positioning and profitability ranking.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0500.zh: 确定从 2019年1月 到 2022年8月 每月利润最高的三种产品（不包括取消和退回的订单），然后分析这些高绩效产品的季节性模式是否与该期间全行业的零售趋势和宏观经济事件相关。对于这些表现最佳的公司中最常出现的产品类别和品牌，检索并比较其官方可持续发展承诺或 ESG 评级，以确定企业责任定位和盈利能力排名之间是否存在关系。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0507.source: Identify the specific date in March-April 2020 that marked the peak daily COVID-19 case growth rate in the United States, then investigate what major policy decisions or public health interventions were announced within 72 hours of that date. Analyze whether peer-reviewed epidemiological research supports a causal relationship between the timing of such interventions and subsequent changes in transmission dynamics.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0507.zh: 确定 3 月至 2020年4月 中标志着美国每日 COVID-19 病例增长率峰值的具体日期，然后调查在该日期的 72 小时内宣布了哪些重大政策决定或公共卫生干预措施。分析同行评审的流行病学研究是否支持此类干预措施的时机与传播动态的后续变化之间的因果关系。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0490.source: Analyze the e-commerce performance trends from mid-2019 through year-end by identifying which product categories showed resilient growth despite the broader retail industry challenges reported during that period, and determine whether our profit margins by category aligned with or deviated from industry benchmarks for similar online retailers. Calculate the month-over-month momentum for each category starting from the second month of available data, and flag any categories where our performance metrics contradicted the market trends you discover through external research.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0490.zh: 通过确定哪些产品类别在该期间报告了更广泛的零售行业挑战，但仍表现出弹性增长，分析从 2019 年期到年底的电子商务业绩趋势，并确定我们按类别划分的利润率是否与类似在线零售商的行业基准一致或偏离。从可用数据的第二个月开始计算每个类别的月度势头，并标记我们的绩效指标与您通过外部研究发现的市场趋势相矛盾的任何类别。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0510.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 case acceleration patterns and state policy responses during the first wave of the pandemic, identifying which state that consistently ranked fourth in daily case increases implemented mitigation measures that deviated most significantly from CDC guidelines at the time. For that state, determine which counties experienced case surges that correlated with specific demographic or economic factors documented in public health research, and assess whether the timing of local interventions aligned with epidemiological best practices recommended during that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0510.zh: 分析第一波大流行期间 COVID-19 病例加速模式与州政策反应之间的关系，确定每日病例增加量始终排名第四的州实施的缓解措施与当时 CDC 指南的偏差最大。对于该州，确定哪些县经历了与公共卫生研究中记录的特定人口或经济因素相关的病例激增，并评估当地干预措施的时机是否符合该时期建议的流行病学最佳实践。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0511.source: Analyze how the search frequency patterns for anosmia-related symptoms in the New York City metropolitan area correlate with the timeline of major public health announcements and policy changes during the transition from 2019 to 2020, identifying which specific borough experienced the most statistically significant deviation from its historical baseline and explaining the likely epidemiological factors that contributed to this regional variation.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0511.zh: 分析纽约市大都市区嗅觉丧失相关症状的搜索频率模式如何与 2019 年到 2020 年过渡期间主要公共卫生公告和政策变化的时间线相关联，确定哪个特定行政区与其历史基线的偏差在统计上最显着，并解释导致这种区域差异的可能流行病学因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0493.source: Analyze the age distribution patterns of users who registered on our e-commerce platform between Q1 2019 and Q2 2022, identifying quarterly trends in the gap between oldest and youngest user cohorts, then evaluate whether our demographic acquisition patterns align with industry best practices for customer lifecycle management and recent academic research on generational targeting strategies in e-commerce.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0493.zh: 分析第一季度 2019 和第二季度 2022 之间在我们的电子商务平台上注册的用户的年龄分布模式，确定最年长和最年轻用户群体之间差距的季度趋势，然后评估我们的人口统计获取模式是否符合客户生命周期管理的行业最佳实践以及电子商务中分代定位策略的最新学术研究。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0512.source: Analyze how the COVID-19 pandemic affected mental health in the United States by comparing anxiety and depression symptom levels between the pre-pandemic year and the first pandemic year, calculating the percentage change and determining whether the observed differences are statistically significant. Then, investigate what major public health policies or events during 2020 most strongly correlate with any spikes in symptom levels, and compare the U.S. mental health trajectory to at least two other countries with different pandemic response strategies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0512.zh: 通过比较大流行前一年和大流行第一年之间的焦虑和抑郁症状水平，计算百分比变化并确定观察到的差异是否具有统计显着性，分析 COVID-19 大流行如何影响美国的心理健康。然后，调查 2020 年期间哪些主要公共卫生政策或事件与症状水平的峰值最密切相关，并将美国的心理健康轨迹与至少两个采用不同流行病应对策略的其他国家进行比较。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0491.source: Analyze the demographic patterns of users who signed up during the period between two major global events that significantly impacted digital platform adoption rates, focusing on age extremes by gender. For each gender group, identify users at the minimum and maximum age boundaries, then cross-reference these findings with industry benchmark data on generational technology adoption trends to determine whether our platform's age distribution aligns with or deviates from typical patterns documented in market research. Finally, search our internal documentation to identify any marketing campaigns or product features that may have influenced the acquisition of these extreme age cohorts during this timeframe.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0491.zh: 分析在两次重大全球事件之间注册的用户的人口统计模式，这些事件对数字平台采用率产生了重大影响，重点关注按性别划分的极端年龄。对于每个性别群体，确定用户的最小和最大年龄界限，然后将这些发现与各代技术采用趋势的行业基准数据进行交叉引用，以确定我们平台的年龄分布是否符合或偏离市场研究中记录的典型模式。最后，搜索我们的内部文档，以确定在此时间范围内可能影响这些极端年龄群体的获取的任何营销活动或产品功能。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0504.source: Identify the countries with the youngest population demographics in 2020 and analyze whether there are correlations between these youth-heavy populations and specific governance challenges, economic development indicators, or international aid patterns. For the top performers, investigate what policies or historical factors contributed to these demographic structures, and assess how international organizations like the UN or World Bank are adapting their strategies to address the unique needs of nations with predominantly young populations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0504.zh: 确定 2020 年人口结构最年轻的国家，并分析这些年轻人口较多的国家与具体治理挑战、经济发展指标或国际援助模式之间是否存在相关性。对于表现最好的国家，调查哪些政策或历史因素促成了这些人口结构，并评估联合国或世界银行等国际组织如何调整其战略，以满足以年轻人为主的国家的独特需求。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0516.source: Analyze the relationship between net migration rates and economic development indicators for the three largest recipient countries (by land area over 500 sq km) in 2017, then investigate how recent policy changes and geopolitical events have altered these migration corridors, and propose an agent-based simulation framework that could model future migration flows based on the economic and political factors you've identified.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0516.zh: 分析 2017 年三个最大接收国（按土地面积超过 500 个平方公里）的净移民率与经济发展指标之间的关系，然后调查最近的政策变化和地缘政治事件如何改变这些移民走廊，并提出一个基于代理的模拟框架，该框架可以根据您确定的经济和政治因素对未来移民流进行建模。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0506.source: Analyze the relationship between healthcare system capacity indicators and COVID-19 recovery rates among countries with significant outbreak levels as of early May 2020, identifying which nations achieved the highest recovery rates and explaining what policy interventions, healthcare infrastructure factors, or testing methodology differences documented in contemporary reports might account for the variance in outcomes between the top performers and the global average at that time.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0506.zh: 分析截至 2020年5月初 疫情严重的国家/地区的医疗保健系统容量指标与 COVID-19 恢复率之间的关系，确定哪些国家实现了最高的恢复率，并解释当代报告中记录的哪些政策干预措施、医疗保健基础设施因素或测试方法差异可能会导致表现最佳国家与当时全球平均水平之间的结果差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0508.source: Analyze which economic and demographic factors best predicted a country's COVID-19 infection rate during the first wave of the pandemic, and determine whether these patterns align with or contradict the findings from peer-reviewed epidemiological studies on pandemic vulnerability. Identify any regional anomalies where actual infection rates significantly deviated from what would be expected based on these predictive factors, and propose evidence-based explanations for these discrepancies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0508.zh: 分析哪些经济和人口因素最能预测一个国家在第一波大流行期间的 COVID-19 感染率，并确定这些模式是否与同行评审的大流行脆弱性流行病学研究结果一致或矛盾。确定实际感染率与基于这些预测因素的预期存在显着偏差的任何区域异常，并对这些差异提出基于证据的解释。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0509.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 infection rates per capita across the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran as of April 20, 2020, and determine whether the variation in these rates correlates with each country's healthcare system ranking, population density in major urban centers, and the timing of their initial lockdown measures relative to their first confirmed case. Based on your findings, evaluate which factor appears to have been most predictive of infection spread during this early pandemic period according to epidemiological research.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0509.zh: 分析截至 2020年4月20日 的美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗的人均 COVID-19 感染率之间的关系，并确定这些比率的变化是否与每个国家的医疗保健系统排名、主要城市中心的人口密度以及相对于首例确诊病例的初始封锁措施的时间相关。根据您的发现，根据流行病学研究评估哪种因素最能预测大流行早期的感染传播。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0476.source: Analyze the navigation patterns of visitors from 'Data Share' campaigns in January 2017 who landed on '/home' pages, identifying their most frequent subsequent destination and maximum dwell time before transition. Compare these behavioral metrics against industry benchmarks for campaign-driven landing page performance, and use semantic search to find research explaining why this specific navigation pattern might indicate user intent signals. Based on your findings, assess whether the observed dwell times and exit paths suggest the campaign landing page strategy was optimally designed according to current UX conversion principles.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0476.zh: 分析 2017年1月 的'Data Share'（数据共享）活动中登陆“/home”页面的访问者的导航模式，确定他们最常访问的后续目的地以及转换前的最长停留时间。将这些行为指标与活动驱动的着陆页性能的行业基准进行比较，并使用语义搜索来查找研究，解释为什么这种特定的导航模式可能表明用户意图信号。根据您的发现，评估观察到的停留时间和退出路径是否表明营销活动着陆页策略是根据当前用户体验转换原则进行优化设计的。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0513.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 vaccine site accessibility and socioeconomic factors across California counties by calculating per-capita vaccine site availability, then compare these distribution patterns against historical precedents of public health resource allocation during previous disease outbreaks. Determine whether counties with lower median household incomes or higher percentages of uninsured residents show statistically significant differences in vaccine site density, and identify which allocation model (population-proportional, need-based, or geographic) best explains the observed distribution.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0513.zh: 通过计算人均疫苗站点可用性，分析加利福尼亚州各县的 COVID-19 疫苗站点可访问性与社会经济因素之间的关系，然后将这些分布模式与先前疾病爆发期间公共卫生资源分配的历史先例进行比较。确定家庭收入中位数较低或未参保居民比例较高的县在疫苗接种点密度方面是否表现出统计上的显着差异，并确定哪种分配模型（人口比例、基于需求或地理）最能解释观察到的分布。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0517.source: Identify census tracts in Kings County, New York that experienced simultaneous demographic and economic growth between 2011 and 2018, meeting elite thresholds for both population percentage increase and absolute median income gains while maintaining a minimum population baseline. For the qualifying tracts, research and explain the specific urban development initiatives, rezoning policies, or infrastructure projects that likely contributed to these growth patterns, and compare their transformation metrics against similar gentrification case studies documented in urban planning literature to assess whether these changes align with typical neighborhood revitalization patterns or represent outliers.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0517.zh: 确定纽约州国王县的人口普查区域，这些区域在 2011 年和 2018 年之间经历了人口和经济同步增长，满足人口百分比增长和绝对中位收入增长的精英阈值，同时保持最低人口基线。对于符合条件的区域，研究并解释可能促成这些增长模式的具体城市发展举措、重新分区政策或基础设施项目，并将其转型指标与城市规划文献中记录的类似绅士化案例研究进行比较，以评估这些变化是否符合典型的社区复兴模式或代表异常值。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0523.source: Analyze how shooting accuracy and court positioning patterns vary across different shot types when comparing regular season games versus playoff games, and determine whether the observed patterns align with documented basketball strategy theories about high-pressure game situations. Additionally, investigate which shot types show the most significant spatial clustering on the court and explain whether these clusters correspond to historically recognized "hot zones" in professional basketball analytics literature.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0523.zh: 在比较常规赛与季后赛时，分析不同投篮类型的投篮准确性和球场定位模式如何变化，并确定观察到的模式是否与记录在案的有关高压比赛情况的篮球策略理论相符。此外，调查哪些投篮类型在球场上表现出最显着的空间聚类，并解释这些聚类是否对应于专业篮球分析文献中历史上公认的“热点区域”。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0522.source: Analyze the NCAA basketball dataset to identify which of the top 5 highest-capacity venues has hosted championship games since 2016, then determine whether any teams that played in those specific venues also appear in both the highest-scoring games and top three-point shooting records since 2011. For any overlapping teams found, research their current head coaches and compare how their historical tournament performance at these major venues correlates with their programs' overall win percentages in neutral-site games.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0522.zh: 分析 NCAA 篮球数据集，确定自 2016 年以来哪些顶级 5 个容量最高的场馆举办过冠军赛，然后确定在这些特定场馆进行比赛的球队是否也出现在自 2011 年以来最高得分比赛和最高三分球命中率记录中。对于发现的任何重叠球队，研究他们现任的主教练，并比较他们在这些主要场地的历史比赛表现与他们的项目在中立场地比赛中的总体获胜百分比之间的关系。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0524.source: Identify which major metropolitan areas have historically produced the most dominant second-quarter scorers in NCAA tournament play, then investigate whether these regional talent concentrations correlate with any documented socioeconomic factors, youth basketball infrastructure investments, or notable coaching academies in those areas. For the top performing markets you discover, compile their complete tournament game histories and determine if teams from these regions demonstrate statistically significant advantages in close games or comeback scenarios compared to the national average.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0524.zh: 确定历史上哪些主要大都市区在 NCAA 锦标赛中产生了最具统治力的第二节得分手，然后调查这些区域人才集中是否与这些地区记录的社会经济因素、青少年篮球基础设施投资或著名教练学院相关。对于您发现的表现最好的市场，编译其完整的锦标赛比赛历史，并确定这些地区的球队与全国平均水平相比，在势均力敌的比赛或翻盘场景中是否表现出统计上显着的优势。
