7-30/FDABench/FDA0528.source: Analyze our customer transaction database to identify which customers exhibit spending patterns consistent with what financial regulators define as "unusual transaction velocity" - first calculate their 30-day rolling average balances by month, then cross-reference the top 10% of balance volatility against industry benchmarks for suspicious activity thresholds. Additionally, find any correlations between these flagged accounts and customers whose transaction descriptions semantically match known fraud indicator patterns in our case notes system.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0528.zh: 分析我们的客户交易数据库，以确定哪些客户表现出符合金融监管机构定义的“异常交易速度”的支出模式 - 首先按月计算其 30 日滚动平均余额，然后将余额波动率最高的 10% 与可疑活动阈值的行业基准进行交叉引用。此外，找到这些标记的帐户和其交易描述在语义上与我们的案例注释系统中已知的欺诈指标模式匹配的客户之间的任何相关性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0529.source: For each customer, calculate their daily balance trajectory (treating negative balances as zero) across all days between their first and last transactions, then identify their peak daily balance per month. Compare these monthly peak balance patterns against industry benchmarks for customer financial health indicators, and cross-reference with our internal risk assessment documentation to categorize customers into risk tiers based on how their peak balance volatility aligns with our defined thresholds.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0529.zh: 对于每个客户，计算其第一笔交易和最后一笔交易之间所有日期的每日余额轨迹（将负余额视为零），然后确定每月的每日余额峰值。将这些每月峰值余额模式与客户财务健康指标的行业基准进行比较，并与我们的内部风险评估文档进行交叉引用，根据客户的峰值余额波动性与我们定义的阈值的一致性将客户分类为风险等级。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0525.source: Analyze which playing style characteristics (tempo, offensive/defensive efficiency patterns) have been most predictive of tournament upset victories where lower-seeded teams defeated higher-seeded opponents since 2014, and determine whether the 2018 tournament's upset rate was statistically anomalous compared to historical trends. Additionally, identify if any recent rule changes or external factors reported in sports analytics research might explain shifts in optimal tournament performance profiles.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0525.zh: 分析哪些比赛风格特征（节奏、进攻/防守效率模式）最能预测自 2014 年以来低种子球队击败高种子对手的锦标赛爆冷胜利，并确定 2018 年锦标赛的爆冷率与历史趋势相比是否在统计上异常。此外，确定最近的规则变化或体育分析研究中报告的外部因素是否可以解释最佳锦标赛表现概况的变化。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0514.source: Identify the three counties with populations exceeding 50,000 that experienced the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates in late August 2020, then investigate what specific local factors—such as healthcare infrastructure, nursing home concentration, demographic vulnerabilities, or early pandemic policy decisions—may have contributed to their disproportionately high mortality rates compared to national averages. For each county, compile their key demographic indicators alongside their COVID-19 outcome metrics, and cross-reference with contemporary news reports or public health analyses to determine whether these counties shared any common characteristics that epidemiologists identified as risk factors during that phase of the pandemic.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0514.zh: 确定人口超过 50,000 的三个县，这些县在 2020年8月底 的 COVID-19 病死率最高，然后调查哪些特定的当地因素（例如医疗基础设施、疗养院集中度、人口脆弱性或早期大流行政策决策）可能导致其死亡率与全国平均水平不成比例。对于每个县，编制其关键人口统计指标以及 COVID-19 结果指标，并与当代新闻报道或公共卫生分析进行交叉参考，以确定这些县是否具有流行病学家在大流行该阶段确定为风险因素的任何共同特征。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0519.source: Using U.S. Census Tract data from BigQuery public datasets, proportionally allocate population and median household income to zip codes based on geographic boundary overlaps, then filter to only include zip codes within a 5-mile radius of the headquarters location of the company that operates the largest hydroelectric dam on the Columbia River in Washington State. After calculating the population-weighted average income for this area, compare it to the median income threshold that would qualify a household for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) in Washington State and determine what percentage of the estimated population in these zip codes likely falls below that threshold.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0519.zh: 使用 BigQuery 公共数据集中的美国人口普查数据，根据地理边界重叠将人口和家庭收入中位数按比例分配给邮政编码，然后进行筛选，仅包含以运营华盛顿州哥伦比亚河上最大水力发电大坝的公司总部位置 5 英里半径范围内的邮政编码。计算该地区的人口加权平均收入后，将其与华盛顿州低收入家庭能源援助计划 (LIHEAP) 家庭资格的中位收入阈值进行比较，并确定这些邮政编码的估计人口中可能低于该阈值的百分比。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0533.source: Analyze how regional Bitcoin acquisition costs correlate with major regulatory events and market sentiment shifts, excluding each region's initial entry year. Rank regions annually by their average purchase price while calculating year-over-year cost changes, then determine whether regions with stricter cryptocurrency regulations consistently paid premiums or discounts compared to the global weighted average during bull versus bear market cycles.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0533.zh: 分析区域性比特币收购成本如何与重大监管事件和市场情绪变化相关，不包括每个区域的初始进入年份。每年按平均购买价格对地区进行排名，同时计算逐年成本变化，然后确定在牛市与熊市周期期间，与全球加权平均值相比，加密货币监管更严格的地区是否始终支付溢价或折扣。

8-17/SEC10K/SEC10K-034.source: Which software or technology-platform companies with a 2020 10-K longer than 50,000 words acquired, or agreed to acquire, a whole company in a different industry sector that can be identified, despite abbreviations or legal-name variants, as a different registrant with a 2019 10-K longer than 50,000 words? Exclude asset purchases, minority-stake investments, spin-offs, and SPAC or blank-check combinations. Report each acquirer, matched target, the target's 2019 industry sector, and its risk-factor count, with each acquirer-target pair appearing once.
8-17/SEC10K/SEC10K-034.zh: 哪些软件或技术平台公司在超过50,000字的2020年10-K申报文件中，披露已收购或同意收购另一行业的整家公司，且该目标公司可识别为拥有超过50,000字的2019年10-K申报文件的另一申报主体，即使其名称存在缩写或法定名称变体？排除资产购买、少数股权投资、分拆以及SPAC或空白支票公司合并。返回收购方、匹配的目标公司、目标公司在2019年的所属行业及其风险因素数量；每个收购方与目标公司的组合只出现一次。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0676.source: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)? If we analyze the demographic and health expenditure growth momentum by calculating the ratio of qualifying countries to the total number of World Bank member countries (189), what does this percentage reveal about global development patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0676.zh: 根据世界银行全球人口数据集和世界银行健康营养人口数据集，2018年有多少个国家在总人口和人均当前购买力平价（PPP）的医疗支出方面较前一年增长了超过1%？如果我们通过计算符合条件国家的数量与世界银行成员国总数（189个）的比例来分析人口和医疗支出的增长趋势，这个百分比揭示了全球发展模式的哪些特征？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0677.source: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)? If we model this as a development capacity index by calculating the cube root of the number of qualifying countries and then determining what percentage this represents of the theoretical maximum development score of 10, what does this sophisticated metric indicate about global health-demographic coordination?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0677.zh: 基于世界银行全球人口数据集和世界银行健康营养人口数据集，2018年有多少个国家在总人口和人均当前购买力平价（PPP）的医疗支出方面较前一年增长了超过1%？如果我们将其建模为发展能力指数，通过计算符合条件国家数量的立方根，然后确定其占理论最大发展得分10的比例，这个复杂的指标表明全球健康-人口协调状况如何？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0827.source: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)? Given the Global Health Expenditure Database covers 194 countries and territories, what percentage of the total covered countries met both demographic and health expenditure growth criteria?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0827.zh: 基于世界银行全球人口数据集和世界银行健康营养人口数据集，2018年有多少个国家在总人口和人均当前购买力平价（PPP）的现期卫生支出方面较前一年增长超过1%？鉴于全球卫生支出数据库覆盖了194个国家和地区，达到上述人口和卫生支出增长标准的比例占多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0828.source: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)? In the context of evidence-based decision-making for global health resource allocation, if international development organizations wanted to target support to countries showing such dual growth patterns, and they could only focus on a subset representing exactly one-third of these qualifying nations, how many countries would receive priority attention?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0828.zh: 基于世界银行全球人口数据集和世界银行健康营养人口数据集，2018年有多少个国家在总人口和人均当前购买力平价（PPP）的现期卫生支出方面较前一年增长超过1%？在证据为基础的全球卫生资源分配决策中，如果国际发展组织希望将支持重点放在这些表现出双重增长模式的国家，并且他们只能关注其中三分之一的这些符合条件的国家，那么有多少个国家会获得优先关注？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0889.source: How many orders in the south superstore with the fastest delivery are items of furniture? Given that premium delivery categories typically require 15-20% higher inventory turnover rates to maintain profitability, what would be the approximate minimum inventory turnover coefficient needed for this furniture segment? (Calculate as: number of orders × 0.18)
7-30/FDABench/FDA0889.zh: 南方超级市场中最快交付的订单中有多少是家具？考虑到高端配送类别通常需要比普通库存周转率高15-20%以维持盈利能力，这个家具品类所需的最低库存周转系数大约是多少？（计算方法：订单数量×0.18）

7-30/FDABench/FDA0928.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? Based on the analysis results, which statement best describes the recovery rate pattern among the top three countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0928.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有COVID-19确诊病例超过5万的国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高（以总康复病例数与总确诊病例数的比例表示），并分别用百分比形式表达他们的康复率？根据分析结果，请描述这三个国家康复率模式的最佳陈述。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0938.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates? Based on the migration rate data, what is the difference between the highest and lowest migration rates among these three countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0938.zh: 在面积大于500平方公里的国家中，哪三个国家2017年的净迁移量最高？它们各自的迁移率是多少？根据这些国家的迁移率数据，在这三个国家之间最高的和最低的迁移率差值是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0939.source: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? Based on the results, how many census tracts in the 36047 area met all the specified criteria for population growth, income increase, and minimum population threshold?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0939.zh: 在36047地区中，找出那些从2011年到2018年间人口增长率最高且排名前20的普查区，并且在同一时期内中位收入绝对增长也排在前20名的普查区。同时，这些普查区在每一年的人口都超过1,000人。根据结果，在36047地区中有多少个普查区满足了人口增长、收入增加以及最低人口数量的所有条件？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0943.source: List the top 5 universities with the most seasons where they achieved the maximum wins in their respective NCAA basketball seasons between 1900-2000, showing each team's total number of such peak-performance seasons, while excluding entries with missing team names. Based on this analysis, how many universities achieved exactly the same number of peak-performance seasons as the third-ranked institution?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0943.zh: 列出在1900年至2000年间，拥有最多赛季达到各自NCAA篮球赛季最大胜场数的前5所大学，并显示每支队伍达到这一成就的总次数。排除缺失队名的记录。根据此分析，在第三位排名的机构中，有多少所大学达到了相同数量的巅峰表现赛季？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0948.source: Which county in Utah experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018, calculated by averaging the employment levels during the third month of each quarter in those years? What is the corresponding percentage increase? Based on the analysis results, if the construction employment in this county was approximately 10,000 workers in 2000, what would be the approximate employment level in 2018?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0948.zh: 犹他州哪个县在2000年至2018年间，通过计算每季度第三个月的就业水平平均值来衡量，经历了最大的建筑就业百分比增长？对应的百分比增长率是多少？根据分析结果，如果该县在2000年的建筑就业人数约为10,000人，那么到2018年大约会有多少就业人数？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0977.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? Based on this analysis, what is the most significant observation about the recovery rate patterns?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0977.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有COVID-19确诊病例超过5万的国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高（以总康复病例与总确诊病例的比例表示），并分别用百分比形式表达他们的康复率？基于此分析，请指出康复率模式中最显著的观察。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0980.source: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data? Based on this analysis, which country had approximately 4.2 times higher cases per 100,000 population than Germany?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0980.zh: 请提供截至2020年4月20日，美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗的累计COVID-19确诊病例总数，并根据世界银行数据计算的各国2020年人口总数（通过将所有相关人口条目相加得出），计算每10万人中的病例数。基于此分析，请指出哪个国家的人均病例数大约是德国的4.2倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0987.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates? Based on the results, what is the approximate difference between the highest and lowest net migration rates among these three countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0987.zh: 在面积大于500平方公里的国家中，哪三个国家2017年的净迁移量最高？它们各自的迁移率是多少？根据结果，在这三个国家之间，最高的净迁移率与最低的净迁移率之间的大约差异是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0988.source: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? Based on the analysis results, how many census tracts in Kings County (36047) simultaneously met all three criteria of high population growth, significant income increases, and substantial resident populations?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0988.zh: 在36047区域中，找出那些从2011年到2018年间人口增长率最高且排名前20的普查区，并且在同一时期内中位收入绝对增长最大且排名前20的普查区。同时，在这些年的每个时间点上，这些普查区的人口都超过1,000人。根据分析结果，请计算在国王县（36047）中有多少个普查区同时满足高人口增长率、显著收入增加以及大量居民数量这三个条件？

7-30/FDABench/FDA0992.source: List the top 5 universities with the most seasons where they achieved the maximum wins in their respective NCAA basketball seasons between 1900-2000, showing each team's total number of such peak-performance seasons, while excluding entries with missing team names. Based on the results, what is the combined total of peak-performance seasons achieved by universities that are tied for the lowest count within this top 5 ranking?
7-30/FDABench/FDA0992.zh: 列出1900-2000年间在各自NCAA篮球赛季中获得最多胜场次数的前5所大学，同时显示每支队伍达到这一巅峰表现赛季的总数，并排除掉缺失队名的记录。根据结果，在这前5名排名中，哪些大学并列拥有最少的巅峰表现赛季数？这些大学总共拥有的巅峰表现赛季数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1002.source: Between April 1 and July 31 of 2017, using the hits product revenue data along with the totals transactions to classify sessions as purchase (transactions ≥ 1 and productRevenue not null) or non-purchase (transactions null and productRevenue null), compare the average pageviews per visitor for each group by month. Suppose product managers decide to run an A/B test in which purchase-classified visitors are shown a ‘quick-checkout’ experience that reduces the session average pageview count by 10%, while non-purchase visitors are shown additional upsell pages expected to raise their average pageview count by 25%. If the campaign budget is capped at 50,000 page-views in July 2017 across both groups, which allocation per visitor (purchase vs non-purchase) keeps total projected page-views ≤ 50,000 while maximising total projected revenue under the assumption that only purchase-classified visitors still complete transactions?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1002.zh: 在2017年4月1日至7月31日期间，使用点击产品收入数据和总交易量来将会话分类为购买（交易≥1且productRevenue不为空）或非购买（交易为空且productRevenue为空）。比较每个组每月的平均页面浏览次数。假设产品经理决定在2017年7月对购买分类的访客进行A/B测试，通过减少他们的会话平均页面浏览次数10%，而对非购买访客展示额外的促销页面以提高其平均页面浏览次数25%。如果该活动预算上限为2017年7月50,000个页面浏览量，那么在购买和非购买访客之间如何分配每个访客（购买 vs 非购买）的数量才能使总预计页面浏览量≤50,000，并且在假设只有购买分类的访客完成交易的情况下最大化总预计收入？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1031.source: Provide a list of the top 10 countries for the year 2020, ordered by the highest percentage of their population under 20 years old. For each country, include the total population under 20 years old, the total midyear population, and the percentage of the population that is under 20 years old. A hypothetical development agency is planning an urgent school-building programme that can cover 15 % of the under-20 population of the top-ranked country; subsequently any funding gap must be closed by reallocating the same absolute head-count of spots from the under-20 population of the lowest-ranked country among these ten. What is the net change (positive or negative) in the total potential beneficiaries still in need after this reallocation when expressed as a percentage of the total under-20 population of the second-highest-ranked country in the list?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1031.zh: 提供2020年排名前10位的国家名单，按其人口中20岁以下比例最高排序。对于每个国家，请包括以下信息：20岁以下总人口数、中期人口总数以及占总人口的比例（百分比）。假设一个发展机构计划紧急开展一项学校建设项目，该计划能够覆盖排名第1位国家20岁以下人口的15%；之后任何资金缺口必须通过从排名最低的国家中重新分配相同数量的名额来弥补。计算在这一重新分配后，第二高排名国家中的潜在受益者净增或减少百分比（相对于总20岁以下人口）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1033.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? Assume an analyst wants to benchmark a recovering health-system index (RHSI) that is simply twice the recovery-rate percentage minus 10 points. Which of the following RHSI values was the HIGHEST among the three best-performing countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1033.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有COVID-19确诊病例超过5万的国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高（以总康复病例与总确诊病例的比例表示），并分别用百分比形式表达他们的康复率？假设分析师想要建立一个恢复健康系统指数（RHSI），该指数是康复率百分比的两倍减去10点。在上述三个表现最好的国家中，哪个RHSI值最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1036.source: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data. Given these figures, which country had the greatest rate of spread over the first 20 days of April 2020, assuming each began April with 25% of its final cumulative cases?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1036.zh: 请提供截至2020年4月20日，美国、法国、中国、意大利、西班牙、德国和伊朗的累计COVID-19确诊病例总数，并根据世界银行数据计算的各国2020年人口总数（通过将所有相关人口条目相加得出），计算每10万人中的病例数。基于这些数字，请问在4月前20天内，哪一国的疫情传播速度最快，假设每个国家开始时拥有其最终累计病例的25%？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1043.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates? Imagine you have to advise a small company that plans to open office branches in two of these three countries. To decide which pair gives the best workforce reception, you multiply each country’s net-migration rate by its population density (persons per km²) relative to the average density of all countries >500 km² (assumed=90 persons/km²), then rank the combined reception index. Company capacity limits demand the final sum must be roughly 120. Which pair meets this requirement?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1043.zh: 哪3个面积大于500平方公里的国家在2017年拥有最高的净移民？它们各自的迁移率是多少？假设有一家小型公司计划在其中两个国家开设分公司。为了决定哪一对国家能最好地接纳劳动力，你需要将每个国家的净移民率乘以其人口密度（每平方公里人数）相对于所有面积大于500平方公里国家平均密度（假设为90人/平方公里）的比例，然后对综合接待指数进行排名。公司容量限制了最终总和大约为120。哪一对满足这个要求？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1044.source: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? If these tracts were ranked by their combined performance (sum of their population growth percentile and income growth percentile divided by 2), which percentile rank would the highest-performing tract achieve?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1044.zh:
请找出位于36047区域的普查区，这些普查区在2011年至2018年间的人口增长率百分比排名前20位，并且在同一期间的中位收入绝对增长量排名也前20位。同时，在这两个时间段内，每个年份的居民人数都超过1,000人。

如果将这些普查区按照它们综合表现（人口增长百分比和收入增长百分比之和除以2）进行排名，最高表现的普查区会获得哪个百分位排名？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1048.source: List the top 5 universities with the most seasons where they achieved the maximum wins in their respective NCAA basketball seasons between 1900-2000, showing each team's total number of such peak-performance seasons, while excluding entries with missing team names. Using the gold_result counts, if coaching tenure longevity (external benchmark = 3 additional peak seasons per coach change) were retroactively applied, which combined metric—raw peak seasons plus adjusted longevity bonus—would place Texas Southern University in a hypothetical second-place tier rather than third?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1048.zh: 列出1900-2000年间在各自NCAA篮球赛季中获得最多胜场次数的前5所大学，同时显示每支队伍达到这一巅峰表现赛季的总数，并排除缺失队名的记录。如果将教练任期长度（外部基准=每位教练每更换一次额外增加3个巅峰表现赛季）追溯应用到gold_result计数上，在假设情境中，哪个综合指标——原始巅峰表现赛季加上调整后的任期长度奖励——会将德克萨斯南方大学从第三位提升至第二位？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1077.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? Using the actual recovery percentages as benchmarks, if Singapore and Qatar had recovery rates approximately 8 percentage points higher than France’s adjusted benchmark and exactly 2 percentage points higher than China’s reported rate, which of the following would best approximate the combined recovery percentage for Singapore and Qatar if averaged together? To determine this, subtract China’s rate from the average rate of France and Germany, then add 30% to represent the documented superior recovery-to-death ratios seen in these two Asia-Pacific countries.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1077.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有COVID-19确诊病例超过5万的国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高（以总康复病例与总确诊病例的比例计算），并分别用百分比表示他们的康复率？使用实际的康复百分比作为基准，如果新加坡和卡塔尔的康复率大约比法国调整后的基准高8个百分点，并且正好比中国的报告率高2个百分点，那么以下哪一项最能近似新加坡和卡塔尔的平均康复百分比（以这两个国家的平均值计算）？要确定这一点，请从法国和德国的平均康复率中减去中国所报的比率，然后加上30%，以代表这些亚太地区国家在记录中的康复与死亡比例优于其他。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1222.source: List the top 5 universities with the most seasons where they achieved the maximum wins in their respective NCAA basketball seasons between 1900-2000, showing each team's total number of such peak-performance seasons, while excluding entries with missing team names. At Centennial Stadium Inc., you must set the contract-award threshold for a new 6-year naming-rights partnership so that, in any year in which a partner is among the historic top-flight programs, the guaranteed bonus pool equals exactly four additional branding events. If no discount is applied for past performance, the base fee is $100,000 per event. Using knowledge that the NCAA officially recognizes 100 years of history (1900-1999 inclusive), estimate what the lifetime ratio (in percentage) of maximum-win seasons to total possible seasons for the fifth-ranked program should be under the award rules to justify the premium-level deal.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1222.zh:
列出在1900年至2000年间，拥有最多赛季达到各自NCAA篮球赛季最大胜场数的前5所大学，并显示每支队伍这些巅峰表现赛季的总数。排除缺失队名的记录。

在Centennial Stadium Inc.，你必须为新的6年命名权合作伙伴关系设置合同奖金额度标准：如果任何一年合作伙伴是历史顶级球队之一，则保证奖金池等于四次额外的品牌活动。如果不考虑过去表现的折扣，基础费用为每次活动10万美元。利用NCAA官方认可100年的历史（1900年至1999年），估计第五名队伍在符合奖励规则下的最大胜场数与总可能赛季的比例（以百分比表示）来证明高端交易的价值。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1237.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates?(This part is not allowed to change. No deletions or Rephrase allowed) Suppose you are tasked with creating a humanitarian-rescue scoring index for the year 2017. The index weights a country's observed net-migration by an aid-fraction that equals (net-migration ÷ 100) capped at 80 %. Only data for nations > 500 km² are considered. A higher aid-fraction means more refugees can be rescued per $1 M of aid. If a country exceeds the cap, its rescue capacity is rounded to a ceiling model that adds an extra 5 % efficiency gain for every full 5 units above the cap. Which of the following statements correctly describes the resulting rescue capacity ranking of the three given countries (highest score first)?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1237.zh: 2017年面积大于500平方公里的国家中，哪三个国家的净迁移最高？它们的迁移率是多少？（这部分不允许更改。不得删除或重写）假设你被要求创建一个2017年人道救援评分指数。该指数将各国观察到的净迁移量乘以援助分数，其中援助分数等于(净迁移÷100)，上限为80%。只有面积大于500平方公里的国家的数据会被考虑。援助分数越高意味着每1百万美元的援助可以拯救更多的难民。如果一个国家超过上限，则其救援能力按天花板模型计算，在达到上限后每增加5单位，效率会额外提高5%。以下哪项陈述正确描述了这三个给定国家的救援能力排名（最高分在前）？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1872.source: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? Based on this original query and considering the broader analytical context from migration research showing that 'cities attract people when they no longer offer good prospects,' and evidence from communal living studies demonstrating 'continuous operation maintaining high occupancy while serving populations inexperienced in communal living,' which analytical interpretations showcase the pinnacle of logical deduction about the intersection of demographic growth patterns, economic mobility, and community stability dynamics?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1872.zh: 你能否找出 36047 区域内满足以下条件的人口普查区（census tract）：在 2011 年至 2018 年间人口增长百分比位列前 20，在同一时期收入中位数的绝对增幅也位列前 20，并且在上述每一年中居民均超过 1,000 人？基于这一原始查询，并结合迁移研究中更广泛的分析背景——表明 'cities attract people when they no longer offer good prospects'（城市在不再提供良好前景时仍吸引人口），以及共同居住研究中的证据——表明 'continuous operation maintaining high occupancy while serving populations inexperienced in communal living'（在服务缺乏共同居住经验人群的同时持续运营并保持高入住率），哪些分析性解读在人口增长模式、经济流动性与社区稳定性动态三者交汇处展现了最高水平的逻辑推理？

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-hard-7.source: Train a density prediction model using OMNI2 variables (f10.7_index, Kp_index, Dst_index_nT) and GOES variables (xrsb_flux_observed, xrsa_flux_observed) to forecast Swarm Alpha's atmospheric density 4 hours ahead. Specifically, use a 16-hour context window to project the input time series forward using a VAR(1) model, then fit a linear regression model to predict the next 4 hours of density. Use data from wu334 (OMNI/GOES: 2016-10-22 to 2016-10-23; Density: 2016-10-23 to 2016-10-24) for training, and wu335 (OMNI/GOES: 2016-10-25 to 2016-10-26; Density: 2016-10-29) for evaluation. Assume that all windows contain valid data. Note that the data for training VAR lies at the end of the OMNI2 and GOES input window, and the corresponding Swarm Alpha density data begins immediately afterward; i.e., they only overlap at a single timestamp where OMNI/GOES ends and Density begins. Report the RMSE between the predicted and observed density values over the 4-hour forecast window.
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-hard-7.zh: 使用OMNI2变量（f10.7_index, Kp_index, Dst_index_nT）和GOES变量（xrsb_flux_observed, xrsa_flux_observed）训练一个密度预测模型，以预报Swarm Alpha的4小时后大气密度。具体来说，使用16小时上下文窗口向前投影输入时间序列，采用VAR(1)模型，然后拟合线性回归模型来预测接下来的4小时密度。使用数据集wu334（OMNI/GOES：2016-10-22至2016-10-23；密度：2016-10-23至2016-10-24）进行训练，使用数据集wu335（OMNI/GOES：2016-10-25至2016-10-26；密度：2016-10-29）进行评估。假设所有窗口包含有效数据。注意，用于训练VAR的数据位于OMNI和GOES输入窗口的末尾，而相应的Swarm Alpha密度数据从那时开始；即它们仅在OMNI/GOES结束与Density开始的时间戳处重叠。报告预测值与观测值之间的4小时预报窗口内的均方根误差（RMSE）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1064.source: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020, specifically calculating the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year. Suppose you need to decide in May 2021 whether to push an extra marketing campaign in the first fortnight after the upcoming June 15. You define a "confidence discount" as the number of percentage points you must reduce the 2019 result before comparing it with the 2020 result to make their outcomes appear equally negative. What should that confidence discount be in order to justify postponing the campaign?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1064.zh: 对于每周销售数据，我需要对2018年、2019年和2020年6月中旬左右的销售表现进行分析，具体计算每年6月15日前四周和6月15日后四周的销售百分比变化。假设你需要在2021年5月决定是否在即将到来的6月15日后的前两周推出额外的营销活动。你定义“信心折扣”为在将2019年的结果与2020年的结果比较之前必须减少的百分点，以使它们的结果看起来同样负面。为了合理推迟该活动，这个信心折扣应是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1071.source: For each neighborhood in San Francisco where at least one bike share station and at least one crime incident are located, provide the neighborhood name along with the total count of bike share stations and the total number of crime incidents in that neighborhood. If a new urban policy aims to reduce the station-to-crime ratio by 50% across all neighborhoods by installing additional stations (rounded to the nearest whole number), how many total new stations must be added to the neighborhood that currently has the 5th highest crime count?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1071.zh: 对于旧金山每一个至少有一个共享单车站点和至少发生一起犯罪事件的社区，请提供社区名称以及该社区内共享单车站点的总数和犯罪事件的总数。如果一项新的城市政策旨在通过增设共享单车站点将所有社区的站点与犯罪的比例降低50%（数量四舍五入到最接近的整数），那么当前犯罪数量排第五的社区需要增设多少新的站点？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1096.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? Suppose a health-policy analyst claims that any country whose recovery rate exceeds the mid-May 2020 European average by at least 25 percentage-points can be classified as an "Exceptional Recovery Outlier". According to this rule, pick the trio that NOT ONLY contains the three highest-recovery-rate countries but also counts how many of them qualify as an Exceptional Recovery Outlier (Note: use the published European average of 46%).
7-30/FDABench/FDA1096.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有确诊COVID-19病例超过50,000的国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高（基于康复病例总数占总确诊病例数的比例），它们各自的康复率以百分比表示是多少？假设一位健康政策分析师声称，任何康复率比2020年5月中旬欧洲平均水平高出至少25个百分点的国家，都可以被归类为“卓越康复异常值”。根据这一规则，选择不仅包含三个康复率最高的国家的三国组合，还要计算其中有多少个符合“卓越康复异常值”的标准（注：使用公布的欧洲平均水平46%）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1106.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates?(This part is not allowed to change. No deletions or Rephrase allowed) To determine which country had the HIGHEST ratio of net migration in 2017 compared to their 2016 population when accounting for the U.S. having ~2.5x Germany's population and ~6x Turkey's population, and Germany having ~2.4x Turkey's population, calculate: (net migration in 2017) divided by (2016 population base). Which country's ratio places it at the top of this efficiency comparison?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1106.zh: 2017年在面积大于500平方公里的国家中，净迁移人数最多的前三个国家是哪些？它们的迁移率是多少？（此部分不得更改。不得删除或改写） 要确定在考虑到美国人口约为德国的2.5倍，约为土耳其的6倍，而德国人口约为土耳其的2.4倍时，2017年净迁移人数与其2016年人口相比比例最高的国家，请计算：（2017年净迁移人数）除以（2016年人口基数）。哪一国的比例使其在这一效率比较中位居首位？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1110.source: List the top 5 universities with the most seasons where they achieved the maximum wins in their respective NCAA basketball seasons between 1900-2000, showing each team's total number of such peak-performance seasons, while excluding entries with missing team names. If these top 5 programs had instead averaged exactly the same number of peak wins per qualifying century-season as the entire pool of other ranked schools (excluding themselves), how many total peak wins would the entire NCAA historical leaderboard (top-25) for 1900-2000 have recorded?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1110.zh: 列出在1900-2000年间各自的NCAA篮球赛季中取得最多胜利赛季的前5所大学，显示每支球队达到这种巅峰表现赛季的总次数，同时排除球队名称缺失的条目。如果这前5支球队的平均每个符合条件的世纪赛季的巅峰胜场数正好与其他已排名学校（不包括它们自身）的平均水平相同，那么整个NCAA历史排行榜（前25名）在1900-2000年间的巅峰胜场总数将是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1144.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? Approximately how many percentage points higher was China's recovery rate compared to Germany's?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1144.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有确诊COVID-19病例超过50,000的国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高（基于康复总人数与确诊总人数的比例），它们各自的康复率以百分比表示是多少？中国的康复率大约比德国高多少个百分点？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1154.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates? What is the combined net migration rate of these three countries?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1154.zh: 2017年，面积大于500平方公里的国家中，净迁移率最高的前三个国家是哪三个？它们的迁移率是多少？这三个国家的净迁移率总和是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1158.source: List the top 5 universities with the most seasons where they achieved the maximum wins in their respective NCAA basketball seasons between 1900-2000, showing each team's total number of such peak-performance seasons, while excluding entries with missing team names. what is the combined total of peak-performance seasons for ALL universities that share the #1 ranking among these top 5?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1158.zh: 列出在 1900-2000 年间 NCAA 篮球赛季中，取得最多胜场赛季的前 5 个所大学，并显示每支球队此类巅峰赛季的总数，同时排除球队名称缺失的条目。所有在这前五名中排名第 1 的大学的巅峰赛季总数合计是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1193.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates... If France's apparent recovery rate of 2112% is the result of misaligned reporting intervals where recovered cases are being reported from a different date range than confirmed cases, what would be France's adjusted recovery rate if we normalize the reporting period to match China's data accuracy standards?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1193.zh: 截至 2020 年 5 月 10 日，在确诊 COVID-19 病例超过 50,000 的所有国家中，哪三个国家的康复率最高……如果法国显然的康复率为 2112% 是由于报告时间段不一致导致的，即康复病例报告与确诊病例的时间范围不同，那么如果我们将报告周期调整以匹配中国的数据准确性标准，法国的调整后康复率会是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1202.source: Using the returned data from 'Please find all zip code areas located within 10 kilometers of the coordinates (-122.3321, 47.6062)...', which ZIP code area exhibits the highest calculated population density (people per km² of land area) according to the sum of male + female population provided?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1202.zh: 使用 '请找出位于坐标 (-122.3321, 47.6062) 10 公里范围内的所有邮政编码区域...' 返回的数据，根据所提供的男性 + 女性人口之和，哪个 ZIP 编码区域的计算人口密度（每 km² 陆地面积的人数）最高？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1203.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates? Among these top 3, approximately how many times higher was Syria's net migration compared to Qatar's?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1203.zh: 在2017年中，面积大于500平方公里的国家中，净迁移数最高的前三个国家是哪三个？它们的迁移率是多少？在这前三个国家中，叙利亚的净迁移大约是卡塔尔的多少倍？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1204.source: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? What is the count of unique census tracts that meet ALL three criteria simultaneously?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1204.zh: 你能找到36047地区在2011 年到2018年期间人口百分比增长最大前20名的普查区，同时在同一期间中位收入绝对增长最大前20名，并且每年居民人数都超过1,000的普查区吗？符合这三个条件的唯一普查区数量是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1215.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. For these counties, provide the name, state, median age, total population, number of confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people, number of deaths per 100,000 people, and the case fatality rate as a percentage. Now, if Franklin County doubled its total population overnight without a single additional COVID-19 case or death, what would its new deaths per 100 000 population number be?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1215.zh: 使用 2020 年 5 年期人口普查数据，找出人口超过 50,000 且在 2020 年 8 月 27 日 COVID-19 病死率最高的前三个县。对于这些县，提供名称、所在州、年龄中位数、总人口、每 100,000 人的 COVID-19 确诊病例数、每 100,000 人的死亡人数，以及以百分比表示的病死率。现在，如果 Franklin County 的总人口在一夜之间翻倍，而没有新增任何一例 COVID-19 病例或死亡，那么其新的每 100 000 人死亡数是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1217.source: Which top 3 countries had the highest net migration in 2017 among those with an area greater than 500 square kilometers? And what are their migration rates? If we want to fund a $300,000 humanitarian impact study proportional to the per-capita contribution implied by net migration values, which country would require the smallest budget slice for their nationals among the top three?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1217.zh: 在2017年，面积超过500平方公里的国家中，净迁移量最高的前三个国家是哪三个？它们的迁移率是多少？如果我们想按净迁移值所暗示的人均贡献比例资助一项30万美元的人道主义影响研究，那么在前三名国家中，哪个国家为其国民分配的预算份额最小？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1218.source: Original question: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? Question extended for inference: If the total 2011 population across the qualifying tracts equals X, and the 2018 population totals Y, what is the approximate combined percentage increase in residents across these tracts over the seven-year span?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1218.zh: 原始问题：你能找到位于 36047 区域内的人口普查区，这些区域在2011年至2018年间的人口百分比增长最大前20名，同时在同期中位收入绝对增长最大前20名，并且每年居民人数超过1,000吗？ 推断延伸问题：如果符合条件的普查区在2011年的总人口为 X，而2018年的总人口为 Y，那么这些普查区在七年期间的居民总数的大约百分比增长是多少？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1226.source: Based on the NCAA men's basketball tournament dataset from the 2014 season onwards, when the difference in pace_rating between two tournament teams exceeds 50 points and the higher-efficiency team has a seed >=8, if the historical average points_100poss for the higher-efficiency team under these conditions is 85% (calculated as (87+93)/2), which outcome (win or loss) is more likely when such a matchup occurs, given that the lower-efficiency team has 10% higher actual points_100poss than expected per matchup history? Consider the strategic implication: does the superior efficiency override the anomaly, or should the underdog's performance boost factor disrupt the predicted outcome? [Calculation: (87+93)/2 = 90 baseline; +10% = 99 actual lower-efficiency points; compare to 85 base efficiency win rate],
7-30/FDABench/FDA1226.zh: 基于从2014 年赛季开始的NCAA男子篮球锦标赛数据集，当两支比赛队伍的pace_rating差异超过50分且效率较高的队伍种子号>=8时，如果在这些条件下效率较高的队伍的历史平均points_100poss为85%（计算方式为 (87+93)/2），在这样的对阵中哪种结果（胜利或失败）更可能发生，考虑到效率较低的队伍的实际points_100poss比每场比赛历史预期值高10%？考虑战略含义：较高效率是否会覆盖异常情况，或者弱势队伍的表现提升因素会打乱预测结果？【计算： (87+93)/2 = 90 基准; +10% = 99 实际低效率得分; 与85基准效率胜率比较】

7-30/FDABench/FDA1228.source: As of May 10, 2020, among all countries that had more than 50,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases, which three countries had the highest recovery rates based on the total number of recovered cases relative to their total confirmed cases, and what were their respective recovery rates expressed as percentages? If these countries maintained these same recovery rates while gaining an additional 1,000 newly confirmed cases each, approximately how many additional recoveries would be needed across all three countries combined to maintain their exact same recovery rate percentages?
7-30/FDABench/FDA1228.zh: 截至2020年5月10日，在所有确诊COVID-19病例超过50,000的国家中，恢复率最高的三个位国家分别是哪几个？恢复率是以康复总人数占确诊总人数的比例计算的，并请列出它们各自的恢复率百分比。如果这些国家在新增各1,000例确诊病例的情况下保持相同的恢复率，那么为了保持相同的恢复率百分比，三国总共大约需要新增多少例康复病例？

7-30/FDABench/FDA1235.source: Find the top three counties with populations over 50,000, using the 2020 5-year census data, that had the highest COVID-19 case fatality rates on August 27, 2020. For these counties, provide the name, state, median age, total population, number of confirmed COVID-19 cases per 100,000 people, number of deaths per 100,000 people, and the case fatality rate as a percentage. — If a 1,000-bed surge hospital were opened in the county whose death-per-100k figure ranks second-highest among the three, how many times higher would that county’s case-fatality-rate be compared with the average of the other two counties’ case-fatality-rates? Round the multiple to two decimal places.
7-30/FDABench/FDA1235.zh: 使用2020年5年人口普查数据，找到人口超过50,000的县中，在2020年8月27日COVID-19病例致死率最高的前三个县。对于这些县，提供名称、州、年龄中位数、总人口、每10万人确诊COVID-19病例数、每10万人死亡人数以及病例致死率（百分比）。——如果在这三个县中死亡率排名第二的县开设了一家1,000床的应急医院，该县的病例致死率将是其他两个县病例致死率平均值的几倍？将倍数四舍五入到两位小数。

7-30/FDABench/FDA1238.source: Can you find the census tracts in the 36047 area that are among the top 20 for the largest percentage increases in population from 2011 to 2018, are also among the top 20 for the largest absolute increases in median income during the same period, and had over 1,000 residents in each of those years? Assuming each qualifying tract must make an additional contribution equal to 5 % of its final population size extra to a pooled economic-development fund in 2018 dollars, and knowing that each $100 per-capita median-income gain above the inflation-adjusted 2018 base line earns one strategic investment point, what is the minimum extra per-capita contribution (rounded to the nearest whole dollar) required to secure exactly five composite investment points in the same pool within these census-tract constraints?

7-30/FDABench/FDA0080.source: Among white individuals, compare the average mortality rates between ICD-10 codes containing "discharge" (excluding urethral, firework, and legal intervention firearm-related codes) and those containing "vehicle." Then, using CDC or WHO guidelines, determine which category represents a greater public health burden when factoring in years of potential life lost, and identify whether recent legislative efforts in any U.S. state have specifically targeted the leading cause of death from the higher-mortality category.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0080.zh: 在白人群体中，比较包含“discharge”的ICD-10代码（不包括尿道、焰火和法律干预相关的枪支代码）与包含“vehicle”的代码的平均死亡率。然后，使用CDC或WHO指南，确定在考虑潜在寿命损失年数时，哪一类别代表更大的公共卫生负担，并识别是否美国任何州的近期立法努力已经特别针对高死亡率类别中的主要死因。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0104.source: Identify the top 5 cricket-playing nations whose players demonstrate the highest mean of individual career batting averages across all IPL seasons, then for each of these countries, research and explain how their domestic cricket infrastructure and player development programs might contribute to this performance, and cross-reference these findings with historical commentary or expert analyses discussing batting talent pipelines from these nations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0104.zh: 确定在所有 IPL 赛季中，球员个人职业击球平均分最高的前五个板球国家，然后针对每个国家，研究并解释其国内板球基础设施和球员发展计划如何可能促成这种表现，并将这些发现与历史评论或专家分析中讨论的这些国家击球人才培养管道进行交叉参考。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0112.source: Analyze the top 5 longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017, and for each trip's start station, research what major urban development projects or transit infrastructure changes were announced for those neighborhoods during that period. Then compare the demographic patterns of these long-duration riders against the city's stated bike share equity goals documented in their transportation planning materials, assessing whether the usage aligns with intended program outcomes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0112.zh: 分析2017年下半年最长的5次共享单车行程，并针对每次行程的起始站点，研究在该期间这些社区发布了哪些主要的城市开发项目或交通基础设施变动。然后，将这些长时程骑行者的人口统计模式与城市在交通规划资料中记录的共享单车公平目标进行比较，评估使用情况是否符合预期的项目成果。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0166.source: Analyze the complete digital journey for customer 1362228 on January 28th 2021 by reconstructing their navigation flow with '>>' separators, applying the standard e-commerce page taxonomy abbreviations from our documentation, and consolidating consecutive duplicate page views. Then compare this customer's session pattern against industry benchmarks for e-commerce conversion funnels to identify whether their journey exhibits characteristics associated with high purchase intent or browse abandonment behavior.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0166.zh: 分析客户 1362228 在 2021 年 1 月 28 日的完整数字旅程，通过使用 '>>' 分隔符重建他们的导航流程，应用我们文档中的标准电子商务页面分类缩写，并合并连续重复的页面浏览。然后将该客户的会话模式与电子商务转化漏斗的行业基准进行比较，以确定他们的旅程是否表现出与高购买意向或浏览放弃行为相关的特征。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0204.source: Analyze New York City taxi trip patterns during a major summer holiday period in 2016 to identify the top 10 longest-distance premium group rides (large parties traveling substantial distances) with valid fare structures, then cross-reference the pickup and dropoff locations with notable events or landmarks that might explain these travel patterns, and finally compare the average fares of these trips against typical rates for similar distances based on NYC taxi regulations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0204.zh: 分析2016年夏季主要假期期间纽约市出租车行程模式，以识别前10名最长距离的高端团体乘车（大团队长距离出行）且票价结构有效的行程，然后将上下车地点与可能解释这些出行模式的知名活动或地标进行交叉参考，最后将这些行程的平均票价与纽约市出租车法规下类似距离的典型票价进行比较。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0205.source: Analyze the relationship between driver distraction-related traffic accidents and state-level smartphone adoption rates for 2015-2016, calculating per-capita accident rates using the most recent decennial census data available at that time while excluding ambiguous distraction classifications. Identify which states showed the strongest correlation between mobile device usage penetration and distraction-caused accidents, and research what distracted driving legislation was in effect in the top 5 most-affected states during this period to determine whether existing laws appeared to have any mitigating impact.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0205.zh: 分析2015-2016年司机分心相关交通事故与州级智能手机普及率之间的关系，使用当时可获得的最新十年人口普查数据计算人均事故率，同时排除分类不明确的分心情况。确定哪些州在移动设备使用渗透率与分心造成的事故之间显示出最强的相关性，并研究在此期间受影响最严重的前五个州实施的分心驾驶立法，以确定现行法律是否似乎产生了任何缓解作用。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0220.source: Analyze the relationship between bike share trip duration patterns in San Francisco and major local events or weather anomalies by identifying the year-month periods with the most extreme variations between first/last and highest/lowest trip durations. For the top 3 most anomalous months you discover, research what significant events, policy changes, or environmental factors in the Bay Area might explain these unusual usage patterns. Compare your findings against user feedback or reviews about the bike share service during those specific periods to determine if the statistical anomalies correlate with documented user experiences.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0220.zh: 分析旧金山共享单车行程时长模式与主要本地事件或天气异常之间的关系，通过识别行程时长的最早/最晚和最高/最低之间差异最极端的年月周期来进行。对于您发现的前三个最异常的月份，研究湾区可能解释这些异常使用模式的重要事件、政策变化或环境因素。将您的调查结果与该特定时期关于共享单车服务的用户反馈或评论进行对比，以确定统计异常是否与记录的用户体验相关联。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0263.source: Analyze the monthly transaction throughput for 2023 and compare each month's transactions-per-second rate against the theoretical maximum TPS that Ethereum's network could handle following the Dencun upgrade specifications. For any months where the actual TPS exceeded 50% of a major competing Layer 1 blockchain's average TPS during the same period, identify what on-chain events or protocol changes might explain the elevated activity, and calculate how the throughput would have differed if those months had the same number of days as their preceding months.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0263.zh: 分析2023年的每月交易吞吐量，并将每个月的每秒交易数（TPS）与以太坊在Dencun升级规格下理论上能够处理的最大TPS进行比较。对于那些实际TPS超过同期主要竞争Layer 1区块链平均TPS 50%的月份，识别可能解释交易活动增加的链上事件或协议变更，并计算如果这些月份的天数与前一个月相同，其吞吐量会有何不同。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0366.source: Analyze the relationship between Germany's fastest-growing patent technology areas (based on exponential moving average trends with a 0.1 smoothing factor for filings culminating in December 2016 grants) and the broader European patent policy landscape during that period. Identify which CPC level 4 groups showed peak innovation momentum, explain how these technical domains align with Germany's industrial strategy initiatives, and compare this patent activity pattern to how the Cooperative Patent Classification system was designed to categorize emerging technologies across different national patent offices.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0366.zh: 分析德国增长最快的专利技术领域（基于截止到2016年12月授权的申请，以0.1平滑系数计算的指数移动平均趋势）与同期欧洲专利政策环境之间的关系。识别哪些CPC四级组显示出创新势头的高峰，解释这些技术领域如何与德国的产业战略举措相符合，并将这一专利活动模式与合作专利分类系统如何在不同国家专利局对新兴技术进行分类的设计进行比较。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0400.source: Analyze the top 5 longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017, and for each trip, determine whether the rider's age at the time falls within the peak cycling demographic according to urban transportation research. Cross-reference the start and end station locations with any major city events or festivals that occurred on those specific dates, and assess whether the trip durations correlate with documented traffic disruptions or road closures reported during that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0400.zh: 分析2017年下半年最长的前五次共享单车行程，并针对每次行程，确定骑行者当时的年龄是否符合城市交通研究所定义的高峰骑行人群。将起点和终点站位置与当日发生的任何主要城市活动或节日进行交叉核对，并评估行程时长是否与该期间记录的交通中断或道路封闭情况相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0429.source: Analyze the NCAA basketball dataset to identify which of the top 5 largest venues have hosted National Championship games since 2016, then for each matching venue, compare the average point margin of championships held there against the historical average championship margin. Additionally, research and explain what architectural features or renovations contributed to these venues achieving their current seating capacities, and determine if there's any correlation between venue size and game scoring trends in high-stakes tournament matchups.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0429.zh: 分析 NCAA 篮球数据集，以确定自 2016 年以来哪五个最大场馆举办过全国锦标赛游戏，然后对于每个匹配的场馆，将其所举办的锦标赛的平均得分差与历史锦标赛平均得分差进行比较。此外，研究并解释哪些建筑特色或翻新促使这些场馆达到当前的座位容量，并确定场馆规模与高风险锦标赛对抗比赛得分趋势之间是否存在任何相关性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0495.source: Identify the top 10 users by average order value (calculated as total revenue from quantity × sale price divided by number of orders) who both registered and made purchases during a year that coincided with a major global e-commerce regulatory change, then cross-reference their email domains against known data breach incidents to assess potential security exposure, and finally retrieve any internal policy documents that outline our company's protocol for notifying affected customers in such scenarios.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0495.zh: 识别在某一年同时注册并进行购买的前10名用户（按平均订单价值计算，公式为数量 × 销售价格的总收入除以订单数量），该年份恰逢重大全球电子商务监管变更，然后将他们的电子邮件域名与已知的数据泄露事件进行交叉核对，以评估潜在的安全风险，最后检索任何内部政策文件，这些文件概述了公司在此类情况下通知受影响客户的协议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0501.source: Identify which months between August 2022 and November 2023 showed anomalous profit growth patterns for Facebook-sourced completed orders compared to what would be expected based on historical e-commerce seasonality and Meta's advertising platform performance metrics during that period. For each anomalous month discovered, determine whether the deviation can be attributed to platform-specific factors (such as algorithm changes or ad pricing shifts), broader market conditions, or internal operational changes, and quantify the unexplained variance. Finally, recommend whether the Facebook acquisition channel should receive increased budget allocation based on your findings about sustainable versus one-time growth drivers.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0501.zh: 识别在2022年8月至2023年11月期间，相较于基于历史电子商务季节性和Meta广告平台绩效指标预期的表现，Facebook来源的已完成订单显示出异常利润增长模式的月份。对于发现的每一个异常月份，确定这种偏差是可以归因于平台特定因素（例如算法更改或广告定价变化）、更广泛的市场状况，还是内部运营变化，并量化未解释的差异。最后，根据关于可持续增长驱动因素与一次性增长驱动因素的发现，建议是否应增加Facebook获取渠道的预算分配。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0503.source: Identify which cannabis reference genome exhibits the highest variant density among all available references, where variants are defined by genotype calls exceeding zero, then calculate and report the precise variant count, reference length, and density ratio. Cross-reference your findings with recent peer-reviewed literature on cannabis genomic variant calling methodologies to evaluate whether the observed density aligns with expected ranges reported in current studies, and explain any significant discrepancies based on the detection methods and sequencing technologies discussed in the research.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0503.zh: 确定在所有可用参考基因组中，哪一个大麻参考基因组显示最高的变异密度，其中变异定义为基因型调用大于零的情况，然后计算并报告具体的变异数量、参考长度和密度比率。将你的发现与近期经过同行评审的关于大麻基因组变异检测方法的文献进行交叉对照，评估观察到的密度是否与当前研究报告的预期范围一致，并根据研究中讨论的检测方法和测序技术解释任何显著差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0515.source: Analyze the demographic and geographic characteristics of postal zones within a 10-kilometer radius of Seattle's iconic Pike Place Market, comparing their 2010 census population densities against current estimates to identify which areas have experienced the most significant population shifts. Determine what major urban development projects or policy changes might explain the top three fastest-growing zones, and assess whether these areas share common geographic features such as waterfront access or proximity to transit infrastructure.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0515.zh: 分析西雅图标志性派克市场（Pike Place Market）周围10公里半径内邮政区域的人口和地理特征，将2010年人口普查的人口密度与当前估计值进行比较，以确定哪些区域经历了最显著的人口变化。确定可能解释前三个增长最快区域的主要城市开发项目或政策变化，并评估这些区域是否具有共同的地理特征，例如临水位置或靠近交通基础设施。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0518.source: Identify the California census tract that experienced the most dramatic median income surge between 2015 and 2018, then investigate whether this tract's transformation aligns with documented gentrification patterns and academic research on neighborhood economic displacement. Analyze how this tract's income growth trajectory compares statistically to surrounding tracts and evaluate what combination of policy interventions, demographic shifts, or economic factors researchers have identified as primary drivers of such concentrated income changes in California communities.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0518.zh: 确定2015年至2018年期间经历中位收入最显著增长的加利福尼亚州普查区，然后调查该普查区的变迁是否与已有文献中记录的士绅化模式和关于社区经济驱逐的学术研究相一致。分析该普查区的收入增长轨迹在统计上与周边普查区相比如何，并评估研究人员已识别出的促成加利福尼亚社区此类集中收入变化的主要因素，包括政策干预、人口结构变化或经济因素的组合。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0520.source: Analyze the scoring dynamics and momentum shifts in the 2014 regular season matchup between Northwestern and Notre Dame, identifying which team held home field advantage and how that may have influenced the game's critical turning points. Cross-reference the play-by-play scoring sequence with historical rivalry context and contemporary media coverage to evaluate whether the final outcome aligned with pre-game expectations and betting lines.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0520.zh: 分析2014年常规赛中西北大学与圣母大学比赛的得分动态和势头变化，确定哪支球队拥有主场优势，以及这可能如何影响比赛的关键转折点。将逐次得分序列与历史对抗背景和当时媒体报道交叉参考，以评估最终结果是否符合赛前预期和博彩赔率。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0521.source: Analyze which universities demonstrated the most consistent peak performance in NCAA basketball between 1900-2000 by identifying those with the highest number of maximum-win seasons, then investigate how these dominant programs' historical success correlates with current academic research on competitive dynasty formation and institutional resource allocation in collegiate athletics. For the top performers you identify, determine whether their peak-performance patterns align with or contradict prevailing theories about sustainable competitive advantage in amateur sports organizations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0521.zh: 分析在1900年至2000年间哪些大学在NCAA篮球中表现出最稳定的巅峰表现，通过识别那些拥有最多赛季最高胜场数的大学，然后研究这些主导项目的历史成功与当前关于大学体育中竞争王朝形成和机构资源分配的学术研究之间的相关性。对于你识别出的顶尖表现者，确定其巅峰表现模式是否与业余体育组织可持续竞争优势的现有理论一致或相违背。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0526.source: Analyze which Utah county experienced the greatest percentage increase in construction employment from 2000 to 2018 using quarterly sampling methodology, then investigate the underlying economic drivers and policy decisions that contributed to this growth pattern. Compare your findings against national construction employment trends during the same period, and evaluate whether the growth was correlated with any major infrastructure projects, population migration patterns, or zoning regulation changes in that county.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0526.zh: 使用季度抽样方法分析从2000年到2018年犹他州哪个县的建筑就业增长百分比最大，然后调查促成这一增长模式的潜在经济驱动因素和政策决策。将你的发现与同期全国建筑就业趋势进行比较，并评估该县的增长是否与任何重大基础设施项目、人口迁移模式或分区法规变化相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0527.source: Analyze the monthly portfolio health by calculating the lagged total balance (with negative values floored to zero) alongside the month-over-month percentage change, then cross-reference these trends against major financial regulatory changes or economic events that occurred during the same periods to explain any significant anomalies. Determine which user segments show the strongest correlation between external market conditions and balance fluctuations, and recommend industry-standard risk metrics that should be implemented based on patterns observed in similar fintech companies' approaches to balance volatility management.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0527.zh: 通过计算滞后的总余额（负值取零）以及环比百分比变化，分析每月投资组合健康状况，然后将这些趋势与同期发生的主要金融监管变化或经济事件进行交叉参考，以解释任何显著异常。确定哪些用户群体在外部市场状况与余额波动之间显示出最强的相关性，并根据在类似金融科技公司管理余额波动中观察到的模式，推荐应实施的行业标准风险指标。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0530.source: Analyze the customer journey funnel for our product catalog, excluding any homepage and confirmation-related pages, by calculating view-to-cart and cart-to-purchase conversion rates, then compare our abandonment rates against current e-commerce industry benchmarks to identify which specific products are underperforming relative to market standards. Additionally, cross-reference the bottom performers with our product documentation to surface any common themes in product descriptions or categories that might explain the conversion gaps.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0530.zh: 分析我们产品目录的客户旅程漏斗，排除任何主页和确认相关页面，通过计算浏览到加入购物车以及购物车到购买的转化率，然后将我们的放弃率与当前电子商务行业基准进行比较，以确定哪些具体产品相对于市场标准表现不佳。此外，将表现最差的产品与我们的产品文档进行交叉参考，找出在产品描述或类别中可能解释转化差距的共同主题。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0531.source: Analyze our interest metrics over a 12-month period and identify which interest category consistently dominates when adjusting for index normalization. Then research what major industry events or seasonal trends during that timeframe might explain the top-performing categories, and find similar patterns in our historical documentation to determine if this represents an anomaly or recurring behavior.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0531.zh: 分析我们在12个月期间的兴趣指标，并确定在进行指数归一化调整后，哪个兴趣类别持续占主导地位。然后研究这一时间段内可能解释表现最好的类别的主要行业事件或季节性趋势，并在我们的历史文档中寻找类似模式，以确定这是否代表异常情况或重复行为。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0532.source: Analyze the seasonal and macroeconomic factors that drove the highest and lowest performing interest categories to their peak composition values, identifying which months showed anomalous spikes compared to historical norms. Cross-reference these patterns with major industry events, consumer behavior shifts, and economic indicators from the same time periods to explain why certain category types consistently dominated or underperformed, and predict which categories are likely to emerge or decline based on current market trends.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0532.zh: 分析推动表现最高和最低的兴趣类别达到其峰值组成的季节性和宏观经济因素，识别与历史规范相比显示异常峰值的月份。将这些模式与同期的主要行业事件、消费者行为变化和经济指标进行交叉参考，以解释为何某些类别类型持续占主导地位或表现不佳，并根据当前市场趋势预测哪些类别可能会出现或下降。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0534.source: Analyze the daily trading volume patterns in our cryptocurrency price database during the week when El Salvador made its historic Bitcoin announcement, identifying which tickers showed abnormal volume spikes compared to their 30-day baseline. Cross-reference these volume anomalies with major news events from that period and explain whether the market movements align with the efficient market hypothesis based on similar historical precedents in our research documents.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0534.zh: 分析我们加密货币价格数据库中，在萨尔瓦多发布历史性比特币公告的那一周的每日交易量模式，识别与其30天基线相比显示异常交易量激增的交易代码。将这些交易量异常与该期间的重要新闻事件进行交叉参考，并解释市场走势是否符合有效市场假说，基于我们研究文档中类似的历史先例。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0535.source: Analyze our vegetable wholesale inventory performance by identifying which product categories have statistically anomalous loss rates compared to both our historical baseline and current industry benchmarks, then recommend specific inventory optimization strategies that leading distributors are implementing to address similar loss patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0535.zh: 分析我们的蔬菜批发库存绩效，识别与我们的历史基线和当前行业基准相比，哪些产品类别的损耗率存在统计异常，然后推荐领先分销商为应对类似损耗模式而实施的具体库存优化策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0536.source: Analyze our vegetable wholesale financial performance from 2020-2023, comparing our category-level metrics (average/max/min wholesale prices, price variance, totals, loss rates, and profitability) against industry benchmarks and market trends to identify which categories underperformed relative to sector averages, and investigate what external factors like supply chain disruptions or regulatory changes might explain any significant deviations from expected performance patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0536.zh: 分析我们2020-2023年的蔬菜批发财务表现，将我们各类别的指标（平均/最高/最低批发价格、价格差异、总量、损耗率和盈利能力）与行业基准和市场趋势进行比较，以确定哪些类别相对于行业平均水平表现不佳，并调查供应链中断或监管变化等外部因素是否可能解释任何显著偏离预期表现模式的情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0537.source: Identify which seller segments are outperforming industry benchmarks for e-commerce fulfillment and customer satisfaction, then determine what external market factors or regional economic conditions might explain why certain Brazilian states have disproportionately higher concentrations of top-performing sellers. Cross-reference your findings with best practices for marketplace seller optimization to recommend actionable improvements for underperforming categories.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0537.zh: 确定哪些卖家细分市场在电子商务履行和客户满意度方面超过行业基准，然后分析哪些外部市场因素或地区经济条件可能解释为什么某些巴西州的顶级卖家集中度异常高。将你的发现与市场卖家优化的最佳实践进行交叉参考，以推荐对表现不佳类别的可操作改进措施。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0538.source: Analyze our sales performance volatility around mid-June (comparing the 4 weeks before and after June 15) across 2018-2020, and determine whether any significant percentage changes correlate with major retail industry events or economic factors that occurred during those periods. Additionally, cross-reference these findings with our internal strategy documents to identify which of our planned seasonal initiatives were actually implemented, and recommend whether our mid-June transition approach should be modified based on current industry best practices for seasonal inventory management.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0538.zh: 分析我们在6月中旬期间的销售业绩波动（比较6月15日之前和之后的4周）在2018-2020年的变化情况，并确定是否存在任何与该期间主要零售行业事件或经济因素相关的显著百分比变化。此外，将这些发现与我们的内部战略文件进行交叉参考，以识别哪些计划中的季节性举措实际上得以实施，并基于当前行业在季节性库存管理方面的最佳实践，建议是否应修改我们在6月中旬的过渡策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0539.source: Analyze how the shift to online shopping during the global event that peaked around mid-2020 affected different customer segments in retail, comparing performance across geographic, demographic, and platform dimensions for the 12-week periods before and after the key date when many regions began reopening. Determine which customer attribute showed the most significant decline, research the external factors that likely caused this specific segment to underperform, and find industry reports or case studies that document similar patterns in comparable retail datasets.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0539.zh: 分析在全球事件（在2020年中期达到高峰）期间向在线购物的转变如何影响零售中的不同客户群体，对比关键日期前后12周内各地理区域、人口统计特征和平台维度的表现变化，关键日期是指许多地区开始重新开放的时间。确定哪个客户属性的下降最为显著，研究可能导致该特定群体表现不佳的外部因素，并查找记录类似模式的可比零售数据集中的行业报告或案例研究。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0540.source: Analyze the latest ride from each region between 2014-2017 to identify which regions show ride duration patterns that correlate with urban density characteristics, then cross-reference the gender distribution of these rides against published transportation equity studies to determine if any regions exhibit statistically significant demographic disparities compared to national cycling participation benchmarks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0540.zh: 分析 2014-2017 年间每个地区的最新骑行，以确定哪些地区的骑行时长模式与城市密度特征相关，然后将这些骑行的性别分布与已发布的交通公平研究进行交叉对比，以判断是否有任何地区在统计上表现出相较于全国骑行参与基准的人口分布显著差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0541.source: Analyze the longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017 and investigate whether the routes taken correspond to any significant local events, festivals, or tourist attractions that occurred during those specific dates. For the riders involved, calculate their generational cohort based on birth year, research the typical cycling behaviors and preferences associated with each generation, and assess whether their trip patterns align with or deviate from these documented trends. Finally, determine if any of these routes have since been impacted by urban infrastructure changes or new bike lane developments.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0541.zh: 分析2017年下半年最长的共享单车行程，并调查所选择的路线是否与在这些特定日期发生的任何重大本地事件、节日或旅游景点有关。对于参与骑行的用户，根据出生年份计算他们的世代群体，研究每一代人典型的骑行行为和偏好，并评估他们的行程模式是否与这些已记录的趋势一致或有所偏离。最后，确定这些路线是否已受到城市基础设施变化或新建自行车道的影响。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0542.source: Identify which month in 2017 showed the most significant divergence in cumulative usage patterns between casual customers and subscribers, then investigate whether this divergence aligns with documented seasonal mobility trends and behavioral research specific to San Francisco's bikeshare system. Explain what external factors—such as tourism patterns, weather events, or local initiatives—might account for this particular month's anomaly based on available research and urban transportation studies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0542.zh: 识别2017年哪个月份在休闲客户和订阅用户的累计使用模式上表现出最显著的差异，然后调查这一差异是否与旧金山共享单车系统的季节性出行趋势和行为研究相一致。根据现有的研究和城市交通研究，解释哪些外部因素——如旅游模式、天气事件或本地举措——可能导致该月份的这一异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0543.source: For transit routes where stops follow a northbound or downtown-bound sequence pattern, identify the earliest and latest service times at key transfer points and compare the total daily service span against industry benchmarks for urban transit systems of similar size. Additionally, investigate whether the headways during peak hours align with recommended standards from transit planning guidelines, and determine if any routes serve areas that historically had significant transit-oriented development or were part of major urban renewal projects.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0543.zh: 对于停靠点遵循北行或前往市中心顺序模式的公交线路，确定关键换乘点的最早和最晚服务时间，并将每日总服务时间与类似规模城市公共交通系统的行业基准进行比较。此外，调查高峰时段的发车间隔是否符合交通规划指南推荐的标准，并确定是否有任何线路服务于历史上有重大交通导向开发或曾经是主要城市更新项目的一部分的地区。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0544.source: Analyze how the maximum average cycling speeds observed in Berkeley compare to both the city's posted speed limits for different road types and the physiological benchmarks for sustained urban cycling identified in transportation research. Based on your findings from trip records exceeding 1000 meters, evaluate whether Berkeley's cycling infrastructure design appears to facilitate or constrain cyclist speeds relative to what studies suggest is optimal for urban bike commuting, and identify any safety implications where cyclist speeds may conflict with local traffic regulations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0544.zh: 分析在伯克利观察到的最大平均骑行速度如何与该市针对不同道路类型公布的限速以及交通研究中确定的可持续城市骑行生理基准相比。根据超过1000米的行程记录的研究结果，评估伯克利的自行车基础设施设计是否似乎促进或限制骑行者的速度，相对于研究所建议的城市自行车通勤的最佳速度，并指出骑行速度可能与当地交通法规冲突的安全隐患。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0545.source: Investigate whether there's a correlation between bike share infrastructure density and crime rates across San Francisco neighborhoods, and compare these patterns to findings from urban planning research on the relationship between public transit accessibility and neighborhood safety. Identify which neighborhoods deviate most significantly from expected patterns based on both the local data and established urban mobility-crime theories, then propose evidence-based explanations for these outliers.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0545.zh: 调查旧金山各社区自行车共享基础设施密度与犯罪率之间是否存在相关性，并将这些模式与城市规划研究中关于公共交通可达性与社区安全关系的发现进行比较。识别哪些社区在基于本地数据和已确立的城市交通-犯罪理论的预期模式上偏离最明显，然后为这些异常值提出基于证据的解释。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0546.source: Identify which product category dominates first successful customer purchases (excluding cancelled and returned orders), then calculate its total revenue contribution and perform a correlation analysis between this category's quarterly revenue trends and customer acquisition costs over the past 8 quarters. Compare your findings against industry benchmarks for first-purchase category performance in e-commerce, and evaluate whether our current measurement methodology aligns with emerging best practices for tracking new customer purchasing behavior.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0546.zh: 确定哪一产品类别在首次成功客户购买中占主导地位（不包括已取消和退货的订单），然后计算该类别的总收入贡献，并对过去 8 个季度该类别的季度收入趋势与客户获取成本进行相关性分析。将你的发现与电商行业首次购买类别绩效的基准进行比较，并评估我们当前的衡量方法是否符合跟踪新客户购买行为的最新最佳实践。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0547.source: Identify the product category that dominates in total purchase volume, then determine if the average time users spend viewing products in this category correlates with industry benchmarks for e-commerce engagement. Additionally, find any product descriptions in this top category that mention sustainability or eco-friendly features, and analyze whether these products show different viewing patterns compared to other products in the same category.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0547.zh: 确定在总购买量中占主导地位的产品类别，然后判断用户在该类别中浏览产品的平均时间是否与电子商务参与的行业基准相关。此外，查找该顶级类别中提到可持续性或环保特征的任何产品描述，并分析这些产品的浏览模式是否与同一类别中的其他产品有所不同。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0548.source: Analyze the historical performance of our product categories to identify which ones showed the strongest recovery patterns after major global supply chain disruptions, comparing their month-over-month growth trajectories in both revenue and order volume against industry benchmarks for e-commerce resilience. For categories that underperformed relative to market expectations, investigate potential contributing factors and recommend whether seasonal timing or external economic indicators better explain the variance in their pre-2022 completed order trends.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0548.zh: 分析我们产品类别的历史表现，以识别在重大全球供应链中断后哪些类别显示出最强的恢复模式，比较它们在收入和订单量方面的月度增长轨迹，并将其与电子商务韧性的行业基准进行对比。对于相较市场预期表现不佳的类别，调查潜在的影响因素，并建议季节性时机还是外部经济指标能更好地解释它们在2022年前已完成订单趋势中的差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0549.source: Analyze customer retention patterns by cohort month through the fourth month after initial purchase, then correlate any significant drops or spikes in retention rates with major economic events, industry disruptions, or competitive landscape changes that occurred during those periods. Additionally, compare these retention patterns against e-commerce industry benchmarks and best practices documented in recent market research to identify which cohorts underperformed relative to expectations and hypothesize root causes based on what was happening in the broader market at those times.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0549.zh: 通过分析客户按首购月份进行的队列保留模式，观察直到首次购买后的第四个月，然后将保留率的任何显著下降或上升与在这些期间发生的重大经济事件、行业中断或竞争格局变化相关联。此外，将这些保留模式与电子商务行业基准和近期市场研究中记录的最佳实践进行比较，以识别哪些队列的表现低于预期，并根据当时更广泛市场的情况推测根本原因。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0550.source: Identify which product category has demonstrated the strongest momentum in customer adoption by analyzing month-over-month growth patterns in completed order volume, then investigate what major industry trends or market events during the peak growth period might explain this acceleration. For that top-performing category, determine whether the products driving this growth align with current sustainability certifications or ethical sourcing standards that consumers increasingly prioritize.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0550.zh: 通过分析已完成订单量的月度增长模式，识别哪个产品类别在客户采纳方面表现出最强的增长势头，然后调查在增长高峰期间可能解释这一加速的主要行业趋势或市场事件。对于表现最佳的类别，确定推动这种增长的产品是否符合消费者日益重视的当前可持续认证或道德采购标准。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0551.source: Analyze how the age distribution extremes among users on our e-commerce platform between January 2019 and April 2022 compare to industry-wide demographic trends during that period, breaking down the youngest and oldest user counts by gender. Then evaluate whether our platform's age-gender composition aligns with or deviates from research findings on generational shopping behavior shifts accelerated by the pandemic. Provide actionable recommendations based on any identified gaps between our user demographics and broader market opportunities.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0551.zh: 分析我们电商平台在2019年1月至2022年4月期间用户的年龄分布极值，与同期行业整体人口结构趋势的比较，按性别分解最年轻和最年长用户的数量。然后评估我们平台的年龄-性别构成是否与研究发现的疫情加速的代际购物行为变化相符或偏离。根据我们用户人口统计数据与更广泛市场机会之间发现的任何差距，提供可行的建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0554.source: Analyze the demographic patterns of users who signed up during the period between two major global events that significantly impacted digital adoption rates, and determine whether the age distribution extremes for each gender correlate with industry benchmarks for platform engagement. Calculate the statistical significance of any gender-based age gaps at the extremes, and investigate whether these patterns align with documented generational technology adoption trends from recent market research.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0554.zh: 分析在两次显著影响数字采用率的全球重大事件之间注册的用户的人口统计模式，并确定每种性别的年龄分布极端值是否与平台参与度的行业基准相关。计算任何性别基础年龄差异极端值的统计显著性，并调查这些模式是否与近期市场研究中记录的代际技术采用趋势一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0555.source: Analyze the performance of sleepwear and loungewear products throughout 2023 by comparing monthly profitability trends against industry benchmarks for this retail segment, and identify which months showed anomalous performance that might correlate with seasonal consumer behavior patterns or major retail events. Additionally, determine whether our profit margins align with what leading retail analysts recommend for this product category.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0555.zh: 通过将2023年整年的睡衣和家居服产品的月度盈利趋势与该零售细分市场的行业基准进行比较，分析其表现，并确定哪些月份表现异常，可能与季节性消费者行为模式或主要零售活动相关。此外，确定我们的利润率是否与领先零售分析师对该产品类别的建议一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0556.source: Analyze the age gap between our oldest and youngest users who registered during our platform's major growth period (2019-2022), then investigate how this demographic spread compares to published industry benchmarks for e-commerce platforms and determine whether our age distribution aligns with research-backed best practices for customer segmentation strategies. Based on your findings, identify potential market opportunities or risks in our current user demographic composition.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0556.zh: 分析在我们平台主要增长时期（2019-2022）注册的最年长和最年轻用户之间的年龄差距，然后调查这一人口分布与已发布的电子商务平台行业基准相比如何，并确定我们的年龄分布是否符合基于研究的客户细分策略最佳实践。根据您的发现，识别当前用户人口构成中的潜在市场机会或风险。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0557.source: Analyze the monthly top-performing products before July 2024 based on completed orders with branded items, using sales volume as the primary metric and revenue as a tiebreaker. For each month's winning product, research the parent company's market position and any significant business events during that period, then search our internal documentation to identify any promotional campaigns or inventory strategies that may have contributed to that product's success. Provide a comprehensive report that connects the sales performance data with external market factors and internal business decisions.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0557.zh: 分析截至2024年7月之前每月的畅销产品，基于已完成订单中带品牌的商品，以销量作为主要指标，收入作为平局决胜因素。对于每个月的冠军产品，研究母公司的市场地位以及该期间的重大商业事件，然后查阅我们内部文件，识别可能促成该产品成功的任何促销活动或库存策略。提供一份综合报告，将销售表现数据与外部市场因素和内部商业决策联系起来。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0558.source: Identify the top 10 highest-value customers from the cohort that registered during the year a major global e-commerce regulation took effect, focusing only on those who made purchases before that regulation's compliance deadline, and rank them by their average order value (calculated as the sum of item quantities multiplied by sale prices across all orders, divided by total order count). For each customer, retrieve their contact information and cross-reference their purchasing patterns against industry benchmark data for that customer segment, then provide a statistical summary comparing their behavior to similar cohorts documented in recent e-commerce research.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0558.zh: 确定在全球主要电子商务法规生效年份注册的群体中，价值最高的前10名客户，仅关注在该法规合规截止日期之前有购买行为的客户，并按其平均订单价值排名（平均订单价值计算方法为所有订单的商品数量与销售价格的乘积之和除以订单总数）。对于每位客户，获取其联系方式，并将其购买行为与该客户细分市场的行业基准数据进行交叉比对，然后提供统计摘要，将其行为与近期电子商务研究中记录的类似群体进行比较。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0559.source: Identify products that consistently appeared as the lowest profit performers across all available months in 2020, then research industry benchmarks for acceptable profit margins in their respective product categories. Compare these underperformers against both historical company data and external market standards to determine whether their poor margins stem from pricing strategy issues, cost inefficiencies, or broader market conditions affecting similar products.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0559.zh: 确定在 2020 年所有可用月份中持续表现为最低利润的产品，然后研究各自产品类别中可接受利润率的行业基准。将这些表现不佳的产品与历史公司数据和外部市场标准进行比较，以确定其低利润是否源于定价策略问题、成本效率低下或影响类似产品的更广泛市场条件。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0560.source: Identify which three browsers have the shortest average session durations (calculated from the difference between earliest and latest timestamps per user session), but only for browsers with more than 10 total sessions. For each of these browsers, research their known performance issues or technical limitations that might explain the shorter session times, and cross-reference with our internal documentation to determine if any logged bugs or user complaints correlate with the session duration patterns you discovered.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0560.zh: 确定哪三款浏览器的平均会话时长最短（根据每个用户会话的最早和最晚时间戳的差值计算），但仅限于总会话数超过 10 个的浏览器。对于这三款浏览器中的每一款，研究其已知的性能问题或技术限制，这些问题或限制可能解释会话时长较短的原因，并与我们的内部文档进行交叉参考，以确定任何记录的错误或用户投诉是否与您发现的会话时长模式相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0561.source: For users who made their first purchase in January 2020, analyze their complete retention journey throughout the year by calculating month-by-month return rates, then compare these patterns against current e-commerce industry benchmarks to identify whether our critical drop-off points align with or deviate from typical customer lifecycle stages. Based on your findings, determine which retention periods represent the greatest opportunity for intervention and recommend evidence-based strategies that have proven effective for similar cohort profiles.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0561.zh: 对于在2020年1月首次购买的用户，通过计算逐月回购率来分析他们全年完整的留存旅程，然后将这些模式与当前电子商务行业基准进行比较，以确定我们的关键流失点是符合还是偏离典型的客户生命周期阶段。根据你的发现，确定哪些留存时期代表最具干预机会，并推荐针对类似用户群体已经被证明有效的循证策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0562.source: Analyze the monthly e-commerce performance metrics for first-year customers purchasing newly-added inventory throughout 2021, segmented by customer geography, product category hierarchy, and one additional demographic dimension you determine would provide the most actionable insights for a retail expansion strategy. Compare the profit margins across segments to industry benchmarks for similar retail categories, and identify which customer-product combinations show statistically significant deviation from expected performance based on market research data.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0562.zh: 分析2021年期间首次购买新增加库存的客户的每月电子商务绩效指标，按客户地理位置、产品类别层级以及您确定将为零售扩张策略提供最具可操作性洞见的另一个人口统计维度进行分段。将各分段的利润率与类似零售类别的行业基准进行比较，并识别哪些客户-产品组合的表现与基于市场研究数据的预期表现存在统计学上显著偏差。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0563.source: Identify the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding canceled and returned orders, then cross-reference these products against current industry reports to determine which ones align with emerging market trends in their respective categories. For each trending product identified, search the product documentation to explain what specific features or attributes likely contributed to both their profitability and market relevance, and flag any products whose profit trajectory contradicts broader industry patterns.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0563.zh: 确定从2019年1月到2022年8月每个月最盈利的前三种产品，排除已取消和退货订单，然后将这些产品与当前行业报告进行交叉对比，以确定哪些产品在各自类别中符合新兴市场趋势。对于每个识别出的趋势产品，查阅产品文档以解释哪些具体功能或属性可能促成了它们的盈利能力和市场相关性，并标记任何其利润走势与更广泛行业模式相悖的产品。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0564.source: Analyze the monthly profit trends from our social media advertising channels over the past 16 months to identify which periods showed the strongest momentum, then cross-reference these findings with major platform algorithm changes or advertising policy updates that occurred during those same periods. Determine whether external platform factors correlate with our most significant profit improvements, and recommend which channel deserves increased budget allocation based on both historical performance patterns and current industry sentiment from recent analyst reports.
