7-30/FDABench/FDA0564.zh: 分析过去16个月我们社交媒体广告渠道的月度利润趋势，以确定哪些时期显示出最强的增长势头，然后将这些发现与同期发生的主要平台算法更改或广告政策更新进行交叉参考。确定外部平台因素是否与我们最显著的利润增长相关，并根据历史绩效模式和近期分析师报告中的当前行业情绪，推荐应增加预算分配的渠道。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0565.source: Identify which reference sequence exhibits the highest variant density in the cannabis genome dataset, then determine whether this density falls within expected ranges by cross-referencing recent genomic studies on cannabis variant calling methodologies. Additionally, investigate how the variant distribution patterns observed in this reference sequence correlate with documented structural features or repetitive elements described in current cannabis genomics literature.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0565.zh: 确定在大麻基因组数据集中哪条参考序列表现出最高的变异密度，然后通过交叉参考近期关于大麻变异检测方法的基因组研究，判断该密度是否在预期范围内。此外，调查在该参考序列中观察到的变异分布模式如何与当前大麻基因组学文献中描述的结构特征或重复元素相对应。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0566.source: Analyze the relationship between reference sequence length and variant density across all cannabis references in the database, identifying which reference exhibits the highest variant density and comparing this metric to benchmarks reported in recent cannabis pangenome studies. Investigate whether the observed variant patterns align with current research findings on genome completeness and structural variation in cannabis, and evaluate what the density distribution suggests about potential assembly quality or biological diversity in the dataset.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0566.zh: 分析数据库中所有大麻参考序列的参考序列长度与变异密度之间的关系，确定哪一个参考显示出最高的变异密度，并将该指标与最近大麻泛基因组研究中报告的基准进行比较。调查观察到的变异模式是否与当前关于大麻基因组完整性和结构变异的研究结果一致，并评估密度分布对数据集中潜在组装质量或生物多样性的暗示。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0567.source: Identify the top 10 countries with the youngest population demographics in 2020, then investigate whether there are correlations between these countries' youth population percentages and their economic development indicators, regional stability, or educational infrastructure investments. Based on your findings, assess which of these nations are best positioned to leverage their demographic dividend over the next two decades and explain the historical or policy factors that contributed to their current age distributions.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0567.zh: 识别2020年人口年龄结构最年轻的前10个国家，然后调查这些国家的青年人口比例与其经济发展指标、区域稳定性或教育基础设施投资之间是否存在相关性。根据调查结果，评估这些国家在未来二十年中哪些最有可能利用其人口红利，并解释导致其当前年龄分布的历史或政策因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0568.source: Analyze the relationship between countries with the youngest population demographics and their economic development trajectories, then investigate whether current research supports or contradicts the "demographic dividend" theory by examining specific case studies from regions with the highest concentrations of youth populations. Based on your findings, identify which factors most strongly predict whether a young population structure leads to economic growth versus increased instability.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0568.zh: 分析拥有最年轻人口结构的国家与其经济发展轨迹之间的关系，然后通过研究青年人口最集中的地区的具体案例，调查现有研究是否支持或反驳“人口红利”理论。根据你的研究结果，确定哪些因素最能预测年轻人口结构是导致经济增长还是增加不稳定性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0570.source: Identify the specific date in March or April 2020 that represented the inflection point in US COVID-19 case growth rates, then analyze whether this timing preceded or followed the majority of state-level stay-at-home orders and what epidemiological research suggests about the lag time between policy implementation and observable case trajectory changes. Based on your findings, evaluate whether the peak growth rate timing supports or contradicts the hypothesis that early intervention significantly altered pandemic outcomes in the US compared to countries with different response timelines.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0570.zh: 确定2020年3月或4月美国COVID-19病例增长率的拐点具体日期，然后分析这一时间是否早于或晚于大多数州级居家令的实施，以及流行病学研究对政策实施与可观测病例轨迹变化之间滞后时间的建议。根据您的研究结果，评估增长率峰值的时间是否支持或反驳早期干预显著改变美国疫情结果的假设，相比之下，与不同应对时间表的国家进行比较。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0571.source: Analyze the relationship between national healthcare infrastructure indicators and COVID-19 infection rates during the first wave of the pandemic, identifying which countries showed statistically significant deviations from expected outcomes based on their development status. Determine whether population density, GDP per capita, or healthcare spending better predicted early pandemic spread patterns, and explain the methodological challenges in making these cross-country comparisons using available data sources from that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0571.zh: 分析第一波疫情期间，国家医疗基础设施指标与 COVID-19 感染率之间的关系，识别哪些国家的结果与其发展水平预期相比呈现统计学上显著的偏差。确定人口密度、人均国内生产总值或医疗支出哪一项能够更好地预测疫情早期的传播模式，并解释在使用该时期的可用数据源进行跨国比较时的方法学挑战。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0572.source: Analyze which of the seven countries with the highest COVID-19 case counts in the Western world and Middle East as of late April 2020 showed infection rates disproportionate to their population density and healthcare infrastructure rankings, then determine whether countries with universal healthcare systems demonstrated statistically different per-capita infection patterns compared to those without, accounting for testing rate variations documented in contemporary epidemiological reports.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0572.zh: 分析截至2020年4月底，西方世界和中东七个COVID-19病例最多的国家中，哪些国家的感染率与其人口密度和医疗基础设施排名不成比例，然后确定拥有全民医疗体系的国家是否在每百万人口感染模式上与没有全民医疗体系的国家表现出统计学上的差异，同时考虑当代流行病学报告中记录的检测率差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0573.source: Analyze the correlation between COVID-19 case acceleration patterns during the initial U.S. outbreak wave and socioeconomic vulnerability indicators, focusing specifically on the fourth-ranked state by frequency of daily top-five appearances, then investigate whether the geographic clustering of high-frequency counties within that state aligns with documented healthcare infrastructure gaps or demographic risk factors reported in contemporary public health assessments. Additionally, determine if the case trajectory in the highest-frequency county within that state preceded or lagged behind state-level policy interventions.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0573.zh: 分析美国初期 COVID-19 爆发浪潮期间病例加速模式与社会经济脆弱性指标之间的相关性，特别关注在每日前五名出现频率中排名第四的州，然后调查该州内高频县的地理聚集是否与当时公共卫生评估中记录的医疗基础设施缺口或人口风险因素一致。此外，确定该州出现频率最高的县的病例发展轨迹是早于还是滞后于州一级政策干预。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0574.source: Analyze how the search frequency patterns for anosmia in New York City's five boroughs during 2020 compared to 2019 correlate with the timeline of key COVID-19 public health events and scientific discoveries about the virus, and determine whether the percentage changes in search behavior preceded or followed official recognition of anosmia as a COVID-19 symptom. Additionally, identify which borough showed the most anomalous search pattern relative to its demographic characteristics and explain potential factors driving this deviation.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0574.zh: 分析2020年纽约市五个行政区对失嗅症的搜索频率模式与2019年的比较，并研究其与关键COVID-19公共卫生事件和病毒科学发现的时间线的相关性，同时确定搜索行为的百分比变化是在官方确认失嗅症为COVID-19症状之前还是之后发生的。此外，识别哪个行政区相对于其人口特征显示出最异常的搜索模式，并解释可能导致这种偏差的因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0575.source: Analyze how the COVID-19 pandemic affected mental health in the United States by comparing anxiety and depression symptom levels between the year before the pandemic declaration and the first year after, then identify which specific pandemic-related policies or events most strongly correlated with the largest weekly spikes in these symptoms and explain the psychological mechanisms that research suggests drove these increases.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0575.zh: 通过比较疫情宣布前一年和疫情后的第一年美国的焦虑和抑郁症状水平，分析 COVID-19 大流行如何影响心理健康，然后确定哪些特定的与大流行相关的政策或事件与这些症状每周最大激增最强相关，并解释研究表明促使这些增加的心理机制。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0576.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 vaccine site accessibility and health equity across California counties by calculating site density per capita, then investigate whether counties with lower densities correlate with specific demographic factors such as median household income, rural classification, or racial composition. Compare your findings against published research on vaccine distribution equity and identify which California counties may have experienced the most significant access barriers during the initial vaccine rollout.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0576.zh: 通过计算每个加州县的人均疫苗接种点密度，分析 COVID-19 疫苗接种点可及性与健康公平之间的关系，然后调查密度较低的县是否与特定的人口统计因素相关，例如家庭收入中位数、农村分类或种族构成。将你的发现与已发表的疫苗分发公平性研究进行比较，并确定在初始疫苗接种过程中哪些加州县可能面临最显著的接种障碍。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0577.source: Analyze how the demographic age structure and population density of high-fatality COVID-19 counties during the summer 2020 surge compared to CDC risk factor guidelines and peer-reviewed epidemiological research from that period. Identify which counties with significant populations experienced the worst outcomes, then evaluate whether their demographic profiles aligned with or contradicted the prevailing public health assumptions about vulnerability factors at that time. Discuss any discrepancies between the observed county-level patterns and the contemporary scientific consensus on COVID-19 mortality risk.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0577.zh: 分析2020年夏季COVID-19高死亡率县的人口年龄结构和人口密度，与疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）风险因素指南以及同期的同行评审流行病学研究相比如何。确定哪些具有大量人口的县经历了最严重的结果，然后评估其人口构成是否与当时关于易感因素的公共卫生假设一致或相矛盾。讨论观察到的县一级模式与当时关于COVID-19死亡风险的科学共识之间的任何差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0578.source: Analyze the demographic patterns of zip code areas surrounding the headquarters of the company that launched the first online bookstore in the mid-1990s. For all postal zones within 10 kilometers of this location, calculate population density (people per square kilometer of land area) and compare how these densities relate to the urban development history of this Pacific Northwest metropolitan area, ranking zones by their density relative to the regional average.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0578.zh: 分析围绕1990年代中期推出第一家在线书店的公司总部的邮政编码区域的人口模式。对于该位置10公里范围内的所有邮政区域，计算人口密度（每平方公里土地的居民数），并比较这些密度如何与该太平洋西北大都市区的城市发展历史相关联，按各区域的密度相对于区域平均值进行排名。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0579.source: Analyze how the top migrant-receiving countries in 2017 (among nations exceeding 500 sq km) compare in their economic absorption capacity, and investigate whether their migration rates correlate with GDP growth patterns and labor market policies documented in recent migration research. Based on your findings, identify which combination of geographic, economic, and policy factors best predicts a country's position as a major migration destination.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0579.zh: 分析2017年接收移民最多的国家（在面积超过500平方公里的国家中）在经济吸纳能力方面的比较，并调查这些国家的移民率是否与最近移民研究中记录的GDP增长模式和劳动力市场政策相关。根据你的研究结果，识别出哪种地理、经济和政策因素的组合最能预测一个国家成为主要移民目的地的地位。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0580.source: Identify census tracts in Kings County, New York that experienced simultaneous rapid population growth and significant income gains between 2011 and 2018, then investigate what major urban development initiatives, rezoning decisions, or infrastructure projects during that period may have driven these demographic shifts. For the tracts showing the strongest dual indicators of gentrification, analyze whether the observed patterns align with documented neighborhood transformation trends reported in urban planning literature or local news coverage, and assess how these changes compare to citywide averages.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0580.zh: 确定纽约州国王县在2011年至2018年间经历人口快速增长和显著收入增加的普查区，然后调查该期间可能推动这些人口变化的主要城市开发计划、重新分区决策或基础设施项目。对于显示强烈双重绅士化指标的普查区，分析观察到的模式是否与城市规划文献或当地新闻报道中记录的社区转型趋势一致，并评估这些变化与全市平均水平的比较情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0581.source: Identify the California census tract that experienced the most dramatic median income growth between 2015 and 2018, then investigate whether this tract's transformation aligns with or contradicts the broader patterns of income inequality and regional economic displacement documented in academic research from that period. Based on your findings, assess whether the factors driving income changes in this specific tract represent organic economic growth or gentrification-related demographic shifts.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0581.zh: 确定加利福尼亚州在2015年至2018年间中位收入增长最显著的人口普查区，然后调查该地区的变化是否与该时期学术研究中记录的收入不平等和地区经济迁移的总体模式相符或相悖。根据你的调查结果，评估推动该特定人口普查区收入变化的因素是代表自然经济增长，还是与绅士化相关的人口结构变化。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0582.source: Using publicly available U.S. Census data, identify the demographic and economic characteristics of zip codes within commuting distance of Microsoft's original headquarters, then compare these metrics against the surrounding county averages to determine whether the tech industry's presence correlates with measurable socioeconomic disparities in that specific metropolitan region.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0582.zh: 使用公开的美国人口普查数据，识别微软原总部通勤范围内邮政编码区域的人口和经济特征，然后将这些指标与周边县的平均值进行比较，以确定科技行业的存在是否与该特定都市区可测量的社会经济差异相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0583.source: Analyze the scoring dynamics and momentum shifts in the 2014 home matchup between the Wildcats and Fighting Irish by examining how each team's scoring patterns compared to their overall season performance metrics. Identify which scoring plays represented statistical anomalies relative to each team's typical offensive production that year, and evaluate whether the game outcome aligned with pre-game predictions and historical rivalry trends between these programs.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0583.zh: 通过分析两队得分模式与其整个赛季表现指标的比较，分析2014年主场对阵野猫队和战斗爱尔兰队的比赛中的得分动态和势头变化。识别哪些得分行为相对于每支球队当年典型的进攻产出而言属于统计异常，并评估比赛结果是否与赛前预测及这两支球队之间的历史宿敌趋势一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0584.source: Analyze which universities dominated NCAA basketball during the 20th century by identifying those with the most seasons achieving maximum wins, then investigate whether these programs' historical success correlates with their current national rankings and research how any coaching dynasties or institutional factors documented in sports history sources contributed to their peak-performance patterns. Compare your statistical findings against contemporary expert assessments of college basketball program prestige to determine if early-century dominance has lasting reputational effects.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0584.zh: 分析在20世纪哪些大学在NCAA篮球中占主导地位，通过确定那些赛季赢得最多胜利的学校，然后调查这些项目的历史成功是否与它们当前的全国排名相关，并研究体育历史资料中记录的任何教练家族或制度因素如何促成它们的高峰表现模式。将你的统计发现与当代专家对大学篮球项目声望的评估进行比较，以确定早期的统治地位是否具有持久的声誉影响。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0585.source: Analyze the relationship between venue characteristics and championship game performance by identifying which of the top venues by capacity have hosted National Championship games since 2016, then determine whether games played in larger venues correlate with bigger point margins. Additionally, research the historical significance of the highest-scoring games since 2011 and explain how rule changes or playing styles documented in sports analytics literature may have influenced scoring trends during this period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0585.zh: 分析场馆特征与冠军赛表现之间的关系，方法是识别自2016年以来哪些容量最大的场馆举办过全国冠军赛，然后确定在较大场馆进行的比赛是否与更大的分差相关。此外，研究自2011年以来得分最高比赛的历史意义，并解释体育分析文献中记录的规则变化或比赛风格如何可能影响这一时期的得分趋势。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0586.source: Analyze how shooting accuracy and court positioning patterns vary by shot type for attempts made before the NBA's 2018 All-Star break, and determine whether teams that historically favor certain shot types from specific court regions have shown statistically significant differences in playoff success rates. Cross-reference your findings with expert basketball analytics commentary to identify which shot selection strategies are considered most efficient in modern NBA play.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0586.zh: 分析在NBA 2018年全明星赛之前，不同投篮类型的投篮命中率和场上位置分布模式的变化，并确定历来偏好从特定场上区域进行某些投篮类型的球队在季后赛胜率上是否显示出统计学上显著的差异。将您的发现与篮球专家分析评论进行交叉参考，以确定哪些投篮选择策略在现代NBA比赛中被认为是最有效的。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0587.source: Analyze which major metropolitan areas have historically produced the most clutch second-half performers in March Madness games over the past decade, then investigate whether teams from these markets have demonstrated statistically significant advantages in tournament advancement rates compared to programs from smaller media markets. Cross-reference your findings with recent sports analytics research on the relationship between market size, recruiting success, and postseason performance to explain any patterns you discover.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0587.zh: 分析过去十年来，哪些主要大都市地区在三月疯狂比赛中产生过最多关键下半场表现突出的球员，然后调查这些市场的球队在锦标赛晋级率方面是否相较于小型媒体市场的球队表现出统计上显著的优势。将你的发现与最近关于市场规模、招募成功率和季后赛表现关系的体育分析研究进行交叉参考，以解释你发现的任何模式。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0588.source: Analyze which playing style characteristics have historically given underdog teams (seeded 10 or lower) the greatest upset potential in March Madness, then identify any current tournament teams whose efficiency and pace metrics suggest they could be this year's Cinderella story. Support your findings with historical upset patterns and explain the statistical thresholds that differentiate successful underdogs from those that fail to advance.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0588.zh: 分析在历史上哪些比赛风格特征让劣势球队（排名第10或更低）在三月疯狂中最有可能爆冷，然后确定当前锦标赛中哪些球队的效率和节奏指标表明它们可能成为今年的灰姑娘故事。用历史爆冷模式支持你的发现，并解释区分成功劣势队和未能晋级队伍的统计阈值。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0589.source: Identify which Utah county showed the most dramatic construction sector growth between 2000 and 2018 using quarterly employment snapshots from March, June, September, and December of each year, then analyze whether this growth correlates with any major infrastructure projects, policy changes, or demographic shifts that occurred in that county during this period. Compare this county's construction employment trajectory against overall state trends and determine if the growth pattern suggests sustainable economic development or potential market volatility.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0589.zh: 使用每年3月、6月、9月和12月的季度就业快照，识别2000年至2018年期间犹他州哪个县的建筑行业增长最为显著，然后分析这一增长是否与该县在此期间发生的重大基础设施项目、政策变化或人口结构变化有关。将该县的建筑就业轨迹与全州总体趋势进行比较，并判断该增长模式是否表明可持续的经济发展或潜在的市场波动性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0590.source: Analyze how ride-sharing adoption patterns across different geographic regions correlate with local economic indicators and transportation infrastructure investments during the mid-2010s period. Identify which demographic segments showed the highest growth rates in each region, then investigate what external factors (such as regulatory changes, competing services, or urban development initiatives) might explain the regional variations in adoption timing and rider behavior.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0590.zh: 分析2010年代中期，不同地理区域的拼车采用模式如何与当地经济指标和交通基础设施投资相关联。识别每个区域中显示最高增长率的人口群体，然后调查哪些外部因素（例如监管变化、竞争服务或城市发展计划）可能解释地区间采用时间和乘客行为的差异。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0591.source: Analyze the longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017 and investigate whether the most popular routes among these extended journeys correspond to areas that experienced significant urban development or infrastructure changes during that period. For each unique route identified, determine if the rider demographics (based on age groups and subscriber patterns) align with research findings about cycling adoption rates across different generations, and explain any correlations or anomalies you discover.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0591.zh: 分析2017年下半年最长的共享单车行程，并调查这些长途行程中最受欢迎的路线是否对应于该期间经历了重大城市发展或基础设施变化的地区。对于每条识别出的独特路线，确定骑行者的人口统计特征（基于年龄组和订阅模式）是否与不同世代的自行车使用率研究结果一致，并解释你发现的任何相关性或异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0592.source: Analyze how the maximum sustained cycling velocity observed in Berkeley's bike-share system compares to both the city's posted speed limits for bicycles in different zone types and the physiological thresholds documented in sports science research for average recreational cyclists. For qualifying trips exceeding 1km, determine whether these peak performers are operating within legal and typical human performance boundaries, and investigate what infrastructure or demographic factors in Berkeley's specific neighborhoods might explain any anomalies you discover.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0592.zh: 分析在伯克利的共享单车系统中观察到的最大持续骑行速度与该市在不同区域类型中发布的自行车限速以及运动科学研究中记录的普通休闲骑行者生理阈值的比较情况。对于超过1公里的合格行程，确定这些高峰表现者是否在法律和典型人体性能范围内运作，并调查伯克利特定社区中的哪些基础设施或人口因素可能解释您发现的任何异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0593.source: Analyze the purchasing behavior of first-time buyers by identifying which product category captures the most customers in their initial successful transactions, then investigate how current market trends and competitor pricing strategies for that category (found through external research) might explain its popularity. Cross-reference your findings with our internal product documentation to determine if our category descriptions and marketing positioning align with industry best practices, and calculate the total revenue impact while recommending whether we should increase inventory investment in this category based on your comprehensive analysis.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0593.zh: 分析首次购买者的购买行为，通过识别哪些产品类别在他们的首次成功交易中吸引了最多客户，然后调查当前市场趋势和该类别竞争对手的定价策略（通过外部研究获取）可能如何解释其受欢迎程度。将您的发现与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉参考，以确定我们的类别描述和市场定位是否符合行业最佳实践，并计算总收入影响，同时根据您的综合分析建议是否应增加该类别的库存投资。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0594.source: Identify which product category generates the highest total purchase volume, then investigate how that category's average page view duration compares to industry benchmarks for e-commerce engagement metrics in that specific product vertical. Based on your findings, explain whether the observed user engagement time suggests potential optimization opportunities according to current UX research and best practices.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0594.zh: 识别出哪个产品类别产生的总购买量最高，然后调查该类别的平均页面浏览时长与该特定产品垂直领域的电子商务参与度指标行业基准相比如何。根据您的发现，解释所观察到的用户参与时间是否根据当前的用户体验研究和最佳实践显示潜在的优化机会。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0595.source: Analyze the performance trends of our product categories by examining completed orders delivered before the major global supply chain disruptions began, calculating both revenue and order volumes on a monthly basis. Identify which categories showed the strongest month-over-month growth momentum, and cross-reference these findings with industry reports to explain whether our top-performing categories aligned with broader e-commerce market trends during that period. Additionally, search our internal documentation to determine if any promotional campaigns or strategic initiatives correlate with significant growth spikes in specific months.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0595.zh: 通过分析在重大全球供应链中断之前交付的已完成订单，按月计算收入和订单量，分析我们产品类别的绩效趋势。识别哪些类别显示出最强的环比增长势头，并将这些发现与行业报告交叉参考，以说明我们表现最好的类别是否与该期间更广泛的电子商务市场趋势一致。此外，查找我们的内部文档，以确定是否有任何促销活动或战略举措与特定月份的显著增长峰值相关联。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0596.source: Analyze customer retention patterns by cohort and determine how our monthly repurchase rates compare to industry benchmarks for e-commerce businesses of similar scale, then identify which product categories show the strongest correlation with higher retention in months 2-4 and recommend specific strategies that have proven effective for improving early-stage customer loyalty based on current best practices.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0596.zh: 通过分组分析客户留存模式，并确定我们的月度复购率与同类规模电子商务企业的行业基准相比情况，然后识别哪些产品类别在第2-4个月与较高留存率呈现最强相关性，并根据当前最佳实践推荐已被证明可有效提升早期客户忠诚度的具体策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0597.source: Analyze the demographic distribution patterns of users at age extremes across genders on our e-commerce platform during the pre-pandemic through early recovery period, and compare these findings against industry benchmarks for e-commerce user age demographics. Investigate whether our platform's age-gender distribution aligns with reported trends in online shopping adoption, and identify any statistically significant gaps that might indicate untapped market segments or potential user acquisition opportunities.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0597.zh: 分析在疫情前至早期恢复期间，我们电商平台上各性别极端年龄用户的人口分布模式，并将这些发现与电商用户年龄人口统计的行业基准进行比较。调查我们平台的年龄-性别分布是否与在线购物采用的已报告趋势一致，并识别任何可能表明未开发市场细分或潜在用户获取机会的统计显著差距。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0598.source: Analyze the monthly profit leaders before January 2024 by identifying which product achieved the highest total profit each month, then investigate whether any external market events, competitor actions, or seasonal trends documented in industry reports could explain the performance patterns of these top products. Cross-reference your findings with our internal product documentation to determine if any recorded marketing campaigns, pricing strategy changes, or supply chain adjustments correlate with months where profit leadership shifted between product categories, and provide a chronological synthesis of financial performance alongside these contextual factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0598.zh: 在2024年1月之前，分析每月利润领先的产品，确定每个月哪个产品实现了最高的总利润，然后调查行业报告中记录的任何外部市场事件、竞争对手行为或季节性趋势是否可以解释这些顶级产品的表现模式。将您的发现与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉参考，以确定是否有记录的营销活动、定价策略变化或供应链调整与利润领先地位在产品类别之间发生变化的月份相关，并提供一个按时间顺序整理的财务表现与这些背景因素的综合分析。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0599.source: Analyze our e-commerce performance from June through December 2019 by identifying which product categories showed consistent month-over-month growth in both revenue and profit margins, then investigate whether any external market factors or competitor activities during that period could explain the performance patterns of our top and bottom performing categories. Additionally, cross-reference these findings with our internal product documentation to determine if any promotional strategies or inventory decisions we implemented align with the observed sales trends.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0599.zh: 分析我们在2019年6月至12月的电子商务表现，找出哪些产品类别在收入和利润率方面显示出持续的月度增长，然后调查在此期间是否有任何外部市场因素或竞争对手的活动可以解释我们表现最好的和最差的类别的表现模式。此外，将这些发现与我们的内部产品文档进行交叉参考，以确定我们实施的任何促销策略或库存决策是否与观察到的销售趋势一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0600.source: Analyze the demographic patterns of users who signed up during the period spanning from a major global health crisis onset to the first quarter after widespread vaccine availability, comparing age extremes across genders. Investigate whether the youngest and oldest user distributions for each gender correlate with documented generational technology adoption trends, and determine if any signup volume anomalies align with significant platform policy changes or competitor events during that timeframe.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0600.zh: 分析在从重大全球健康危机开始到疫苗广泛可用后的第一个季度期间注册的用户的人口统计模式，比较各性别的年龄极端情况。调查每个性别的最年轻和最年长用户分布是否与已记录的世代技术采用趋势相关，并确定在此期间是否有任何注册量异常与重要的平台政策变更或竞争对手事件相符。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0601.source: Analyze the performance of sleepwear and loungewear products throughout 2023, comparing monthly profit-to-cost ratios against industry benchmarks for this retail segment, and identify which months significantly underperformed or overperformed relative to seasonal expectations. Additionally, cross-reference any anomalous months with major market events or competitor activities that may have influenced consumer purchasing behavior in this category.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0601.zh: 分析2023年全年睡衣和居家服产品的表现，比对各月的利润成本比与该零售细分市场的行业基准，并确定哪些月份的表现显著低于或高于季节性预期。此外，将任何异常月份与可能影响该类别消费者购买行为的主要市场事件或竞争对手活动进行交叉参考。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0602.source: Analyze the monthly best-selling products (by volume, with revenue as tiebreaker) from completed orders before July 2024, but only include products whose brands are publicly traded companies. For each qualifying month, research the brand's stock performance during that same month and use our internal product documentation to determine if the product was part of any promotional campaign. Provide a comprehensive report showing the month, product details, sales metrics, stock price movement correlation, and whether promotional activities may have influenced the sales performance.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0602.zh: 分析截至2024年7月前已完成订单的月度畅销产品（按销售量排名，如果销量相同则以收入为决胜），但仅包括品牌为上市公司的产品。对于每一个符合条件的月份，研究该品牌在同一月份的股票表现，并使用我们的内部产品文档确定该产品是否参与了任何促销活动。提供一份综合报告，显示月份、产品详情、销售指标、股票价格走势相关性，以及促销活动是否可能影响了销售表现。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0603.source: Identify products that achieved sales across all available months in 2020 while ranking in the bottom 10% for profit margin, then cross-reference these underperformers against current industry benchmarks and competitor pricing strategies to determine whether their low profitability stems from internal cost inefficiencies or external market pressures. For each identified product, provide strategic recommendations based on similar product turnaround case studies and current market trends.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0603.zh: 识别在2020年所有可用月份中都有销售的产品，同时利润率排名在底部10%，然后将这些表现不佳的产品与当前行业基准和竞争对手定价策略进行交叉参考，以确定其低利润是否源于内部成本低效还是外部市场压力。对于每个识别出的产品，根据类似产品的转型案例研究和当前市场趋势提供战略性建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0604.source: Identify the three browsers with the shortest average session durations (calculated as the difference between earliest and latest timestamps per user session) among those with more than 10 total sessions, then research the typical user behavior patterns and market positioning associated with each of these browsers to explain why their sessions might be shorter. Cross-reference your findings with our internal documentation on browser optimization strategies to recommend specific improvements that could increase engagement for users of these underperforming browsers.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0604.zh: 确定在总会话数超过10次的浏览器中，平均会话持续时间最短的三个浏览器（会话持续时间计算为每个用户会话的最早和最晚时间戳的差值），然后研究每个浏览器的典型用户行为模式和市场定位，以解释其会话为何可能较短。将您的研究结果与我们内部的浏览器优化策略文档进行交叉参考，以推荐可以提高这些表现不佳浏览器用户参与度的具体改进措施。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0607.source: Identify the top three most profitable products for each month from January 2019 through August 2022, excluding canceled and returned orders, then analyze how external market events or industry trends during that period may have influenced the profitability patterns of these top performers. For each product identified, cross-reference with available product documentation to determine which product features or attributes most strongly correlate with sustained high profitability across multiple months.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0607.zh: 识别从2019年1月到2022年8月每个月最盈利的前三种产品，排除已取消和已退货的订单，然后分析在此期间外部市场事件或行业趋势如何可能影响这些顶级产品的盈利模式。对于每个识别出的产品，参考可用的产品文档以确定哪些产品特性或属性与多个月持续高盈利最强相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0608.source: Identify which months showed the strongest profit momentum for orders originating from our primary social media advertising platform, then research what major platform algorithm changes or advertising policy updates during those specific months might explain the performance spikes. Cross-reference your findings with our internal marketing strategy documents to determine whether our campaign adjustments aligned with these external factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0608.zh: 确定哪些月份来自我们主要社交媒体广告平台的订单显示出最强的利润动量，然后研究在这些特定月份该平台的主要算法变化或广告政策更新可能解释业绩高峰的原因。将您的发现与我们内部的营销策略文档交叉核对，以确定我们的活动调整是否与这些外部因素一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0609.source: Identify which genomic region in the cannabis dataset shows the most concentrated genetic variation, then investigate whether this pattern correlates with known cannabinoid biosynthesis pathways or breeding selection pressures documented in scientific literature. Based on your findings, assess whether this variation density suggests recent evolutionary adaptation, artificial selection during cultivation, or potential sequencing artifacts, supporting your conclusion with both the quantitative evidence from the data and external research on cannabis genomics.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0609.zh: 确定大麻数据集中哪个基因组区域显示出最集中的遗传变异，然后调查这种模式是否与已知的大麻素生物合成途径或科学文献中记录的育种选择压力相关。根据你的发现，评估这种变异密度是否表明近期的进化适应、栽培过程中的人工选择，或潜在的测序伪影，并使用数据中的数量证据以及外部关于大麻基因组的研究来支持你的结论。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0610.source: Analyze how the variant density of the cannabis reference genome with the longest sequence length compares to published variant densities in other major crop species, and determine whether the observed distribution patterns align with known biological factors affecting mutation rates in plants. Cross-reference your findings with scientific literature on cannabis genomic diversity to assess whether the variant characteristics suggest the reference originated from a wild, landrace, or domesticated cultivar lineage.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0610.zh: 分析具有最长序列长度的大麻参考基因组的变异密度与其他主要作物物种已发表的变异密度相比如何，并确定观察到的分布模式是否与已知影响植物突变率的生物因素一致。将你的发现与关于大麻基因组多样性的科学文献进行交叉参考，以评估这些变异特征是否表明参考基因组来源于野生、地方品种，还是驯化栽培品系。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0611.source: Analyze the relationship between countries with the youngest population demographics in 2020 and their current economic development challenges, then investigate whether international aid organizations have strategic initiatives specifically targeting these nations. Cross-reference your demographic findings with recent policy documents or development reports to assess whether youth-focused infrastructure investments correlate with projected GDP growth through 2030.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0611.zh: 分析2020年人口最年轻的国家与其当前经济发展挑战之间的关系，然后调查国际援助组织是否有专门针对这些国家的战略计划。将你的人口统计发现与最近的政策文件或发展报告进行交叉参考，以评估以青年为重点的基础设施投资是否与预测到2030年的国内生产总值增长相关联。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0612.source: Analyze how the top three countries with the highest COVID-19 recovery rates (among those exceeding 50,000 confirmed cases as of May 10, 2020) achieved their outcomes by investigating the correlation between their recovery rates and their specific healthcare policies, testing strategies, and demographic factors. Compare these findings against WHO guidelines from that period to determine which country's approach most closely aligned with recommended practices, and assess whether their recovery success can be attributed to policy adherence or other contextual factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0612.zh: 分析截至2020年5月10日COVID-19确诊病例超过50,000例的国家中，康复率最高的前三个国家是如何实现其成果的，方法是调查它们的康复率与其具体医疗政策、检测策略和人口因素之间的相关性。将这些发现与当时的世卫组织指南进行比较，以确定哪个国家的方法最符合推荐的做法，并评估其康复成功是否可归因于政策遵循或其他背景因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0613.source: Analyze the relationship between U.S. COVID-19 case growth rate spikes during March-April 2020 and major federal policy announcements or state-level intervention orders, identifying which specific date showed the highest confirmed case growth rate and determining whether this peak occurred before or after the most significant policy response based on epidemiological effectiveness research. Your analysis should explain the typical lag time between policy implementation and observable case trend changes, and assess whether the timing of the peak growth rate aligns with expected patterns from public health studies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0613.zh: 分析美国在2020年3月至4月期间COVID-19病例增长率激增与主要联邦政策公告或州级干预命令之间的关系，确定具体哪一天显示最高确认病例增长率，并判断这一峰值是否发生在基于流行病学有效性研究的最重要政策响应之前或之后。你的分析应解释政策实施与可观察病例趋势变化之间的典型滞后时间，并评估增长率峰值的时间是否符合公共卫生研究预期的模式。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0614.source: Analyze the correlation between COVID-19 case surge patterns during the initial pandemic wave and state-level healthcare infrastructure capacity, focusing on the state that ranked fourth in daily top-five appearances for new cases between March-May 2020. For that state, identify which counties most frequently appeared in daily top-five case counts and investigate whether their surge timing aligned with any documented policy interventions or demographic factors that epidemiological research has linked to transmission rates. Provide a comprehensive assessment of whether healthcare resource availability in those specific counties influenced their case trajectories compared to similarly populated counties nationwide.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0614.zh: 分析在疫情初期时期COVID-19病例激增模式与州级医疗基础设施容量之间的相关性，重点关注在2020年3月至5月每日新增病例前五名中排名第四的州。对于该州，识别哪些县最频繁出现在每日新增病例前五名中，并调查它们的激增时间是否与任何已记录的政策干预或流行病学研究中与传播率相关的人口因素相一致。提供一份全面的评估，分析这些特定县的医疗资源可用性是否影响了其病例走势，与全国人口相似的县比较。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0615.source: Analyze the relationship between major national policy responses to the 2020 health crisis and weekly mental health symptom trends in the United States by comparing pre-crisis baseline periods with crisis periods, identifying which specific intervention types (lockdowns, economic relief measures, or public health mandates) showed the strongest correlation with changes in anxiety and depression indicators. Calculate the percentage changes in symptom levels across these phases and compare the U.S. trajectory against two other countries that employed substantially different policy approaches, then evaluate whether peer-reviewed research supports the causal mechanisms your data analysis suggests.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0615.zh: 分析美国针对2020年健康危机的主要国家政策应对与每周心理健康症状趋势之间的关系，通过比较危机前基线期与危机期间，识别哪种具体干预类型（封锁、经济救助措施或公共卫生命令）与焦虑和抑郁指标的变化相关性最强。计算这些阶段症状水平的百分比变化，并将美国的轨迹与采取显著不同政策方法的另外两个国家进行比较，然后评估同行评审研究是否支持您的数据分析所示的因果机制。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0616.source: Analyze the relationship between COVID-19 vaccine site accessibility and socioeconomic vulnerability across California counties. Determine which counties show the greatest disparity between their CDC Social Vulnerability Index rankings and their per-capita vaccine site availability, then investigate whether state or federal funding initiatives were implemented to address these gaps. Provide recommendations based on successful intervention models from other states facing similar rural-urban healthcare access challenges.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0616.zh: 分析加利福尼亚州各县 COVID-19 疫苗接种点可及性与社会经济脆弱性之间的关系。确定哪些县在其 CDC 社会脆弱性指数排名与人均疫苗接种点可用性之间存在最大差距，然后调查是否实施了州或联邦资金计划以弥补这些差距。根据其他面临类似城乡医疗可及性挑战的州的成功干预模型提供建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0617.source: Analyze the demographic density patterns of postal zones within close proximity to Seattle's iconic downtown landmark, comparing their population distributions against national urban averages. For each qualifying zone, provide complete geographic boundaries, physical area measurements, administrative jurisdiction details, and assess whether the area would be classified as "high density" based on current urban planning standards you'll need to research.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0617.zh: 分析 Seattle（西雅图）标志性市中心地标附近邮政区域的人口密度模式，并将其人口分布与全国城市平均水平进行比较。对于每个符合条件的区域，提供完整的地理边界、实际面积测量值和行政管辖信息，并根据你需要查阅的现行城市规划标准，评估该区域是否会被归类为 "high density"（高密度）。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0618.source: Analyze the relationship between the top 3 net migration destinations in 2017 (among countries exceeding 500 sq km) and their immigration policy frameworks during that period. For each country, determine whether their migration rates correlated with specific policy changes, economic indicators, or regional geopolitical events, and assess how their historical migration patterns over the preceding decade influenced their 2017 position.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0618.zh: 分析2017年净迁移量前三大目的地国家（面积超过500平方公里）与其当时的移民政策框架之间的关系。对于每个国家，确定其迁移率是否与特定政策变化、经济指标或区域地缘政治事件相关，并评估其前十年的历史迁移模式如何影响其在2017年的位置。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0619.source: Identify census tracts in Kings County, New York that experienced simultaneous demographic and economic growth between 2011 and 2018, then investigate what specific urban development initiatives, rezoning policies, or infrastructure investments during that period might explain why these particular neighborhoods transformed while adjacent tracts with similar starting conditions did not. Cross-reference your findings with academic research on gentrification patterns in Brooklyn to assess whether these changes align with documented displacement risk indicators.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0619.zh: 识别纽约州国王县在2011年至2018年期间同时经历人口和经济增长的人口普查区，然后调查在此期间可能解释为什么这些特定社区发生变革的具体城市发展计划、重新分区政策或基础设施投资，而邻近具有相似起点条件的普查区却没有发生类似变化。将你的发现与布鲁克林关于贵族化模式的学术研究进行交叉对照，以评估这些变化是否与已记录的居民搬迁风险指标一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0620.source: Identify the California census tract that experienced the greatest median income growth between 2015 and 2018, then investigate what economic development projects, corporate relocations, or policy changes in that specific geographic area might explain this transformation. Cross-reference your findings with any documented demographic shifts or housing market trends reported for that tract during this period, and assess whether this income growth pattern aligns with broader regional economic indicators or represents an anomaly worth further study.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0620.zh: 确定2015年至2018年期间加利福尼亚州中位收入增长最大的普查区，然后调查该特定地理区域可能解释这一变化的经济发展项目、企业搬迁或政策变化。将你的发现与该普查区在此期间记录的任何人口结构变化或住房市场趋势进行交叉参考，并评估这种收入增长模式是否与更广泛地区的经济指标一致，或是否代表一个值得进一步研究的异常情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0621.source: Using publicly available U.S. Census data, identify the demographic and economic characteristics of zip codes within commuting distance of the headquarters of the company that operates the largest e-commerce fulfillment center in Washington State's King County. Proportionally allocate tract-level population and median household income to zip codes based on geographic boundary overlaps, then analyze how these metrics compare to statewide averages and explain what factors might drive any observed disparities.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0621.zh: 使用公开的美国人口普查数据，识别位于华盛顿州金县（King County）最大电子商务履约中心运营公司总部通勤距离内的邮政编码的人口和经济特征。根据地理边界的重叠情况，将地区级人口和家庭收入中位数按比例分配到邮政编码，然后分析这些指标与全州平均水平的比较情况，并解释可能导致任何观察到差异的因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0622.source: Analyze the strategic momentum shifts in the 2014 matchup between Northwestern and Notre Dame by examining how each scoring play affected the win probability for both teams, then compare this game's scoring patterns to historical rivalry games between these programs to determine whether the outcome was statistically predictable based on pre-game rankings and previous head-to-head results.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0622.zh: 通过分析每次得分对双方获胜概率的影响，分析2014年西北大学与圣母大学比赛中的战略势头变化，然后将这场比赛的得分模式与这两支球队历史上的对抗比赛进行比较，以确定比赛结果是否可以根据赛前排名和以往的交锋结果在统计上预测得出。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0623.source: Analyze the historical dominance patterns in NCAA basketball by identifying which universities most frequently achieved peak win totals in their respective seasons during the 20th century, then research what institutional factors (such as coaching changes, conference affiliations, or recruitment strategies) might explain why these programs consistently outperformed their peers during specific eras. Cross-reference your findings with contemporary sports analytics literature to determine whether the success metrics from this historical period align with modern predictive models for collegiate basketball excellence.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0623.zh: 分析 NCAA 篮球历史上的统治模式，通过识别哪些大学在 20 世纪各自的赛季中最频繁地达到最高胜场数，然后研究哪些制度因素（如教练变动、联盟隶属关系或招募策略）可能解释了这些项目为何在特定时代持续超越同行。将你的发现与当代体育分析文献交叉参照，以确定这一历史时期的成功指标是否与现代大学篮球卓越的预测模型一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0624.source: Analyze the relationship between venue capacity and game outcomes by identifying whether National Championship games played in the five largest venues since 2016 produced point margins that differed significantly from the tournament average, and research what external factors (such as team travel distance or regional fan base proximity) might explain any correlation you find. Additionally, determine if the highest-scoring tournament games in the past decade showed any pattern related to venue size or geographic location, citing relevant sports analytics sources to support your conclusions.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0624.zh: 分析场馆容量与比赛结果之间的关系，通过确定自2016年以来在五个最大场馆进行的全国锦标赛比赛的得分差是否显著不同于锦标赛平均水平，并研究可能解释你发现的任何相关性的外部因素（例如球队旅行距离或区域球迷群体接近度）。此外，确定过去十年得分最高的锦标赛比赛是否显示出与场馆大小或地理位置相关的任何模式，并引用相关体育分析资料来支持你的结论。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0625.source: Analyze the shooting performance patterns across different shot types by calculating positional averages (normalized for court orientation) and success rates, but only include games played before the NBA implemented its controversial rule change in early 2018 that affected how certain fouls were called. Compare these metrics against the historical shooting percentages of Hall of Fame players known for each respective shot type, and identify which current shot types show the most significant deviation from those legendary benchmarks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0625.zh: 通过计算各个投篮类型的定位平均值（已针对球场方向归一化）和命中率，分析投篮表现模式，但仅包含NBA在2018年初实施其有争议规则更改以前的比赛，这项规则更改影响了某些犯规的判罚方式。将这些指标与以各自投篮类型著称的名人堂球员的历史投篮命中率进行比较，并找出当前哪些投篮类型与这些传奇基准值偏差最大。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0626.source: Identify which major metropolitan areas have historically produced the most elite second-half scorers in March Madness games over the past decade, then investigate whether teams from these markets have demonstrated consistent tournament success patterns and how their performance correlates with recruiting rankings and regional basketball culture factors that sports analysts have documented.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0626.zh: 识别过去十年中，在三月疯狂比赛中产生最多精英下半场得分手的主要大都市区，然后调查来自这些市场的球队是否表现出一致的锦标赛成功模式，以及他们的表现如何与招募排名和体育分析师记录的地区篮球文化因素相关联。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0627.source: Analyze which NCAA men's basketball tournament teams since 2014 have most consistently outperformed their regular season efficiency metrics during March Madness, and determine whether the "Cinderella" upset patterns correlate with specific pace differentials identified in sports analytics research. Based on your findings, identify which performance factors from historical tournament data best predict bracket-busting outcomes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0627.zh: 分析自2014年以来，哪些NCAA男子篮球锦标赛球队在三月疯狂期间最经常超越常规赛效率指标，并确定“灰姑娘”爆冷模式是否与体育分析研究中确定的特定节奏差异相关。根据你的发现，识别历史锦标赛数据中哪些表现因素最能预测破坏赛程的结果。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0628.source: Analyze how the Utah county with the highest construction employment growth rate between 2000 and 2018 (using quarterly third-month employment averages) was affected by major regional infrastructure projects during that period, and determine whether its growth pattern correlates with any federal economic development initiatives or natural disaster recovery efforts documented for that region. Compare this county's construction sector resilience during the 2008 financial crisis against the state average, and identify what demographic or geographic factors from census data might explain its exceptional performance.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0628.zh: 分析2000年至2018年期间（使用季度第三个月的就业平均值），犹他州建筑就业增长率最高的县在此期间受到主要区域基础设施项目的影响情况，并确定其增长模式是否与该地区记录的任何联邦经济发展计划或自然灾害恢复工作相关。将该县在2008年金融危机期间建筑行业的韧性与全州平均水平进行比较，并确定人口普查数据中哪些人口或地理因素可能解释其卓越表现。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0629.source: Analyze the relationship between user dormancy patterns and re-engagement likelihood by identifying users who showed engagement in an extended historical window but became inactive in the most recent period before a specific cutoff date. Determine what industry benchmarks exist for acceptable inactive user ratios, cross-reference your findings with documented best practices for win-back campaign timing, and assess whether the observed pattern in our analytics data suggests an emerging churn risk that warrants intervention based on behavioral segmentation principles.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0629.zh: 通过识别那些在较长的历史时间窗口中表现出活跃但在特定截止日期前的最近时期变得不活跃的用户，分析用户休眠模式与重新参与可能性之间的关系。确定行业中对于可接受的不活跃用户比例有哪些基准，将你的发现与已记录的挽回活动最佳实践时间进行交叉参考，并评估我们分析数据中观察到的模式是否表明出现了基于行为细分原则需要干预的潜在流失风险。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0630.source: Analyze traffic source performance for 2017 to identify which source generated the highest total transaction revenue, then calculate the revenue volatility by finding the difference between its peak and lowest performing months (in millions, rounded to two decimal places), identifying those specific months. Cross-reference this volatility pattern against current industry benchmarks for e-commerce traffic source reliability, and using our internal marketing strategy documents, determine whether our channel diversification recommendations from that period aligned with the observed revenue fluctuations.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0630.zh: 分析2017年的流量来源表现，以确定哪一来源产生了最高的总交易收入，然后通过计算其表现最好的月份与最差的月份之间的差额（以百万为单位，四舍五入到小数点后两位）来计算收入波动，并标明具体的月份。将这种波动模式与当前电子商务流量来源可靠性的行业基准进行交叉对比，并使用我们的内部营销策略文档，确定当期的渠道多样化建议是否与观察到的收入波动一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0631.source: Analyze the relationship between visitor conversion latency and device preferences during February 2017, then compare these patterns against industry benchmark data for e-commerce conversion windows. Determine whether the observed median time-to-first-transaction and device distribution align with published retail analytics standards, and identify any statistically significant deviations that might indicate platform-specific user behavior anomalies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0631.zh: 分析 2017 年 2 月期间访问者转换延迟与设备偏好之间的关系，然后将这些模式与电子商务转换窗口的行业基准数据进行比较。确定观察到的首次交易中位时间和设备分布是否符合已发布的零售分析标准，并识别可能表明平台特定用户行为异常的任何统计学显著偏差。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0632.source: Analyze the relationship between traffic source performance and product revenue patterns during the first half of 2017 by identifying which acquisition channel dominated hits-based product revenue, then investigate whether the daily, weekly, and monthly revenue volatility patterns for this top channel align with or contradict current industry research on e-commerce traffic source effectiveness and seasonality trends. Based on your findings, determine if the observed revenue concentration in this channel represents a strategic strength or vulnerability compared to marketplace benchmarks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0632.zh: 分析2017年上半年交通来源表现与产品收入模式之间的关系，通过识别哪个获客渠道主导了基于点击量的产品收入，然后调查该顶级渠道的每日、每周和每月收入波动模式是否与当前关于电子商务交通来源有效性和季节性趋势的行业研究一致或相悖。根据你的发现，判断该渠道观察到的收入集中度相比市场基准是战略优势还是脆弱性。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0633.source: Analyze the behavioral patterns of purchase versus non-purchase sessions from Q2-Q3 2017, calculating key engagement metrics and their statistical variation across months, then determine whether the observed trends indicate statistically significant shifts in visitor behavior. Compare your findings against established e-commerce industry benchmarks from that period to assess whether performance was above or below typical conversion funnel expectations, and identify which specific months showed anomalous patterns that might warrant further investigation into potential external factors or site changes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0633.zh: 分析2017年第二季度至第三季度购买与未购买会话的行为模式，计算关键参与指标及其在各月份的统计变异，然后确定观察到的趋势是否显示出访问者行为的统计显著变化。将你的发现与当时已建立的电子商务行业基准进行比较，以评估性能是否高于或低于典型转换漏斗的预期，并识别哪些特定月份显示出异常模式，这可能需要进一步调查潜在的外部因素或网站变更。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0634.source: Among visitors who purchased YouTube-related merchandise in July 2017, identify the top-selling product whose name doesn't contain 'YouTube' and analyze whether its sales performance correlates with any major platform announcements or creator economy trends during that period. Compare the purchasing behavior patterns of returning versus new visitors for this product, and determine if similar bundling strategies were being employed by competing video platform merchandise stores at the time.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0634.zh: 在2017年7月购买了与YouTube相关商品的访客中，找出名称中不包含“ YouTube”的畅销产品，并分析其销售表现是否与该期间的任何主要平台公告或创作者经济趋势相关。比较该产品中回访访客与新访客的购买行为模式，并确定当时竞争视频平台商品商店是否采用了类似的捆绑策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0635.source: Analyze the behavioral patterns of visitors from data-sharing partnership campaigns in early 2017 who landed on the homepage, determining their primary navigation paths and engagement duration thresholds. Cross-reference these findings with industry benchmarks for data partnership campaign performance during that period, and evaluate whether the observed user journeys align with best practices documented in marketing analytics literature for cooperative data-driven acquisition strategies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0635.zh: 分析2017年初来自数据共享合作活动的访客在首页的行为模式，确定他们的主要导航路径和参与时长阈值。将这些发现与该时期数据合作活动表现的行业基准进行交叉参考，并评估观察到的用户旅程是否与营销分析文献中记录的合作数据驱动获取策略的最佳实践一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0636.source: Analyze how ride-sharing duration patterns evolved across different regions between 2014-2017, examining whether gender-based usage differences correlate with documented urban transportation policy changes during that period. For each region's most recent trip in the dataset, investigate what external factors (infrastructure investments, demographic shifts, or competing transit options) might explain the observed duration variations, and assess whether these patterns align with broader mobility trends reported in transportation research from that era.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0636.zh: 分析2014年至2017年不同地区的共享出行时长模式如何演变，研究基于性别的使用差异是否与该期间已记录的城市交通政策变化相关。对于每个地区数据集中最近的行程，调查哪些外部因素（基础设施投资、人口变化或竞争性交通选项）可能解释观察到的时长差异，并评估这些模式是否与当时交通研究中报告的更广泛的出行趋势一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0637.source: Analyze the longest bike share trips from the second half of 2017 and determine whether the riders' age demographics correlate with research findings on cycling behavior patterns across different generations. For the top trips identified, investigate whether the routes taken align with popular cycling paths or tourist attractions mentioned in urban planning studies for that city, and assess if the subscriber patterns reflect national bike-sharing adoption trends reported during that period.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0637.zh: 分析2017年下半年最长的共享单车行程，并确定骑行者的年龄分布是否与关于不同代际自行车行为模式的研究结果相关。对于识别出的热门行程，调查所选路线是否与该城市城市规划研究中提到的热门自行车路线或旅游景点相符，并评估订阅者模式是否反映出该时期全国共享单车采用趋势的报告情况。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0638.source: Analyze the San Francisco bikeshare trip data to identify which month in 2017 showed the most significant divergence in cumulative usage patterns between casual users and subscribers based on trip end dates, then investigate what specific local events, weather patterns, or transportation policy changes during that period might explain this behavioral gap. Compare your findings against academic research on bikeshare subscription models and urban mobility trends to assess whether San Francisco's pattern aligns with or deviates from other major metropolitan bikeshare systems.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0638.zh: 分析旧金山共享单车出行数据，以确定2017年哪一个月份在累计使用模式上，按行程结束日期区分，休闲用户与订阅用户之间的差异最显著，然后调查该期间可能解释这种行为差距的具体本地事件、天气模式或交通政策变化。将您的发现与关于共享单车订阅模式和城市出行趋势的学术研究进行比较，以评估旧金山的模式是否与其他主要大都市共享单车系统一致或存在偏差。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0639.source: Analyze the temporal patterns between the two stops nearest to the Embarcadero waterfront on routes traveling toward the Financial District, comparing the earliest and latest service times against the neighborhood's typical business hours and peak commute periods. Determine whether the current schedule adequately serves the historical significance and modern commercial activity of this area, and identify any service gaps that might affect accessibility to nearby landmarks.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0639.zh: 分析前往金融区路线中，靠近Embarcadero海滨的两个车站之间的时间模式，将最早和最晚的服务时间与该社区的典型工作时间和高峰通勤时段进行比较。确定当前的时间表是否充分服务于该地区的历史意义和现代商业活动，并识别可能影响附近地标可达性的任何服务空档。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0640.source: Analyze the velocity distribution patterns of high-distance bicycle trips in Berkeley to identify statistical anomalies and performance tiers, then determine whether the observed maximum average speeds align with or deviate from established urban cycling benchmarks documented in transportation research. Investigate what physiological, infrastructural, or environmental factors might explain any significant gaps between local trip data and optimal human-powered velocities in metropolitan contexts, incorporating both empirical measurements from the dataset and peer-reviewed findings on urban mobility performance.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0640.zh: 分析伯克利高距离自行车行程的速度分布模式，以识别统计异常和性能层级，然后确定观察到的最高平均速度是否与交通研究中记录的城市骑行基准一致或偏离。调查哪些生理、基础设施或环境因素可能解释本地行程数据与大都市环境中最佳人力速度之间的显著差距，结合数据集的实测数据和关于城市出行性能的同行评审研究结果。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0641.source: Analyze the relationship between bike-sharing infrastructure and public safety across San Francisco neighborhoods, determining whether areas with higher alternative transportation access correlate with different crime patterns. Identify which specific types of criminal activity are most prevalent near bike stations and research what urban planning strategies other major cities have implemented to address similar transportation-safety intersections. Based on your findings, recommend the top 3 neighborhoods where expanding bike share infrastructure might have the greatest positive community impact.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0641.zh: 分析旧金山各社区间共享单车基础设施与公共安全的关系，确定交通替代方案可达性较高的地区是否与不同的犯罪模式相关。识别在共享单车站附近最普遍的具体犯罪类型，并研究其他主要城市为应对类似交通与安全交叉问题所实施的城市规划策略。根据研究结果，推荐在扩展共享单车基础设施可能对社区产生最大积极影响的前三个社区。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0642.source: For the product category with the highest volume of first valid (non-cancelled, non-returned) customer orders, calculate the total revenue contribution and average order value, then analyze how these metrics compare to current industry benchmarks for that specific category's typical first-purchase performance, and investigate what shifts in digital marketing costs or customer acquisition strategies over the past 12 months might explain the observed first-order patterns in this category.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0642.zh: 对于首批有效（未取消、未退货）客户订单量最高的产品类别，计算总收入贡献和平均订单价值，然后分析这些指标与该特定类别典型首次购买表现的当前行业基准相比如何，并调查过去12个月内数字营销成本或客户获取策略的变化可能如何解释该类别观察到的首单模式。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0643.source: Identify which product category generates the highest total purchase volume, then determine if the average time users spend browsing products in that category correlates with industry benchmark engagement metrics for that type of merchandise. Based on your findings, explain whether user engagement for this top-performing category is above or below typical e-commerce standards and what factors might explain any discrepancy.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0643.zh: 识别哪个产品类别产生的总购买量最高，然后确定用户在该类别中浏览产品的平均时间是否与该类型商品的行业基准参与指标相关。根据您的发现，解释该表现最佳类别的用户参与度是高于还是低于典型的电子商务标准，以及可能解释任何差异的因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0644.source: Analyze our historical order performance to identify which product categories showed the strongest momentum before the market shift in early 2022, calculating monthly trends and year-over-year patterns for completed deliveries. Compare these internal growth trajectories against recent B2C retail industry benchmarks and expert analyses to determine whether our top-performing categories aligned with or diverged from broader market trends. Based on this comparison, identify any categories where our performance signals might have predicted wider industry movements.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0644.zh: 分析我们的历史订单表现，以确定在2022年初市场变化前哪些产品类别显示出最强劲的增长势头，计算已完成交付的月度趋势和同比模式。将这些内部增长轨迹与近期B2C零售行业基准和专家分析进行比较，以确定我们表现最佳的类别是否与更广泛的市场趋势一致或存在差异。基于此比较，识别任何可能表明我们的表现信号先于行业整体动向的类别。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0645.source: Analyze customer retention patterns across our e-commerce platform by calculating cohort-based repeat purchase rates for the first four months following each user's initial transaction, then compare these retention metrics against industry benchmarks for our sector to determine how our performance ranks. Additionally, cross-reference the findings with our internal customer feedback database to identify the primary factors mentioned by customers that correlate with high versus low retention cohorts, and recommend specific interventions based on successful strategies documented in retail literature.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0645.zh: 通过计算每位用户首次交易后的前四个月的基于群组的重复购买率，分析我们电子商务平台上的客户保留模式，然后将这些保留指标与我们行业的基准进行比较，以确定我们的表现排名。此外，将这些发现与我们的内部客户反馈数据库进行交叉参考，识别客户提到的与高保留率和低保留率群体相关的主要因素，并根据零售文献中记录的成功策略推荐具体干预措施。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0646.source: Analyze the seasonal ordering patterns across all product categories to identify which category shows the strongest correlation between its monthly growth trajectory and broader market trends in that industry sector. For the top-performing category by growth volatility, determine whether its revenue patterns align with or deviate from typical consumer behavior benchmarks for similar product types, and explain what external economic or seasonal factors might account for any anomalies in the data.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0646.zh: 分析所有产品类别的季节性订单模式，以确定哪个类别的月度增长轨迹与该行业部门的更广泛市场趋势显示出最强的相关性。对于按增长波动性表现最好的类别，确定其收入模式是否与类似产品类型的典型消费者行为基准一致或偏离，并解释数据中任何异常可能由哪些外部经济或季节性因素导致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0647.source: Analyze the age distribution extremes among users who registered on our e-commerce platform between Q1 2019 and Q1 2022, identifying the youngest and oldest user counts by gender. Then research industry benchmarks for customer lifetime value across these demographic segments and compare our platform's age-gender distribution against typical e-commerce demographic patterns to assess whether our user base composition suggests stronger or weaker long-term revenue potential.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0647.zh: 分析在2019年第一季度至2022年第一季度期间注册我们电商平台的用户的年龄分布极值，确定按性别划分的最年轻和最年长用户数量。然后研究这些人口细分市场的客户生命周期价值行业基准，并将我们平台的年龄-性别分布与典型的电商人口模式进行比较，以评估我们的用户群组成是否表明长期收入潜力更强或更弱。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0648.source: Analyze the monthly profit leaders across our product catalog through the end of 2023, then investigate whether the top-performing products in each quarter align with broader industry trends or seasonal patterns that external market research would predict for those product categories. For any month where our highest-profit item belongs to a category that experienced significant external market disruption (based on your research), explain the anomaly and calculate how that product's profit trajectory deviated from both our historical internal patterns and the industry benchmark performance documented in our knowledge base.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0648.zh: 分析截至2023年底我们产品目录中每月的利润领先产品，然后调查每个季度的表现最佳产品是否与外部市场研究预测的该类产品的更广泛行业趋势或季节性模式一致。对于任何一个月，如果我们利润最高的商品属于经历了显著外部市场干扰的类别（根据你的研究），请解释这一异常情况，并计算该产品的利润轨迹与我们历史内部模式以及知识库中记录的行业基准表现的偏差。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0649.source: Analyze our e-commerce performance from June through December 2019 by identifying which product categories showed anomalous growth patterns compared to typical retail seasonality trends, then cross-reference these findings with any major industry events or competitor actions during that period to explain the deviations, and finally recommend inventory optimization strategies based on similar case studies from comparable retail businesses.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0649.zh: 分析我们从2019年6月至12月的电子商务表现，识别与典型零售季节性趋势相比，哪些产品类别显示出异常增长模式，然后将这些发现与该期间的主要行业事件或竞争对手行动进行交叉参考，以解释偏差，最后根据可比零售企业的类似案例研究推荐库存优化策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0650.source: For users who registered between 2019-01-01 and 2022-04-30, identify the youngest and oldest user within each gender category, then calculate what percentage of total users in that signup period each extreme age group represents. Cross-reference these findings with current demographic research on digital platform adoption patterns to explain whether your observed age-gender distribution aligns with or contradicts established theories about generational technology engagement, and search internal documentation to determine if any marketing campaigns during this period specifically targeted these demographic extremes.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0650.zh: 对于在 2019-01-01 到 2022-04-30 之间注册的用户，识别每个性别类别中最年轻和最年长的用户，然后计算这些极端年龄组占该注册期间总用户的百分比。将这些发现与当前关于数字平台采用模式的人口统计研究进行交叉参考，说明观察到的年龄-性别分布是否符合或与有关代际技术参与的既定理论相矛盾，并查阅内部文档以确定在此期间是否有任何营销活动专门针对这些人口统计极端群体。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0651.source: Analyze how macroeconomic factors and consumer spending trends in the sleepwear and loungewear market during 2023 influenced our Sleep & Lounge category's monthly performance metrics and profitability efficiency, then determine whether the correlation between our completed order volumes and profit margins aligns with industry-wide patterns reported for this product segment, while identifying which months showed the most significant deviation from expected year-over-year growth based on market conditions.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0651.zh: 分析2023年宏观经济因素和睡衣及家居服市场消费者支出趋势如何影响我们睡眠与家居服类别的月度绩效指标和盈利效率，然后确定我们完成订单量与利润率之间的相关性是否与该产品细分市场报告的行业普遍模式一致，同时识别基于市场条件，哪些月份的同比增长偏离预期最为显著。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0652.source: Analyze the age distribution of users registered on our e-commerce platform between January 1, 2019 and April 30, 2022, calculate the numerical difference between the count of users in the oldest versus youngest age brackets, and determine whether this generational gap aligns with or contradicts the cohort retention patterns predicted by BGNBD and Gamma-Gamma models in recent SaaS customer lifetime value research. Based on your findings, assess whether our platform's age-based acquisition strategy should be adjusted according to current industry benchmarks for RFM segmentation effectiveness.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0652.zh: 分析自 2019 年 1 月 1 日至 2022 年 4 月 30 日在我们电商平台注册的用户年龄分布，计算最高年龄组与最低年龄组用户数量的差异，并确定这一代际差距是否与近期 SaaS 客户生命周期价值研究中 BGNBD 和 Gamma-Gamma 模型预测的群体保留模式一致或相悖。根据你的分析结果，评估我们的平台是否应根据当前行业 RFM 分层有效性的基准调整基于年龄的用户获取策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0653.source: Analyze the monthly top-performing products before the major e-commerce platform update in mid-2024, considering only verified completed transactions from established brands. For each month's winner, research whether that brand has faced any recent controversies, recalls, or significant market events that might explain sales patterns, and cross-reference with our internal product documentation to identify which items were part of promotional campaigns. Provide a comprehensive report combining sales metrics with external market context and internal campaign notes to explain the performance trends.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0653.zh: 分析2024年中期主要电商平台更新之前每月表现最好的产品，仅考虑来自知名品牌的已核实完成交易。对于每个月的销售冠军，研究该品牌是否近期发生过任何争议、召回或重大市场事件，这些可能解释销售趋势，并与我们内部产品文档交叉核对，以识别哪些产品参与了促销活动。提供一份综合报告，将销售指标与外部市场背景及内部促销记录相结合，以解释表现趋势。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0655.source: Identify which product categories consistently appeared among the bottom 10% profit margin performers across all quarters of 2020, then analyze whether their poor performance correlates with documented supply chain disruptions or demand shifts during that period. For any recurring low-margin products, determine if similar items in our product database share characteristics that might explain the pattern, and recommend whether these products should be discontinued based on both the financial data and current market trajectory.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0655.zh: 识别在2020年所有季度中，始终出现在利润率最低10%的产品类别，然后分析其表现不佳是否与该期间记录的供应链中断或需求变化相关。对于任何经常出现的低利润产品，确定我们产品数据库中是否存在具有相似特征的类似产品，这些特征可能解释这一模式，并根据财务数据和当前市场趋势，建议是否应停产这些产品。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0656.source: Identify the three browsers with the shortest average session durations (calculated from the time difference between earliest and latest timestamps per user session), but only consider browsers with more than 10 total sessions. For each of these browsers, calculate the standard error of the mean session duration, then research their current global market share trends and any known performance issues that might explain the short session times. Finally, cross-reference your findings with our internal documentation to determine if any of these browsers have known compatibility issues with our platform that could be contributing to user abandonment.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0656.zh: 确定平均会话持续时间最短的三款浏览器（通过每个用户会话的最早和最晚时间戳的时间差计算），但仅考虑总会话数超过10的浏览器。对于这三款浏览器中的每一款，计算平均会话持续时间的标准误差，然后研究它们当前的全球市场份额趋势以及可能解释会话时间较短的任何已知性能问题。最后，将您的发现与我们的内部文档进行交叉参考，以确定这些浏览器中是否存在已知的与我们平台兼容性问题，这可能导致用户流失。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0657.source: For users who made their first purchase in January 2020, analyze how their retention patterns across the remaining months of 2020 compare to industry benchmarks for e-commerce customer loyalty during that period, and determine whether any observed drop-off points correlate with documented market events or competitive dynamics that affected online marketplace user behavior that year.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0657.zh: 对于在2020年1月首次购买的用户，分析他们在2020年剩余月份的留存模式与当时电商客户忠诚度的行业基准相比如何，并确定观察到的任何流失点是否与当年影响在线市场用户行为的已记录市场事件或竞争动态相关。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0658.source: Analyze our 2021 commercial performance by calculating monthly profit margins across all country-department-category combinations, then benchmark these results against published 2021 e-commerce performance metrics from comparable large-scale retailers to identify which specific segments underperformed or outperformed industry standards. For any underperforming segments, investigate market conditions or industry events from that period that might explain the variance and recommend whether our pricing strategy needs adjustment.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0658.zh: 通过计算所有国家-部门-类别组合的月度利润率来分析我们2021年的商业表现，然后将这些结果与可比大型零售商发布的2021年电子商务绩效指标进行基准比较，以确定哪些特定细分市场表现低于或高于行业标准。对于任何表现不佳的细分市场，调查当时可能解释差异的市场状况或行业事件，并建议是否需要调整我们的定价策略。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0659.source: Identify which product categories consistently appeared in the top three most profitable positions each month from 2019 through mid-2022, excluding canceled and returned orders, then research what major global supply chain events during this period may have influenced the profit volatility patterns you observe, and cross-reference internal product documentation to explain any anomalous month-over-month profit swings exceeding 25%.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0659.zh: 确认从2019年到2022年中期，每个月总是出现在最赚钱前三名的产品类别，排除已取消和退货订单，然后研究这一期间可能影响你观察到的利润波动模式的主要全球供应链事件，并交叉参考内部产品文档来解释任何超过25%的月度利润异常波动。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0660.source: Analyze the monthly profit trends from Facebook-sourced completed orders over the past 15-month period and identify which months showed the strongest month-over-month profit growth. For the top 3 months with the largest increases, research what major Facebook advertising algorithm changes or platform updates occurred during those periods that might explain the performance spikes, and cross-reference these findings with our internal marketing campaign documentation to determine if our strategy adjustments aligned with these external factors.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0660.zh: 分析过去 15 个月中来自 Facebook 的完成订单的月度利润趋势，并确定哪些月份显示出最强的环比利润增长。对于增长幅度最大的前三个月，调查在这些期间发生了哪些主要的 Facebook 广告算法更改或平台更新，这些可能解释了业绩的激增，并将这些发现与我们内部的营销活动文档进行交叉核对，以确定我们的策略调整是否与这些外部因素一致。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0661.source: Identify which reference sequence exhibits the highest variant density in the cannabis genome dataset, then compare the top-performing variant calling workflows by calculating their average variant counts per kilobase alongside their F-scores. Using these findings, investigate how major genome assembly transitions (such as GRCh38) have historically affected variant density benchmarks across plant species, and evaluate whether the VarFind pipeline's architectural approach addresses the computational bottlenecks commonly reported in current variant detection literature.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0661.zh: 确定大麻基因组数据集中哪条参考序列表现出最高的变异密度，然后通过计算每千碱基的平均变异数及其 F 分数来比较表现最好的变异检测工作流。利用这些结果，研究主要的基因组组装版本转换（例如 GRCh38）过去如何影响植物物种的变异密度基准，并评估 VarFind 流水线的架构方法是否解决了当前变异检测文献中常报告的计算瓶颈问题。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0662.source: Identify the cannabis genomic reference with the greatest sequence length, then calculate its variant density and compare this metric to variant densities observed in human chromosome 20 from large-scale population genomics projects. Analyze what this comparison reveals about the relative genetic diversity between cannabis cultivars and human populations, citing relevant methodologies from contemporary population-scale studies.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0662.zh: 识别具有最长序列长度的大麻基因组参考序列，然后计算其变异密度，并将该指标与来自大型群体基因组学项目的人类第20号染色体的变异密度进行比较。分析这一比较揭示的大麻品种与人类群体之间相对遗传多样性，并引用当代群体规模研究中的相关方法论。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0663.source: Identify which of the top 10 countries with the highest youth population percentages (under 20) in 2020 are located in Sub-Saharan Africa, then research how their demographic profiles correlate with recent economic growth patterns and educational infrastructure challenges documented in development reports. Based on your findings, determine whether there is evidence that youth-intensive populations in this region are experiencing a "demographic dividend" or a "demographic burden," and explain the key factors that differentiate outcomes between these countries.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0663.zh: 确认2020年青少年人口比例（20岁以下）最高的前10个国家中哪些位于撒哈拉以南非洲，然后研究它们的人口结构与近期经济增长模式以及发展报告中记录的教育基础设施挑战之间的关系。根据你的调研结果，判断该地区青年人口密集是否正在经历“人口红利”还是“人口负担”，并解释导致这些国家结果差异的主要因素。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0664.source: Identify the nation with the most youth-dominated population structure as of 2017, then analyze how its projected demographic shifts through 2030 compare to at least three other countries that had similar age distributions in previous decades. Based on this comparative analysis and academic research on youth bulge management strategies, evaluate which policy interventions in education, employment, and healthcare have proven most effective, and assess whether this country's current policy trajectory aligns with evidence-based best practices.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0664.zh: 确定截至2017年青少年占主导的人口结构最多的国家，然后分析其预计到2030年的人口变化与至少三个在前几十年具有类似年龄分布的其他国家的对比情况。基于这种比较分析以及关于青少年潮管理策略的学术研究，评估在教育、就业和医疗领域哪些政策干预被证明最有效，并评估该国当前的政策轨迹是否符合基于证据的最佳实践。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0666.source: Identify the single date in March-April 2020 when the United States experienced its highest day-over-day COVID-19 confirmed case growth rate, then analyze whether this peak was driven by genuine transmission acceleration or by specific testing policy changes and diagnostic capacity expansions occurring in that timeframe. Cross-reference the 7-day case trajectory surrounding this date with contemporaneous federal and state-level public health announcements to determine the primary factors behind the anomaly.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0666.zh: 确定2020年3月至4月期间美国 COVID-19 确诊病例日增长率最高的单一日期，然后分析这一高峰是由真正的传播加速驱动，还是由该时期发生的特定检测政策变化和诊断能力扩张引起的。将该日期前后7天的病例轨迹与当时的联邦和州级公共卫生公告进行交叉对照，以确定异常的主要原因。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0667.source: Analyze which factors best explain why certain countries had disproportionately high COVID-19 confirmation rates relative to their population by mid-2020, specifically examining whether the pattern among top-ranked nations reflects genuine outbreak severity, superior testing infrastructure, or demographic and economic characteristics that made detection more likely. Determine if small states and wealthy Gulf nations appear overrepresented in the highest per-capita case rankings, and evaluate what peer-reviewed research suggests about interpreting these early pandemic metrics as indicators of actual infection prevalence versus healthcare system capacity.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0667.zh: 分析哪些因素最能解释为什么到2020年中期某些国家的COVID-19确诊率相对于其人口数异常高，特别是检查排名靠前的国家是否反映了真正的疫情严重程度、优越的检测基础设施，还是人口和经济特征让检测更容易。确定小国和富裕的海湾国家是否在最高人均病例排名中显得过度集中，并评估同行评议的研究对将这些早期疫情数据解读为实际感染率指标还是医疗系统能力指标的建议。

7-30/FDABench/FDA0668.source: Analyze which countries among the major early COVID-19 hotspots had infection rates that were statistically anomalous relative to their healthcare infrastructure capacity, and determine whether population density or GDP per capita better predicted per-capita case counts during the first wave peak in spring 2020. Cross-reference your findings with contemporaneous WHO situation reports to identify any reporting methodology differences that might explain outliers in the data.
7-30/FDABench/FDA0668.zh: 分析在主要的早期 COVID-19 热点国家中，哪些国家的感染率相对于其医疗基础设施容量表现出统计异常，并确定在人口密度或人均 GDP 哪一个在 2020 年春季第一波高峰期间更能预测人均病例数。将您的发现与当时的世界卫生组织情况报告进行交叉参考，以识别可能解释数据异常的任何报告方法差异。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-1.source: What is the average Potassium in ppm from the first and last time the study recorded people in the Maltese area? Assume that Potassium is linearly interpolated between samples. Round your answer to 4 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-1.zh: 从研究首次和最后一次记录马耳他地区人群时测得的钾（Potassium）的平均值是多少？假设钾在样本之间是线性插值的。将您的答案四舍五入到小数点后 4 位。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-2.source: Across the years, what was the percent of years the wet-dry index was increasing? Give your answer in percentage, round your answer to 2 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-2.zh: 在这些年中，湿干指数（wet-dry index）上升的年份百分比是多少？以百分比形式给出答案，四舍五入到小数点后 2 位。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-3.source: What is the average rank of cities in Greece? Assume that if there is an 'or', the average of the two numbers. Round your answer to 4 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-3.zh: 希腊城市的平均排名是多少？假设如果存在'or'（或），则取两个数字的平均值。将答案四舍五入到小数点后四位。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-4.source: What is the amount of calcium in ppm when the dust proxy was the smallest, breaking ties by the minimum wet-dry index? Round your answer to 4 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-4.zh: 当粉尘替代指标（dust proxy）最小时，钙的含量是多少 ppm？并列时取湿-干指数（wet-dry index）最小者。答案保留 4 位小数。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-5.source: In the Maltese dataset, find the year of the most northern Neolithic sample, breaking ties by considering the later year. What is the maximum aluminum value recorded in the climate dataset in the closest year to that year? If there are multiple closest years, take the max aluminum value measured across all of them. Round your answer to 4 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-5.zh: 在马耳他数据集中，找出最北的新石器时代样本的年份，如果有并列，取年份较晚的那个。在接近该年份的气候数据集中记录的最大铝值是多少？如果有多个最接近的年份，则取所有这些年份中测得的最大铝值。将答案四舍五入到小数点后四位。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-6.source: What city contained in both the southern and western hemispheres has the highest population?
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-6.zh: 哪个位于南半球和西半球的城市人口最多？

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-7.source: How many modern cities with a population of over 100k are within 0.1 degrees of ancient Roman-era cities?
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-7.zh: 在距古罗马时代城市0.1度范围内，有多少个现代人口超过10万的城市？

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-8.source: How many unique sources were used in the Roman cities dataset?
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-8.zh: 罗马城市数据集中使用了多少个独特的来源？

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-9.source: What is the correlation (to 6 decimal places) between the rank of ancient Roman cities and the population of their corresponding modern cities with a population of over one million? For rank, assume that if there is an 'or', the average of the two numbers. Assume that an ancient city is the same as a current city if the distance between the two is less than 0.1 degrees. If there are multiple ancient cities, take the last sample in the data. Round your answer to 6 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-9.zh: 古罗马城市的排名与其对应的现代城市（人口超过一百万）的居民数量之间的相关性是多少（精确到小数点后6位）？对于排名，如果存在'or'（或），则取两个数字的平均值。假设如果两座城市之间的距离小于0.1度，则古代城市与当前城市相同。如果有多座古代城市，则取数据中的最后一个样本。将答案四舍五入到小数点后6位。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-10.source: Which country has the highest average population in its cities?
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-10.zh: 哪个国家的城市平均人口最多？

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-11.source: What is the average latitude of capital cities? If there're more than one capital in a country, only count the lat of the capital with the largest population. Round your answer to 4 decimal places.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-easy-11.zh: 首都城市的平均纬度是多少？如果一个国家有多个首都，只计算人口最多的首都的纬度。将答案四舍五入到小数点后四位。

7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-12.source: Count the number of human conflicts between 800 and 1400 AD, and attribute them as best you can to modern countries. Define a conflict as between two actors that lasts at least a year.
7-30/KramaBench/archeology-hard-12.zh: 计算公元800年至1400年间的人类冲突次数，并尽可能将其归属到现代国家。将冲突定义为至少持续一年的两个参与者之间的事件。

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-1.source: What is the estimation error, in terms of MAE, of NOAA SWPC's 3-day forecast of AP from March 9, 2025 for the period March 10-12, 2025?
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-1.zh: NOAA SWPC 对2025年3月9日AP的三天预测在2025年3月10日至12日期间的估计误差（以MAE表示）是多少？

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-2.source: Calculate the ratio of peak atmospheric mass density experienced by Swarm A satellite during March 14th-17th 2014 vs July 18th-21st 2018.
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-2.zh: 计算Swarm A卫星在2014年3月14日至17日与2018年7月18日至21日期间经历的峰值大气质量密度的比值。

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-3.source: Using Swarm Alpha satellite data available by the warmup dataset, find the average atmospheric density measured between 450km and 500km altitude during in 2015 for availiable data points at 00:00 of each day in the initial state file. Clean up the density measurement data (n/a values or 9.99E32).
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-3.zh: 使用由预热数据集提供的Swarm Alpha卫星数据，找出2015年在初始状态文件中每天00:00可用数据点的450公里到500公里高度之间测量的平均大气密度。清理密度测量数据（n/a值或9.99E32）。

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-4.source: Determine the approximate period of solar activity cycles and identify the top five years of minimum and maximum activity between 1960 and 2020 using historical yearly mean sunspot numbers. To be considered as a maximum, a peak needs to have a prominence of 20 and distance of 5. Similar rules apply for the minimum.
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-4.zh: 确定太阳活动周期的近似周期，并使用历史年平均太阳黑子数，找出1960年至2020年最低和最高活动的前五个年份。被视为最大值的峰值需要突出度为20且距离为5。类似规则也适用于最小值。

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-5.source: Estimate the total count of satellite major altitude changes (change of altitude > 1000m within 12h) for satellite 48445 during 2024 using TLE history. Use skifield's itrf_xyz to estimate altitude from TLE.
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-5.zh: 使用TLE历史数据，估算卫星48445在2024年的总主要高度变化次数（12小时内高度变化超过1000米）。使用skifield的itrf_xyz根据TLE估算高度。

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-6.source: Using TLE data fetched for Starlink satellites 58214, calculate the average rate of semi-major axis decay (km/day) for the Gannon storm (May 10-13, 2024) and the preceding quiet period (May 1-4, 2024). Use earth's gravitational paremeter mu = 398600.4418 km^3/s^2, earth radius 6371.0 km, and Kepler's law as a rough estimate of the semi-major axis length. Report in a pair of numbers: (average_quiet_rate_km_day, average_storm_rate_km_day). The tle files are located in input/space-track/, with format <NORAD_ID>_storm.csv and <NORAD_ID>_quiet.csv.
7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-easy-6.zh: 使用为 Starlink 卫星 58214 获取的 TLE 数据，计算 Gannon 风暴期间（2024 年 5 月 10-13 日）和之前的平静期（2024 年 5 月 1-4 日）半长轴衰减的平均速率（公里/天）。使用地球的引力参数 mu = 398600.4418 km^3/s^2，地球半径 6371.0 km，以及开普勒定律作为半长轴长度的粗略估算。以一对数字报告结果：(average_quiet_rate_km_day, average_storm_rate_km_day)。TLE 文件位于 input/space-track/，文件格式为 <NORAD_ID>_storm.csv 和 <NORAD_ID>_quiet.csv。

7-30/KramaBench/astronomy-hard-12.source: Estimate the mean geopotential energy per unit mass (in J/kg) experienced by Swarm-A from September 2 to 29, 2019 using precise orbital data.
